But Israel's reluctance to make concessions and ongoing terrorism from different organizations led to disruption of peaceful process and the Palestinian Intifada in 2000-2005.
0x001B9D4C.translated:
|我们的介入与强迫双方谈判，标志着巴勒斯坦—以色列冲突走向“
解决”的开端。北京协议（Beijing Accords）
在巴勒斯坦领土上设立了巴勒斯坦民族行政机构（作为领土自治安排），
并使巴解组织（PLO）停止恐怖袭击。
但以色列不愿作出让步，以及来自不同组织的持续恐怖活动，
导致和平进程遭到破坏，并引发2000—2005年的巴勒斯坦起
义。

0x001BA0AF.text: |Our interference and forcing sides to negotiate marked the beginning of Palestinian-Israeli conflict's settlement. The Beijing Accords created the State of Palestine on some parts of Israel's territory. Transfering control of these areas to palestinian administration was accompanied by many excesses, the status of Eastern Jerusalem, creating a corridor between the Gaza Strip and the West Bank of Jordan river and ongoing terrorist's attacks are still causing trouble. The relations between two states are still strained but there is already a progress in achieving peace.
0x001BA0AF.translated:
|我们的介入与强迫双方谈判，标志着巴勒斯坦—以色列冲突走向“
解决”的开端。北京协议（Beijing Accords）
在以色列领土的部分地区建立了巴勒斯坦国。
将这些地区的控制权移交给巴勒斯坦行政机构的过程中伴随着种种越
界行为；东耶路撒冷的地位、在加沙地带与约旦河西岸之间建立走廊，
以及持续的恐怖袭击至今仍在制造麻烦。
两国关系仍然紧张，但在实现和平方面已经出现了进展。

0x001BA530.text: |Our interference and forcing sides to negotiate marked the beginning of Palestinian-Israeli conflict's settlement. The Beijing Accords created the United State of Palestine and Israel with two state languages and developed local governance. The subjects' borders and status of Eastern Jerusalem became subjects of sharp disputes, some terrorists organizations are also causing trouble. Another problem is USPI's foreign policy, which causes harsh arguments in newly created state agency. The relations between nations in the new state will be strained for long but international control and equality and brotherhood propaganda will eventually end this conflict.
0x001BA530.translated:
|我们的介入与强迫双方谈判，标志着巴勒斯坦—以色列冲突走向“
解决”的开端。北京协议（Beijing Accords）
建立了巴勒斯坦—以色列联合国家（United State o
f Palestine and Israel），
并确定两种国家语言，同时发展地方治理。
有关领土边界以及东耶路撒冷地位的问题，
成为激烈争议的焦点；一些恐怖组织也在继续制造麻烦。
另一个问题是USPI的外交政策，它在新成立的国家机构内部引发
了尖锐争论。新国家内各民族之间的关系将长期紧张，
但在国际控制以及“平等与兄弟情谊”的宣传之下，
这场冲突最终会被终结。

0x001BAA5F.text: |Nothing interesting has happened in the Arab-Israeli conflict.
0x001BAA5F.translated: |阿拉伯—以色列冲突中没有发生什么值得一提的事。

0x001BAADF.text: |The long-awaited unification of main Arab states into the United Arab Republic, based on arabic socialism principles, had finally been done. Uniting states with similar systems into one was not so difficult, and though the struggle between centralization supporters and local elites is weakening the country's stability, the integration in common went fine. By uniting the economy of several countries and creating a united army UAR became the strongest country in the Near East and a powerful member of international community. UAR tries to maintain friendship with socialist countries and it's growing appetites undermine already weak peace in the region. Israel strengthens the borders and some people say about coming UAR's invasion to Saudi Arabia and Sudan.
0x001BAADF.translated:
|以阿拉伯社会主义原则为基础、将主要阿拉伯国家统一到阿拉伯联
合共和国（UAR）这一久盼的目标，终于实现了。
把拥有相似制度的国家合并为一个并不算太难；
尽管中央集权支持者与地方精英之间的斗争正在削弱国家稳定，
但共同整合进展顺利。
通过联合数国经济并组建统一军队，UAR成为近东最强大的国家，
并成为国际社会中的有力成员。
UAR试图同社会主义国家保持友谊，但其日益膨胀的胃口正在侵蚀
本就脆弱的地区和平。
以色列加强了边境防务，有人甚至说UAR即将入侵沙特阿拉伯和苏
丹。

0x001BB0DA.text: |Initial jubilation of creating the united Arab state was changed by comprehension of many problems - not all Arab countries have joined the UAR and the ones who joined began to struggle for power in the new state. The struggle between centralization supporters and local elites led to many laws of authonomies and special statuses what didn't helped the efficiency of governance. The UAR continues to exist but it's members conduct more and more independent policy and the unity is more and more formal.
0x001BB0DA.translated:
|建立统一阿拉伯国家的初期欢呼，很快被对诸多问题的认识所取代
——并非所有阿拉伯国家都加入了UAR；
而加入的国家也开始在新国家内部争夺权力。
中央集权支持者与地方精英之间的斗争，
导致出台了大量自治法令与特殊地位安排，
却并未帮助提升治理效率。
UAR仍在存在，但其成员的独立政策越来越多，
统一也越来越流于形式。

0x001BB4CD.text: |Arabic states continue to remain scattered and plans of unification are forgotten
0x001BB4CD.translated: |阿拉伯国家继续各自分散，统一计划也被遗忘了

0x001BB574.text: |Nothing interesting has happened in the Arab issue.
0x001BB574.translated: |阿拉伯问题中没有发生什么有意思的事。

0x001D0221.text: Your policy has made Chinese people more and more angry. When you tried to calm the growing protests by any means, you failed and began an open uprising, which was quickly supported by army and some party members. Arresting and judging you in court, high party members and generals have declared a temporary goverment. Chinese future is obscure...
0x001D0221.translated:
你的政策使中国人民的愤怒与日俱增。
你试图不择手段地平息不断高涨的抗议，
却失败了，并引发了公开起义；起义很快得到军队和部分党内成员的
支持。高层党政人士与将军们将你逮捕并在法庭上审判，
宣布成立临时政府。中国的未来一片昏暗……

0x001D04F0.text: Your actions has made the Party more and more angry. Getting tired of you, high party members had organised the meeting where you were criticized and the party voted for your resignation. Now you are a pensioner, nobody wants, and your former spot is occupied by a compromise candidate, trying to manoeuvre between rival fractions.
0x001D04F0.translated:
你的所作所为使党越来越愤怒。
高层党内人士对你忍无可忍，组织了批判你的会议，
党内表决通过了你的辞职。
如今你成了领退休金的人——无人问津；
而你原来的位置被一名折中候选人占据，
试图在各派对立之间周旋。

0x001D07A1.text: You have made your way to the precious red button and launched the missiles. Your strike has destroyed the weak balance between USA and USSR and after you they have also swapped nuclear strikes. Most cities have been destroyed, the planet is polluted and most of the survivors have gone down to the bunkers and shelters.
0x001D07A1.translated:
你走到了那枚珍贵的红色按钮前，按下并发射了导弹。
你的打击摧毁了美苏之间那脆弱的平衡；
在你之后，他们也互相进行了核打击。
大多数城市已被毁灭，地球遭到污染；幸存者中的大多数都躲进了掩
体与防空洞。

0x001D0A36.text: During your leadership China's population - once the largest in the world - decreased dramatically. This cannot remain unnoticed, you were more and more often accused  in genocide and eventually when the Party got tired of it you were arrested and sent to court.
0x001D0A36.translated:
在你的领导时期，中国的人口——曾是世界上最多的——急剧下降。
这件事不可能被忽视：你越来越频繁地被指控犯下种族灭绝罪；
最终，当党也厌倦了这一切，你被逮捕并送上法庭。

0x001D0C45.text: Behind every machine is a man

0x001D0C81.text: decided to avoid possible bloodshed and voluntarily resigned for health reasons. The old leaders were replaced by new, but much less proactive.  Censorship has been tightened in domestic politics, and any deviations from the general line are totally suppressed. IECS was limited to automation of production and the armed forces, and now there is a person behind each machine, so the state apparatus even had to be significantly increased. Even despite this, the economy of the PRC is developing, but every year the growth rate is falling and falling, and someday all the problems of the Chinese economy will surface. China's future is foggy.
0x001D0C81.translated:
决定避免可能的流血冲突，并以健康原因主动辞职。
旧领导人被新的取代，但新者却远不如前者积极。
国内政治中的审查进一步收紧，任何偏离总路线的行为都被彻底压制。
IECS被限制在对生产与武装力量的自动化上；
而如今每一台机器后面都有一个人，因此国家机器甚至不得不大幅扩
充。即便如此，中华人民共和国的经济仍在发展，
但每年的增长率却一年比一年下滑；总有一天，
中国经济的所有问题都会暴露出来。
中国的未来一片迷雾。

0x001D119C.text: The elections in the NPC did not bring success to the CPC, and radical Communists from the MCPC get the victory on the wave of populism, gaining a relative majority of votes. The MCPC candidate also won the presidential election. Taking advantage of the position of President, as well as the relative majority in Parliament, the MCPC formed a quasi-coalition government in which representatives of other parties received only 3 minor posts. The new government declared its goal to return to Maoism, building socialism and communism in China and around the world, entering into a decisive confrontation with the Soviet revisionists and American imperialists. As part of the policy of returning to socialism, first of all, it was decided to return to the one-party system, destroying the bourgeois Republic and launching a new Cultural revolution against the revisionists and capitalists. The list of revisionists and capitalists included all parties, except for the MCPC. Other parties tried to organize public actions against the Maoists and their policies, calling in support of the United States and the USSR, but this initiative was suppressed by the police with the support of the army and armed youth from the military organization of the MCPC. In response, the Maoists organized far more rallies in support of the Maoist cause throughout the country, where they forcibly rounded up all those who came to hand in support of Chairman Mao's cause. The people, led by the state and the party, defeated the headquarters of the opposition parties, and their leaders and activists were killed part, part - sent to the village. The leaders of the CCP also failed to avoid a fair popular anger: the leaders were subjected to the 'corridor of shame', after which they publicly confessed to revisionism, which they immediately repented of, and then were exiled to the people's communes. The United States and the USSR condemned such actions, the Chinese government apologized, shifting the responsibility to the radicals, saying that “could not contain the people's rage, and did not seek to prevent the people in the fight against his enemies, fearing to expose honest people in danger”. However, when the opposition was destroyed, the Armed Forces entered Beijing and other major cities and dispersed with battle not wishing to give power in the hands of the state combat organizations of the MCPC, which officially voluntarily dissolved. A new era in China's history is beginning, in which economic reforms will be combined with an extreme increase in the power of the state over society and the party over the state in the struggle for Chinese socialist culture and the construction of socialism and communism through dictatorship, total control and the new culture of selfless devotion to Mao, ideology and party, eradicating conservative traditionalism and liberal pluralism.
0x001D119C.translated:
在全国人大（NPC）的选举中，中共（CPC）
未能取得成功；来自MCPC的激进共产党人乘着民粹浪潮获胜，
赢得相对多数票。MCPC候选人也赢得总统选举。
凭借总统职位以及议会中的相对多数，MCPC组建了一个准联合政
府：其他党派的代表只获得3个小职位。
新政府宣布其目标是回归毛主义——在中国及全世界建设社会主义与
共产主义，并与苏联修正主义者和美国帝国主义者展开决定性的对抗。
作为回归社会主义政策的一部分，首先决定恢复一党制：
摧毁资产阶级共和国，并对修正主义者与资本家发动新的文化大革命。
被列为修正主义者与资本家的名单包括除MCPC以外的所有党派。
其他党派试图组织针对毛主义者及其政策的公开行动，
呼吁美国与苏联予以支持，但这一倡议在军队支持下、
并由MCPC军事组织中的武装青年配合下，
被警方压制。作为回应，毛主义者在全国范围内组织了更多支持毛主
义事业的集会，在那里他们强行围捕所有前来声援毛主席事业的人。
由国家与党领导的人民击败了反对党总部：
他们的部分领导人和积极分子被杀，部分则被送往农村。
中共领导层同样未能躲过“公正的民愤”：
领导人遭到“羞辱走廊”的审判，随后公开忏悔修正主义——并立刻
为此悔悟——之后被流放到人民公社。
美国与苏联谴责这类行动；中国政府道歉，
把责任推给激进派，称“无法遏制人民的愤怒，
也并不寻求阻止人民与其敌人作战，担心让诚实的人陷入危险”。
然而，当反对力量被摧毁后，武装力量进入北京及其他主要城市，
战斗中四散开来——不愿把权力交到MCPC的国家战斗组织手中；
该组织也正式自愿解散。
中国历史将迎来一个新的时代：经济改革将与国家对社会的极端强化、
党对国家的极端强化相结合；在争夺中国社会主义文化、
以及通过专政、全面控制与对毛、意识形态和党的无私奉献的新文化
来建设社会主义与共产主义的斗争中，清除保守传统主义与自由多元
主义。

0x001D3E38.text: The new liberal democratic government of China has declared the victory over the old order and the liberalization of the regime as its primary and most important goal. The government carried out economic reforms in the direction of the free market, which dealt a serious blow to the economy, causing disorganization through the collapse of old ties, but the fight against corruption and fraud on the part of the young civil society in conjunction with loans and huge investments from the United States and the West allowed to gradually cope with the situation, entering into a state of a certain growth, which somewhat compensates for the former decline and even allows us to talk about some successes in economic growth and increasing social wealth, however, a huge share of income is concentrated in the hands of a narrow group of people - the nascent oligarchy, while millions of people leave China, hoping to find a better life abroad. The DPC is eliminating state control in all areas of public life, including political life, where there is an opportunity for the functioning of a minor opposition. In the Democratic Republic of China, as the country is now called, a regime of liberal democracy is being formed. Relations with the United States become friendly, and with the USSR deteriorate. The US is becoming the main economic partner of China, the main creditor and investor of a young participant in the world market, whose dependence on developed countries is increasing. The USSR gradually breaks off trade relations with China and increases its military presence on the Soviet-Chinese border.
0x001D3E38.translated:
中国新的自由民主政府宣布：战胜旧秩序、
实现政权自由化，是其首要且最重要的目标。
政府推行面向自由市场的经济改革，这对经济造成了严重打击：
旧的联系崩塌，导致体系失序；但年轻的公民社会在反腐败与反欺诈
方面的斗争，叠加来自美国与西方的大额贷款和巨额投资，
使局势得以逐步应对，进入某种增长状态——在一定程度上弥补了此
前的衰退，甚至可以谈到经济增长与社会财富增加的一些“成就”。
然而，收入的巨大份额集中在一小撮人手中——新兴寡头；
与此同时，数以百万计的人离开中国，期望在海外找到更好的生活。
DPC正在取消公共生活各领域的国家控制，
包括政治生活领域——在那里，少数反对力量有机会运作。
如今国家被称为“中华人民共和国民主共和国”，
正在形成自由民主政体。
与美国的关系变得友好，而与苏联的关系则恶化。
美国正成为中国的主要经济伙伴、世界市场中年轻参与者的主要债权
人和投资者，其对发达国家的依赖也在不断加深。
苏联逐步中断与中国的贸易关系，并在苏中边境增加军事存在。

0x001D4AC9.text: The new liberal democratic government of China has declared the strengthening and improvement of democracy to be its first and foremost goal. The government has kept the course for a free inside and open outside market, the economy continues to grow, but with a rather unstable GDP, because the crises strongly shake it from time to time and while most of the population is trying to fit into the market, a narrow group of people becomes only richer, and foreign investors continue to pump out of country resources. The DPC protects freedom in all areas of public life, including political life, creating conditions for the semi-free activity of the opposition, although in times of crisis there is strong administrative pressure on radical organizations. The Democratic Republic of China, as the country is now called, maintains a regime of liberal democracy. Relations with the US remain friendly, and with the USSR - rather hostile. The US remains the main economic partner of the DRC, the main creditor and investor of a young participant in the world market, whose dependence on developed countries is growing. The USSR gradually breaks off trade relations with China and increases its military presence on the Soviet-Chinese border.
0x001D4AC9.translated:
中国新的自由民主政府宣布：加强并完善民主，
是其首要目标。政府坚持“国内自由、对外开放”的市场路线；
经济继续增长，但GDP相当不稳定——因为危机会时不时地强烈冲
击它。与此同时，大多数人口试图适应市场，
而只有一小部分人变得更富；外资则继续抽取本国资源。
DPC在公共生活各领域（包括政治生活）
保障自由，创造条件让反对派得以“半自由”地活动；
尽管在危机时期，政府对激进组织仍施加强有力的行政压力。
如今国家被称为“中华人民共和国民主共和国”，
维持自由民主政体。与美国的关系仍保持友好，
而与苏联——则相当敌对。
美国仍是DRC的主要经济伙伴、世界市场中年轻参与者的主要债权
人和投资者，其对发达国家的依赖正在增长。
苏联逐步中断与中国的贸易关系，并在苏中边境增加军事存在。

0x001D5478.text: The CCP, which lost the election, was able to maintain the support of part of the population, especially the working class, and unity in its ranks, and the party line and a decisive confrontation with the Democrats during the power of the DPC rallied the entire opposition around the CCP. However, CPC's activities were severely limited by a number of court decisions, and several of its leaders were arrested on various (and manifestly false) charges.
0x001D5478.translated:
在选举中失利的中共（CCP）仍能维持部分人口的支持，
尤其是工人阶级，并保持党内队伍的团结；
在DPC掌权期间，党纲路线以及与民主党人的坚决对抗，
促使整个反对派都围绕中共集结。
然而，中共的活动受到多项法院裁决的严厉限制，
其数名领导人也因各种（且显然是捏造的）
指控被逮捕。

0x001D5803.text: Lost the election, the CPC was able to retain the support of the population and the unity in its ranks, and the line of the party and some support the liberal policies of the DPC allowed the CCP to remain in politics as a 'constructive opposition' in a few years United with the DPC and the CZGP in the coalition block.
0x001D5803.translated:
在选举中落败后，中共（CPC）仍能保住民众支持与党内团结；
党内路线以及对DPC部分自由化政策的支持，
使中共得以在几年内以“建设性反对派”的身份继续留在政治舞台上，
并与DPC和CZGP在联合阵营中结成同盟。

0x001D5A84.text: The CCP, which lost the elections, was unable to maintain unity in its ranks, but at the same time lost the support of a large part of the population and suffered a split into three parties. During the period of power of the DPC, one of them supported the Democrats, and two - the opposition. The last few years, they reunited to restore the CCP, but the Chinese Communists are still far from a full revival...
0x001D5A84.translated:
在选举中失利的中共（CCP）未能维持党内团结，
同时也失去了大部分民众的支持，并分裂成三个党派。
在DPC掌权时期，其中一派支持民主党，
另外两派则站在反对方。
近几年，他们重新合拢以恢复中共，但中国共产党人距离全面复兴仍
然很远……

0x001D5DBB.text: The new social-Patriotic government of the PRC declared its primary and most important goal to preserve state unity with multinational population and sustainable growth of social prosperity. The government has also announced economic reforms towards a socially-oriented market economy, which is a serious blow to the economy, causing disorganization through the collapse of old ties, and an attempt to maintain social security leads to a budget deficit and the final collapse of the Chinese economy, fueled by a widespread surge of corruption and fraud, and only loans and investments from the US and the West can finally cope with the situation, entering a state of rapid growth, which partially compensates for the former decline and even allows us to talk about some success in economic growth and increasing social wealth, but a huge share of income leaves China in favor of its economic partners. Given the need to preserve state unity, the CZGP is going to federalize and further democratic reforms, introducing more freedom in all areas while maintaining state regulation. In China, a regime of socialism with Chinese specifics is being formed. Relations with the US warm, and with the USSR cold. The US is becoming the main economic partner of China, the main creditor and investor of a young participant in the world market, whose dependence on developed countries is increasing, but at the same time, as part of deepening cooperation, negotiations are underway to return Hong Kong and Macau, the status of Taiwan, which seems to end in a compromise in favor of China. The USSR continues negotiations with China on the establishment of full diplomatic relations, but the PRC, urged by the US, requires territorial concessions, and the USSR repeatedly refuses.
0x001D5DBB.translated:
中华人民共和国新成立的社会—爱国政府宣布，
其首要且最重要的目标是：在多民族人口的基础上维护国家统一，
并实现社会繁荣的可持续增长。
政府还宣布朝向社会导向型市场经济的经济改革——这对经济是一次
沉重打击，旧的纽带崩塌导致体系失序；
而维持社会保障的努力又引发预算赤字，
最终在腐败与诈骗的普遍爆发中导致中国经济崩溃。
只有来自美国和西方的贷款与投资才能最终应对局势，
使经济进入快速增长状态；这在一定程度上弥补了此前的衰退，
甚至让我们能够谈论经济增长与社会财富增加的某些“成就”。
但巨额收入却流向中国的经济伙伴。
鉴于需要维护国家统一，CZGP将实行联邦化并推进进一步的民主
改革：在保持国家监管的同时，在各领域引入更多自由。
在中国，正在形成具有中国特色的社会主义制度。
对美国关系升温，对苏联关系转冷。
美国正成为中国的主要经济伙伴、世界市场上年轻参与者的主要债权
人和投资者；其对发达国家的依赖不断加深。
但与此同时，随着合作的深化，关于归还香港与澳门、
以及台湾地位的谈判正在进行，似乎将以对中国有利的折中告终。
苏联继续与中国就建立全面外交关系进行谈判，
但在美国的怂恿下，中华人民共和国要求领土让步，
而苏联一再拒绝。

0x001D6B8E.text: The new social-Patriotic government of the PRC declared its primary and most important goal to preserve state unity with multinational population and sustainable growth of social prosperity. The government has also announced economic reforms towards a socially oriented market economy, leading to an increase in the public sector, increased state control and higher taxes for the upper class, striking a blow to economic growth, causing a reduction in domestic and foreign investment and an overall unfavourable market environment for entrepreneurs, but at the same time raising the level of public wealth through increased public investment in social security. In the context of the need to preserve state unity, the CZPG follows the principles of federalism and democracy, while strengthening Patriotic agitation in the state media. In China, a regime of socialism with Chinese specifics is being formed. Relations with the US are getting cold, and with the USSR warm. The US is cutting loans and investments by choosing other countries for this purpose, and negotiations on the return of Hong Kong and Macau, the status of Taiwan, are stalled. The USSR continues negotiations with the PRC on the establishment of full-fledged diplomatic relations and achieves success: the PRC refuses its territorial requirements, and the USSR sends specialists to the PRC, issues a number of large interest-free loans.
0x001D6B8E.translated:
中华人民共和国新成立的社会—爱国政府宣布，
其首要且最重要的目标是：在多民族人口的基础上维护国家统一，
并实现社会繁荣的可持续增长。
政府还宣布朝向社会导向型市场经济的经济改革：
公共部门比重上升、国家控制加强、对上层阶级的税负提高——这对
经济增长造成打击，导致国内外投资减少，
并使企业家的整体市场环境不利；但与此同时，
通过加大对社会保障的公共投资，提升了公众的财富水平。
在需要维护国家统一的背景下，CZPG遵循联邦主义与民主原则，
同时在国家媒体中加强爱国动员。
在中国，正在形成具有中国特色的社会主义制度。
对美国关系降温，对苏联关系升温。
美国通过选择其他国家来达到目的，削减对华贷款与投资；
关于归还香港与澳门、以及台湾地位的谈判陷入停滞。
苏联继续与中华人民共和国就建立全面外交关系进行谈判并取得成功：
中华人民共和国拒绝其领土要求，苏联向中华人民共和国派遣专家，
并发放若干大额无息贷款。

0x001D768D.text: The CCP, which lost the elections, was able to maintain the support of a part of the population and unity in the ranks of its members, and the party's line and resolute resistance to the policy of the CZGP made it the main radical opposition force. The CCP continues its political struggle against the CZGP, remaining a parliamentary party and at the same time resorting to numerous ways of confrontation, not limited to participation in elections and campaigning, often arranging radical opposition public actions.
0x001D768D.translated:
在选举中失利的中共，仍能维持一部分民众的支持，
并保持党内队伍的团结；而党的路线以及对CZGP政策的坚决抵抗，
使其成为主要的激进反对力量。
中共继续同CZGP进行政治斗争：既保持议会党派身份，
又采取多种对抗方式——不仅限于参加选举与竞选活动，
常常组织激进的反对派公开行动。

0x001D7A96.text: The CCP, which lost the elections, was able to maintain the support of a part of the population and unity in the ranks of its members, and the party's line and resolute opposition to the excessively socialist in all senses policy of the CZGP made it the main democratic opposition force. The CCP continues its political struggle against the CZGP, not limited to participation in elections and campaigning, often arranging democratic opposition public actions.
0x001D7A96.translated:
在选举中失利的中共，仍能维持一部分民众的支持，
并保持党内队伍的团结；而党的路线以及对CZGP在各方面都过度
社会主义化的政策的坚决反对，使其成为主要的民主反对力量。
中共继续同CZGP进行政治斗争：不只限于参加选举与竞选活动，
常常组织民主派的公开行动。

0x001D7E2F.text: The CCP, which had lost the elections, had failed to maintain unity among its members, but had lost popular support and had broken up into several independent and opposing parties almost immediately after the defeat. During the power of the CZGP, some of them supported the radicals, some - the CZGP, and some - Democrats. In the end, all the parties became part of other, larger and more cohesive parties or remained small, fragmented groups with no real influence on politics.
0x001D7E2F.translated:
在选举中失利的中共未能维持党内团结，
但同时失去民众支持，几乎在败选后立刻分裂为数个独立且彼此对立
的党派。在CZGP执政期间，其中一些支持激进派，
一些支持CZGP，还有一些支持民主派。
最终，所有党派要么并入其他更大、更紧密的政党，
要么仍作为缺乏真实政治影响力的小型分裂团体存在。

0x001D81EE.text: The new government of the PRC, which came to power through promises of stable prosperity, declared its primary and most important goal to preserve national unity with a more careful consideration of the problems of the national issue and the sustainable growth of social prosperity. The government has also announced economic reforms in the direction of a socially oriented market economy, which strikes a certain blow to the economy, causing disorganization through the collapse of old ties, but much less than expected, which allowed to more or less minimize the consequences (however, it struck a blow to the standard of living of a large part of the population). Given the need to preserve state unity, the CZGP is going to federalize and further democratic reforms, introducing more freedom in all areas while maintaining state regulation. In China, a regime of socialism with Chinese specifics is being formed. Relations with the US warm, and with the USSR cold. The US becomes China's main economic partner, the main creditor and investor of a young participant in the world market, whose dependence on developed countries is increasing, but at the same time, as part of deepening cooperation, negotiations are underway to return Hong Kong and Macau, and the special status of Taiwan, which seems to end in a compromise in favor of China. The USSR continues negotiations with the PRC on the restoration of full diplomatic relations, but the PRC, urged by the US, requires territorial concessions, and the USSR repeatedly refuses.
0x001D81EE.translated:
以承诺“稳定繁荣”而上台的中华人民共和国新政府宣布，
其首要且最重要的目标是：在更审慎地处理民族问题的同时，
维护国家统一，并实现社会繁荣的可持续增长。
政府还宣布朝向社会导向型市场经济的经济改革——对经济造成一定
打击，旧的纽带崩塌导致失序，但远低于预期，
因此得以或多或少把后果降到最低（不过，
这确实打击了相当一部分民众的生活水平）。
鉴于需要维护国家统一，CZGP将实行联邦化并推进进一步的民
主改革：在保持国家监管的同时，在各领域引入更多自由。
在中国，正在形成具有中国特色的社会主义制度。
对美国关系升温，对苏联关系转冷。
美国成为中国的主要经济伙伴、世界市场上年轻参与者的主要债权人
和投资者；其对发达国家的依赖不断加深。
但与此同时，随着合作深化，关于归还香港与澳门以及台湾的特殊地
位的谈判正在进行，似乎将以对中国有利的折中告终。
苏联继续与中华人民共和国就恢复全面外交关系进行谈判，
但在美国的怂恿下，中华人民共和国要求领土让步，
而苏联一再拒绝。

0x001D8DF1.text: The new social-Patriotic government of the PRC declared its primary and most important goal to preserve state unity with multinational population and sustainable growth of social prosperity. The government has also announced economic reforms towards a socially oriented market economy, leading to an increase in the public sector, increased state control and higher taxes for the upper class, with some impact on economic growth, causing a reduction in domestic and foreign investment and an overall unfavourable market environment for entrepreneurs, but at the same time raising the level of public wealth through increased public investment in social security. In the context of the need to preserve state unity, the CZGP follows the principles of federalism and democracy, while strengthening Patriotic agitation in the state media. In China, a regime of socialism with Chinese specifics is being formed. Relations with the US deteriorated and with the USSR improved. The US is cutting loans and investments by choosing other countries for this purpose, and negotiations on the return of Hong Kong and Macao, the status of Taiwan, come to a standstill on the last point, but with the first two are gradually going to success. The USSR continues negotiations with the PRC on the restoration of full-fledged diplomatic relations and achieves success: the PRC abandons its territorial requirements, and the USSR sends specialists to the PRC, issues a number of large interest-free loans.
0x001D8DF1.translated:
中华人民共和国新成立的社会—爱国政府宣布，
其首要且最重要的目标是：在多民族人口的基础上维护国家统一，
并实现社会繁荣的可持续增长。
政府还宣布朝向社会导向型市场经济的经济改革：
公共部门比重上升、国家控制加强、对上层阶级的税负提高——对经
济增长造成一定影响，导致国内外投资减少，
并使企业家的整体市场环境不利；但与此同时，
通过加大对社会保障的公共投资，提升了公众的财富水平。
在需要维护国家统一的背景下，CZGP遵循联邦主义与民主原则，
同时在国家媒体中加强爱国动员。
在中国，正在形成具有中国特色的社会主义制度。
对美国关系恶化，对苏联关系改善。
美国通过选择其他国家来达到目的，削减对华贷款与投资；
关于归还香港与澳门、以及台湾地位的谈判在最后一点上陷入停滞，
但前两项正在逐步走向成功。
苏联继续与中华人民共和国就恢复全面外交关系进行谈判并取得成功：
中华人民共和国放弃其领土要求，苏联向中华人民共和国派遣专家，
并发放若干大额无息贷款。

0x001D9992.text: The CCP, which lost the elections , was able to maintain the support of a large part of the population, especially the working class, and unity in its ranks, and the party's line and resolute resistance to the CZGP's policy, which was too soft in every sense, made it the main opposition force. The CCP continues its political struggle against the CZGP, remaining a parliamentary party and at the same time resorting to numerous ways of confrontation, not limited to participation in elections and campaigning, often arranging public actions.
0x001D9992.translated:
在选举中失利的中共，能够维持相当大一部分民众的支持，
尤其是工人阶级，并保持党内队伍的团结；
而党的路线以及对CZGP政策的坚决抵抗——后者在各方面都过于
“温和”——使其成为主要反对力量。
中共继续同CZGP进行政治斗争：既保持议会党派身份，
又采取多种对抗方式——不仅限于参加选举与竞选活动，
常常组织公开行动。

0x001D9DD1.text: The CCP, which lost the elections, was able to maintain the support of part of the population and unity in its ranks, and the party's line and resolute opposition to the overly cautious policy of the CZGP made it the main democratic opposition force. The CPC continues its political struggle against the CZGP, not limited to participation in elections and campaigning, often arranging public actions.
0x001D9DD1.translated:
在选举中失利的中共，能够维持一部分民众的支持，
并保持党内队伍的团结；而党的路线以及对CZGP过度谨慎政策的
坚决反对，使其成为主要的民主反对力量。
中共继续同CZGP进行政治斗争：不只限于参加选举与竞选活动，
常常组织公开行动。

0x001DA0F4.text: The CCP, which lost the elections, was unable to maintain unity in its ranks, but at the same time lost the support of the population and split into two parties. During the power of the CZGP, the first entered into a coalition with it, and the second supported the opposition. In the end, both parties reunited after 3 years, restoring a single CCP, but the Chinese Communists will have to restore their influence throughout the vast country for a long time...
0x001DA0F4.translated:
在选举中失利的中共未能维持党内团结，
但与此同时失去民众支持，并分裂为两个党派。
在CZGP执政期间，第一个党派与其结成联合，
第二个党派支持反对派。
最终，两党在3年后重新合并，恢复为单一的中共；
但中国共产党人要在广袤全国范围内重建影响力，
还得很长时间……

0x001DA48F.text: China's new government announced that its primary and most important purpose of preserving the national unity of China, as well as the return of lost territories - Hong Kong, Macau and Taiwan. The government has also announced economic reforms in the direction of expanding private initiative while maintaining state control, as well as allowing limited foreign investment, which gives impetus to economic growth, but at the same time increasing corruption and fraud, and the resulting income is to expand and improve the content of the state apparatus and social security, which in the short term allows to strengthen the state and raise the standard of living of the population, but prevents further growth and slows down the development of the economy. In the context of national fragmentation, it was decided to strengthen the national state, which led to informal repression against opposition Federalists from the CZGP and liberals from the DPC, as well as the establishment of strong state control in the media, acting with aggressive nationalist propaganda, with the same informal ban on any unauthorized public actions. Having met almost no resistance, the regime of the left imitation democracy was formed in China. Relations with the US and the USSR remain tense and unfriendly. Nevertheless, the US has not spared the possibility of profitable investments, pushing its allies to start negotiations on the return of the lost Hong Kong and Macao and the status of Taiwan, which, however, strongly stalled because of the tense relations between the RCCK and, in fact, the Kuomintang. The USSR, in turn, continued negotiations with the PRC on the restoration of full-fledged diplomatic relations, but the PRC requires territorial concessions, to which the USSR does not agree, and the negotiations are also gradually coming to a standstill.
0x001DA48F.translated:
中国新政府宣布，其首要且最重要的目的，
是维护中国的国家统一，并实现失地回归——香港、
澳门和台湾。政府还宣布经济改革：在保持国家控制的同时扩大民间
自主性，并允许有限的外资进入。
此举为经济增长注入动力，但同时也滋生腐败与诈骗；
由此产生的收入将用于扩充并改善国家机构与社会保障。
短期内这有助于强化国家、提高民众生活水平，
但却阻碍进一步增长，并拖慢经济发展。
在国家分裂的背景下，决定加强民族国家，
这导致对来自CZGP的反对联邦派与来自DPC的自由派采取“非
正式”的压制；同时在媒体领域建立强有力的国家控制，
配合激进的民族主义宣传，并对任何未经授权的公开行动同样施加“
非正式”的禁令。几乎没有遭遇抵抗，中国便形成了“左翼仿民主”
的政权。对美国与苏联的关系仍然紧张且不友好。
然而，美国并未放弃通过有利可图的投资来施加影响，
推动其盟友就失去的香港与澳门回归以及台湾地位问题启动谈判；
但由于RCCK与——事实上——国民党之间关系紧张，
这些谈判严重受阻。苏联则继续与中华人民共和国就恢复全面外交关
系进行谈判，但中华人民共和国要求领土让步，
苏联不予同意，谈判也逐步走向停滞。

0x001DB302.text: The new Chinese government has declared its primary and most important goal to preserve the national unity of China, as well as the return of the lost territories - Hong Kong, Macau and Taiwan. The government also announced economic counter-reforms in the direction of reducing private initiative, strengthening state control, as well as limiting foreign investment, which leads to a decrease in economic growth in conjunction with the growth of corruption and fraud, the merger of entrepreneurship and the state apparatus, but gives the state access to large resources, which mainly go to expand and improve the content of the state apparatus and social security, which in the short term allows to strengthen the state and raise the standard of living of the population, however, it hinders further growth and slows down economic development. In the context of national fragmentation, it was decided to strengthen the national state, which led to informal repression against opposition Federalists from the CZGP and liberals from the DPC, as well as the establishment of strong state control in the media, acting with an aggressive nationalist agenda, with the same informal ban on any unauthorized public actions. The opposition was suppressed or bribed, the regime of the left imitation democracy was formed in China. Relations with the US and the USSR deteriorated markedly. The US, in response to counter-reforms, began a gradual withdrawal of investments and pushed its allies to jointly strengthen the Western military presence in Hong Kong, Macau and Taiwan, which China considers its own. The USSR in response to the counter-reforms called China a social fascist state, also increasing its military presence in the disputed territories with China.
0x001DB302.translated:
新中国政府宣布，其首要且最重要的目标是维护中国的国家统一，
并实现失地回归——香港、澳门和台湾。
政府还宣布经济“反改革”：减少民间自主性、
强化国家控制，并限制外资。
这导致经济增长下降，同时腐败与诈骗增长、
创业力量与国家机构合流；但这也使国家能够获得大量资源，
主要用于扩充并改善国家机构与社会保障。
短期内这有助于强化国家、提高民众生活水平，
但却阻碍进一步增长，并拖慢经济发展。
在国家分裂的背景下，决定加强民族国家，
这导致对来自CZGP的反对联邦派与来自DPC的自由派采取“非
正式”的压制；同时在媒体领域建立强有力的国家控制，
配合激进的民族主义议程，并对任何未经授权的公开行动同样施加“
非正式”的禁令。反对派被压制或被收买，
中国形成了“左翼仿民主”的政权。
对美国与苏联的关系明显恶化。
美国作为对反改革的回应，开始逐步撤回投资，
并推动其盟友共同加强在香港、澳门和台湾（中国认为是其领土）
的西方军事存在。苏联则作为对反改革的回应，
称中国为“社会法西斯国家”，并进一步增加其在与中国争议地区的
军事存在。

0x001DC0BD.text: The CCP, which lost the elections, was able to maintain the support of a large part of the population and unity in its ranks, and the party's line and strong support for the RCCK during the period of counter-reforms allowed it to remain in politics, becoming one of the legal opposition parties. The CCP continues its activities, voting in Parliament and through agitation in his favor, and organizing actions, strongly supporting the RCCK and only occasionally speaking with a criticism of some of its representatives.
0x001DC0BD.translated:
在选举中失利的中共，能够维持相当大一部分民众的支持，
并保持党内队伍的团结；而在反改革时期，
党的路线以及对RCCK的强力支持，使其得以继续留在政治舞台上，
成为合法反对党之一。
中共继续开展活动：在议会投票，并通过宣传动员为其造势、
组织行动；它对RCCK给予强力支持，
仅偶尔对其部分代表提出批评。

0x001DC4CE.text: The CCP, which lost the elections, was able to maintain the support of a part of the population and unity in its ranks, and the party's line and a decisive confrontation with the RCCK during the counter-reforms rallied the entire opposition around the CCP. However, in response, CPC's activities were severely limited by a number of court decisions and some of its leaders were arrested on various (and manifestly false) charges.
0x001DC4CE.translated:
在选举中失利的中共，能够维持一部分民众的支持，
并保持党内队伍的团结；而在反改革期间，
党的路线以及与RCCK的果断对抗，促使整个反对派都围绕中共集
结。然而作为回应，中共的活动受到多项法院裁决的严厉限制，
且其部分领导人因各种（且显然是捏造的）
指控被逮捕。

0x001DC82B.text: The CCP, which lost the elections, was unable to maintain unity in its ranks, but at the same time lost the support of the population and broke up into four parties. During the counter-reforms, one of them supported the RCCK and three supported the opposition. The first joined the RCCK a few years later, the second merged with the third, restoring the CCP, and the fourth remained an independent party in opposition to the ruling regime.
0x001DC82B.translated:
在选举中失利的中共未能维持党内团结，
但与此同时失去民众支持，分裂为四个党派。
在反改革期间，其中一个支持RCCK，
三个支持反对派。第一个在几年后加入RCCK；
第二个与第三个合并，恢复中共；第四个则作为反对执政政权的独立
党派继续存在。

0x001DCB9C.text: The new liberal democratic government of China has declared the victory over the old order and the liberalization of the regime as its primary and most important goal. The government carried out economic reforms towards free market, which dealt a serious blow to the economy, causing disruption in the collapse of old ties, however, the fight against corruption and fraud on the part of the young civil society in conjunction with loans and investments from the United States and the West eventually allowed to cope with the situation, went into a state of economic growth, which somewhat offsets its former decline, and even allows us to speak about certain successes in the field of economic growth and increasing social wealth, however, the vast majority of income is concentrated in the hands of a narrow group of individuals - the nascent oligarchy, while hundreds of thousands of people leave China, hoping to find a better life abroad. The DPC liquidates state control in all areas of public life, including political life, where all obstacles to the free activity of the opposition are eliminated. In the Democratic Republic of China, as the country is now called, a regime of liberal democracy is being formed. Relations with the US are becoming friendly, and with the USSR gradually deteriorating. The US is becoming the main economic partner of China, the main creditor and investor of a young participant in the world market, whose dependence on developed countries is increasing. СThe USSR is gradually breaking off trade relations with China and increasing its military presence on the Soviet-Chinese border. The new authorities are already beginning negotiations with Taiwan to restore the unity of the country, since all the contradictions between them have been eliminated.
0x001DCB9C.translated:
中国新成立的自由民主政府宣布：战胜旧秩序、
实现政权自由化，是其首要且最重要的目标。
政府推行面向自由市场的经济改革——这对经济造成严重打击，
旧的纽带崩塌引发阵痛与失序；然而，年轻的民间社会在反腐败与反
诈骗方面的斗争，再加上来自美国和西方的贷款与投资，
最终使局势得以应对，并进入经济增长状态；
这在一定程度上抵消了此前的衰退，甚至让我们能够谈论经济增长与
社会财富增加领域的某些“成功”。
但绝大多数收入集中在一小撮个人手中——新兴寡头；
与此同时，数十万乃至更多的人离开中国，
希望在国外找到更好的生活。
DPC在公共生活的各个领域取消国家控制，
包括政治生活领域——在那里，消除了反对派自由活动的一切障碍。
如今被称为“中华民主共和国”的国家，
正在形成自由民主的政权。
对美国关系日益友好，对苏联关系则逐步恶化。
美国正成为中国的主要经济伙伴、世界市场上年轻参与者的主要债权
人和投资者，其对发达国家的依赖不断加深。
苏联则逐步中断与中国的贸易关系，并增加其在苏中边境的军事存在。
新当局已经开始与台湾谈判，以恢复国家统一，
因为双方之间的所有矛盾都已被消除。

0x001DD99B.text: The new liberal democratic government of China has declared the strengthening and improvement of democracy to be its first and foremost goal. The government has kept the course for a free inside and open outside market, the economy continues to grow, but with a rather unstable GDP, because the crises strongly shake it from time to time and while most of the population is trying to fit into the market, a narrow group of people becomes only richer, and foreign investors continue to pump out of country resources. The DPC protects freedom in all areas of public life, including political life, creating conditions for the semi-free activity of the opposition, although in times of crisis there is strong administrative pressure on radical organizations. The Democratic Republic of China, as the country is now called, maintains a regime of liberal democracy. Relations with the US remain friendly, and with the USSR - rather hostile. The US remains the main economic partner of the democratic Republic of the Congo, the main creditor and investor of a young participant in the world market, whose dependence on developed countries is growing. The USSR gradually breaks off trade relations with China and increases its military presence on the Soviet-Chinese border.
0x001DD99B.translated:
中国新自由民主政府宣布：加强并完善民主，
是其首要目标。政府坚持“国内自由、对外开放”的市场方针；
经济继续增长，但GDP相当不稳定——危机时不时强烈冲击它；
而当大多数民众试图适应市场时，一小撮人却只会变得更富，
外资则继续抽取国内资源。
DPC在公共生活各领域（包括政治生活）
保障自由，为反对派的“半自由”活动创造条件；
尽管在危机时期，仍对激进组织施加强有力的行政压力。
如今被称为“中华民主共和国”的国家，
维持自由民主的政权。
对美国关系保持友好，对苏联则相当敌对。
美国仍是“刚果民主共和国”的主要经济伙伴、
世界市场上年轻参与者的主要债权人和投资者，
其对发达国家的依赖正在增长。
苏联则逐步中断与中国的贸易关系，并增加其在苏中边境的军事存在。

0x001DE384.text: The CCP, which lost the elections, was unable to maintain unity in its ranks, but at the same time lost the support of a large part of the population and suffered a split into three parties. During the period of power of the DPC, one of them supported the Democrats, and two - the opposition. The last few years have reunited, restoring the CCP, but before the full revival of the Chinese Communists is still very far...
0x001DE384.translated:
在选举中失利的中共未能维持党内团结，
但与此同时失去相当大一部分民众的支持，
并分裂为三个党派。在DPC执政时期，
其中一个支持民主派，另外两个支持反对派。
近几年它们重新合拢，恢复了中共；但要实现中国共产党人的全面复
兴，仍然遥遥无期……

0x001EE2AB.text: We won with a devastating result, taking the majority of seats in the NPC and proving to China and the whole world that it is the people who recognize us as their rulers!
0x001EE2AB.translated:
我们以摧枯拉朽的结果获胜，夺得全国人大多数席位，
并向中国和全世界证明：是人民承认我们是他们的统治者！

0x001EE402.text: Our alliance of parties won the elections to the NPC and proved to China and the whole world that it is the people who recognize us as their rulers!
0x001EE402.translated:
我们各党派的联盟赢得了全国人大选举，
并向中国和全世界证明：是人民承认我们是他们的统治者！

0x001EE52D.text: We have lost not only the majority, we no longer even occupy 50% of the seats in the NPC! It's a shame!
0x001EE52D.translated:
我们不但失去了多数席位，甚至连全国人大50%的席位都占不够了！
真是耻辱！

0x001EE642.text: With the promise of bonuses, payouts and threats of layoffs and downgrades, we managed to get the civil servants to come to the polls and vote for our party. But people will long remember such an open scam.
0x001EE642.translated:
凭借奖金、发放与裁员降级的威胁，我们终于让公务员走进投票站，
为我们的党投票。但人们会很久都记得这种赤裸裸的骗局。

0x001EE7FD.text: The special services did a great job getting places for us. Only they are very tired.
0x001EE7FD.translated: 特务机关为我们安排席位干得很出色。只是他们也累坏了。

0x001EE8CE.text: After Mao’s death was announced, his body was placed in the House of People’s Congregations for a week so that everyone could say goodbye to the chairman, mourning was declared throughout the country. Many Chinese people have come to pay their last honors to their great leader and teacher. After the deadline, Mao's body was cremated, according to his wish, and the urn with ashes after three minutes of silence and Hua Guofeng's farewell speech in Tiananmen Square was walled up in a monument specially built on the same square.
0x001EE8CE.translated:
毛主席逝世的消息宣布后，遗体安放在人民大会堂一周，
供大家向主席告别，全国哀悼。
许多中国人前来向这位伟大领袖和老师作最后的告别。
到期后，按毛主席遗愿将遗体火化；三分钟的默哀之后，
在天安门广场由华国锋作告别讲话，骨灰坛被封入一座专门在同一广
场修建的纪念碑中。

0x001EECF5.text: After Mao’s death was announced, his body was placed in the House of People’s Congregations for a week so that everyone could say goodbye to the chairman, mourning was declared throughout the country. Many Chinese people have come to pay their last honors to their great leader and teacher. After the deadline, Mao's body was taken to the hospital and embalmed by a specially developed technique. After three minutes of silence and Hua Guofeng's farewell speech on Tiananmen Square, the chairman rested in a mausoleum built on the same square by a special order of Guofeng.
0x001EECF5.translated:
毛主席逝世的消息宣布后，遗体安放在人民大会堂一周，
供大家向主席告别，全国哀悼。
许多中国人前来向这位伟大领袖和老师作最后的告别。
到期后，毛主席遗体被送往医院，采用专门研制的技术进行防腐处理。
三分钟默哀之后，在天安门广场由华国锋作告别讲话，
主席安息于由华国锋特别下令修建在同一广场的陵墓之中。

0x001EF172.text: Guofeng decided not to participate directly in the organization of the funeral, which did not go unnoticed. After Mao’s death was announced, his body was placed in the House of People’s Congregations for a week so that everyone could say goodbye to the chairman, mourning was declared throughout the country. Many Chinese people have come to pay their last honors to their great leader and teacher. After the deadline, Mao's body was taken to the hospital and embalmed by a specially developed technique. After three minutes of silence and Hua Guofeng's farewell speech on Tiananmen Square, the chairman rested in a mausoleum built on the same square by a special order of the funeral commission.
0x001EF172.translated:
华国锋决定不直接参与丧事的组织，这一点并未被人忽视。
毛主席逝世的消息宣布后，遗体安放在人民大会堂一周，
供大家向主席告别，全国哀悼。
许多中国人前来向这位伟大领袖和老师作最后的告别。
到期后，毛主席遗体被送往医院，采用专门研制的技术进行防腐处理。
三分钟默哀之后，在天安门广场由华国锋作告别讲话，
主席安息于由丧事委员会特别下令修建在同一广场的陵墓之中。

0x001EF6FB.text: Before the conspirators managed to voice their accusations, you attacked them with criticism and counter accusations. Most of those present at the congress supported you and the conspirators had to retreat.
0x001EF6FB.translated:
在阴谋者还没来得及提出指控之前，你就以批判和反指控向他们发起
攻击。大会上大多数人站在你这边，阴谋者只得退却。

0x001EF89A.text: Before the conspirators managed to voice their accusations, you attacked them with criticism and counter accusations. However, you clearly did not have enough credibility, and most of the party members are tired of your rule. The majority of those present at the congress supported the conspirators, and you were removed from post, expelled from the Central Committee and sent to a distant, powerless position.
0x001EF89A.translated:
在阴谋者还没来得及提出指控之前，你就以批判和反指控向他们发起
攻击。然而你显然缺乏足够的威信，而大多数党员早已厌倦了你的统
治。大会上多数人支持阴谋者，你被撤职、
开除出中央委员会，并被打发到遥远而无权的岗位上。

0x001EFBD1.text: Even before the start of the congress, the secret service agents loyal to you, overwhelmed the conspirators who had arrived and sent them to the detention facilities. At the congress, you criticized them in absentia, which was supported by the delegates. But it’s not so easy to get rid of high party members...
0x001EFBD1.translated:
在大会开始之前，你忠诚的秘密情报人员就已压制了赶来的阴谋者，
并把他们送进拘留设施。
大会上，你对他们进行“隔空批判”，得到了与会代表的支持。
但要摆脱高级党内人物，可没那么容易……

0x001EFE42.text: Even before the start of the congress, the officers loyal to you overwhelmed the conspirators who had arrived and, at gunpoint, took them to military jails. At the congress, in the presence of armed soldiers, you criticized them in absentia, which was supported by the delegates. But it’s not so easy to get rid of high party members...
0x001EFE42.translated:
在大会开始之前，你忠诚的军官就已压制了赶来的阴谋者，
并在枪口威逼下把他们押往军中监狱。
大会上，在武装士兵在场的情况下，你对他们进行“隔空批判”，
得到了与会代表的支持。
但要摆脱高级党内人物，可没那么容易……

0x001F00E5.text: Even before the start of the congress, you appealed through the media to the people with a call to support you and protect the conquests of your power. The people loyal to you went to mass demonstrations in your support and began to storm the departments under your opponent's control. Realizing their unpopularity, the conspirators retreated, and the last congress secured your power. But the people are already rather tired of similar Cultural Revolutions.
0x001F00E5.translated:
在大会开始之前，你就通过媒体向人民发出号召，
要求支持你、保卫你权力的“成果”。
你忠诚的群众举行大规模集会声援，并开始冲击对手所控制的部门。
阴谋者意识到自己不得人心，于是退却；
最后一届大会也就稳固了你的权力。
但人民早已对类似的文化大革命感到厌倦。

0x001F04A2.text: You personally spoke to the protesters in Beijing, which was broadcast throughout the country. You promised to make every effort to change the policy and take into account the interests of all citizens, as well as to create mechanisms of real democracy (which, however, you are not in a hurry to implement). It seems that you have succeeded in convincing the people, the protests are slowly falling.
0x001F04A2.translated:
你亲自向北京的抗议者讲话，并通过全国广播。
你承诺将尽一切努力改变政策，兼顾所有公民的利益，
并建立真正民主的机制（不过，你并不急着去落实）。
看来你已经成功说服了人民，抗议活动正在慢慢降温。

0x001F07C3.text: You personally spoke to the protesters in Beijing, which was broadcast throughout the country. You promised to make every effort to change the policy and take into account the interests of all citizens, as well as to create mechanisms of real democracy (which, however, you are not in a hurry to implement). Nevertheless, the people, tired of your promises, took them without enthusiasm and demanded your resignation. Having finally disappointed in you, the party urgently organized your dismissal and arrest and formed a new government that will lead the country until the general election while you are sitting in the detention center.
0x001F07C3.translated:
你亲自向北京的抗议者讲话，并通过全国广播。
你承诺将尽一切努力改变政策，兼顾所有公民的利益，
并建立真正民主的机制（不过，你并不急着去落实）。
然而，人民早已厌倦你的空话，听了也毫无热情，
要求你辞职。党终于对你彻底失望，紧急组织你的撤职与逮捕，
并组建新政府，直到大选前继续领导国家——而你则坐在拘留中心里。

0x001F0CC0.text: The army, having received the order, led the armored vehicles to the streets of the cities and firmly dispersed the protest. There were casualties on both sides. Of course, such actions have already been condemned by almost all countries of the world.
0x001F0CC0.translated:
军队接到命令后，驾驶装甲车开上城市街头，
强行驱散抗议。双方都有伤亡。
当然，这种行动早已遭到世界上几乎所有国家的谴责。

0x001F0EB9.text: Through the media, you appealed to people sympathizing with you to help protect your conquests from traitors funded by the USA and the USSR. They immediately went to mass rallies in your support, which often resulted in clashes with protesters and their arrests. When the dust of street battles subsided and the protesters fled, your supporters marched on Tiananmen.
0x001F0EB9.translated:
你通过媒体向同情你的人发出呼吁，要求他们帮助保卫你“夺取的成
果”，抵御由美国和苏联资助的叛徒。
对方立刻组织大规模集会声援，常常演变为与抗议者的冲突，
并导致后者被捕。街头战斗的尘埃落定、
抗议者四散逃离之后，你的支持者向天安门进发。

0x001F127C.text: You personally spoke to the protesters in Beijing, which was broadcast throughout the country. You promised to make every effort to change the policy and take into account the interests of all citizens, as well as to create mechanisms of real democracy, which are about to begin work. The people are inspired, but at the same time, the stream of criticism also went through the newly acquired freedoms
0x001F127C.translated:
你亲自同北京的抗议者对话，并在全国播出。
你承诺竭尽全力改变政策，兼顾所有公民的利益，
还要建立真正民主的机制——即将开始运转。
人民备受鼓舞，但与此同时，批评的洪流也借着新获得的自由奔涌而
出。

0x001F15A1.text: You personally spoke the protesters in Beijing, with the speech broadcast nationwide. You promised to make every effort to reform policies, consider the interests of all citizens. However, the people, weary of your promises, received them without enthusiasm and demanded your resignation. In response to the growing discontent, you made an unexpected decision: to nominate a leader from the people, as the protesters demanded. You introduced a candidate—a charismatic politician whose career is built on the ability to persuade and win the trust of the masses. Your decision temporarily quelled the protests but caused a split within the party, undermining its unity. Will the new leader be able to hold onto power, or has your decision merely delayed the crisis?
0x001F15A1.translated:
你亲自对北京的抗议者讲话，讲话在全国播出。
你承诺竭尽全力改革政策，考虑所有公民的利益。
然而，人民对你的承诺已感疲惫，既不买账，
也不热情接受，反而要求你辞职。
面对日益增长的不满，你作出一个出人意料的决定：
按抗议者的要求，提名一位“来自人民”的领袖。
你推出了一名候选人——一位魅力型政治家，
其仕途建立在说服民众、赢得群众信任的能力之上。
你的决定暂时平息了抗议，却在党内造成分裂，
动摇了团结。新领袖能否守住权力，还是说你的决定只是把危机延后
了？

0x001F1C9F.text: The MSS was engaged in the usual business - they bribed someone, they eliminated someone, and all sorts of organizations and people who decompose it from the inside in our interests began to actively join in the protest. The opposition fights with itself, the protest turned into a gathering without any strategy and soon dried up.
0x001F1C9F.translated:
国安系统照例忙活——收买一个、清除一个，
各种组织和人物从内部瓦解、为我们利益服务的“力量”也开始积极
加入抗议。反对派自相残杀，抗议变成毫无策略的聚会，
很快就偃旗息鼓了。

0x001F1F66.text: Large funds from the budget were urgently allocated to social programs, housing development and to help the poor. Social problems are gradually beginning to be solved and people are satisfied
0x001F1F66.translated:
财政预算中大笔资金被紧急拨付到社会项目、
住房建设以及救助贫困。
社会问题正逐步开始得到解决，人民也感到满意

0x001F20E7.text: We requested foreign humanitarian assistance, which was provided. Volunteers from different countries and from the UN distribute food, as well as develop housing for people on free terms. However, such actions showed both our people and the world community that we cannot cope with such things on our own, which greatly undermines our prestige.
0x001F20E7.translated:
我们请求外援的人道主义援助，援助已被提供。
来自不同国家以及联合国的志愿者分发食物，
并以无偿方式为民众修建住房。
然而，这样的行动让我们的人民和国际社会都看清：
我们自己无法应对这些事，这极大损害了我们的威信。

0x001F239A.text: Through the development of labor laws, government orders, benefits and banal coercion, we managed to force our businessmen to provide social support to the people, improve working conditions and housing conditions. However, they are not particularly happy to share their wealth with the people and are actively using connections at the highest levels to put pressure on you.
0x001F239A.translated:
通过完善劳动法规、政府命令、福利待遇以及司空见惯的强制手段，
我们终于迫使我们的商人向人民提供社会支持，
改善劳动条件和住房条件。
然而，他们并不太愿意把自己的财富与人民分享，
并正积极动用最高层的关系对你施压。

0x001F2689.text: Speaking at the extraordinary party congress, you explained to the top the brunt of the situation and decided to allocate funds for social needs of the party and voluntarily-forcedly attracted party members and officials to participate in charity events. This, of course, raised the standard of living, but the party was not satisfied.
0x001F2689.translated:
在特别党代会上，你向上层说明了形势的严峻，
并决定拨款满足党内社会需要，同时“自愿—被迫”吸引党员干部参
加慈善活动。当然，这提高了生活水平，
但党内并不满足。

0x001F294E.text: We urgently organized a magnificent meeting of the foreign ministers of China and the USA, and the American delegation was invited to a luxurious tour of China, where various festivals and events are being prepared, showing our peacefulness. The detente succeeded, the tension subsided.
0x001F294E.translated:
我们紧急组织了中美两国外长的盛大会晤，
并邀请美方代表团在中国进行豪华参观——各类节庆和活动正在筹备，
以展示我们的和平姿态。
缓和取得成功，紧张局势随之缓解。

0x001F2B8D.text: We have abandoned some foreign policy claims, reduced the support of loyal opposition in other countries and, in general, reduced the degree of interventionism of Chinese politics. This was positively perceived by the Ministry of Foreign Affairs of the USA, tensions decreased. Like our influence.
0x001F2B8D.translated:
我们放弃了部分外交主张，减少了对其他国家“忠诚反对派”的支持，
总体上也降低了中国政治的干预主义程度。
美国外交部对此作出了积极评估，紧张局势下降。
也就是承认了我们的影响力。

0x001F2E00.text: We urgently organized a magnificent meeting of the foreign ministers of China and the USSR, and the Soviet delegation was invited to a luxurious tour of China, where various festivals and events are being prepared, showing our peacefulness. The detente succeeded, the tension subsided.
0x001F2E00.translated:
我们紧急组织了中苏两国外长的盛大会晤，
并邀请苏方代表团在中国进行豪华参观——各类节庆和活动正在筹备，
以展示我们的和平姿态。
缓和取得成功，紧张局势随之缓解。

0x001F303D.text: We have abandoned some foreign policy claims, reduced the support of loyal opposition in other countries and, in general, reduced the degree of interventionism of Chinese politics. This was positively perceived by the Ministry of Foreign Affairs of the USSR, tensions decreased. Like our influence.
0x001F303D.translated:
我们放弃了部分外交主张，减少了对其他国家“忠诚反对派”的支持，
总体上也降低了中国政治的干预主义程度。
苏联外交部对此作出了积极评估，紧张局势下降。
也就是承认了我们的影响力。

0x001F32BC.text: Tibet Autonomous Region officially declared its independence within the borders of 1950. This will be a big blow for us and a great opportunity for the USSR and the USA.
0x001F32BC.translated:
西藏自治区正式宣布在1950年边界内独立。
这将给我们造成沉重打击，也将为苏联和美国提供绝佳机会。

0x001F3411.text: We have further expanded the powers of local authorities and the rights of Tibetan autonomy. It seems that the majority of the population is satisfied, but it gives the radicals more opportunities to promote separatism, and other national outskirts are thinking about greater independence.
0x001F3411.translated:
我们进一步扩大了地方当局的权力和西藏自治权。
看起来多数民众是满意的，但这也给激进分子提供了更多推动分裂的
机会，其他民族边缘地区也在考虑更大的独立。

0x001F3656.text: The loyal parts of the PLA entered Tibet and quickly restored order. But the nationalists and the opposition will not forget this.
0x001F3656.translated:
忠于我们的人民解放军部队进入西藏，迅速恢复秩序。
但民族主义者和反对派不会忘记这一点。

0x001F375D.text: We organized a referendum in which the majority, of course, voted to preserve the status of Tibet. Dissatisfied nationalists and other radicals took to the streets, claiming falsification, but without past support these protests no longer pose a serious threat.
0x001F375D.translated:
我们组织了一场全民公决，当然，大多数人投票赞成保留西藏现状。
那些不满的民族主义者和其他激进分子走上街头，
声称存在造假，但在失去以往支持之后，
这些抗议已不再构成严重威胁。

0x001F3998.text: Xinjiang Uygur Autonomous Region officially declared its independence. This will be a big blow for us and a great opportunity for the USSR and the USA.
0x001F3998.translated:
新疆维吾尔自治区正式宣布独立。
这将给我们造成沉重打击，也将为苏联和美国提供绝佳机会。

0x001F3AC9.text: We have further expanded the powers of local authorities and the rights of Xinjiang Uygur autonomy. It seems that the majority of the population is satisfied, but it gives the radicals more opportunities to promote separatism, and other national outskirts are thinking about greater independence.
0x001F3AC9.translated:
我们进一步扩大了地方当局的权力和新疆维吾尔自治权。
看起来多数民众是满意的，但这也给激进分子提供了更多推动分裂的
机会，其他民族边缘地区也在考虑更大的独立。

0x001F3D1C.text: The loyal parts of the PLA entered Xinjiang and quickly restored order. But the nationalists and the opposition will not forget this.
0x001F3D1C.translated:
忠于我们的人民解放军部队进入新疆，迅速恢复秩序。
但民族主义者和反对派不会忘记这一点。

0x001F3E29.text: We organized a referendum in which the majority, of course, voted to preserve the status of Xinjiang. Dissatisfied nationalists and other radicals took to the streets, claiming falsification, but without past support these protests no longer pose a serious threat.
0x001F3E29.translated:
我们组织了一场全民公决，当然，大多数人投票赞成保留新疆现状。
那些不满的民族主义者和其他激进分子走上街头，
声称存在造假，但在失去以往支持之后，
这些抗议已不再构成严重威胁。

0x001F406C.text: Large funds from the budget were urgently allocated for the modernization of the industry, the purchase of imported technologies and the involvement of specialists in this area. The problem starts to be solved
0x001F406C.translated:
财政预算中大笔资金被紧急拨付用于工业现代化、
引进进口技术，并吸纳该领域专家参与。
问题开始得到解决

0x001F4211.text: Our campaign to attract foreign investment was a great success! Foreigners themselves now build and modernize our plants without a single yuan from our budget. True, for this it was necessary to reduce the minimum wage, production safety requirements and other requirements of labor legislation, but nothing, the people will suffer.
0x001F4211.translated:
我们吸引外资的运动大获成功！
现在，外国人自己出钱出力建厂、改造、
现代化我们的工厂，连一分钱预算都不用。
不错，为此需要压低最低工资、降低生产安全要求以及劳动立法的其
他要求——不过没关系，受苦的还是人民。

0x001F44AC.text: The Soviet Union agreed how in the old days to help us with the modernization of industry. However, he doesn’t particularly like distributing specialists and machines for nothing, and we’ve got some dependence on the USSR.
0x001F44AC.translated:
苏联同意像从前那样帮助我们进行工业现代化。
然而，他并不太喜欢无偿分发专家和机器，
我们对苏联也因此产生了一定依赖。

0x001F466B.text: By the method of redistributing budget funds and revenues from enterprises, we were able to direct the power of agriculture to the development of industry. This helped the industry, but agriculture suffered a big blow.
0x001F466B.translated:
通过重新分配预算资金以及企业收入，我们把农业的力量导向工业发
展。这帮助了工业，但农业遭受了沉重打击。

0x001F4858.text: Large funds from the budget were urgently allocated for the modernization of the agriculture, the purchase of imported technologies and the involvement of specialists in this area. The problem starts to be solved
0x001F4858.translated:
财政预算中大笔资金被紧急拨付用于农业现代化、
引进进口技术，并吸纳该领域专家参与。
问题开始得到解决

0x001F4A03.text: Our campaign to attract foreign investment was a great success! Foreigners themselves now build and modernize our farms without a single yuan from our budget. True, for this it was necessary to reduce the minimum wage, production safety requirements and other requirements of labor legislation, but nothing, the people will suffer.
0x001F4A03.translated:
我们吸引外资的运动大获成功！
现在，外国人自己出钱出力建造并改造、
现代化我们的农场，连一分钱预算都不用。
不错，为此需要压低最低工资、降低生产安全要求以及劳动立法的其
他要求——不过没关系，受苦的还是人民。

0x001F4C9C.text: The Soviet Union agreed how in the old days to help us with the rise of agriculture. However, he doesn’t particularly like distributing specialists and machines for nothing, and we’ve got some dependence on the USSR.
0x001F4C9C.translated:
苏联同意像从前那样帮助我们发展农业。
然而，他并不太喜欢无偿分发专家和机器，
我们对苏联也因此产生了一定依赖。

0x001F4E4F.text: By the method of redistributing budget funds and revenues from enterprises, we were able to direct the power of industry to the development of agriculture. This helped the agriculture, but industry suffered a big blow.
0x001F4E4F.translated:
通过重新分配预算资金以及企业收入，我们把工业的力量导向农业发
展。这帮助了农业，但工业遭受了沉重打击。

0x001F5042.text: Large funds from the budget were urgently allocated for the modernization of the service sector, the purchase of imported technologies and the involvement of specialists in this area. The problem starts to be solved
0x001F5042.translated:
财政预算中大笔资金被紧急拨付用于服务业现代化、
引进进口技术，并吸纳该领域专家参与。
问题开始得到解决

0x001F51F3.text: Our campaign to attract foreign investment was a great success! Foreigners themselves now build and modernize our shops and restaurants without a single yuan from our budget. True, for this it was necessary to reduce the minimum wage, production safety requirements and other requirements of labor legislation, but nothing, the people will suffer.
0x001F51F3.translated:
我们吸引外资的运动大获成功！
现在，外国人自己出钱出力建造并改造、
现代化我们的商店和餐馆，连一分钱预算都不用。
不错，为此需要压低最低工资、降低生产安全要求以及劳动立法的其
他要求——不过没关系，受苦的还是人民。

0x001F54AC.text: The Soviet Union agreed how in the old days to help us with the the development of the service sector. However, he doesn’t particularly like distributing specialists and machines for nothing, and we’ve got some dependence on the USSR.
0x001F54AC.translated:
苏联同意像从前那样帮助我们发展服务业。
然而，他并不太喜欢无偿分发专家和机器，
我们对苏联也因此产生了一定依赖。

0x001F5683.text: By the method of redistributing budget funds and revenues from enterprises, we were able to direct the power of industry and agriculture to the development of services sector. This helped the services sector, but industry and agriculture suffered a big blow.
0x001F5683.translated:
通过重新分配预算资金以及企业收入，把工农业的力量引导到服务业
发展上。服务业因此受益，但工农业却遭到重创。

0x001F588A.text: We have no money, but you hang in there!
0x001F588A.translated: 我们没钱，但你们要挺住！

0x001F58DC.text: Taxes and fees were raised, and social programs for the population were reduced. It helped, of course, to replenish the budget, but the people are not happy.
0x001F58DC.translated:
提高税费，压缩对群众的社会项目。
当然，这有助于补充财政，但群众并不高兴。

0x001F5A19.text: Taxes on luxury and super-wealth were raised, which made it possible to replenish the budget without hurting the common people. But the oligarchs, using their strength, tell the people how the state "plunders honest entrepreneurs" and uses the levers of influence in the party to put pressure on you.
0x001F5A19.translated:
提高奢侈品和超高收入的税负，使得在不伤害普通民众的情况下补充
财政成为可能。但寡头们凭借势力，向群众宣称国家“掠夺守法的企
业家”，并动用党内影响力的杠杆对你施压。

0x001F5C74.text: A foreign loan was taken, which helped replenish the budget, but had a negative impact on our influence. Yes, and you still have to pay it...
0x001F5C74.translated:
举借外债，确实有助于补充预算，却对我们的影响力造成负面影响。
是的，而且你们还得还……

0x001F5D91.text: Many state-owned enterprises were sold into private hands, which of course hit the standard of living and disrupted the mechanism of our economy, but it helped replenish the budget.
0x001F5D91.translated:
许多国有企业被卖给私人，当然打击了生活水平、
扰乱了我们的经济机制，但它确实有助于补充财政。

0x001F5F54.text: We decided not to intervene in the conflict. Pol Pot and the Khmer Rouge leadership, of course, are very unhappy with this, but it does not seem that they will live long - the Vietnamese troops are moving fast, and the Kampuchean soldiers are deserting en masse. It seems that the fall of the Pol Pot regime is only a matter of time.
0x001F5F54.translated:
我们决定不介入这场冲突。
当然，波尔布特和红色高棉领导层对此非常不满，
但看来他们也活不长——越军推进很快，
而柬埔寨军队正在大规模逃亡。
看来波尔布特政权的垮台只是时间问题。

0x001F61F1.text: Coming in contact with the Left Opposition within the Kampuchean army, we were able to organize the displacement and arrest of Pol Pot. The Provisional Revolutionary Council has come to power, which has yet to pull Cambodia out of the chaos into which Pol Pot has led it. Seeing that Pol Pot was finished, the army resists the Vietnamese more actively, and Vietnam itself is not so decisive, because the main goal of the campaign was fulfilled. Here are just a new leadership of Cambodia is still loyal to China.
0x001F61F1.translated:
我们与柬埔寨军队内部的左派反对派取得联系，
组织了对波尔布特的架空与逮捕。
临时革命委员会已上台，但尚未把柬埔寨从波尔布特所带来的混乱中
拉出来。看到波尔布特已完蛋，军队对越军的抵抗更积极，
而越南本身也不那么果断了，因为这次战役的主要目标已经达成。
只是柬埔寨的新领导层仍然忠于中国。

0x001F65F4.text: We sent help to our old ally, Pol Pot, but it is not known whether this is enough for him. The Vietnamese army is successfully advancing, and the Kampuchean soldiers are actively deserting, and the Pol Pot regime does not enjoy the support of the people. Vietnam and the USSR remained unhappy with our actions and most likely will continue to strengthen their cooperation to our detriment.
0x001F65F4.translated:
我们向老盟友波尔布特提供了援助，但这是否足够他也不得而知。
越军推进顺利，柬埔寨士兵正在积极逃亡，
而波尔布特政权并不得到民众支持。
越南和苏联对我们的行动仍然不满，恐怕会继续加强合作，
从而对我们不利。

0x001F692D.text: The election campaign of 1976 was accompanied by bloody street clashes. Killed about 30 people. The Seni Pramoj's Democratic Party — somewhat more right-wing than the Kukrit Pramoj's Social Action Party — received the largest number of votes. Pongpol Adireksarn, leader of the right-wing national party, became deputy prime minister. Left radicals noticeably lost influence.
0x001F692D.translated:
1976年的竞选活动伴随着血腥的街头冲突，
约有30人丧生。森尼·巴莫吉的民主党——比库立·巴莫吉的社会
行动党更偏右——获得最多选票。
右翼民族党领袖蓬波尔·阿迪雷沙恩出任副总理。
左翼激进派的影响力明显下降。

0x001F6C1C.text: We managed to provide substantial support for the CPT and to achieve an alliance with various moderately left-wing activists and some warming of relations with the Social Action Party and the Democratic Party in exchange for the termination of partisan attacks on military bases. The election campaign of 1976 was accompanied by bloody street clashes. As a result the Premier Kukrit Pramoj's Social Action Party, received the largest number of votes, which had to form a coalition with the Democratic Party and the CPT. Royalists in the government and officers are unhappy with the strengthening of the left, the situation is heating up.
0x001F6C1C.translated:
我们设法对CPT提供了相当的支持，并通过终止对军事基地的党派
袭击，与各类温和左翼活动分子达成联盟，
同时也使同社会行动党与民主党的关系有所回暖。
1976年的竞选活动伴随着血腥的街头冲突。
结果，首相库立·巴莫吉的社会行动党获得最多选票，
必须与民主党和CPT组成联合政府。
政府中的王党派与军官对左翼力量的增强不满，
局势正在升温。

0x001F7119.text: Ignoring the elections, we sent more weapons to the guerrillas from CPT, who continue to raid military sites with new forces. However, it does not seem that the CPT will be able to control a sufficient part of the country in this way. The election campaign of 1976 was accompanied by bloody street clashes. Killed about 30 people. The Seni Pramoj's Democratic Party — somewhat more right-wing than the Kukrit Pramoj's Social Action Party — received the largest number of votes. Pongpol Adireksarn, leader of the right-wing national party, became deputy prime minister.
0x001F7119.translated:
不理会选举，我们向CPT的游击队增送武器，
他们继续以新力量袭扰军事据点。
不过看来，这样CPT恐怕难以控制足够多的国土。
1976年的竞选活动伴随着血腥的街头冲突，
约有30人丧生。森尼·巴莫吉的民主党——比库立·巴莫吉的社会
行动党更偏右——获得最多选票。
右翼民族党领袖蓬波尔·阿迪雷沙恩出任副总理。

0x001F75BC.text: On October 6, police forces, along with right-wing militants, broke through to the territory of the university and, despite the students' willingness to surrender, began the massacre. According to various sources, the death toll can reach more than 100 people. In the evening of the same day, the ultra-right militants together with the military force forced the prime minister Pramoj to resign. The government, with the support of the king, again turned to the military junta, ending the three-year period of democracy. Thailand once again entered the era of repression, and only the partisan operations in the north of the country remained from the CPT.
0x001F75BC.translated:
10月6日，警力与右翼武装一起突破到大学范围内，
尽管学生愿意投降，仍开始屠杀。
据多方消息，死亡人数可能超过100人。
同日傍晚，极右翼武装联合军方强迫总理普拉莫吉辞职。
在国王支持下，政府再次转向军事政变集团，
结束为期三年的民主时期。
泰国再次进入镇压时代，而CPT仅在该国北部保留了党派行动。

0x001F7ADD.text: Thanks to our support and the efforts of the special services, the armed militants of the CPT came to Tammasat University and, together with the students, started a battle with the right-wing militants, the outcome of which was decided only by the police that arrived to the right. However, by this time, clashes and demonstrations were already taking place all over Bangkok, to suppress which the army and police were thrown. Prime Minister Pramoj was arrested by the military. This cruelty and the beginning of chaos plunged society into shock and forced many students, trade union activists and workers to go into the cells of the CPT, which, taking advantage of the chaos, launched a full-scale offensive from the north of the country.
0x001F7ADD.translated:
多亏我们的支持以及特工部门的努力，CPT的武装分子进入塔玛萨
特大学，并与学生一起同右翼武装展开战斗，
结果却由赶到“右边”的警察决定。
然而此时，冲突与示威已在曼谷各处发生，
为了镇压，军队和警察被投入行动。
普拉莫吉总理被军方逮捕。
这种残酷与混乱的开端令社会震惊，并迫使许多学生、
工会活动分子和工人进入CPT的组织体系；
而CPT则借助混乱，从该国北部发动全面攻势。

0x001F80FC.text: On October 6, police forces, along with right-wing militants, broke through to the territory of the university and, despite the students' willingness to surrender, began the massacre. According to various sources, the death toll can reach more than 100 people. In the evening of the same day, the ultra-right militants together with the military force forced the prime minister Pramoj to resign. The government, with the support of the king, again turned to the military junta, ending the three-year period of democracy. Thailand once again entered the era of repression, and only the partisan operations in the north of the country remained from the CPT. We formally condemned the cruelties of the military junta and sent out additional support for the CPT, but this is unlikely to change anything.
0x001F80FC.translated:
10月6日，警力与右翼武装一起突破到大学范围内，
尽管学生愿意投降，仍开始屠杀。
据多方消息，死亡人数可能超过100人。
同日傍晚，极右翼武装联合军方强迫总理普拉莫吉辞职。
在国王支持下，政府再次转向军事政变集团，
结束为期三年的民主时期。
泰国再次进入镇压时代，而CPT仅在该国北部保留了党派行动。
我们正式谴责军事政变集团的残暴，并向CPT追加支持，
但恐怕改变不了什么。

0x001F878F.text: Rumor had it Mao Zedong himself started the Five "no" campaign, though no one was certain — he was barely reachable because of his failing health and decisions had to be made quickly. As part of the campaign, government and police officers removed improvised memorials and tore down posters marking Zhou Enlai’s achievements. Constant propaganda aimed at denigrating Zhou and bans on open commemoration of the deceased caused widespread discontent of people with Mao Zedong and the top party, especially his wife Jiang Qing.
0x001F878F.translated:
传言说是毛泽东本人亲自发动了“五不”运动，
虽然没人敢肯定——他因病重几乎联系不上，
决策又必须迅速作出。
运动期间，政府和警察人员拆除临时纪念物，
撕掉标注周恩来功绩的海报。
持续的抹黑宣传，以及禁止公开悼念逝者，
引发了群众对毛泽东和最高层的不满，尤其是对他的妻子江青。

0x001F8BAA.text: Rumor had it Mao Zedong himself started the Five "no" campaign, though no one was certain — he was barely reachable because of his failing health and decisions had to be made quickly. As Prime Minister of the State Council, as well as the Minister of Public Security, you personally followed the strict execution of the campaign. As part of the campaign, government and police officers removed improvised memorials and tore down posters marking Zhou Enlai’s achievements. Constant propaganda aimed at denigrating Zhou and bans on open commemoration of the deceased caused widespread discontent of people with Mao Zedong and the top party, especially his wife Jiang Qing and successor Hua Guofeng.
0x001F8BAA.translated:
传言说是毛泽东本人亲自发动了“五不”运动，
虽然没人敢肯定——他因病重几乎联系不上，
决策又必须迅速作出。
作为国务院总理、同时也是公安部长，你亲自盯着运动的严格执行。
运动期间，政府和警察人员拆除临时纪念物，
撕掉标注周恩来功绩的海报。
持续的抹黑宣传，以及禁止公开悼念逝者，
引发了群众对毛泽东和最高层的广泛不满，
尤其是对他的妻子江青以及接班人华国锋。

0x001F911D.text: Rumor had it Mao Zedong himself started the Five "no" campaign, though no one was certain — he was barely reachable because of his failing health and decisions had to be made quickly. As Prime Minister of the State Council, as well as the Minister of Public Security, you personally followed the strict execution of the campaign and were responsible for the publication of criticism of Zhou Enlai in newspapers, which, however, had no effect on people already tired of criticism in the spirit of the Cultural Revolution.. As part of the campaign, government and police officers removed improvised memorials and tore down posters marking Zhou Enlai’s achievements. Constant propaganda aimed at denigrating Zhou and bans on open commemoration of the deceased caused widespread discontent of people with Mao Zedong and the top party, especially his wife Jiang Qing and successor Hua Guofeng.
0x001F911D.translated:
传言说是毛泽东本人亲自发动了“五不”运动，
虽然没人敢肯定——他因病重几乎联系不上，
决策又必须迅速作出。
作为国务院总理、同时也是公安部长，你亲自盯着运动的严格执行，
并负责在报纸上刊发对周恩来的批判；然而这对早已厌倦“文化大革
命精神”式批判的人们并没有什么效果。
运动期间，政府和警察人员拆除临时纪念物，
撕掉标注周恩来功绩的海报。
持续的抹黑宣传，以及禁止公开悼念逝者，
引发了群众对毛泽东和最高层的广泛不满，
尤其是对他的妻子江青以及接班人华国锋。

0x001F9810.text: Rumor had it Mao Zedong himself started the Five "no" campaign, though no one was certain — he was barely reachable because of his failing health and decisions had to be made quickly. As Prime Minister of the State Council, as well as the Minister of Public Security, you were able, as far as possible, to mitigate the effect of the campaign. As part of the campaign, government and police officers removed improvised memorials and tore down posters marking Zhou Enlai’s achievements. Constant propaganda aimed at denigrating Zhou and bans on open commemoration of the deceased caused widespread discontent of people with the top party, especially his wife Jiang Qing, however, thanks to your efforts to sabotage the campaign, discontent does not go beyond reasonable limits.
0x001F9810.translated:
传言说是毛泽东本人亲自发动了“五不”运动，
虽然没人敢肯定——他因病重几乎联系不上，
决策又必须迅速作出。
作为国务院总理、同时也是公安部长，你尽可能地缓和了运动的影响。
运动期间，政府和警察人员拆除临时纪念物，
撕掉标注周恩来功绩的海报。
持续的抹黑宣传，以及禁止公开悼念逝者，
确实引发了群众对最高层的广泛不满，尤其是对他的妻子江青；
不过多亏你在暗中破坏运动，这种不满没有超出合理限度。

0x001F9E21.text: Criticize Deng and fight with right!

0x001F9E6B.text: In the media controlled by Jiang Qing's group, active persecution of Deng Xiaoping and his ideas began. Deng was stripped of all posts, though his party card was left with him, and he spends these months confined at home, waiting for his fate. Like any action of the Jiang Qing group, this one did not arouse sympathy among the people, where Xiaoping was respected for his ties to the popular Zhou Enlai and for trying to pull China out of the disastrous aftermath of the Great Leap by using market and even capitalist tools. Provincial party committees also joined the criticism of Xiaoping soon after Mao issued a directive on March 3, confirming the legitimacy of the Cultural Revolution and noting that Deng Xiaoping is an internal problem of the country.
0x001F9E6B.translated:
在江青集团控制的媒体上，对邓小平及其思想的积极迫害开始了。
邓小平被撤去一切职务，党籍卡却留在他手里，
这几个月他被关在家里，等待命运。
像江青集团的任何行动一样，这次也没有在群众中引起同情；
在群众眼里，小平因与深受欢迎的周恩来关系密切、
并试图借助市场乃至资本主义工具把中国从“大跃进”的灾难后果中
拉出来而受到尊敬。3月3日毛泽东发出指示，
确认文化大革命的合法性，并指出邓小平是国内问题；
随后，各省党委也很快加入对小平的批判。

0x001FA45C.text: In the media controlled by Jiang Qing's group, active persecution of Deng Xiaoping and his ideas began. The new Premier Hua Guofeng also joined the persecution, saying that Deng’s reformist ideas lead China to capitalist slavery. Deng was removed from every post but kept his party membership, and was pushed into forced seclusion. Like any action of the Jiang Qing group, this one did not arouse sympathy among the people, where Xiaoping was respected for his ties to the popular Zhou Enlai and for trying to pull China out of the disastrous aftermath of the Great Leap by using market and even capitalist tools. Provincial party committees also joined the criticism of Xiaoping soon after Mao issued a directive on March 3, confirming the legitimacy of the Cultural Revolution and noting that Deng Xiaoping is an internal problem of the country.
0x001FA45C.translated:
在江青集团控制的媒体上，对邓小平及其思想的积极迫害开始了。
新任总理华国锋也加入迫害，称邓的改革思想会把中国引向资本主义
奴役。邓小平被撤去所有职务，但保留党籍，
被迫进入强制隐居。像江青集团的任何行动一样，
这次也没有在群众中引起同情；在群众眼里，
小平因与深受欢迎的周恩来关系密切、并试图借助市场乃至资本主义
工具把中国从“大跃进”的灾难后果中拉出来而受到尊敬。
3月3日毛泽东发出指示，确认文化大革命的合法性，
并指出邓小平是国内问题；随后，各省党委也很快加入对小平的批判。

0x001FAAFD.text: In the media controlled by Jiang Qing's group, active persecution of Deng Xiaoping and his ideas began. You, however, stood up for him, arguing that Xiaoping made mistakes but admitted them, helped China develop, and now was being stripped of every post while still formally kept in the party. This caused discontent among the party top, but it appealed to the people, where Xiaoping was respected for his ties to the popular Zhou Enlai and for trying to pull China out of the disastrous aftermath of the Great Leap by using market and even capitalist tools. Provincial party committees also joined the criticism of Xiaoping soon after Mao issued a directive on March 3, confirming the legitimacy of the Cultural Revolution and noting that Deng Xiaoping is an internal problem of the country, after which provincial party committees also criticized Xiaoping.
0x001FAAFD.translated:
在江青集团控制的媒体上，对邓小平及其思想的积极迫害开始了。
然而你为他辩护，认为小平犯过错误但承认了错误，
帮助中国发展；如今却在形式上仍保留党籍的情况下被撤去一切职务。
这在党内最高层引起不满，但在群众中却引起共鸣；
在群众眼里，小平因与深受欢迎的周恩来关系密切、
并试图借助市场乃至资本主义工具把中国从“大跃进”的灾难后果中
拉出来而受到尊敬。3月3日毛泽东发出指示，
确认文化大革命的合法性，并指出邓小平是国内问题；
随后，各省党委也加入对小平的批判。

0x001FB1F2.text: An obscure article sparked rumors: some say it attacks Zhou Enlai, others whisper it targets Zhou Rongxin, and that talk of Enlai was inflated by Deng’s capitalist-roadings to whip up grief for a fallen hero. With targets unclear and tempers hot, we chose to keep our heads down and not end up under a swinging axe. Even so, word spread, and protests flared across Yangtze cities, especially Nanjing, and are now reaching Beijing despite our passivity.
0x001FB1F2.translated:
一篇不明不白的文章引发了谣言：有人说它攻击周恩来，
也有人低声说它针对周荣鑫；还有人说，
邓的“资本主义道路”把对恩来的提法夸大其词，
借此煽动对“倒下的英雄”的悲痛。
目标不明、火气又大，我们选择低头不惹事，
免得落到挥下的屠刀之下。
即便如此，消息还是传开了，长江沿岸各城——尤其南京——抗议之
火迅速燃起，如今即便我们消极应对，也正传到北京。

0x001FB57D.text: The article’s exact target remained murky: some saw a swipe at Zhou Enlai, others insisted it was Zhou Rongxin and that Deng’s capitalist-roadings hyped an ‘Enlai insult’ to inflame the crowds. We moved hard to seize the text and choke off any speculation to avoid giving the masses a martyr. The clampdown slowed the spread; protests still erupted, but the scale stayed contained.
0x001FB57D.translated:
文章的具体指向仍然扑朔迷离：有人看出是在影射周恩来，
也有人坚持说是周荣鑫，并认为邓的“资本主义道路”炒作所谓“恩
来侮辱”，以激起群众情绪。
我们强力抓文本、掐断任何猜测，避免给群众送上“烈士”。
严控确实减缓了扩散；抗议仍然爆发，但规模被控制在一定范围内。

0x001FB87A.text: With the article’s aim unclear—Enlai to some, Zhou Rongxin to others—you framed it as proof of the dangers of capitalist-roadings reforms and pushed it beyond Shanghai. The party appreciated the line; the public did not. Protests, fueled by competing rumors, spread through the Yangtze cities, Nanjing foremost, and with our amplification reached Beijing as well. For now, the situation stays under control.
0x001FB87A.translated:
由于文章的目的不明——有人说是恩来，
有人说是周荣鑫——你把它包装成“资本主义道路改革的危险”的证
据，并把它推到上海之外。
党内觉得这条路子不错，群众却不买账。
抗议在互相竞争的谣言推动下席卷长江沿岸各城，
首当其冲的是南京；而在我们的放大之下，
也传到了北京。就目前而言，局势仍在可控范围内。

0x001FBBD1.text: Following Jiang Qing and Zhang Chunqiao’s line, we first used radio appeals to separate mourners from provocateurs, then moved in city police and the Peking Garrison to clear the square. Clashes and beatings occurred, but no one was killed; about a hundred people were detained and most were released soon after. The events on Tiananmen were officially declared a counter-revolutionary incident, with Deng Xiaoping blamed. On Mao Zedong’s proposal, the Politburo formally removed Deng Xiaoping from all posts while keeping his CCP membership. Deng himself is now in Guangzhou under the protection of his old comrade-in-arms, Guangzhou Military District commander Xu Shiyu.
0x001FBBD1.translated:
按照江青、张春桥的路线，我们先用广播号召把悼念者与挑衅者分开，
然后出动北京市公安与北京卫戍部队清场。
发生了冲突和殴打，但没有人被杀；约一百人被拘留，
随后大多数很快获释。
天安门的事件被官方定性为反革命事件，
并把责任推给邓小平。
根据毛泽东的提议，政治局正式撤销邓小平的一切职务，
同时保留其在中共的党籍。
邓本人现由老战友、广州军区司令员徐世友保护，
在广州。

0x001FC114.text: At half past six in the evening, Wu De spoke over loudspeakers urging the crowd to disperse. Many left, some stayed. By night, city police and Peking Garrison units dispersed the remaining protest. There were no deaths; about a hundred people were detained and most were released later. The square remained under military and police control in the following days. The events on Tiananmen were officially declared a counter-revolutionary incident, with Deng Xiaoping blamed. On Mao Zedong’s proposal, the Politburo removed Deng Xiaoping from all posts while retaining his CCP membership. Deng is now in Guangzhou under the protection of his old comrade-in-arms, Guangzhou Military District commander Xu Shiyu.
0x001FC114.translated:
晚上六点半，吴德通过扩音器呼吁群众散去。
许多人离开了，也有些人留下。
到了夜里，市公安和北京卫戍部队驱散了剩余的抗议人群。
没有人死亡；约一百人被拘留，随后大多数获释。
接下来的几天，广场仍由军警控制。
天安门的事件被官方定性为反革命事件，
并把责任推给邓小平。
根据毛泽东的提议，政治局在保留邓小平中共党籍的同时，
撤销其一切职务。邓现在在广州，由老战友、
广州军区司令员徐世友保护。

0x001FC69F.text: At half past six in the evening, Wu De spoke over loudspeakers urging the crowd to go home. Many left, but some stayed. By night, police and Peking Garrison units cleared the square. No one was killed; around a hundred were detained and most were released later. The square stayed under military-police control for the following days. The events on Tiananmen were officially declared a counter-revolutionary incident, with Deng Xiaoping blamed. On Mao Zedong’s proposal, the Politburo removed Deng Xiaoping from all posts while retaining his CCP membership. Deng is now in Guangzhou under the protection of his old comrade-in-arms, Guangzhou Military District commander Xu Shiyu.
0x001FC69F.translated:
晚上六点半，吴德通过扩音器呼吁群众回家。
许多人离开了，但也有些人留下。
到了夜里，警察和北京卫戍部队清理了广场。
没有人被杀；大约一百人被拘留，随后大多数获释。
接下来的几天，广场仍处于军警控制之下。
天安门的事件被官方定性为反革命事件，
并把责任推给邓小平。
根据毛泽东的提议，政治局在保留邓小平中共党籍的同时，
撤销其一切职务。邓现在在广州，由老战友、
广州军区司令员徐世友保护。

0x001FCC18.text: Funds from the PRC budget were immediately allocated to carry out rescue and restoration work, which made it possible to mitigate the effects of the earthquake. The earthquake in Tangshan today turned out to be the second in the history of the number of victims after the Shaanxi earthquake in 1556.
0x001FCC18.translated:
中华人民共和国预算资金立即拨付，用于开展救援与恢复工作，
从而减轻了地震的影响。
今天的唐山地震，结果成为继1556年陕西地震之后，
历史上伤亡人数第二多的一次地震。
