0x001FCE71.text: The world community and charitable organizations, assessing the scale of the disaster, agreed to provide us with assistance in the form of gratuitous loans and assistance of volunteers, which made it possible to mitigate the effects of the earthquake. The earthquake in Tangshan today turned out to be the second in the history of the number of victims after the Shaanxi earthquake in 1556.
0x001FCE71.translated:
国际社会与慈善机构在评估灾害规模后，
决定以无偿贷款和志愿者援助的形式向我们提供帮助，
从而减轻了地震的影响。
今天的唐山地震，结果成为继1556年陕西地震之后，
历史上伤亡人数第二多的一次地震。

0x001FD180.text: Funds from the PRC budget were immediately allocated to carry out rescue and restoration work, which made it possible to mitigate the effects of the earthquake. The earthquake in Tangshan today turned out to be the second in the history of the number of victims after the Shaanxi earthquake in 1556 Additional funding was also provided for the construction of earthquake-resistant buildings in hazardous regions, and numerous tests were carried out on the suitability of current buildings, which revealed numerous violations. We hope that in the future this will help to avoid so many victims.
0x001FD180.translated:
中华人民共和国预算资金立即拨付，用于开展救援和恢复工作，
从而减轻了地震的影响。
今天的唐山地震，结果竟成为继1556年陕西地震之后、
历史上受害者人数第二多的地震。
另拨经费用于对危险地区建设抗震建筑，
并对现有建筑的适用性进行了大量测试，
暴露出种种违规。我们希望今后能借此避免如此多的伤亡。

0x001FD627.text: The center remained deaf to the problems of Hebei Province, which of course made it difficult to eliminate the consequences of the earthquake and gave rise to discontent among the people, but somehow the local administration copes. The earthquake in Tangshan today turned out to be the second in the history of the number of victims after the Shaanxi earthquake in 1556.
0x001FD627.translated:
中央对河北省的问题充耳不闻，这当然使得消除地震后果困难重重，
也引起了民众的不满，但地方政府总算是应付过去了。
今天的唐山地震，结果竟成为继1556年陕西地震之后、
历史上受害者人数第二多的地震。

0x001FD92E.text: You and Wang Dongxing coined the slogan of the 'Two Whatevers'—'We will resolutely uphold whatever policy decisions Chairman Mao made, and unswervingly follow whatever instructions Chairman Mao gave'—to legitimize the new leadership. You now present it more as a personal code of honor than a rigid line, while quietly snuffing out the last embers of the long-fading Cultural Revolution, which pleases the people. Even so, holding to conservative Maoism breeds unease among the public, abroad, and within CPC reform circles.
0x001FD92E.translated:
你和汪东兴炮制了“两个凡是”的口号——“凡是毛主席作出的决策，
我们都坚决维护；凡是毛主席发出的指示，
我们都一以贯之地遵循”——以此为新领导层“正名”。
如今你把它更多包装成个人的荣誉准则，
而不是僵硬的路线，同时又悄悄掐灭那场久已衰微的文化大革命最后
的余火，倒也讨得了人心。
可即便如此，守着保守的毛主义仍会在国内外以及中共改革圈里引起
不安。

0x001FDD49.text: Relying on loyal radicals, you and Wang Dongxing elevated your own 'Two Whatevers' formula to the binding line—'We will resolutely uphold whatever policy decisions Chairman Mao made, and unswervingly follow whatever instructions Chairman Mao gave'—to anchor your authority. You proclaimed an uncompromising fight against revisionism and fidelity to Mao and the Cultural Revolution, trying to rekindle it with lessons claimed from past errors. A wave of repression hit the revisionists, and a wave of protests rose from those weary of a new turn of the Cultural Revolution.
0x001FDD49.translated:
你和汪东兴依靠忠于激进派的力量，把你们自己的“两个凡是”公式
抬升为必须遵守的“铁律”——“凡是毛主席作出的决策，
我们都坚决维护；凡是毛主席发出的指示，
我们都一以贯之地遵循”——以此稳固你们的权威。
你们宣称要毫不妥协地反对修正主义，忠于毛和文化大革命，
并试图用“从过去错误中吸取的教训”把它重新点燃。
一波镇压打向修正主义者，另一波反抗则从厌倦了文化大革命再度转
向的人群中涌起。

0x001FE1C4.text: You and Wang Dongxing reminded cadres of your authorship of the 'Two Whatevers' to legitimize the transition, framing them as a code of honor rather than a hard line while declaring the Cultural Revolution’s tasks complete and moving to liquidate its last pockets. You also underlined the need to reorganize and modernize the economy, without yet detailing the path. Reformers wait in suspense; the people expect improvements.
0x001FE1C4.translated:
你和汪东兴提醒干部们“两个凡是”出自你们之手，
以此为权力交接“站台”。
你们把它包装成荣誉守则而非硬邦邦的路线，
同时宣布文化大革命的任务已经完成，准备清算其最后的残余。
你还强调要调整和实现经济现代化，却尚未说明具体路径。
改革者在悬念中等待，人民则期待改进。

0x001FE51B.text: You and Wang Dongxing asserted the 'Two Whatevers'—your own formula—as a strict obligatory line to buttress your mandate while announcing the rapid dismantling of the Cultural Revolution’s remnants. Simultaneously, you spoke of further market reforms and a gradual opening to the world market, promoting veteran reformers like Zhao Ziyang and restoring Deng Xiaoping to the vice-premiership. The people await better times, though conservatives bristle at these decisions.
0x001FE51B.translated:
你和汪东兴把“两个凡是”——你们自己的那套公式——宣称为严格
必须遵守的“硬线”，以巩固你们的授权，
同时又宣布要迅速拆除文化大革命的残余。
与此同时，你们谈到进一步的市场改革以及逐步面向世界市场的开放，
提拔像赵紫阳这样的老牌改革者，并让邓小平重回副总理岗位。
人民期待更好的日子，尽管保守派对这些决定怒目而视。

0x001FE8E6.text: Enlisting the support of Special Regiment 8341, as well as the highest generals, Hua Guofeng convened an extraordinary congress of the Politburo, right at which the leaders of the radical faction were arrested. Following this, a wave of arrests of loyal functionaries swept through Beijing and Shanghai, practically causing no resistance. A large-scale campaign was launched in the press to condemn the conspirators, who had already been dubbed the «Gang of Four», which was now blamed for the numerous victims of the Cultural Revolution, as well as the attempt to seize power after Mao’s death. The people, like most of the party members, generally accepted with relief the defeat of the radicals and gradually express the hope of a softening of domestic policy.
0x001FE8E6.translated: 在争取了第8341特种团以及最高将领的支持后， 华国锋召集了政治局的非常会议，当场逮捕了激进派的主要头目。 此后，一波又一波对忠于激进派的官员的抓捕席卷北京和上海， 几乎没有遭到抵抗。新闻界随即发动大规模运动， 声讨那些阴谋者——早已被称为“四人帮”——并把他们归咎于文化 大革命造成的众多受害者，以及毛泽东逝世后企图夺权。 人民——和大多数党员一样——总体上如释重负地接受了激进派的失 败，并逐渐表达出希望国内政策有所缓和的愿望。

0x001FEEDF.text: Unwilling to take risks, Hua Guofeng decided to arrest only Wang Hongwen and Jiang Qing, who represented the greatest threat to the authorities. This happened at a specially convened meeting of the Politburo. At the same time, Yao Wenyuan and Zhang Chunqiao were offered seats in the government in exchange for loyalty to the current ruler. The positions of the left faction were undermined, but not so significantly as to completely disregard them, although now they can not dream of seizing power. An active media campaign began against Jiang Qing and Wang Hongwen, who were now accused of trying to seize power and excesses during the time of the Cultural Revolution. In general, the people and the majority of the party members accepted their fall with relief, although many are strained by the fact that some radicals remained in power and consider the conspirators to be only «scapegoats».
0x001FEEDF.translated: 华国锋不愿冒险，决定只逮捕代表对当局最大威胁的王洪文和江青。 这发生在一次专门召开的政治局会议上。 与此同时，姚文元和张春桥被“安排”进入政府， 以换取对现任统治者的忠诚。 左派的地位被削弱了，但并未削弱到可以完全无视他们的程度——尽 管他们现在也别想再做夺权的美梦。 舆论战随即展开，矛头指向江青和王洪文， 指控他们企图夺权、以及在文化大革命时期的种种过火。 总体而言，人民和大多数党员都如释重负地接受了他们的倒台， 尽管不少人仍为“仍有一些激进分子掌权”而感到紧张， 并认为阴谋者不过是“替罪羊”。

0x001FF5E0.text: The growing influence of reformers in the wake of Mao’s death scared not only Guofeng, but also the Wang-Zhang-Jiang-Yao group, so the new Chairman of the PRC decided to join forces with them. The negotiations were conducted through the mediation of Mao Yuanxin (Mao Zedong's nephew) for a long time. However, we managed to reach an agreement - in exchange for support, the Wang-Zhang-Jiang-Yao group demanded: removal from the post of the PRC Minister of Defense Marshal Ye Jianying, the transfer of the posts of the Chairman of the Military Council of the CPC Central Committee and the Minister of Foreign Affairs of the PRC to her. Comrade Guofeng agreed to these terms. The military council of the CPC Central Committee was headed by Wang Hongwen, Yao Wenyuan became foreign minister, and Chen Xilian, commander of the PLA Beijing military district, became defense minister. At a meeting of the Political Bureau of the CPC Central Committee, Deng Xiaoping was again attacked, returning the slogan "Criticize Dang and speak against the flow of the right bias aimed at revising the right decisions". The influence of Xiaopeng began to decline again, especially due to the departure of his "guardian angel" Jianing from the PLA command posts... The people and the majority of the party, however, are dissatisfied with such a strange alliance, foreshadowing the continuation of the Cultural Revolution.
0x001FF5E0.translated: 毛泽东逝世后，改革派影响力不断扩大， 不仅吓着了华国锋，也吓着王-张-江-姚集团， 于是新任中华人民共和国主席决定与他们“结盟”。 谈判长期由毛远新（毛泽东的侄子）居中斡旋。 可最终还是达成了协议——作为支持的交换， 王-张-江-姚集团提出条件：撤掉中华人民共和国国防部长、 叶剑英元帅的职务，并将中共中央军委主席与中华人民共和国外交部 长的职位转交给她。华国锋同志同意了这些条件。 中共中央军委由王洪文担任负责人，姚文元出任外长， 担任北京军区司令的陈锡联则出任国防部长。 在中共中央政治局会议上，邓小平再次遭到攻击， 重新喊回口号：“批邓、反击右倾翻案风， 反对修正正确决定”。 “小平”的影响力又开始回落，尤其是他的“守护天使”简宁离开了 人民解放军的指挥岗位…… 然而，人民和大多数党员对这种荒唐的联盟并不满意， 这也预示着文化大革命将继续。

0x00200103.text: Enlisting the support of Special Regiment 8341, as well as the highest generals, Hua Guofeng convened an extraordinary congress of the Politburo, right at which the leaders of the radical faction were arrested. Following this, a wave of arrests of loyal functionaries swept through Beijing and Shanghai, although it was not without some excesses, given the increased influence of the radicals. A large-scale campaign was launched in the press to condemn the conspirators, who had already been dubbed the «Gang of Four», which was now blamed for the numerous victims of the Cultural Revolution, as well as the attempt to seize power after Mao’s death. The people, like most of the party members, generally accepted with relief the defeat of the radicals, although given the past alliance with them, these actions did not greatly added much popularity to Guofeng
0x00200103.translated: 在争取了第8341特种团以及最高将领的支持后， 华国锋召集了政治局的非常会议，当场逮捕了激进派的主要头目。 此后，随着激进派影响力的上升，虽然也难免出现一些过火， 但一波又一波对忠于激进派官员的抓捕仍席卷北京和上海。 新闻界随即发动大规模运动，声讨那些阴谋者——早已被称为“四人 帮”——并把他们归咎于文化大革命造成的众多受害者， 以及毛泽东逝世后企图夺权。 人民——和大多数党员一样——总体上如释重负地接受了激进派的失 败，尽管考虑到此前曾与他们结过盟，这些行动并未给华国锋带来太 多声望。

0x002007BE.text: Unwilling to take risks, Hua Guofeng decided to arrest only Wang Hongwen and Jiang Qing, who represented the greatest threat to the authorities. This happened at a specially convened meeting of the Politburo. At the same time, Yao Wenyuan and Zhang Chunqiao were offered further advancement in exchange for loyalty to the current ruler. The positions of the left faction were undermined, but not so significantly as to completely disregard them, although now they can not dream of seizing power. An active media campaign began against Jiang Qing and Wang Hongwen, who were now accused of trying to seize power and excesses during the time of the Cultural Revolution. In general, the people and the majority of the party members accepted their fall with relief, although many are strained by the fact that some radicals remained in power and consider the conspirators to be only «scapegoats», especially since Guofeng had already made concessions to them, therefore this decision not much add to his popularity.
0x002007BE.translated: 华国锋不愿冒险，决定只逮捕代表对当局最大威胁的王洪文和江青。 这发生在一次专门召开的政治局会议上。 与此同时，姚文元和张春桥被“安排”获得进一步升迁， 以换取对现任统治者的忠诚。 左派的地位被削弱了，但并未削弱到可以完全无视他们的程度——尽 管他们现在也别想再做夺权的美梦。 舆论战随即展开，矛头指向江青和王洪文， 指控他们企图夺权、以及在文化大革命时期的种种过火。 总体而言，人民和大多数党员都如释重负地接受了他们的倒台， 尽管不少人仍为“仍有一些激进分子掌权”而感到紧张， 并认为阴谋者不过是“替罪羊”，尤其因为华国锋此前已经向他们让 过步，因此这一决定对他的声望提升并不明显。

0x00200FA7.text: Fearing to go into open conflict with ever-increasing radicals, Guofeng made further concessions, essentially unleashing their hands to fight the opposition, which they actively use, including to remove Guofang from power, which he is losing every day. At this rate, Wang Hongwen is becoming the new de facto head of state, relying on his associates. However, they still remember to whom they owe their triumph, so Guofeng may not yet fear persecution, but the end of his career is only a matter of time. All of these changes caused fear and discontent in the party and the people, who are now waiting for a new round of the Cultural Revolution.
0x00200FA7.translated:
担心与日益壮大的激进派公开翻脸，华国锋又作出进一步让步，
等于放开他们的手去打击反对者，而他们正积极利用这一点，
包括把“国防”——也就是华国锋——从权力上挤下去；
他每天都在失去控制。
照这样下去，王洪文就会逐渐成为新的事实上的国家首脑，
依靠其同伙运作。然而他们仍记得自己的胜利要归功于谁，
所以华国锋也许暂时不必担心遭到清算，
但他的仕途终点只是时间问题。
所有这些变化在党内和人民中引起了恐惧与不满，
大家现在都在等待文化大革命的下一轮。

0x002014B4.text: The fate of Hong Kong and Macau

0x002014F4.text: After long negotiations, you finally signed an agreement with the representatives of Britain and Portugal, according to which Hong Kong will be transferred to China in 1997 at the same time as the end of the lease period of the New Territories, and Macao in 1999. Both former colonies will gain wide autonomy, retaining control over the legal and economic spheres, while the central government of the PRC will deal only with defense and foreign policy issues. Of course, this will lead to the concentration of power in the hands of local business elites, but this is not so important, because the long-awaited reunion with our brothers will take place very soon!
0x002014F4.translated:
经过长期谈判，你终于与英国和葡萄牙的代表签署了协议：
香港将于1997年在新界租约期满的同时移交中华人民共和国，
澳门则于1999年移交。
两处旧殖民地都将获得广泛的自治权，保留对法律和经济领域的控制
权，而中华人民共和国中央政府只处理国防和外交事务。
当然，这会导致权力集中在地方工商精英手中，
但这并不重要，因为我们久盼的与兄弟的团聚很快就要实现了！

0x00201A23.text: After long negotiations, you finally signed an agreement with the representatives of Britain and Portugal, according to which Hong Kong will be transferred to China in 1997 at the same time as the end of the lease period of the New Territories, and Macao in 1999. Both former colonies will get limited autonomy, while retaining control over the economic and, in part, legal sphere. The authority of the administration will be divided between the local electoral administration and the supervising bodies of the CPC. This is our diplomatic victory!
0x00201A23.translated:
经过长期谈判，你终于与英国和葡萄牙的代表签署了协议：
香港将于1997年在新界租约期满的同时移交中华人民共和国，
澳门则于1999年移交。
两处旧殖民地将获得有限的自治权，同时保留对经济以及部分法律领
域的控制。行政权力将由地方选举机构与中共的监督机构共同分担。
这是我们的外交胜利！

0x00201E6C.text: After long negotiations, the British and the Portuguese abandoned our conditions, calling them unacceptable, which caused great frustration of the party and the people. It seems that the issue of the transfer of colonies is postponed indefinitely. At least New Territories Britain is still ready to return in 1997 on such conditions.
0x00201E6C.translated:
经过长期谈判，英国和葡萄牙放弃了我们的条件，
称其“不可接受”，这使党和人民都大为沮丧。
看来殖民地移交的问题将被无限期地拖延。
至少，新界的英国方面仍准备在这种条件下于1997年归还。

0x00202109.text: After long negotiations, you finally signed an agreement with the representatives of Britain and Portugal, according to which Hong Kong will be transferred to China in 1997 at the same time as the end of the lease period of the New Territories, and Macao in 1999. Both former colonies will completely come under the control of the PRC, retaining only some elements of local self-government. Private property of foreign nationals will continue to work within the framework of the Special Economic Zones created, and the administrative institutions will be bought out by China from Britain and Portugal by the time of the transfer of the colonies. The people and the party are celebrating our huge diplomatic victory!
0x00202109.translated:
经过长期谈判，你终于与英国和葡萄牙的代表签署了协议：
香港将于1997年在新界租约期满的同时移交中华人民共和国，
澳门则于1999年移交。
两处旧殖民地将完全纳入中华人民共和国的控制，
仅保留部分地方自治要素。
外国国民的私有财产将继续在已设立的特别经济区框架内运作，
而在殖民地移交之时，中国将从英国和葡萄牙“赎买”行政机构。
人民和党都在庆祝我们这场巨大的外交胜利！

0x002026A2.text: The end of the Asian Pinochet

0x002026DE.text: Unable to cope with the protests, Suharto resigned, transferring the board to the vice-president, who liberalized the regime and held free elections and initiated a more independent foreign policy.
0x002026DE.translated:
由于无法应对抗议浪潮，苏哈托辞职，把权力交给副总统。
副总统放宽了政体，举行自由选举，并启动了更独立的外交政策。

0x0020286B.text: БUnable to cope with the protests, Suharto resigned. Despite all the efforts of the ruling elite, in the course of the protests, with our support, a moderate-left party was formed, following the course of the first president, Sukarno, which won the subsequent elections. The restructuring of the economy begins with the introduction of elements of socialist governance into it, as well as the tribunal over involved in the tyranny of Suharto.
0x0020286B.translated:
Б由于无法应对抗议浪潮，苏哈托辞职。
尽管执政精英竭尽全力，但在抗议过程中，
在我们的支持下，一个温和的左翼政党成立，
沿着首任总统苏加诺的道路前进，并在随后选举中获胜。
经济重组从把社会主义治理的要素引入其中开始，
同时还要对参与苏哈托暴政的人进行审判。

0x00202BE2.text: Unable to cope with the protests, Suharto resigned. Thanks to our support in Indonesia, after the almost complete destruction in the 60s, the Communist Party was formed again, which was able to replenish its ranks well at the expense of the protesters and was able to carry out many guerrilla attacks on government facilities. All this, together with our pressure, forced the Indonesian government to allow the communist party to the elections in which it, with our active intervention, won, forming a coalition with the Democrats. For Indonesia began a new era.
0x00202BE2.translated:
由于无法应对抗议浪潮，苏哈托辞职。
多亏我们在印尼的支持，在60年代遭到几乎彻底的摧毁之后，
印尼共产党得以重新组建，并能够在以抗议者为代价的情况下迅速补
充队伍，还能对政府设施发动许多游击袭击。
所有这些，再加上我们的施压，迫使印尼政府允许共产党参加选举；
在我们积极介入之下，共产党赢得选举，
并与民主党组成联合政府。
印尼由此开始了一个新时代。

0x00203071.text: Not wanting to meet with serious economic problems, Kim Il-sung nevertheless agreed to our demands and went to soften the party-state control and partial rehabilitation of those who had been subjected to past repressions, and also went to partial contacts with Japan and South Korea.
0x00203071.translated:
金日成不想面对严重的经济问题，尽管如此，
他还是同意了我们的要求：放松党国控制，
对过去遭受迫害者进行部分平反，并且与日本和韩国展开了有限接触。

0x002032AA.text: Not wanting to make concessions to us, Kim Il-sung originally wanted to completely turn over to the side of the USSR in exchange for help from them, but we turned out to be much more influential and, not wanting to go with us to confrontation, he agreed to our demands. Large-scale reforms have taken place in the DPRK - party-state control has been relaxed, a lot of publicity and freedom has been introduced in the media, and reforms have begun in the economy, based on the introduction of cost accounting and self-government. All of this was positively appreciated by Japan, South Korea and the United States, whose president noted China’s outstanding contribution to the struggle for world democracy.
0x002032AA.translated:
金日成原本不愿向我们让步，想以完全倒向苏联来换取他们的援助；
但事实证明，我们的影响力更大，他又不愿与我们走向对抗，
于是同意了我们的要求。
朝鲜民主主义人民共和国已经展开大规模改革——放松了党国控制，
媒体上引入了大量宣传与自由；经济改革也开始推进，
基础是引入成本核算与自主管理。
日本、韩国和美国对这一切都给予了积极评价，
美国总统还指出中国在争取世界民主的斗争中作出了杰出贡献。

0x0020382D.text: Not wanting to bend over our demands, Kim Il-sung appealed for help to the Soviet Union, who gladly increased the supply of material aid and sent a small contingent of troops to the DPRK for basing. The DPRK, which previously maintained neutrality with respect to China and the USSR, has now firmly entered the Soviet sphere.
0x0020382D.translated:
金日成不愿屈从我们的要求，便向苏联求援。
苏联欣然增加物资援助，并派出一小支部队进驻朝鲜民主主义人民共
和国作为基地。此前对中国和苏联保持中立的朝鲜，
如今已坚定地进入苏联势力范围。

0x00203ABA.text: Not wanting to meet with serious economic problems, Kim Il-sung nevertheless agreed to our demands and authorized the opening of special economic zones where foreign enterprises could operate, and Chinese would also receive preferential terms. Our entrepreneurs are very satisfied and we are already looking forward to receiving new profits.
0x00203ABA.translated:
金日成不想面对严重的经济问题，尽管如此，
他还是同意了我们的要求，并授权开设特别经济区，
允许外国企业经营，同时中国方面也将获得优惠待遇。
我们的企业家对此非常满意，我们也已经期待获得新的利润。

0x00203D89.text: Following the talks, Yasser Arafat, the leader of the PLO, agreed to the rejection of terrorist methods of struggle, the condemnation of terrorists and the recognition of Israel’s right to exist, and Israel in turn agreed to the gradual establishment of the State of Palestine in the West Bank, Gaza and most parts of East Jerusalem (although the issue of the latter is still the subject of heated debate) and the gradual withdrawal of the Israeli army from these territories. Many radical Arab groups called such agreements a betrayal and decided to continue the struggle until the complete destruction of Israel. However, this is a great victory for the Arab world, which can mark the beginning of the normalization of relations between the Arab world and Israel.
0x00203D89.translated:
会谈之后，巴勒斯坦解放组织（PLO）
领导人亚西尔·阿拉法特同意摒弃恐怖主义的斗争方式，
谴责恐怖分子，并承认以色列的存在权；
作为回应，以色列同意在约旦河西岸、加沙地带以及东耶路撒冷的大
部分地区，逐步建立巴勒斯坦国（至于后者的问题仍在激烈争论中），
并逐步从这些地区撤出以色列军队。
许多激进的阿拉伯组织称这类协议为背叛，
并决定继续斗争，直到以色列被彻底摧毁为止。
然而，这对阿拉伯世界而言是一场重大胜利，
意味着阿拉伯世界与以色列关系正常化的开端。

0x00204386.text: Despite all our efforts, the parties could not reach a compromise, our proposal was rejected, and the negotiations failed. It seems that a new round of violence will soon begin.
0x00204386.translated:
尽管我们竭尽全力，双方仍无法达成妥协，
我们的提案被拒绝，谈判破裂。
看来新一轮暴力很快就要开始了。

0x002044EB.text: Following the talks, Yasser Arafat, the leader of the PLO, agreed to the rejection of terrorist methods of struggle, the condemnation of terrorists and the recognition of Israel’s right to exist, and Israel in turn agreed to create a Palestinian National Administration based on the West Bank and the Gaza Strip, which would become the self-government body of the Palestinian autonomy until a final decision on the status of Arabs in Palestine, which should be made in 5 years. Many radical Arab groups called such agreements a betrayal and decided to continue the struggle until the complete destruction of Israel. However, we hope that these agreements will eventually lead to a settlement of the conflict.
0x002044EB.translated:
会谈之后，巴勒斯坦解放组织（PLO）
领导人亚西尔·阿拉法特同意摒弃恐怖主义的斗争方式，
谴责恐怖分子，并承认以色列的存在权；
作为回应，以色列同意在约旦河西岸和加沙地带建立巴勒斯坦民族行
政机构，该机构将成为巴勒斯坦自治的自我管理机构，
直到对巴勒斯坦境内阿拉伯人的地位作出最终决定——该决定应在5
年内做出。许多激进的阿拉伯组织称这类协议为背叛，
并决定继续斗争，直到以色列被彻底摧毁为止。
然而，我们希望这些协议最终能促成冲突的解决。

0x00204A76.text: Following the talks, Yasser Arafat, the leader of the PLO, agreed to the rejection of terrorist methods of struggle, the condemnation of terrorists and the recognition of Israel’s right to exist. However, the further came as a complete surprise - the parties agreed on the creation of a Union State of Palestine and Israel, with a common army, bilingual paperwork, developed local self-government and an obligatory foreign policy neutrality. Part of the radical groups, of course, called it a betrayal, but others decided to stop the terrorist attacks. Of course, the creation of a new state will take place with difficulty, and many more conflicts remain to be resolved, but the very decision to create one speaks of a serious step towards the long-awaited peace.
0x00204A76.translated: 会谈之后，巴勒斯坦解放组织（PLO） 领导人亚西尔·阿拉法特同意摒弃恐怖主义的斗争方式， 谴责恐怖分子，并承认以色列的存在权。 然而后续发展完全出人意料——双方同意建立巴勒斯坦与以色列的“ 联邦国家”，实行共同军队、双语文书， 发展地方自治，并在外交政策上实行必然的中立。 激进派中的一部分当然称之为背叛，但也有其他人决定停止恐怖袭击。 当然，新国家的建立将困难重重，更多冲突仍有待解决， 但仅仅是作出建立决定，就表明迈向久盼和平的重大一步。

0x002050CB.text: The victory in the first free elections, playing on the fragmentation of the opposition, was won by Roh Tae-woo, a supporter of the old military regime, who managed to dissociate himself from it in time after the fall in popularity of Chun Doo-hwan.
0x002050CB.translated:
在首届自由选举中，利用反对派分裂的局面获胜者是卢泰愚——旧军
政府的支持者。他在全斗焕人气下滑之后，
及时与旧势力撇清关系。

0x002052C0.text: Thanks to our help, Kim Dae-jung managed to rally the opposition around himself, which led him to victory in the elections. South Korea is awaited by large-scale democratic reforms, and rhetoric towards North has already been relaxed. Significant warming is expected in the relations of the two Koreas, but it seems that it will not come to unification.
0x002052C0.translated:
多亏我们的帮助，金大中成功把反对力量凝聚到自己周围，
从而在选举中获胜。韩国将迎来大规模的民主改革，
对北方的强硬言辞也已开始松动。
两韩关系预计将明显升温，但看来还不会走到统一。

0x00205585.text: Thanks to our help, Kim Dae-jung managed to rally the opposition around himself, which led him to victory in the elections. South Korea is awaited by large-scale democratic reforms, and rhetoric towards North has already been relaxed. Also, the North Korea itself, under our pressure, made peaceful contacts with its southern neighbor and Japan, which eventually led to the historic meeting of the leaders of both Koreas in Pyongyang, where in addition to the long-awaited detente, it was decided to gradually unite Korea into a neutral confederation, where the parties jointly would solve issues of foreign policy and defense, while maintaining internal independence. And the American soldiers from South Korea will soon have to sail home.
0x00205585.translated:
多亏我们的帮助，金大中成功把反对力量凝聚到自己周围，
从而在选举中获胜。韩国将迎来大规模的民主改革，
对北方的强硬言辞也已开始松动。
与此同时，在我们的压力下，朝鲜也与其南方邻国以及日本展开和平
接触，最终促成了两韩领导人在平壤举行的历史性会晤。
在久盼的缓和之外，双方还决定把朝鲜半岛逐步统一为一个中立的邦
联：由各方共同解决外交与国防问题，同时保持内部独立。
而驻韩美军也将很快启航回国。

0x00205B78.text: Under pressure from the protesters, the MPR made some concessions, having dispersed the most radical of them. Censorship and pressure on dissidents and religion was greatly relaxed. Although foreign policy has become more independent, but mainly Mongolia is still oriented towards the USSR.
0x00205B78.translated:
在抗议者的压力下，蒙古人民革命党作出了一些让步，
驱散了其中最激进的部分。
对新闻审查以及对持不同政见者和宗教的压制大幅放松。
尽管外交政策变得更加独立，但主要而言，
蒙古仍然倾向于苏联。

0x00205DBF.text: Under pressure from the protesters, the MPR made some concessions, having dispersed the most radical of them. Censorship and pressure on dissidents and religion was greatly relaxed. Due to this, we were able to conduct in the Mongolian media and the social and political life individuals who advocate a more independent foreign policy from the USSR and, in particular, the establishment of relations with China.
0x00205DBF.translated:
在抗议者的压力下，马来西亚人民党（MPR）
作出了一些让步，驱散了其中最激进的部分。
对新闻审查以及对持不同政见者和宗教的压制大幅放松。
正因如此，我们得以在蒙古的媒体中开展工作，
并在社会与政治生活中推动那些主张采取更独立的对外政策、
尤其是建立同中国关系的人士。

0x00206122.text: At around midnight on July 4, General Zia-ul-Haq ordered the 111th Brigade from Rawalpindi to encircle all the main federal government buildings, police stations and the National Assembly. After that, he ordered the police to arrest Zulfikar Bhutto, ministers and other leaders from the Pakistan People’s Party. In an address to the population on national television, General Zia stated that the National Assembly of Pakistan and the provincial assemblies were dissolved, and the Constitution of Pakistan was no longer valid. The new government headed for the Islamization of Pakistan and returned to pro-American foreign policy.
0x00206122.translated:
7月4日午夜左右，齐亚·乌尔·哈克将军命令驻拉瓦尔品第的第1
11旅包围所有主要的联邦政府建筑、警察局以及国民议会。
随后，他下令警方逮捕祖勒菲卡尔·布托以及巴基斯坦人民党部长们
和其他领导人。齐亚在国家电视台向全国发表讲话时表示，
巴基斯坦国民议会和各省议会已被解散，
巴基斯坦宪法不再有效。
新的政府将着手推进巴基斯坦的伊斯兰化，
并恢复亲美的外交政策。

0x0020660F.text: Thanks to our warning, Bhutto managed to hide from the rebels and put up loyal units against them, who together with the special forces of the MSS arrived to help them stopped the rebels and captured the leaders of the coup. General Zia-ul-Haq was executed for treason, and the situation in the country, thanks to our material assistance and help in the fight against the protesters, was normalized. Bhutto continued the course of building Islamic socialism, introducing more and more socialist methods into the economy. There is also a slight warming in relations with India.
0x0020660F.translated:
多亏了我们的警告，布托得以躲过叛军，
并部署忠诚部队与他们对抗。
与此同时，摩萨德（MSS）的特种部队也赶来支援，
协助他们击退叛军，并俘获了政变的头目。
齐亚-乌尔-哈克将军因叛国罪被处决。
由于我们提供的物资援助以及在镇压抗议者斗争中的帮助，
国内局势得以恢复正常。
布托继续推进建设伊斯兰社会主义的进程，
逐步在经济中引入越来越多的社会主义做法。
与此同时，中印关系也出现了轻微缓和。

0x00206A92.text: At around midnight on July 4, General Zia-ul-Haq ordered the 111th Brigade from Rawalpindi to encircle all the main federal government buildings, police stations and the National Assembly. After that, he ordered the police to arrest Zulfikar Bhutto, ministers and other leaders from the Pakistan People’s Party. In an address to the population on national television, General Zia stated that the National Assembly of Pakistan and the provincial assemblies were dissolved, and the Constitution of Pakistan was no longer valid. The new government headed for the Islamization of Pakistan and returned to pro-American foreign policy, which did not prevent us from maintaining close and mutually beneficial relations with them.
0x00206A92.translated:
7月4日午夜左右，齐亚·乌尔·哈克将军命令第111旅从拉瓦尔
品第出发，包围所有主要的联邦政府建筑、
警察局以及国民议会。
随后，他下令警察逮捕祖勒菲卡尔·布托以及巴基斯坦人民党部长和
其他领导人。齐亚在国家电视台向全国发表讲话时表示，
巴基斯坦国民议会和各省议会已被解散，
巴基斯坦宪法不再有效。
新的政府将着手对巴基斯坦进行伊斯兰化，
并恢复亲美的外交政策；这并不妨碍我们与他们保持密切且互利的关
系。

0x00207065.text: At the next meeting of the politburo of the CPC Central Committee, Comrade Guofen criticized some members of the reformers faction for being too hasty in the need for domestic political and economic changes, and also urged them to solve all pressing problems collectively in order to prevent a split in the party and Khrushchev's «voluntarist mistakes» in the USSR. Loyal conservatives supported our proposal «not to bring discord to the party», however, the liberal-minded wing still continues to insist on accelerating economic reforms, but nevertheless agrees to make concessions to us on the need to maintain intra-party democracy. At the same time, the people who read the transcripts of the meeting in the media were not satisfied with the slowdown in the long-awaited changes that seemed to have already begun after the defeat of the «Gang of Four».
0x00207065.translated:
在中共中央政治局下一次会议上，郭芬同志批评改革派中的一些成员，
在推进国内政治与经济变革的必要性上过于急躁，
并且还敦促他们共同解决所有迫切问题，
以防止党内分裂，避免重演苏联赫鲁晓夫的“主观随意性错误”。
忠于保守立场的同志支持我们的主张“不要把不和带进党内”，
然而，倾向自由化的一翼仍继续坚持加速经济改革；
不过，他们在维持党内民主的必要性上仍同意向我们作出让步。
与此同时，媒体上阅读会议记录的民众，
对这场人们翘首以盼、似乎在“江青集团”被击败之后已经开始的变
革却被放慢，仍然感到不满。

0x00207718.text: Not wanting to loosen up your already difficult situation, you did not dare to enter into open confrontation with the most influential representatives of the reformers, but only limited yourself to promoting the loyal members of the moderately conservative wing in order to prevent rash reforms. The reformers, in turn, accuse the chairman in an attempt to split the party and plans to create own «gang of four», from loyal people who do not represent the interests of broad sections of the population. However, the charges have not gone further.
0x00207718.translated:
你并不想让你本已艰难的处境进一步松动，
因此你不敢与改革派中最有影响力的代表展开公开对抗，
而只是着力提拔温和保守翼中忠诚的成员，
以防止鲁莽的改革。与此同时，改革派反过来指责主席，
企图分裂党，并计划从不代表广大人民利益的忠诚人士中另立自己的
“江青式四人帮”。然而，这些指控并没有进一步发展。

0x00207B5F.text: Having enlisted the support of a moderately conservative majority, you criticized the positions of reformers at the next congress of the CPC Central Committee and, using your influence in the Ministry of Public Security, began to actively interfere with the careers of various less eminent reformists and promote your people from among moderate conservatives. The people, to whom your criticism has come, remained, of course, dissatisfied, as did the reformist wing of the party. But your position is significantly strengthened.
0x00207B5F.translated:
在争取到一支相对保守的多数支持之后，
你在中共中央党校（中央委员会）下一次代表大会上批评了改革派的
主张，并凭借你在公安部的影响力，开始有力地干预各类不那么显赫
的改革派人士的仕途，同时在中间偏保守派中提拔起你自己的人。
那些受你批评波及的人当然不满，党内的改革派阵营也同样不满。
但你的地位却得到了显著加强。

0x00207F82.text: At the next meeting of the politburo, Comrade Guofeng said it was necessary to continue the planned course of socio-economic changes, and also managed to negotiate with Lee Xiannian and Ye Jianying on joining efforts and creating a kind of moderate-reformist alliance. Taking advantage of their freedom of action, the reformers are already actively promoting their people in the party with appropriate views, such as Deng Xiaoping and Zhao Ziyang. The people, noting the movement for reforms, expect them to change for the better, however, the conservative part of the party is unhappy with this state of affairs.
0x00207F82.translated:
在下一次政治局会议上，同志郭峰表示，
有必要继续执行既定的社会经济变革方针，
并且还设法与李先念、叶剑英就联合努力、
建立某种温和改革派联盟达成了协商。
利用他们所拥有的行动自由，改革派已经在党内积极推举自己的人选，
并以适当的观点加以推动，例如邓小平、
赵紫阳。人民在察觉到改革运动之后，期待它们朝着更好的方向改变；
然而，党内保守派对这种局面并不满意。

0x0020844F.text: In the Politburo and the rest of the CPC, reformist-liberal sentiments are rapidly growing, which makes the old conservatives very angry, who are afraid of losing their positions and former influence, as well as of China’s fall into revisionism. The power is still in your hands, but for how long?
0x0020844F.translated:
在政治局以及中共其他各部门中，改革—自由派的情绪正在迅速增长，
这令那些旧保守派极为愤怒：他们担心自己会失去职位和昔日的影
响力，也担心中国会滑向修正主义。
权力仍在你手中，但还能维持多久？

0x002086C8.text: Despite the completed folding of the Cultural Revolution, there seems to be no further movement towards liberalization. The people and the reform wing are disappointed.
0x002086C8.translated:
尽管文化大革命已经彻底结束，似乎并没有进一步走向自由化的动向。
民众和改革派都感到失望。

0x0020881B.text: As part of the continuation of the struggle with the excesses of the Cultural Revolution, the repressive control in China was gradually reduced slightly. The people and the reformers are satisfied, but what if something happens...
0x0020881B.translated:
作为继续纠正“文化大革命”过激现象的一部分，
中国的高压控制逐步被略微放松。
人民和改革派对此感到满意，但如果会发生什么意外……

0x002089EA.text: As part of the continuation of the struggle with the excesses of the Cultural Revolution, the repressive control in China was gradually reduced slightly, and the active struggle against traditionalism was also stopped, which marked a slight, but reduced, pressure on religion. State atheism, however, has not gone away. Despite some underground anti-state sermons of priests, the people, in general, are pleased. Hopefully this will not lead to problems.
0x002089EA.translated:
作为继续纠正“文化大革命”过激现象的一部分，
中国的高压控制被逐步略微放松，同时针对传统主义的积极斗争也被
停止了，这意味着对宗教的压力有所减轻，
但仍然存在。尽管如此，国家无神论并没有消失。
尽管有一些地下的反国家布道活动来自牧师，
但总体而言，人们是满意的。
希望这不会引发问题。

0x00208D79.text: As part of the continuation of the struggle with the excesses of the Cultural Revolution, the repressive control in China was gradually reduced slightly, and the active struggle against traditionalism was also stopped and freedom of conscience was approved while maintaining the state course on atheism and its control over religious institutions. Despite some anti-state sermons of the clergy, which, often quickly suppressed, the people, in general, are pleased. We hope this will not lead to problems and clashes of the peoples of the PRC.
0x00208D79.translated:
作为继续纠正“文化大革命”过激行为的一部分，
中国逐步略微放松了镇压性的控制；同时，
针对传统主义的积极斗争也被停止，并在维持国家在无神论方向上的
方针以及对宗教机构的控制的前提下，批准了良心自由。
尽管有些来自教士的反国家布道——往往很快就被压制——但总体而
言，民众是满意的。我们希望这不会引发中华人民共和国各族人民之
间的问题与冲突。

0x002091E0.text: Having suffered for some time and unsuccessfully trying to establish relations with the Baathist leadership, the ICP eventually decided to break. In April 1979, communist ministers withdrew from the government, the Communist Party ceased its participation in the National Front. In May 1979, the leadership of the ICP decided to withdraw from the PNPF and go to the illegal situation.
0x002091E0.translated:
在遭受了一段时间的折磨，并且多次尝试与复兴党领导层建立关系却
始终未果之后，伊拉克共产党最终决定决裂。
1979年4月，共产党部长退出政府；
共产党停止参与全国阵线。
1979年5月，伊拉克共产党领导层决定退出PNPF，
转入非法状态。

0x002094E3.text: Our condemnation expectedly led only to exacerbation of relations with Iraq and to further repression against the communists. Having suffered for some time and unsuccessfully trying to establish relations with the Baathist leadership, the ICP eventually decided to break. In April 1979, communist ministers withdrew from the government, the Communist Party ceased its participation in the National Front. In May 1979, the leadership of the ICP decided to withdraw from the PNPF and go to the illegal situation.
0x002094E3.translated:
我们本来预料到的谴责，果然只会导致同伊拉克关系的进一步恶化，
并对共产党人实施更严厉的镇压。
由于长期遭受打击却始终未能同复兴党领导层建立关系，
伊共最终决定决裂。1979年4月，共产党部长从政府中撤出；
共产党停止参加“民族阵线”。
1979年5月，伊共领导层决定退出PNPF，
转入非法状态。

0x002098E2.text: Our unofficial political pressure on both sides, backed up by the compromising information collected by the secret services and small protests against the Ba'ath, has finally borne fruit. The Baathists stopped repressions and declared their firm alliance with the ICP, which also confirmed its membership in the PNPF, refusing anti-government agitation and demands for the abolition of the state of emergency. It is clear that behind these beautiful words there is only a hidden struggle and a shaky resemblance of the alliance, but for some time such a coalition will hold on.
0x002098E2.translated:
我们对双方施加的非正式政治压力，得到了情报机构收集到的妥协性
信息的支撑，以及针对复兴党的小规模抗议，
终于结出了果实。复兴党人停止了镇压，
并宣布他们与伊斯兰共产党（ICP）之间的坚定同盟；
而ICP也确认了自己加入人民民族阵线（PNPF），
拒绝煽动反政府行动，并拒绝要求废除紧急状态。
很显然，这些漂亮话背后只有一场隐藏的较量，
以及同盟关系那摇摇欲坠的相似性；但在一段时间内，
这样的联合仍将维持下去。

0x00209D67.text: The end of the Egyptian pasha

0x00209DA3.text: We decided to actively intervene in the situation and support the unrest. Through secret channels, many weapons fell into the hands of the demonstrators, which they immediately used against the police. In Cairo and a number of other cities, real street fighting began, which resulted in many people being killed on both sides. Sadat tried to enlist the support of the United States and Israel, but this set up against him all three factions of the ASU and the command of the army, who had not forgotten the defeat of 1973. After attempting to assassinate him, Sadat fled to the American embassy in Cairo and sought political asylum. After negotiations between the demonstrators and the army command, it was decided to transfer power to the government of national unity, led by former Vice President Ali Sabri. He began a reversal of capitalist reforms, restored the unity of the ASU, broke off all ties with the United States and Israel, and had already begun negotiations to restore diplomatic relations with the USSR, China, Libya, Syria, Iraq and other socialist countries. The new president also announced Egypt’s readiness to participate in pan-Arab and pan-African integration projects, which opens up interesting prospects for us to form a broad confederation of Arab countries against the United States and their puppet in the Middle East.
0x00209DA3.translated:
我们决定积极介入局势并支持动乱。
通过秘密渠道，许多武器落入示威者手中，
他们立刻将这些武器用于对警察的攻击。
在开罗以及其他一些城市，真正的街头巷战爆发，
双方都造成了大量人员伤亡。
萨达特试图争取美国和以色列的支持，但这反而使他与ASU的三个
派系以及军队指挥部彻底对立——他们从未忘记1973年的失败。
萨达特在遭到刺杀企图后逃往开罗的美国大使馆，
并寻求政治庇护。在示威者与军队指挥部之间进行谈判后，
决定将权力移交给由前副总统阿里·萨布里领导的民族团结政府。
萨布里开始扭转资本主义改革，恢复ASU的统一，
切断与美国和以色列的一切联系，并已开始与苏联、
中国、利比亚、叙利亚、伊拉克以及其他社会主义国家恢复外交关系
的谈判。新总统还宣布埃及愿意参与泛阿拉伯与泛非洲的整合项目，
这为我们组建一个由阿拉伯国家组成的广泛邦联、
以对抗美国及其在中东的傀儡，打开了颇具吸引力的前景。

0x0020A82C.text: Not daring to intervene directly, we went the other way and began to act through Libya and Syria, having their own accounts for Sadat. The secret organization of the Libyan Jamahiriya and the Syrian Military Intelligence, with the help of our MSS and with the secret approval of the Soviet KGB, have joined forces in developing a plan to eliminate the Egyptian President. On October 25, Anwar Sadat was killed by a Libyan sniper while speaking to Egyptian protesters in Tahrir Square in Cairo. With the support of the surviving supporters of Nasserism, pardoned Ali Sabri became the new president of Egypt, but the associate of the late, Hosni Mubarak, became his prime minister. The ARE refuses to deepen reforms, turns off the most radical of them and gradually normalizes relations with Arab countries. Sabri has already resumed negotiations with the USSR on the restoration of military-technical cooperation, so that the country's course has swung to the left again - but not in our direction...
0x0020A82C.translated:
我们不敢直接干预，于是转而从利比亚和叙利亚下手，
由他们各自去处理萨达特的问题。
利比亚“人民群众国”的秘密组织与叙利亚军事情报机构，
在我方国家安全部（MSS）的协助下，
并在苏联克格勃的秘密批准之下，已经联手制定了一项消除埃及总统
的计划。10月25日，安瓦尔·萨达特在开罗塔里尔广场向埃及抗
议者讲话时，被一名利比亚狙击手击毙。
借助仍存的纳赛尔主义支持者的支持，被赦免的阿里·萨布里成为埃
及新总统，但已故霍斯尼·穆巴拉克的同僚则出任他的总理。
阿联拒绝深化改革，关闭其中最激进的部分，
并逐步与阿拉伯国家恢复正常关系。
萨布里已经重新与苏联就恢复军事技术合作展开谈判，
因此该国的路线再次向左转——但并不是朝我们的方向……

0x0020AFFD.text: Not daring to intervene directly, we went the other way and began to act through Libya and Syria, having their own accounts for Sadat. The secret organization of the Libyan Jamahiriya and the Syrian Military Intelligence, with the help of our MSS and with the secret approval of the Soviet KGB, have joined forces in developing a plan to eliminate the Egyptian President. On October 25, Anwar Sadat was killed by a Libyan sniper while speaking to Egyptian protesters in Tahrir Square in Cairo. The new president of Egypt was his associate Hosni Mubarak, who abandoned the deepening of reforms and headed for a multi-vector foreign policy, albeit with the preservation of the anti-Soviet tone. Relations between Egypt and its Arab neighbors gradually normalized.
0x0020AFFD.translated:
由于不敢直接干预，我们转而从另一条路入手，
通过利比亚和叙利亚来行动，让它们各自对萨达特采取行动。
利比亚“人民群众国”的秘密组织与叙利亚军事情报机构，
在我方MSS的协助下，并在苏联克格勃的秘密批准下，
联手制定了一项消灭埃及总统的计划。
10月25日，安瓦尔·萨达特在开罗解放广场向埃及抗议者讲话时，
被一名利比亚狙击手击毙。
埃及新总统是他的同僚胡斯尼·穆巴拉克，
他放弃了正在加深的改革进程，转而推行多方向的外交政策，
尽管在措辞上仍保留反苏的基调。
埃及与其阿拉伯邻国之间的关系逐步走向正常化。

0x0020B5F2.text: Anwar Sadat went to a number of concessions to the protesters, promising to increase subsidies to the CPG to the poor and begin rearming the Egyptian army and its training on the NATO standard, so that "no one else could take advantage of our weaknesses". This allowed him to stabilize the situation in the country. Sadat is expected to visit Israel and the final restoration of relations with it...
0x0020B5F2.translated:
安瓦尔·萨达特向抗议者作出了多项让步，
承诺向贫困者增加对CPG的补贴，并开始重新武装埃及军队、
使其训练达到北约标准，以便“没有人能够利用我们的弱点”。
这使他得以稳定国内局势。
据预计，萨达特将访问以色列，并最终恢复与以色列的关系……

0x0020B937.text: China's economy continues to grow gradually, but how soon will it pay off? Wait and see.
0x0020B937.translated: 中国的经济持续稳步增长，但它要多久才能见效？拭目以待。

0x0020B9EA.text: At the next meeting of the Political Bureau of the CPC Central Committee, a decision was made to restore the Soviet-style planning system, forcedly rejected in the 60s, a Planning Committee was set up, which should soon adopt a five-year strategy for the development of the national economy. Of course, the reformers are dissatisfied with the rollback of Zhou's reforms, the people reacted with doubt to the restoration of the old system, and the funds for transformation and the creation of bureaucracy had to be allocated.
0x0020B9EA.translated:
在中共中央政治局下一次会议上，决定恢复苏联式的计划体制——在
60年代曾被强行否定。
成立了计划委员会，该委员会应尽快制定国家经济发展的五年战略。
当然，改革派对撤回周的改革不满，民众对恢复旧体制也产生了疑虑；
同时还必须拨出用于改造与建立官僚体系的资金。

0x0020BE05.text: In accordance with the previously proclaimed course of changing socio-economic life, you, together with the most prominent reform figures, formed a special commission and began to develop a program of future economic reforms that should continue the work of Zhou Enlai. The party (or rather only its right and moderate wing) is looking forward to the decisions of the commission, and the part of the people, to which only fragmentary rumors have flown so far, are waiting for a change for the better.
0x0020BE05.translated:
根据此前所宣告的改变社会经济生活的方针，
你与最杰出的改革人物一道，成立了一个特别委员会，
并开始制定未来经济改革的方案，以继续周恩来的工作。
党（准确说是党内的右翼与温和派）正期待委员会的决定，
而迄今仅有零星传闻传到的那部分民众，
则在等待向好的变化。

0x0020C22C.text: made a decision to personally head the commission for drafting "Resolution on certain questions in the history of our party since the founding of the PRC", and appointed one of the main ideologues of the "Cultural Revolution"
0x0020C22C.translated:
决定亲自担任起草《中华人民共和国成立以来我党历史若干问题的决
议》的委员会负责人，并任命“文化大革命”的主要思想家之一

0x0020C3F5.text: as his deputy. In its assessment, the commission focuses on the work of Mao Zedong since the "Great Controversy". The personality of Mao himself is evaluated positively, however, excesses of both the right and left sense are mentioned, which, however, are not of fundamental importance in his activities. The document begins to take the form of another Maoist pamphlet of the time of the "Cultural Revolution", although it criticizes it...
0x0020C3F5.translated:
作为他的副手。委员会的评估重点放在“伟大争论”以来毛泽东的工
作。对毛本人性格的评价是正面的，但也提到了右倾与左倾两方面的
过火行为，不过这些在他的活动中并不具有根本性。
该文件开始呈现出另一种“文化大革命”时期的毛主义小册子的样式，
尽管它对其进行了批评……

0x0020C768.text: In accordance with the decision of the Politburo, the commission was headed by the old reform ideologist Deng Xiaoping. He appointed his associate Hu Yaobang as his deputy. Although both were hit by the "Cultural Revolution", they nevertheless managed to rise above resentment against Mao Zedong and impartially appreciated his period. Mao himself received the same assessment, which in his articles "On the historical experience of the dictatorship of the proletariat", "More on the historical experience of the dictatorship of the proletariat" and "On The Question Of Stalin" he gave to Stalin - "Merit and error Stalin is in the ratio of 70 to 30", while all the major failures (like "Great Leap") are dumped on the late Lin Biao and Kang Sheng, who gave " wrong advice" to Chairman Mao. Deng Xiaoping made remarks to editors nine times about the text («not good», «needs to be processed», «too voluminous», «too sad», etc.). Perhaps, we completely guessed with the choice and "Resolution on certain questions in the history of our party since the founding of the PRC" will be balanced and can serve as the first step to rethink our past for the sake of a bright future...
0x0020C768.translated:
根据政治局的决定，委员会由老牌改革思想家邓小平担任负责人。
他任命同僚胡耀邦为副手。
尽管两人都遭受过“文化大革命”的打击，
但他们仍设法超越对毛泽东的怨恨，对他的那段时期作出了相对公允
的评价。毛泽东本人也得到了同样的评价：
在他关于《无产阶级专政的历史经验》《关于无产阶级专政的历史经
验的再探讨》以及《论斯大林问题》等文章中，
他对斯大林的判断是——“功过斯大林七三开”，
而所有主要的失败（如“大跃进”）则被归咎于晚年的林彪和康生，
正是他们给了毛主席“错误的建议”。
邓小平还就这份文本向编辑们作了九次修改意见（“不好”“需要加
工”“太冗长”“太悲伤”等）。
也许，我们的选择完全猜中了，而《中华人民共和国成立以来我党历
史若干问题的决议》将会保持平衡，并能作为为了光明未来而重新思
考我们过去的第一步……

0x0020D09B.text: Hua Guofeng, despite objections from both the right and left wing of the CCP, appointed the disgraced party member of the liberal views Peng Zhen as head of the commission. He appointed Zhao Ziyang as his deputy, whose views were not too different from his. Both were seriously affected during the "Cultural Revolution" and now do not particularly hide the desire to recoup for their experiences. The document, compiled by them, assesses the socialist period in the history of China as "the time of the feudal-fascist dictatorship of Mao Zedong, who produced mass terror, destroyed honest communists such as Liu Shaoqi and Peng Dehuai, and completely subjugated the party of his will by establishing a personality cult in the PRC". He recommends "returning to the sources, to Marx, Lenin, Chen Duxiu and Wang Ming, reject the anti-Marxist cult of Mao Zedong’s personality and brand their totalitarian past for the sake of building China’s bright socialist future". Something I do not think that this Chinese copy of the Khrushchev "secret report" of 1956 will appeal to both ordinary party members and the people...
0x0020D09B.translated:
华国锋尽管遭到中共内右翼与左翼两方面的反对，
仍任命持自由主义观点、已被打入冷宫的彭真为委员会负责人。
他任命赵紫阳为副手，而赵紫阳的观点与他也并不太不同。
两人都在“文化大革命”期间遭受了严重影响，
如今也并不太掩饰想要为自己的遭遇讨回公道的愿望。
由他们编写的这份文件，将中国历史中的社会主义时期评为：
“毛泽东的封建法西斯式独裁时期——他制造大规模恐怖，
摧毁像刘少奇、彭德怀这样的正直共产党员，
并通过在中华人民共和国建立个人崇拜而使党完全屈从于他的意志。
”文件还主张“回到源头，回到马克思、
列宁、陈独秀和王明，摒弃反马克思的毛泽东个人崇拜，
并为建设中国光明的社会主义未来而对他们的极权主义过去加以定性
”。我认为，这份对1956年赫鲁晓夫“秘密报告”的中国式抄本，
恐怕不会让普通党员和民众都买账……

0x0020D954.text: |On the night after the document was adopted, Mao was removed from the Mausoleum, and the next day the building was demolished. On the site of the Mausoleum will be built a museum of Chen Duxiu, the 1st Secretary of the Central Bureau of the CPC, who was accused of indecision and, later, sided with the Trotskyist opposition.
0x0020D954.translated:
|文件通过后的当晚，毛被从陵墓中移走；
次日，陵墓建筑被拆毁。
陵墓旧址将兴建陈独秀纪念馆——中共中央局第一书记，
曾被指控优柔寡断，后来又站到了托洛茨基主义反对派一边。

0x0020DBE3.text: The fate of the Panchen Lama

0x0020DC1D.text: The letter went away from you with the following resolution: "The merits of the 10th Panchen Lama before the Tibetan and Chinese peoples are great, but the blow he struck on the international friendship of Tibet and China is even greater. His release is inopportune and dangerous". In March 1979, a Chinese dissident, Wei Jingsheng, published a letter condemning the conditions of the Panchen Lama's prison in Jincheng Prison, after which he was transported to Lhasa and changed his preventive measure to house arrest. However, the 10th Panchen Lama never came to freedom until his death on January 28, 1989...
0x0020DC1D.translated:
这封信离开你时附带了如下决议：“第十世班禅喇嘛在藏族和中国人
民面前的功绩是巨大的，但他对西藏与中国国际友谊所造成的打击更
为巨大。他的释放时机不当且危险。
”1979年3月，中国异议人士魏京生发表了一封信，
谴责班禅喇嘛在金城监狱的囚禁条件；之后他被转送到拉萨，
并将防范措施改为居家监禁。
然而，第十世班禅喇嘛直到1989年1月28日去世，
也从未获得自由……

0x0020E0E4.text: Choekyi Gyaltsen flatly refused to fulfill this condition, citing the extremely repressive nature of the attitude of our state to the Tibetan clergy. Well, this is his choice - let him stay in Jincheng until the end of his earthly existence...
0x0020E0E4.translated:
却吉坚赞断然拒绝履行这一条件，理由是我国对藏传佛教僧侣的态度
极其压迫。好吧，这是他的选择——让他在金城待到尘世生命的尽头……

0x0020E2CD.text: Choekyi Gyaltsen agreed with this condition by asking to transfer to comrade
0x0020E2CD.translated: 却吉坚赞同意了这一条件，并请求调到同志

0x0020E36A.text: , that, in general, he approves of our state’s policy regarding the Tibetan clergy and undertakes to no longer take part in spiritual life. After his release, he traveled to China, married a soldier Li Jye, and in 1982 he was fully rehabilitated and received permission to return to Lhasa. He was even elected to the NPC from the Tibetan AR.
0x0020E36A.translated:
……总体上，他赞同我国关于藏传佛教僧俗的政策，
并保证不再参与宗教活动。
获释后，他赴中国，结婚嫁给军人李杰；
1982年他被彻底平反，并获准返回拉萨。
他甚至还当选为西藏自治区全国人大代表。

0x0020E617.text: The letter went away from you with the following resolution: "10th Panchen Lama spent enough time in custody to consider and reflect on his actions and mistakes. I agree to release him soon and allow him to return to Tibet, but under observation". Upon returning to Lhasa, Choekyi Gyaltsen reburied the  remains of the previous Panchen-lamas from the graves that were destroyed during the destruction of the Tashi Lhunpo monastery in 1959, however, in general, behaved quietly and made contact with the runaway 14th Dalai Lama or his supporters did not try. Therefore, in 1983, the observation of him was filmed. The pardon of the Panchen Lama was well received by the people, the West and Tibetan emigration.
0x0020E617.translated:
这封信随你们的决议一并送出：“第十世班禅喇嘛在羁押中已足够时
间，足以反思其行为与过失。
我同意尽快释放他并允许其返回西藏，但须置于观察之下。
”回到拉萨后，确吉坚赞将1959年塔尔寺（塔什伦布寺）
遭毁时被毁坏的前任班禅喇嘛遗骨重新安葬；
但总体上他表现得很安分，也没有去接触逃亡的第十四世达赖喇嘛或
其支持者。因此，1983年对他的观察被拍成了片。
班禅喇嘛获赦，受到人民、西方以及藏人流亡群体的普遍欢迎。

0x0020EBA4.text: On his return to Lhasa, 10th Panchen Lama officially announced that he had no complaints against the Chinese authorities and that the punishment he had suffered was a fair and very important lesson for him, which brought him even closer to enlightenment. He took up the reburial of the remains of the previous Panchen-lamas from the graves that were destroyed during the destruction of the Tashi Lhunpo monastery in 1959, actively participated in charitable activities, visited (with the consent of the Soviet leadership) the Kalmyk, Buryat and Tuva Autonomous Soviet Socialist Republics, where he helped establish cultural ties Tibetan AR with these autonomous republics. The people and the international community are satisfied.
0x0020EBA4.translated:
回到拉萨后，第十世班禅喇嘛正式宣布：
他对中国当局没有任何怨言；他所受的惩罚是公平且极其重要的一课，
使他更接近觉悟。他承担起1959年塔什伦布寺遭毁时被毁坏的
前任班禅喇嘛遗骨的重新安葬工作，积极参加慈善活动；
并在苏联领导层同意下访问了卡尔梅克、
布里亚特和图瓦等自治苏维埃社会主义共和国，
帮助建立西藏自治区与这些自治共和国之间的文化联系。
人民与国际社会都感到满意。

0x0020F15B.text: 10th Panchen Lama  never forgave the Chinese authorities for the offense he suffered. Immediately after returning to Lhasa, he began to speak with inflammatory speeches (for example: "Thanks to the release, of course, there was a development, but the price paid for this development was more than the benefits"), to establish contacts with supporters of the Dalai Lama , send messages to the world community with a criticism of the situation in China and in the Tibet AR in particular. Finally, when the Supreme People’s Court ruled to arrest the Panchen Lama, he fled to Bhutan, from where he moved to India and became part of the so-called "Tibetan government in exile". The leadership of India refused to give him to us, so now the camp of the Tibetan separatists is replenished with an extremely important figure. This clearly does not turn out to our advantage...
0x0020F15B.translated:
第十世班禅喇嘛从未原谅他所遭受的那一切。
回到拉萨的当即，他就开始发表煽动性言论（例如：
“当然，获释带来了发展，但为这发展付出的代价大于收益”），
并着手与达赖喇嘛的支持者建立联系，
向世界共同体发出信息，批评中国以及尤其是西藏自治区的局势。
最后，当最高人民法院作出逮捕班禅喇嘛的裁决时，
他逃往不丹；随后又转到印度，成为所谓“藏人流亡政府”的一员。
印度领导层拒绝把他交给我们，因此藏族分裂势力阵营如今又补充了
一位极其重要的人物。
这显然对我们不利……

0x0020F826.text: On October 28, 1977, the guards of the Jincheng Prison found Panchen-Lamu X on the floor of his cell without signs of life. In the morning of the same day, under the guise of the injection of a tonic substance, he was injected with a special poison, which provoked myocardial infarction. Although the newspaper "Sitszan zhibao" (an organ of the Tibetan Council of People’s Representatives) published an official communique in which the cause of death was called a heart attack, few people believed it. The autonomy has already openly said that the "Panchen Lama was killed by the MSS for disagreeing with the Chinese annexation of Tibet"... The head of the committee on the search for the new Panchen Lama, appointed by our approval, secretly maintained contact with the fugitive Dalai Lama that did not hide from the attention of the MSS. Rinpoche was arrested and replaced by Sengchen Lobsang Gyaltsen, who was a political opponent of both the Dalai Lama and the late Panchen Lama. He achieved the outcome we needed - on November 11 a new 11th Panchen Lama was declared. "Buddhism made a solemn oath to the state and society to protect the country and work for the good of the people. Chinese society is a favorable environment for the Buddhist faith", Norbu said. He also praised his predecessor for the "outstanding contribution to strengthening the unity of the country and the solidarity of its people". However, 14th Dalai Lama and his so-called "Tibetan government in exile" declared the new Panchen Lama XI a little baby from Tibetan territory. We had to send him to a state orphanage... Tibetan clergy sabotage the activities of the new Panchen Lama and support the Dalai Lama's appointee, separatist sentiments spread among them...
0x0020F826.translated:
1977年10月28日，金城监狱的看守发现班禅喇嘛X倒在牢房
地上，已无生命迹象。
同日早晨，借口注射“补品”，实则给他注射了一种特殊毒药，
引发心肌梗死。尽管《西藏日报》（西藏人民代表大会机关报）
刊登了官方通告，称死因是心脏病发作，
但相信的人并不多。自治区方面早已公开说：
“班禅喇嘛因不同意中国吞并西藏而被中共中央情报部门（MSS）
杀害”……由我们批准任命的寻找新班禅喇嘛委员会负责人，
暗中与逃亡的达赖喇嘛保持联系，而达赖喇嘛并未躲过中共中央情报
部门的注意。仁波切被捕，随后由桑臣·罗桑坚赞顶替；
他是达赖喇嘛与已故班禅喇嘛的共同政治对手。
他达成了我们所需要的结果——11月11日宣布了新的第十一世班
禅喇嘛。诺布说：“佛教向国家和社会作出庄严誓言：
保卫国家、为人民的利益而工作。
中国社会是佛教信仰的有利环境。
”他还称赞前任对“加强国家统一、增进人民团结所作出的杰出贡献
”。然而，第十四世达赖喇嘛及其所谓“藏人流亡政府”却宣称新任
第十一世班禅喇嘛只是“藏地的一名小孩”。
我们只好把他送进国家孤儿院……
藏传僧侣破坏新班禅喇嘛的活动，并支持达赖喇嘛的任命者；
分裂情绪在他们中间蔓延……

0x002105E7.text: Due to the fall in the popularity of Gandhi and the INC, and also because the fight against the state of emergency in the eyes of the population made them kin with the freedom fighters of India from British domination, Janata party managed to bypass the INC. Morarji Desai became the new prime minister. The government formed by him restored diplomatic relations with the PRC, improved relations with Pakistan, and defended the Indian nuclear policy on the world stage. A tribunal was established to investigate abuses during a state of emergency, which, however, failed to bring Gandhi to justice. However, in the new ruling party, there is already an active split between its members regarding the future vector of the country's development.
0x002105E7.translated:
由于甘地与印度国民大会党（INC）的声望下跌，
再加上在民众眼中反对紧急状态的斗争使他们与印度反抗英国殖民统
治的自由斗士“同气相连”，人民党（Janata）
得以绕开INC。莫拉尔吉·德赛成为新任总理。
他组建的政府恢复了同中华人民共和国的外交关系，
改善了同巴基斯坦的关系，并在世界舞台上为印度的核政策辩护。
成立了一个法庭调查紧急状态期间的滥权行为，
但却未能把甘地送上法庭追究责任。
然而，在新的执政党内部，关于国家未来发展方向，
其成员之间已经出现了积极的分裂。

0x00210BB8.text: Due to the fall in the popularity of Gandhi and the INC, our active support and also because the fight against the state of emergency in the eyes of the population made them kin with the freedom fighters of India from British domination, Janata party managed to bypass the INC. Morarji Desai became the new prime minister. The government formed by him restored diplomatic relations with the PRC, improved relations with Pakistan, and defended the Indian nuclear policy on the world stage. A tribunal was established to investigate abuses during a state of emergency, which, however, failed to bring Gandhi to justice. However, in the new ruling party, there is already an active split between its members regarding the future vector of the country's development. We hope that our good relations with Janata party will allow us to save it from collapse.
0x00210BB8.translated:
由于甘地与INC的声望下跌，再加上我们积极的支持，
以及在民众眼中反对紧急状态的斗争使他们与印度反抗英国殖民统治
的自由斗士“同气相连”，人民党（Janata）
得以绕开INC。莫拉尔吉·德赛成为新任总理。
他组建的政府恢复了同中华人民共和国的外交关系，
改善了同巴基斯坦的关系，并在世界舞台上为印度的核政策辩护。
成立了一个法庭调查紧急状态期间的滥权行为，
但却未能把甘地送上法庭追究责任。
然而，在新的执政党内部，关于国家未来发展方向，
其成员之间已经出现了积极的分裂。
我们希望同人民党保持良好关系，能让我们把它从崩溃边缘挽救回来。

0x00211263.text: Despite past disagreements with us, Gandhi gratefully accepted our help, only thanks to which INC managed to bypass the opposition and win. Indira Gandhi continued to be prime minister, diplomatic relations between India and China were restored, although there is still noticeable tension between us, and territorial disputes are not settled. Hopefully, the INC will go on a further rapprochement and the USSR will not prevent it.
0x00211263.translated:
尽管过去曾与我们有过分歧，甘地仍心怀感激地接受了我们的帮助—
—正是因为这份帮助，INC才得以绕开反对派并赢得胜利。
英迪拉·甘地继续担任总理；尽管我们之间仍有明显紧张，
且领土争端尚未解决，但印度与中国的外交关系已得以恢复。
希望INC能够继续进一步缓和，而苏联不会阻挠。

0x002115E8.text: Protests and strikes in Iran continue without our participation.
0x002115E8.translated: 伊朗的抗议与罢工在没有我们参与的情况下仍在继续。

0x0021166B.text: We were able to establish contacts with Tudeh Party of Iran and other smaller communist, Maoist and left-nationalist organizations, having agreed on support from our side. The first step has been taken, but we must not forget to periodically send them new help.
0x0021166B.translated:
我们得以同伊朗的图德党以及其他较小的共产党、
毛主义和左翼民族主义组织建立联系，并就由我们方面提供支持达成
一致。第一步已经迈出，但我们不能忘记要定期向他们再提供新的帮
助。

0x00211878.text: We were able to establish contacts with Islamic movements in Iran and even with Khomeini himself in Paris. Not to say that they were delighted with such patrons, however, apparently they considered us a lesser evil than the USSR, the USA and the Shah. The first step has been taken, but we must not forget to periodically send them new help.
0x00211878.translated:
我们得以同伊朗的伊斯兰运动建立联系，
甚至在巴黎还与霍梅尼本人取得了接触。
话虽如此，他们未必对这样的“靠山”感到高兴，
但显然他们认为我们比苏联、美国和国王（沙阿）
更“次要的恶”。第一步已经迈出，但我们不能忘记要定期向他们再
提供新的帮助。

0x00211B25.text: We were able to establish contacts with the ruling dynasty Pahlavi and Shah Mohammad Reza Pahlavi, who gladly accepted our help in the fight against the opposition. Our agents, together with the Iranian secret police SAVAK, are now engaged in the disclosure of opposition networks and the capture of their members. The first step has been taken, but we must not forget to periodically send the shah new help.
0x00211B25.translated:
我们得以同统治王朝巴列维以及沙阿穆罕默德·礼萨·巴列维建立联
系；他们欣然接受我们在打击反对派斗争中的帮助。
我们的特工目前正与伊朗秘密警察萨瓦克（SAVAK）
一道，致力于揭露反对派网络并抓捕其成员。
第一步已经迈出，但我们不能忘记要定期向沙阿再提供新的帮助。

0x00211E58.text: We managed to establish contacts with the National Front and other democratic organizations (including Islamic democrats) and agreed with them to provide our assistance. The first step has been taken, but we must not forget to periodically send them new help..
0x00211E58.translated:
我们成功同民族阵线以及其他民主组织（包括伊斯兰民主派）
建立了联系，并与他们达成协议：由我们提供援助。
第一步已经迈出，但我们不能忘记要定期向他们再提供新的帮助。

0x0021208F.text: In November 1978, Vietnam joined the CMEA, which led to a further deterioration in our relations. The anti-Vietnamese sentiments are already actively maturing in the CPC. Hopefully, this will not result in a large scale conflict.
0x0021208F.translated:
1978年11月，越南加入经互会（CMEA），
导致我们之间关系进一步恶化。
中共内部反越情绪正在积极酝酿成熟。
希望这不会引发大规模冲突。

0x0021225C.text: Our intervention and the mobilization of supporters of a more moderate course in Vietnam ultimately forced Le Duan and the CPV leadership to postpone the planned accession to the CMEA for an indefinite period and pursue a more balanced foreign policy. The Soviet Union, of course, was not happy, but it helped us at least temporarily avoid further rapprochement of Vietnam with the USSR.
0x0021225C.translated:
我们的介入以及动员越南内部主张更温和路线的支持者，
最终迫使黎笋与越南共产党（CPV）领导层将原定加入经互会的计
划无限期推迟，并转而奉行更平衡的外交政策。
当然，苏联并不高兴，但至少在一段时间内，
它帮助我们避免越南与苏联进一步靠拢。

0x00212565.text: It doesn't matter if a cat is black or white...
0x00212565.translated: 不管黑猫白猫，抓到老鼠就是好猫……

0x002125C5.text: At the current plenary session of the CPC Central Committee, with  almost universal approval (the few conservatives had almost no power), the beginning of market reforms was announced and so-called "The policy of reform and openness" was approved, implying China’s access to the world market and the restructuring of the economy on market principles. Despite the fact that nominally the country still heads
0x002125C5.translated:
在中共中央委员会当前全体会议上，几乎全票赞成（少数保守派几乎
没有什么权力），宣布启动市场改革，并通过所谓“改革开放”政策，
意味着中国将进入世界市场，并按市场原则重组经济。
尽管名义上国家仍由

0x002128F6.text: , virtually all of the power now has
0x002128F6.translated: ，实际上现在几乎所有权力都掌握在

0x00212942.text: who is ready to lead the country into a bright market future.
0x00212942.translated: 手中——他已准备好带领国家走向光明的市场未来。

0x002129C0.text: While you were delay the meeting with demagogy, the staff of the MSS, arrived at the building and arrested the majority of the reformers. Following this, a wave of arrests, propaganda and personnel changes aimed at hounding reformers swept across China.
0x002129C0.translated:
就在你以花言巧语拖延会议之际，中共中央情报部门（MSS）
的人员赶到大楼，逮捕了大多数改革派。
随后，一股以追捕改革派为目标的逮捕浪潮、
宣传攻势与人事更替席卷全国。

0x00212BBF.text: himself is now under arrest, but you still managed to keep the power by upholding your policy, although this caused widespread discontent in the party and the people.
0x00212BBF.translated:
他本人如今也被拘押了，但你仍凭借坚持自己的政策而保住了权力，
尽管这在党内和人民中引起了广泛不满。

0x00212D10.text: At the current plenary session of the CPC Central Committee, with your support and almost universal approval (the few conservatives had almost no power), the beginning of market reforms was announced and so-called "The policy of reform and openness" was approved, implying China’s access to the world market and the restructuring of the economy on market principles.
0x00212D10.translated:
在中共中央委员会当前全体会议上，在你的支持下并获得几乎全票赞
成（少数保守派几乎没有什么权力），宣布启动市场改革，
并通过所谓“改革开放”政策，意味着中国将进入世界市场，
并按市场原则重组经济。

0x00212FF1.text: nevertheless managed to retain power, thanks to the fact that he had not previously expressed himself obviously in opposition to the reforms and in time had gone over to the side of reformers. However, can he continue to retain it in the course of reforms?
0x00212FF1.translated:
他却仍设法保住了权力——因为他此前并未明显表示反对改革，
并且及时转到了改革派一边。
不过，在改革进程中，他还能继续保住吗？

0x0021323C.text: It was decided to reduce the role of the central government in the management of state-owned enterprises, to encourage local initiatives on them, to actively introduce market-based business methods and to expand the rights of private and cooperative enterprises.|Discontent with this policy came from no one expected: In Albania, Enver Hoxha sharply criticized our policy for revisionism and the departure from Marxism, breaking off everything connect with us. Well, he wants to sit in isolation - his right.
0x0021323C.translated:
决定削弱中央政府在国有企业管理中的作用，
鼓励地方在这方面的主动性，积极引入市场化经营方式，
并扩大私营与合作企业的权利。
|对这项政策的不满，出乎意料地来自某些人：
在阿尔巴尼亚，霍查（恩维尔·霍查）尖锐批评我们的政策是修正主
义、背离马克思主义，并与我们断绝一切联系。
好吧，他想坐在孤立里——这是他的权利。

0x0021364D.text: We did not respond to the Hungarian events. Kadar launched an attack on Biszku and his supporters. It seems they and Biszku himself will soon be waiting for resignation, and in their place Kadar will promote young reformers.
0x0021364D.translated:
我们对匈牙利的事态没有作出反应。
卡达尔（卡达尔）对比兹库（比斯库）及其支持者发动了打击。
看来他们——连比兹库本人——很快就要等着辞职了，
而卡达尔将提拔年轻改革派顶上。

0x00213810.text: Thanks to the timely assistance of our intelligence services, Biszku realized that Andropov had betrayed him, and urgently, with the help of our agents, changed the coup plans and spoke almost instantly, isolating the Kadar supporters by the Workers' Militia and holding an extraordinary congress of the Central Committee of the HSWP, where Kadaru was reminded of his cooperation with Imre Nagy and initial support for the uprising of 1956, as well as a departure from the principles of Marxism and the growing external debt of the country. Kadar was removed from all posts and excluded from the HSWP, Bela Biszku became the new general secretary, who began returning the economy to central planning, began cleansing against cadist reformers, and also began to pursue a more independent foreign policy, having already concluded several useful contracts with us. The USSR, of course, was not happy, but having understood that everything was calm in Hungary, confined theyself to dry comments.
0x00213810.translated:
多亏我们情报部门的及时协助，比兹库意识到安德罗波夫出卖了他；
在我们特工的帮助下，他紧急改动政变计划，
并几乎立刻采取行动：通过工人民兵把卡达尔支持者隔离起来，
并召开了匈牙利社会主义工人党（HSWP）
中央委员会的非常代表大会。
在会上，向卡达尔提醒他曾与伊姆雷·纳吉合作、
并在1956年起义初期给予支持；同时也指出他背离马克思主义原
则、以及国家外债不断增长。
卡达尔被撤去所有职务，并被开除出HSWP。
贝拉·比兹库成为新的总书记；他开始把经济拉回中央计划体制，
开始清洗“卡达尔式”的改革派，并且开始奉行更独立的外交政策—
—已经与我们签订了几份颇有用的合同。
当然，苏联并不高兴，但在明白匈牙利一切都已平静之后，
只能作些干巴巴的评论。

0x00213FD1.text: Thanks to our operational information and support, Biszku was able to quickly gather around him conservative communists, stalinists, nationalists and other disgruntled Kadar policies and brought his supporters to street demonstrations, simultaneously with the help of the Workers Police, taking control of the administrative buildings and arrested Kadar and his supporters. However, this street performances did not stop. Sensing the instability of his power, Biszku then tried to calm the demonstrators, to whom anti-Soviet elements had already begun to join, then to use them to their advantage. The USSR bombarded Budapest with calls to restore order in the country and restore law. However, tired of fruitless negotiations and seeing that Biszku is increasingly inclined to receive direct support from China with the possibility of withdrawing from the Warsaw Pact, the USSR sent troops into Hungary, who arrested the failed coup, freed the former leadership and reassured the people. Having decided not to take any more risks, the Soviet leadership did not return Kadar to the post of general secretary (he retired for health reasons), but put the pro-Soviet moderate Janos Pap there, who began to return to the Soviet planned system and cut ties with the West, pursuing an increasingly pro-Soviet policy.
0x00213FD1.translated:
多亏我们提供的行动情报与支持，比兹库得以迅速聚拢一批保守派共
产党人、斯大林主义者、民族主义者以及其他对卡达尔政策不满的人，
并把他的支持者带上街头示威；同时在工人警察的协助下，
控制行政大楼，逮捕卡达尔及其支持者。
然而，这场街头表演并未就此停止。
察觉自己权力的不稳，比兹库随后试图安抚那些示威者——而反苏势
力已开始加入其中——再转而利用他们为自己所用。
苏联向布达佩斯发出一轮又一轮呼吁，要求恢复国内秩序、
恢复法制。但在厌倦了无果的谈判、并看到比兹库越来越倾向于接受
来自中国的直接支持，且有可能退出华沙条约的情况下，
苏联派兵进入匈牙利：逮捕了失败的政变者，
释放了原领导层，并安抚了民众。
苏联领导层决定不再冒险，便没有把卡达尔再推回总书记岗位（他因
健康原因退下），而是扶植亲苏的温和派亚诺什·帕普（János
 Pápp）上台；他开始把匈牙利拉回苏联式计划体制，
并切断同西方的联系，奉行日益亲苏的政策。

0x00214A10.text: Due to the fact that we told him about the betrayal of Andropov, Biszku realized that in Hungary he was waiting, at best, for his resignation with the ban on criticizing the Kadar course. He decided to take advantage of our proposal and, together with his family and supporters who wished to follow him, fled to China, where he began to widely criticize Hungarian and even sometimes Soviet revisionism in our media. This made our people think and increased our influence in the eyes of the world left movement, but spoiled our already not the best relations with the USSR. In Hungary, young reformers continue to come to the place of departed conservatives with the support of Kadar.
0x00214A10.translated:
由于我们告诉他安德罗波夫的背叛，比兹库意识到在匈牙利，
自己最多也不过是被迫辞职，并被禁止批评卡达尔路线。
他决定利用我们的提议：携同家人以及愿意追随他的支持者逃往中国。
在我们媒体上，他开始广泛批判匈牙利，
甚至有时也批判苏联的修正主义。
这使我们的人民有所思考，并在世界左翼运动的眼中扩大了我们的影
响力，但也破坏了我们与苏联本就不算最好的关系。
在匈牙利，年轻改革派继续在卡达尔的支持下顶替离去的保守派。

0x00214F69.text: Thanks to the fact that we had informed him of Andropov's betrayal, Bisku realised that at best he would be dismissed in Hungary with a ban on criticism of Kádár's course, so he decided to carry out a pre-emptive coup without any preparation and in extreme haste. As a result, the extraordinary congress of the MSZMP organised by Bisku's group resulted in a confrontation between several forces, and the facade of monolithic and unanimous party unity collapsed. As a result, although Biscu's group and he himself were expelled from the party for factionalism by a majority vote, we and many other newspapers of communist parties outside the control of Soviet influence managed to print articles about what had happened at the congress. As a consequence, Kadar was forced to take the blame for the disgrace of the whole party and facilitated the transfer of power to a promising, in his opinion, young communist Károly Grosz. Having come to power and lacking sufficient authority, Grosz tries to form a collective leadership of the MSZMP aimed at moderate, gradual reforms. Imre Pozsgay, a prominent party reformer, became the ideology secretary. Without formally attacking the ideological foundations, Požgai gradually relaxed the ideological control, allowed some public discussions and initiatives and thus gained popularity, primarily among the intelligentsia. At the same time Károly Grosz himself was actively engaged in the fight against economic problems and for this purpose Hungary joined the IMF (for the sake of another loan, despite Moscow's protests, becoming the first COMECON country to join the IMF), legalised small businesses and joint ventures between the state and foreign corporations. Hungary started to follow a new course...
0x00214F69.translated:
由于我们已告知他安德罗波夫的背叛，比斯库意识到在匈牙利，
自己最多也就是被撤职，并被禁止批评卡达尔路线；
因此他决定不作任何准备、极端仓促地发动先发制人的政变。
结果，由比斯库集团组织的MSZMP非常代表大会引发了数股力量
之间的对抗，“党内铁板一块、步调一致”的外观随之崩塌。
于是，尽管比斯库集团及他本人都因派别活动而在多数票表决中被开
除出党，我们以及许多其他不受苏联影响控制的共产党报纸，
还是设法刊登了关于大会上所发生事情的文章。
后果是：卡达尔被迫为全党的丢脸承担责任，
并促成了权力向一位在他看来前途可期的年轻共产党人卡罗伊·格罗
什（Károly Grosz）移交。
格罗什上台后由于权威不足，试图组建面向温和、
渐进改革的MSZMP集体领导。
党内著名改革派伊姆雷·波兹加伊（Imre Pozsgay）
出任宣传思想书记。在不正式攻击意识形态根基的前提下，
波兹加伊逐步放松意识形态控制，允许一些公开讨论与倡议，
从而赢得了人气，主要是在知识分子中间。
同时，卡罗伊·格罗什本人也积极投入到对经济问题的斗争；
为此，匈牙利加入了国际货币基金组织（IMF）
（为再争取一笔贷款，尽管莫斯科提出抗议，
匈牙利仍成为第一个加入IMF的经互会国家），
并对小型企业以及国家与外国公司之间的合资企业予以合法化。
匈牙利开始走上新的道路……

0x00215D32.text: In the old manner, the MS and the police began to tear big-character poster and search for underground "samizdat", and the CPC again passed a wave of purges from reformers (which however did not go so smoothly due to the dominance of the reformers themselves in many CPC structures). The people and reformers are unhappy, but the wave of protests has stopped. Hopefully, now the discontented will not move to more radical actions.
0x00215D32.translated:
一如既往，中央情报部门（MS）和警察开始撕毁大字报，
并搜查地下“萨米兹达特”（samizdat）；
中共又掀起了一轮对改革派的清洗（不过由于改革派在许多中共机
构中占据主导，这次并不那么顺利）。
人民与改革派都不满，但抗议浪潮已经停了。
希望现在不满者不会转向更激进的行动。

0x00216091.text: The media controlled by us engaged in the active release of our articles refuting the theses of the reformers, and in the CPC meeting rooms the controversy between the left and right wing flared up again. Of course, reformers also responded with new articles and magazines. The population followed your controversy with interest, and although, because of the populism of the reformers, the majority sympathies were on their side, your position also had its supporters. But the fact of such a broad discussion of political issues (for the first time since the campaign "Hundred Flowers") strengthened the confidence of the people in the inevitability of democratic change. Who knows what it will turn out...
0x00216091.translated:
由我们控制的媒体积极发表文章，反驳改革派的论点；
而在中共会议室里，左右两派之间的争论又一次燃起。
当然，改革派也用新的文章和杂志作出回应。
群众带着兴趣关注你们的争论；尽管由于改革派的民粹主义，
大多数同情站在他们一边，但你们的立场也同样有支持者。
然而，这样广泛地讨论政治问题（自“百花齐放”运动以来第一次）
增强了人民对民主变革必然性的信心。
谁知道最后会变成什么样……

0x00216618.text: No special reaction on your part. The fights between the left and right wing mostly do not go beyond the walls of the CPС meeting rooms, our media continue to speak out in your support and criticize the reformers and theses of their supporters (it turns out media is not particularly good), and the students continue to hang big-character poster. Well, at least not see large-scale discontent.
0x00216618.translated:
你这边没有什么特别反应。
左右两派的争斗大多还局限在中共会议室的墙内；
我们的媒体继续为你们摇旗呐喊，批评改革派及其支持者的那些论点
（看来媒体也并不怎么灵）；学生们则继续张贴大字报。
好吧，至少还看不到大规模的不满。

0x0021694F.text: We did not respond to the April revolution and the events in the PDPA. The party, of course, is dissatisfied with such passivity. In the DRA, the Khalqists, who gained authority during the revolution, are actively trying to take away share of power from Parcham.
0x0021694F.translated:
我们没有回应“四月革命”以及PDPA（阿富汗人民民主党）
内部的事态。当然，党对这种消极被动很不满意。
在阿富汗民主共和国（DRA）里，革命中获得权力的“哈勒克派”
（Khalqists）正积极试图从“帕尔查姆派”（Parch
am）手中夺取一部分权力。

0x00216B5E.text: Being dissatisfied with such an expansion of Soviet influence, the leadership of the CPC decided to extend feasible support to the opposition in Afghanistan loyal to the PRC. Arms and undercover assistance were sent to the Maoists, the left opposition, moderate Islamists and other opposition forces. Let's hope it keeps Soviet expansion.
0x00216B5E.translated:
鉴于对苏联影响力这种扩张的不满，中共领导层决定对阿富汗境内那
些忠于中华人民共和国的反对派提供力所能及的支持。
武器与秘密援助被送往毛主义者、左翼反对派、
温和派伊斯兰主义者以及其他反对力量。
希望这能遏制苏联的扩张。

0x00216E05.text: After long disputes, it was decided to establish relations with the new government of Afghanistan, and especially with the Khalq faction in the PDPA. This turned out to be simpler than we thought, because the PDPA did not take part in the Soviet-Chinese controversy and, after coming to power, nominally proclaimed a policy of non-alignment. Khalqists appreciated our support and, apparently, use their growing power to put pressure on Parcham and to get a monopoly on power in the DRA.
0x00216E05.translated:
经过长期争论，决定同阿富汗新政府建立关系，
尤其是同PDPA中的<color=red>喀尔克</color>派建立关系。
结果比我们想的更简单，因为PDPA并未卷入苏中争论，
而且上台后名义上宣称奉行不结盟政策。
<color=red>喀尔克</color>派感激我们的支持，显然还在利用其日益增长的力量向<color=red>帕尔查
姆</color>施压，并在DRA争取对权力的垄断。

0x002171D4.text: After long disputes, it was decided to establish relations with the new government of Afghanistan, and especially with the Parcham faction in the PDPA. This turned out to be simpler than we thought, because the PDPA did not take part in the Soviet-Chinese controversy and, after coming to power, nominally proclaimed a policy of non-alignment. Thanks to our support, the Parcham succeeds in overcoming the growing pressure from Khalq, in particular, the Parchamists, together with some Khalqists, have been able to slow down the career path of Hafizullah Amin, a close ally of Taraki, who does not being trusted by the party.
0x002171D4.translated:
经过长期争论，决定同阿富汗新政府建立关系，
尤其是同PDPA中的<color=red>帕尔查姆</color>派建立关系。
结果比我们想的更简单，因为PDPA并未卷入苏中争论，
而且上台后名义上宣称奉行不结盟政策。
多亏我们的支持，<color=red>帕尔查姆</color>得以克服来自<color=red>喀尔克</color>日益加大的压力。
尤其是<color=red>帕尔查姆</color>派，联合部分<color=red>喀尔克</color>派，
已经能够放慢塔拉基亲密盟友哈菲祖拉·阿明的上升之路——而他又
不被党所信任。

0x002176D7.text: Having come to power, Amin launched widespread repression as against his current and potential political opponents. Despite the stated policy of "the destruction of feudal lords" under the destruction come not only them. The USSR seems to be dissatisfied with the coup, although it pretends that everything is fine.
0x002176D7.translated:
阿明上台后，对其现有及潜在的政治对手发动了广泛镇压。
尽管其宣称要“摧毁封建主”，但在“摧毁”的名义下，
遭殃的并不只是他们。
苏联似乎对这次政变不满，尽管它假装一切都好。

0x00217950.text: Having come to power, Amin launched widespread repression as against his current and potential political opponents. Despite the stated policy of "the destruction of feudal lords" under the destruction come not only them. The USSR seems to be dissatisfied with the coup, although it pretends that everything is fine. Our secret ambassadors and special services established contacts with Amin, who was very pleased with the acquisition of new allies. However, at the same time, he began to asking us for providing material assistance to Afghanistan.
0x00217950.translated:
阿明上台后，对其现有及潜在的政治对手发动了广泛镇压。
尽管其宣称要“摧毁封建主”，但在“摧毁”的名义下，
遭殃的并不只是他们。
苏联似乎对这次政变不满，尽管它假装一切都好。
我们的秘密使节和特工部门与阿明建立了联系——他对获得新的盟友
非常高兴。然而与此同时，他又开始向我们索要对阿富汗的物质援助。

0x00217D99.text: Continuing our great friendship with the USSR and not really trusting Amin,
0x00217D99.translated: 在继续同苏联的“伟大友谊”同时，并不太信任阿明，

0x00217E34.text: decided, despite the protests of individual members of the Central Committee, to hold tacit negotiations with the USSR about the danger of the Amin regime for the DRA and the need for his removing. The Soviet leadership was very surprised at such a willingness to "finish" a potential ally and, it seems, does not fully trust us, but on the whole was very happy. We will wait for the further development of these events. Having come to power, Amin launched widespread repression as against his current and potential political opponents. Despite the stated policy of "the destruction of feudal lords" under the destruction come not only them. The USSR seems to be dissatisfied with the coup, although it pretends that everything is fine. Our secret ambassadors and special services established contacts with Amin, who was very pleased with the acquisition of new allies. However, at the same time, he began to asking us for providing material assistance to Afghanistan..
0x00217E34.translated:
尽管中央委员会个别成员提出抗议，仍决定同苏联进行秘密磋商，
讨论阿明政权对DRA的危险性以及需要将其除掉。
苏联领导层对这种“干掉”潜在盟友的意愿感到十分惊讶——看起来
也并不完全信任我们，但总体上还是很高兴。
我们将等待这些事件的进一步发展。
阿明上台后，对其现有及潜在的政治对手发动了广泛镇压。
尽管其宣称要“摧毁封建主”，但在“摧毁”的名义下，
遭殃的并不只是他们。
苏联似乎对这次政变不满，尽管它假装一切都好。
我们的秘密使节和特工部门与阿明建立了联系——他对获得新的盟友
非常高兴。然而与此同时，他又开始向我们索要对阿富汗的物质援助。

0x002185F3.text: On the evening of December 27, having previously blocked parts of the Kabul garrison and seized the General Staff building, the USSR forces of the KGB special forces and the army stormed the Amin residence during which he died (although it was ordered to take him alive). With the support of the USSR, Afghanistan was headed by Assadullah Sarwari, a member of the Khalq faction and the former head of the Afghan special services, who fell under the repression of Amin. In general, despite the resistance of individual parts of the army that were loyal to Amin, his displacement went without problems. Meanwhile, the entry and deployment of Soviet troops continues.
0x002185F3.translated:
12月27日晚，苏联方面先封锁了喀布尔驻军部分兵力，
并夺取了总参谋部大楼。
随后，苏联克格勃特种部队与军队对阿明住所发起突袭——阿明在突
袭中身亡（尽管命令是要活捉）。
在苏联支持下，阿富汗由<color=red>阿萨杜拉·萨尔瓦里</color>出任领导——他是<color=red>喀尔
克</color>派成员，曾任阿富汗特工部门负责人，
曾遭阿明的镇压。总体而言，尽管有少数忠于阿明的军队部队抵抗，
但他的更替进行得毫无障碍。
与此同时，苏军的进入与部署仍在继续。

0x00218B26.text: On the evening of December 27, having previously blocked parts of the Kabul garrison and seized the General Staff building, the USSR forces of the KGB special forces and the army stormed the Amin residence during which he died (although it was ordered to take him alive). With the support of the USSR, Afghanistan was headed by Babrak Karmal, founder and permanent leader of the Parcham faction and longtime opponent of Amin. In general, despite the resistance of individual parts of the army that were loyal to Amin, his displacement went without problems. Meanwhile, the entry and deployment of Soviet troops continues.
0x00218B26.translated:
12月27日晚，苏联方面先封锁了喀布尔驻军部分兵力，
并夺取了总参谋部大楼。
随后，苏联克格勃特种部队与军队对阿明住所发起突袭——阿明在突
袭中身亡（尽管命令是要活捉）。
在苏联支持下，阿富汗由<color=red>巴布拉克·卡尔迈勒</color>出任领导——他是<color=red>帕尔
查姆</color>派的创始人和长期领导者，也是阿明的老对手。
总体而言，尽管有少数忠于阿明的军队部队抵抗，
但他的更替进行得毫无障碍。
与此同时，苏军的进入与部署仍在继续。

0x00219003.text: Thanks to our timely warning, Amin managed to bring his loyal parts to combat readiness, while he left the residence and took refuge on the outskirts of Kabul. The USSR, even at the beginning of the operation, realized that his plan had failed, and recalled the special forces. Only thanks to the efforts of our and Afghan diplomats, as well as Amin, who diligently pretended that nothing happened and did not nominally change the policy, a major international scandal was avoided. Although the USSR, of course, is still unhappy and is beginning to rapidly reduce aid to Afghanistan. The entry of Soviet troops was also slowed down, as were their tasks. It seems that in time they will be completely withdrawn along with Soviet specialists, so that we will have to take all the help for Afghanistan in the beginning civil war. Meanwhile, Amin concluded a number of treaties with the PRC, and also invited the Maoists, who until recently were in opposition, would join PDPA on favorable terms and co-opted them into the government.
0x00219003.translated:
多亏我们及时的警告，阿明设法让其忠诚部队进入战备状态；
而他本人则离开住所，躲到喀布尔郊外避难。
苏联甚至在行动一开始就意识到他的计划失败了，
于是召回了特种部队。
只有依靠我们与阿富汗外交官的努力，以及阿明刻意装作若无其事、
名义上也不改变政策，才避免了一场重大的国际丑闻。
当然，苏联仍然不快，并开始迅速减少对阿富汗的援助。
苏军的进入也被放慢了，他们的任务同样被拖延。
看来他们最终会连同苏联专家一起撤走——这样在内战初期，
我们就得把对阿富汗的一切援助都扛起来。
与此同时，阿明同中华人民共和国签订了一系列条约，
并邀请此前一直处于反对地位的毛主义者以有利条件加入PDPA，
把他们纳入政府。
