0x0021988C.text: We decided not to get involved in Afghan affairs. In the country, meanwhile, a civil war is in full swing, the outcome of which no one can predict.
0x0021988C.translated:
我们决定不介入阿富汗事务。
与此同时，国内内战正打得如火如荼，结局谁也无法预料。

0x002199B5.text: Thanks to our relations with the USSR, we were able to negotiate with the DRA. In exchange for our support, they stops the persecution of the Maoists, who had previously been in opposition, and formed with them an alliance of progressive forces to fight Islamism and American imperialism, provided that the Maoists themselves lay down their arms (they reluctantly, but agreed). This is our diplomatic victory! In the country, meanwhile, a civil war is in full swing, the outcome of which no one can predict.
0x002199B5.translated:
多亏我们同苏联的关系，我们得以同DRA进行谈判。
作为我们支持的交换，他们停止对此前处于反对地位的毛主义者的迫
害，并与他们结成“进步力量联盟”，共同对抗伊斯兰主义与美国帝
国主义——前提是毛主义者自己放下武器（他们虽不情愿，
但还是同意了）。这就是我们的外交胜利！
与此同时，国内内战正打得如火如荼，结局谁也无法预料。

0x00219DAE.text: After long discussions in the Politburo, where individual party members stubbornly protested against the support of the pro-Soviet DRA regime, the comrade
0x00219DAE.translated:
在政治局经过长期讨论时，个别党内成员固执地反对支持亲苏的DR
A政权，同志

0x00219EE7.text: still pushed through the strategy of supporting the DRA (at least in words), against which they definitely did not mind. In the country, meanwhile, a civil war is in full swing, the outcome of which no one can predict.
0x00219EE7.translated:
仍然力排众议，推行支持DRA的战略（至少在口头上），
他们对此当然并不介意。
与此同时，国内内战正打得如火如荼，结局谁也无法预料。

0x0021A0A0.text: Fearing the expansion of Soviet influence, we decided to support the Maoist organizations in Afghanistan in their armed struggle against both the DRA and the Islamists. Naturally, neither the USSR nor the United States liked this, and the Afghan Maoists do not represent a particularly formidable force, so a lot of our forces will go to support them... In the country, meanwhile, a civil war is in full swing, the outcome of which no one can predict.
0x0021A0A0.translated:
担心苏联势力扩张，我们决定支持阿富汗的毛主义组织，
参与其对DRA与伊斯兰主义者的武装斗争。
当然，苏联和美国都不喜欢这一点；而阿富汗的毛主义者也并不算什
么特别强大的力量，所以我们将投入不少力量去支援他们……
与此同时，国内内战正打得如火如荼，
结局谁也无法预料。

0x0021A473.text: Later, the summit between the United States and the PRC unexpectedly quickly took place under the pretext of “developing trade and economic cooperation”, but its goal was completely different. At closed negotiations, the US delegation offered China a contract to buy weapons and send them across the Chinese border to neighboring Afghanistan in order to support Mujahideen opposition against Soviet aggression and deal a serious blow to the puppet DRA regime. The Chinese side accepted the US proposal, the first arms shipments are planned to be deployed in the next three months, however, we will only benefit from this, our costs will be covered by our new strategic ally.
0x0021A473.translated:
后来，美中峰会竟以“发展贸易与经济合作”为借口出乎意料地迅速
举行，但其目标完全不同。
在闭门谈判中，美方代表团向中国提出一份合同：
购买武器，并将其跨过中国边境运往邻近的阿富汗，
以支持圣战者对抗苏联的侵略，并对傀儡DRA政权给予沉重打击。
中方接受了美方提议，首批武器运送计划在未来三个月内部署；
不过，我们从中只会获益——我们的成本将由新的战略盟友来承担。

0x0021A9F2.text: With the release of part of their forces and with the help of Soviet advisers and aviation, the DRA launched relatively successful hostilities against the Islamists. It is too early to make predictions about a future victory, but in the absence of direct US access to Afghanistan, the DRA has a significant advantage.
0x0021A9F2.translated:
在释放部分兵力、并在苏联顾问与航空力量的帮助下，
DRA对伊斯兰主义者发动了相对成功的军事行动。
至于未来能否取得胜利，现在还为时过早；
但在美国无法直接进入阿富汗的情况下，
DRA确实占据明显优势。

0x0021AC6F.text: Having joined the speeches of Western diplomats, we also condemned the entry of Soviet troops into Afghanistan, calling it a rude interference in the affairs of a sovereign state. Western leaders supported our statement, but the Soviet leadership did not respond. With the release of part of their forces and with the help of Soviet advisers and aviation, the DRA launched relatively successful hostilities against the Islamists. It is too early to make predictions about a future victory, but in the absence of direct US access to Afghanistan, the DRA has a significant advantage.
0x0021AC6F.translated:
在加入西方外交官的发言之后，我们也谴责苏军进入阿富汗，
称其是对主权国家事务的粗暴干涉。
西方领导人支持我们的表态，但苏联领导层没有回应。
与此同时，在释放部分兵力、并在苏联顾问与航空力量的帮助下，
DRA对伊斯兰主义者发动了相对成功的军事行动。
至于未来能否取得胜利，现在还为时过早；
但在美国无法直接进入阿富汗的情况下，
DRA确实占据明显优势。

0x0021B0FC.text: Contrary to the voices heard from around the world about the "invasion" we decided to support the entry of Soviet troops, as it aims to ensure peace and stability in Afghanistan and is absolutely legitimate according to the Soviet-Afghan Friendship Treaty. In the west, of course, we were called accomplices of the bloody regimes, but the USSR thanked for the support.
0x0021B0FC.translated:
与全世界对“入侵”的舆论相反，我们决定支持苏军的进入——因为
它的目的在于确保阿富汗的和平与稳定，
并且依据《苏阿友好条约》完全具有合法性。
当然，在西方，我们被称为血腥政权的同谋；
但苏联对我们的支持表示感谢。

0x0021B413.text: Everything goes as it went. The Pakistani authorities suppress radical sermons and do not allow weapons to be carried through checkpoints at the border, but they don’t have the strength, desire, or both.
0x0021B413.translated:
一切照旧。巴基斯坦当局压制激进宣讲，
并不允许武器通过边境检查站携带入境，
但他们既没有力量，也没有意愿——或者两者都没有。

0x0021B5AC.text: Transparently hinting to Bhutto that it was time to stop the terrorists rampant on the border, and sending him ours agents and military to help, we and Pakistan began operations to patrol the border and track down radical Islamist groups. I must say that it was crowned with success - the Islamists did not expect such a harsh reaction from Pakistan and were caught almost by surprise. The rest are hiding and now can not work with the same efficiency. Good luck in digging tunnels under the border.
0x0021B5AC.translated:
我们向布托做了再明显不过的暗示：是时候制止边境上猖獗的恐怖分
子了；同时派出我们的特工和军队协助。
于是，中巴双方开始行动：巡逻边境、追踪激进伊斯兰主义团体。
我必须说，这次行动取得了成功——伊斯兰主义者根本没想到巴基斯
坦会有如此强硬的反应，几乎是被打了个措手不及。
其余的则躲了起来，现在也无法再以同样效率运作。
祝你们挖边境下的地道好运。

0x0021B995.text: Having entered into a tacit agreement with the United States and persuading Bhutto not to hinder us, we began transporting American weapons and advisers to the Pakistan-Afghanistan border, transferring them to the Mujahideen, who then half-legally crossed the border, going to Afghanistan. This greatly helps the Afghan rebels against the DRA, and in turn, for the "intermediary services" in our pockets American money goes.
0x0021B995.translated:
在与美国达成默契协议，并说服布托不要阻挠我们之后，
我们开始把美制武器与顾问运往巴基斯坦—阿富汗边境，
再转交给圣战者；他们随后以“半合法”的方式越过边境，
进入阿富汗。这极大地帮助了反对DRA的阿富汗反叛者；
而反过来，作为“中介服务费”，美国的钱也会流进我们的口袋。

0x0021BCE8.text: Continuing our assistance to the Maoist insurgents in Afghanistan, we drove the Islamists away from the border, organized training camps and supply centers for the Maoists, where we now supply weapons and send instructors, which greatly help these rebels. The Pakistani authorities also agreed on the unimpeded sending of people and weapons to Afghanistan. Naturally, we had to fork out for the creation of such an infrastructure , as well as strain the army for supplies, and the USSR and the United States were dissatisfied.
0x0021BCE8.translated:
继续援助阿富汗的毛主义叛乱者，我们把伊斯兰主义者赶离边境，
为毛主义者组织训练营和补给中心——如今我们在这里向他们提供武
器并派遣教官，这极大地帮助了这些反叛者。
巴基斯坦当局也同意让人员与武器得以不受阻碍地送往阿富汗。
当然，为了建立这种基础设施，我们得掏钱；
为补给而动用军队也要付出代价；苏联和美国对此都不满意。

0x0021C12F.text: It was decided not to break something that already works. The only problem is that it works extremely poorly - the situation in agriculture is not the best, which adversely affects the standard of living of the population and its contentment.
0x0021C12F.translated:
决定不去打破已经在运转的东西。
问题只有一个：它运转得极其糟——农业形势并不理想，
这反过来损害了人民的生活水平与满意度。

0x0021C316.text: It was decided to dissolve the communes and distribute the land between independent family farms, who would be obliged to sell the specified harvest to the state at fixed prices. This spurred the growth of our economy, contributed to an increase in food supplies, and people liked it.
0x0021C316.translated:
决定解散人民公社，把土地分给独立的家庭农场；
家庭农场必须按固定价格向国家出售规定的收成。
这推动了我们经济的增长，增加了粮食供应，
人民也很喜欢。

0x0021C551.text: After long discussions with the conservative and even moderate part of Politburo, the reformers managed to persuade the CPC to introduce private land tenure instead of communes. New farmers were given loans for the purchase of machinery and equipment, as well as they were obliged to sell part of the crop to the state, while the rest could be sold at free prices on the markets. This made it possible to improve productivity and replenish the treasury at the expense of taxes and fees from young private owners, but not everyone in the party is satisfied with this decision, and the new private owners are already beginning to speculate on prices, and the people are waiting for further reforms.
0x0021C551.translated:
在与政治局保守派、甚至较为温和的部分进行长期讨论后，
改革派终于说服中共用“私有土地承包”取代公社。
新农户获得贷款，用于购买机械和设备；
同时他们也被要求向国家出售部分农作物，
其余部分则可在市场上按自由价格出售。
这使得提高生产率、并通过向年轻的私有者征收税费来补充财政成为
可能；但并非党内所有人都对这一决定感到满意。
新的私有者已经开始投机炒作价格，而人民则在等待进一步改革。

0x0021CAC4.text: It was decided to recall the Stalinist practice of collective farms, we don’t need to do special collectivization - most of the collective farms were created on the basis of reorganized communes. Now our agriculture consists of a multitude of state-controlled artels, which are obliged to sell part of the crop to it at fixed prices, and the remains can be sold at markets at freer prices. Mass construction and equipping of machine tractor stations, which will have to provide collective farms with equipment, also began. This ultimately helped us overcome technical backwardness and in the future promises productivity growth, however, for these events we had to fork out.
0x0021CAC4.translated:
决定恢复斯大林式的集体农场做法——我们不需要搞什么特别的集体
化；大多数集体农场都是在对公社进行改组的基础上建立起来的。
如今我们的农业由林林总总、由国家控制的合作社构成：
它们被要求以固定价格向国家出售部分收成，
其余部分则可在市场上以更自由的价格出售。
大规模兴建并配备机耕站的工作也开始了——机耕站将为集体农场提
供设备。最终，这帮助我们克服了技术落后，
并在未来有望带来生产率增长；不过，为这些事情，
我们得掏钱。

0x0021D04F.text: Despite numerous protests and accusations of slowing down the reforms,
0x0021D04F.translated: 尽管不断有抗议与指责，称其是在拖慢改革，

0x0021D0E0.text: nevertheless decided to postpone the question of investment for the time being "so that we can work out best solutions on this issue".
0x0021D0E0.translated:
仍然决定暂时把投资问题推迟，“以便我们能就此问题拿出最佳方案
”。

0x0021D1F3.text: It was announced the gradual opening of some cities on the coast for foreign investment. Special economic zones will soon be opened in Shenzhen, Zhuhai and Shantou in Guangdong Province and in Xiamen (Fujian Province), and the entire Hainan Province will be turned into a special economic zone. The United States and Western European countries warmly welcomed this decision, as did the heads of large Western companies.
0x0021D1F3.translated:
宣布将逐步开放部分沿海城市以吸引外资。
广东省的深圳、珠海和汕头，以及福建省的厦门（福建省）
将很快设立经济特区；整个海南省也将被改造为经济特区。
美国和西欧国家对此决定表示热烈欢迎，
大型西方企业的负责人也同样表示欢迎。

0x0021D53C.text: Despite the protests of some of the reformers and moderates, it was finally decided to fully open the Chinese economy to foreign investment. In accordance with the plan, special economic zones will soon be opened in Shenzhen, Zhuhai and Shantou in Guangdong Province and in Xiamen (Fujian Province), and also the entire Hainan Province will be turned into a special economic zone. At the same time, most state-owned enterprises also open to foreign funding under the joint venture plan. And although foreign companies can only develop their activities directly in the SEZ, it is already possible to talk about the imminent rapid penetration of foreign capital into our economy, because the West has already taken our transformations with great enthusiasm.
0x0021D53C.translated:
尽管有些改革派与温和派提出抗议，最终还是决定全面向外资开放中
国经济。按照计划，广东省的深圳、珠海和汕头，
以及福建省的厦门（福建省）将很快设立经济特区；
同时，整个海南省也将被改造为经济特区。
与此同时，在合资计划下，绝大多数国有企业也向外资开放。
尽管外资公司只能在经济特区内直接开展业务，
但已经可以谈论外资将迅速、迅猛渗透进我们经济的迫在眉睫——因
为西方已经以极大热情投入到我们的转变之中。

0x0021DB25.translated: 缅甸式通往社会主义的道路

0x0021DB59.text: In the BSPP, mass purges against the communists and sympathizers took place, which further strengthened the regime of Ne Win.
0x0021DB59.translated:
在缅甸社会主义纲领党（BSPP）内部，
对共产党人及其同情者进行了大规模清洗，
进一步巩固了吴奈温的统治。

0x0021DC56.text: A meeting was held between representatives of the PRC and Burma, where a number of treaties were signed and a vector of relations development was outlined. We have also allocated additional assistance for the restoration of the Burmese economy. In the meantime, mass purges against the Communists and sympathizers took place in the BSPP, which further strengthened the regime of Ne Win.
0x0021DC56.translated:
中方与缅方代表举行了会谈，签署了一系列条约，
并明确了关系发展的方向。
我们还追加拨付援助，用于恢复缅甸经济。
与此同时，BSPP内部对共产党人及其同情者又进行了大规模清洗，
进一步巩固了吴奈温的统治。

0x0021DF5D.text: Thanks to the intervention of our intelligence services, the left wing of the BSPP was able to organize an internal party coup. Our special services were able to prevent the intervention of the army loyal to Ne Win. The former dictator himself was accused of violating the principles of democratic centralism, imprisoned and soon mysteriously died. The new government began large-scale socialist reforms and a way out of isolation through building friendly relations with socialist countries, including the PRC.
0x0021DF5D.translated:
多亏情报部门的介入，BSPP的左翼得以组织一次党内政变。
我们的特工力量成功阻止了忠于吴奈温的军队插手。
前独裁者本人被指控违反民主集中制原则，
被关押后不久便以离奇方式死亡。
新政府开始推行大规模社会主义改革，并通过同包括中华人民共和国
在内的社会主义国家建立友好关系，寻找摆脱孤立的出路。

0x0021E35E.translated: 要不要给越南一个教训？

0x0021E38E.text: You managed to calm the CPC, though not without discontent. Everything is going as it was, and Vietnam continues its rapprochement with the USSR.
0x0021E38E.translated:
你总算安抚住了中共（CPC），尽管并非没有怨气。
一切照旧，越南继续向苏联靠拢。

0x0021E4B3.text: It was decided to prepare the invasion of Vietnam. On February 17, at 4:30, PLA units crossed the border and, after heavy fighting, captured border areas, breaking down Vietnamese resistance. However, recovered Vietnamese troops are now turning into violent counterattacks. We hope we have enough strength to fulfill our plan.
0x0021E4B3.translated:
决定准备对越南的入侵。
2月17日4时30分，解放军部队越过边境，
经过激烈战斗，攻占边境地区，瓦解了越南的抵抗。
然而，已恢复的越南军队正转为猛烈反击。
我们希望有足够的力量完成计划。

0x0021E742.text: After numerous disputes with anti-Soviet-minded party members, you still managed to organize the dispatch of the Chinese delegation to Vietnam. As a result of the negotiations, we had to abandon claims to some Vietnamese islands, but managed to end the oppression of the Vietnamese Chinese with the right to emigrate them to China, to settle relations and sign several trade and political treaties. Although Vietnam still focuses on the USSR, our relations with it have improved significantly, and the prospects for cooperation have increased significantly. The USSR also took with interest our attempts to establish relations with the socialist camp.
0x0021E742.translated:
在同一批反苏倾向的党内成员反复争论之后，
你仍然设法组织派遣中国代表团赴越南。
谈判结果，我们不得不放弃对部分越南岛屿的主张，
但最终争取到结束对越南华人的压迫，并获得将其迁往中国的权利；
同时理顺关系，签署了若干贸易与政治条约。
尽管越南仍把重心放在苏联方面，但我们同它的关系已显著改善，
合作前景也大幅提升。
苏联对我们试图同社会主义阵营建立关系的努力也表现出浓厚兴趣。

0x0021EC79.text: As a result, the LDP managed to retain its rule, gaining 44% of the vote and playing on the fragmentation of the opposition. Prime Minister Masayoshi Ohira continued the liberal-Western course of Japan.
0x0021EC79.translated:
结果，自民党（LDP）得以保住政权，
得票率达44%，并利用反对派分裂的局面。
首相大平正芳继续推行日本的自由—亲西方路线。

0x0021EE10.text: Thanks to the timely elimination of Kenji Miyamoto, the CPJ returned to Beijing’s control with joy and accepted our help. Thanks to our finances, they were able to establish an effective pre-election campaign, and our intelligence services engaged in stuffing of compromising materials at the LDP and disrupting their speeches. As a result, the CPJ managed to reach a record 31% and form a coalition with the socialists, the Buddhist Komeito and various center-left opposition parties. Soon criminal cases were opened against LDP officials on charges of corruption and abuse, and with broad popular support, a law was passed to withdraw Japan from military treaties with the United States and NATO and to gradually withdraw American bases from the country.
0x0021EE10.translated:
多亏及时铲除宫本健治（Kenji Miyamoto），
共产党（CPJ）喜气洋洋地重新回到北京的掌控之下，
并接受了我们的援助。
凭借我们的资金支持，他们得以建立一套高效的选前攻势；
而我们的情报部门则向自民党塞入足以致命的丑闻材料，
破坏其演说。结果，CPJ得以创纪录地拿下31%的支持率，
并与社会党、佛教公明党以及各个中间偏左的反对党组成联合政府。
不久，自民党官员因腐败与滥用职权而被提起刑事案件；
在广泛的民意支持下，国会通过法律，要求日本退出与美国及北约（
NATO）的军事条约，并逐步撤出美国在日本的基地。

0x0021F433.text: And they managed to achieve their goal: in January, the Shah and his family fled the country, transferring power to Prime Minister Shapour Bakhtiar from a moderate opposition, which himself was soon overthrown by working protests. With the support of urban workers and military units, the left coalition from various parties and movements came to power on the wave of the popularity of promises to create a socially just state. Returning to Iran from exile, Khomeini tried to organize an uprising by loyal militants, but was quickly captured, and the movements that supported him were dispersed. The new government announced the construction of socialism with Islamic specifics (from the usual, differing only in soft religious policies), however, it seems that the first task of the formed Revolutionary Council will be the destruction of the Islamic and democratic opposition dissatisfied with the outcome of the revolution.
0x0021F433.translated:
他们终于达成目标：1月，沙阿及其家人逃离该国，
把权力交给来自温和反对派的总理沙普尔·巴赫蒂亚尔（Shapo
ur Bakhtiar）；而巴赫蒂亚尔本人很快就被工人抗议浪
潮推翻。在城市工人和军队单位的支持下，
由各党派与运动组成的左翼联盟乘着“建立社会公正国家”的承诺热
潮上台。霍梅尼从流亡中返回伊朗，试图由忠诚的武装分子组织起义，
但很快被捕，支持他的运动也随之被瓦解。
新政府宣布要建设带有伊斯兰特色的社会主义（与通常模式相比，
只是在宗教政策上更为温和），然而看来，
成立后的革命委员会首要任务将是消灭对革命结局不满的伊斯兰与民
主反对派。

0x0021FB72.text: However, with our and American active support of Pahlavi, SAVAK and the army succeeded in suppressing the demonstrations, destroying the main opposition leaders and discording its ranks. An assassination attempt was made on Khomeini himself in Paris, which he survived, but was forced to lie to the bottom and has not yet made itself felt. However, now that the most radical protesters have been defeated, the Shah made concessions - a new government was formed, control over Muslim priests, censorship and the scale of repression were reduced and demonstrative arrests of corrupt officials from the highest echelons were held.
0x0021FB72.translated:
然而，在我们与美国对巴列维（Pahlavi）
的积极支持下，萨瓦克（SAVAK）和军队成功镇压了示威，
打掉了主要反对派领袖，瓦解了其队伍。
巴黎也曾对霍梅尼本人发动暗杀企图，他幸存下来，
但被迫隐入地下，至今尚未显露。
可如今，最激进的抗议者已被击败，沙阿作出让步——组建了新政府，
收紧对穆斯林宗教人士的控制、审查与镇压规模有所减轻，
并举行了对最高层腐败官员的示范性逮捕。

0x0022005B.text: And they managed to achieve their goal: in January, the Shah and his family fled the country, transferring power to Prime Minister Shapour Bakhtiar from a moderate opposition, who began to draft a new constitution and, at the request of protesters who refused to create a government "national unity", had free elections, which won, led by the Iranian National Front, the democratic coalition, which then successfully suppressed the performance of Islamic radicals led by Khomeini and began a careful purge against the Islamists and radical left dissatisfied with such a result. The newly formed government announced its loyalty to the principles of Islam and democracy and aimed at the development of the country on the model of Kemalist Turkey, while pursuing a multi-vector foreign policy.
0x0022005B.translated:
他们终于达成目标：1月，沙阿及其家人逃离该国，
把权力交给来自温和反对派的总理沙普尔·巴赫蒂亚尔（Shapo
ur Bakhtiar）。
巴赫蒂亚尔开始起草新宪法，并在拒绝组建“民族团结政府”的抗议
者要求下举行自由选举。
选举胜出的是由伊朗民族阵线（Iranian National
 Front）领导的民主联盟；随后，
该联盟成功压制了由霍梅尼领导的伊斯兰激进派的行动，
并对那些对这一结果不满的伊斯兰主义者与激进左翼展开谨慎清洗。
新成立的政府宣布忠于伊斯兰与民主原则，
目标是以凯末尔土耳其模式推动国家发展，
同时奉行多方向的外交政策。

0x0022068C.text: And they managed to achieve their goal: in January, the Shah and his family fled the country, transferring power to Prime Minister Shapour Bakhtiar from a moderate opposition, who began to draft a new constitution and invited disgraced Ayatollah Khomeini to the country, for which he soon paid. Not intending to cooperate with the new government, Khomeini, with the help of his numerous supporters, organized a new uprising that quickly spread to Tehran. The police sided with the rioters, and the generals declared neutrality, with the result that Bakhtiar fled the country. The new government of Khomeini proclaimed Iran as an Islamic republic and launched a brutal repression against yesterday's allies.
0x0022068C.translated:
他们终于达成目标：1月，沙阿及其家人逃离该国，
把权力交给来自温和反对派的总理沙普尔·巴赫蒂亚尔（Shapo
ur Bakhtiar）。
巴赫蒂亚尔开始起草新宪法，并邀请被打入冷宫的阿亚图拉·霍梅尼
回国——而他很快就为此付出了代价。
霍梅尼并不打算与新政府合作，在众多支持者的帮助下组织了新的起
义，并迅速蔓延到德黑兰。
警方站在暴乱者一边，军方将领宣布中立，
结果巴赫蒂亚尔逃离该国。
霍梅尼的新政府宣布伊朗为伊斯兰共和国，
并对昨天的盟友发动残酷镇压。

0x00220C31.text: And nothing happened, let's hope this is only for the better.
0x00220C31.translated: 什么也没发生，咱们希望这只是往好的方向发展。

0x00220CAD.text: Today, at the initiative of the PRC, a closed economic meeting was convened in Beijing, which adopted a resolution establishing the Economic Cooperation Organization (ECO), the purpose of which is to expand trade and economic contacts between China’s friendly countries. Founding members of the new alliance are China
0x00220CAD.translated:
今天，在中华人民共和国的倡议下，北京召开了一次闭门经济会议，
会议通过决议，成立经济合作组织（ECO）。
该组织的宗旨是扩大中国友好国家之间的贸易与经济联系。
新联盟的创始成员是中国

0x00220F2A.text: Continuing the line on «resetting relations with the USSR», China has applied for membership in the Council for Mutual Economic Assistance. This initiative, according to the idea, should revive and increase economic contacts between the PRC and the socialist countries that were severed during the «Soviet-Chinese split». For this purpose, an extraordinary session of the CMEA was convened, as a result of which, China was admitted to the union as a full member of the organization. The most radical party members «took this step with hostility», calling it «indulgence of Soviet revisionists», but now our relations with the USSR are better than ever. Can not be said about the United States, who were unhappy with the change in the vector of our foreign policy. However, now the socialist camp is stronger than ever before.
0x00220F2A.translated:
延续“重置同苏联关系”的路线，中国申请加入互助经济委员会（C
MEA）。按设想，这一举措应当恢复并扩大在“苏中分裂”期间被
切断的中华人民共和国与社会主义国家之间的经济联系。
为此，CMEA召开了特别会议，结果中国以正式成员身份被接纳为
该组织的成员。最激进的党内分子“怀着敌意迈出了这一步”，
称之为“纵容苏联修正主义”，但如今我们同苏联的关系比以往任何
时候都更好。至于美国就不能这么说了——他们对我国外交政策向新
方向转变显然不满。然而，如今社会主义阵营比以往任何时候都更强
大。

0x0022159F.text: The Chinese government has applied for membership in the 'Non-aligned Movement' and, without question, China has been admitted to the organization by a majority vote. Now, if we wish to resolve any conflict by military means, we will be condemned and expelled from the organization. Strategic neutrality will allow us to maneuver between the Soviet Union and the United States, receiving preferences from both superpowers, which, however, is only to our advantage.
0x0022159F.translated:
中国政府申请加入“不结盟运动”，毫无疑问，
中国在多数票表决中被接纳进入该组织。
现在，如果我们想用军事手段解决任何冲突，
就会遭到谴责并被逐出该组织。
战略中立将使我们在苏联与美国之间周旋，
从两大超级强权那里获得种种优惠——不过这对我们只有好处。

0x00221942.text: The Chinese government applied for membership in the «Association of Southeast Asian Nations» and without any questions asked, China was accepted into the organization by a majority vote. China's entry into ASEAN should improve China's relations with neighboring countries and the Western bloc. Due to the accession of a country that is not entirely in Southeast Asia, a new acronym, «Association of Asian Nations» (AAN), was added to the name of the union.
0x00221942.translated:
中国政府申请加入“东南亚国家联盟”（ASEAN），
并在毫无争议的情况下以多数票接纳中国进入该组织。
中国加入ASEAN应当有助于改善中国同邻国以及西方阵营的关系。
由于有一个并不完全属于东南亚的国家加入，
联盟名称中又增加了新的缩写“亚洲国家联盟”（AAN）。

0x00221CFB.text: Today in Shanghai, an agreement was signed on the creation of the Collective Security Alliance (CRA), a military-political organization that united all allied countries of China into a single military bloc. The purpose of the CSA is to create a common system of collegial protection against other military alliances - Warsaw pact and NATO. The members of the newly formed organization became PRC
0x00221CFB.translated:
今天在上海签署了关于成立集体安全联盟（CRA）
的协议。该军事—政治组织将中国的所有盟国统一为一个单一军事集
团。集体安全联盟（CSA）的目的，是建立针对其他军事联盟——
华沙条约组织与北约（NATO）——的共同集体防护体系。
新成立组织的成员包括中华人民共和国

0x00222014.text: . The USSR and the United States reacted negatively to the expansion of Chinese influence, calling the new bloc «an obstacle to detente of international tensions» and «a destroyer of peaceful coexistence» . In turn, the party and the people perceived the growth of the prestige of the PRC with enthusiasm and admiration. It seems that a third force appears on the international arena, let's hope this is only for the better.
0x00222014.translated:
。苏联与美国对中国影响力的扩张作出消极反应，
称这个新集团是“国际紧张局势缓和的障碍”，
是“和平共处的破坏者”。
与此同时，党和人民则满怀热情与敬佩地看待中华人民共和国威望的
提升。看来国际舞台上出现了第三股力量——希望这只是往好的方向
发展。

0x00222367.text: China continues to be out of military alliances. Peace on Earth - above all.
0x00222367.translated: 中国继续不参加军事联盟。世界和平——至上。

0x00222420.text: The Resolution of the NPC Standing Committee on the Restoration of the "March of the Volunteers" was read on the radio as the hymn of the PRC. At the same time, a law regulating the use of the hymn was adopted (radio and television broadcasting begins every day, the National Flag of the People's Republic of China rises to the sounds of the hymn, the NPC Session and the CPC Congress begin their work, etc.). The party is satisfied, like the people.
0x00222420.translated:
全国人大常委会关于恢复《义勇军进行曲》的决议通过广播宣读，
作为中华人民共和国的国歌。
同时通过了规范国歌使用的法律（每天广播电视开播时奏响国歌，
中华人民共和国国旗在国歌声中升起，全国人大会议和中共代表大会
开始工作等）。党很满意，人民也一样。

0x002227A7.text: Today, " Radio Peking" started broadcasting, like 10 years ago, with the song "The East Is Red", after which the Resolution of the NPC Standing Committee on the approval it as a hymn of the People's Republic of China was read. The people, in general, are very pleased, however, the party members met this decision with incomprehension and accuse us of a "radical left deviation" and "an attempt to creeping revaluation of the Cultural Revolution". The USSR and the USA are also unhappy, but chose not to declare it.
0x002227A7.translated:
今天，“北京广播电台”（Radio Peking）
像10年前那样，以歌曲《东方红》开播；
随后宣读了全国人大常委会关于将其批准为中华人民共和国国歌的决
议。总体上，人民很高兴，但党内成员对这一决定却表示不理解，
指责我们犯了“极左偏差”，并“试图悄悄重新评价文化大革命”。
苏联和美国也不高兴，只是选择不表态。

0x00222BB0.text: Today, the broadcast of "Radio Peking" began with "March of the Volunteers", but with a modified text, in which "the great Communist Party ", "the Communist tomorrow" and "the Flag of Mao Zedong". In this version, it was approved by the national anthem of the PRC. This caused some discontent in the party, although the people, in general, accepted new words.
0x00222BB0.translated:
今天，“北京广播电台”（Radio Peking）
的播音以《义勇军进行曲》开头，但歌词做了修改，
加入了“伟大的共产党”“共产主义的明天”以及“毛泽东旗帜”。
在这一版本上，它被批准为中华人民共和国国歌。
此举在党内引起了一些不满，尽管总体上人民接受了新词。

0x00222E81.text: The problems of the heirs of Genghis Khan
0x00222E81.translated: 成吉思汗的继承者们的问题

0x00222ED5.text: Today, a joint decision of the NPC Standing Committee and the CPC Central Committee was issued, according to which all the territories  of Inner Mongolia, transferred to the neighboring provinces of the PRC in 1969, are returned to it. The policy of assimilation of the Mongols also ceases, the protection of their national culture, traditional way of life and national economy is guaranteed. The mausoleum of Genghis Khan, the tomb of Wang Zhaojun, the Wu Dan monastery and the Five Pagodas temple are open again to visit, the traditional Nadom festival revived, the publication of the newspaper "Namengu zhibao" in Mongolian begins. This step was enthusiastically met in the autonomous region and supported by the Mongolian People’s Republic, and behind it by the Soviet Union, which approved changes in our national policy. True, the left wing of the party thinks very differently, and our budget is forced to take on additional expenses.
0x00222ED5.translated:
今天，全国人大常委会与中共中央联合作出决定：
1969年移交给中华人民共和国邻省的内蒙古全部地区，
全部归还。对蒙古人的同化政策也随之停止，
保证保护其民族文化、传统生活方式与民族经济。
成吉思汗陵、王昭君墓、乌丹寺以及五塔寺重新对外开放参观，
传统那达慕节日得以恢复，蒙古文报纸《内蒙古之报》（Namen
gu zhibao）开始出版发行。
此举在自治区内受到热烈欢迎，并得到蒙古人民共和国的支持；
在其背后，还有苏联的认可——他们批准了我们民族政策的调整。
只是，党内左翼的看法大不相同，我们的预算也被迫承担额外开支。

0x00223632.text: The central authorities showed no interest in the problem of Inner Mongolia. Mongolian assimilation continues in AR, more and more Chinese immigrants come to autonomy, and they will soon become the majority of its population. The situation is worsening, and dissidents of Mongolian origin are actively trying to attract the attention of the United States and the Soviet Union.
0x00223632.translated:
中央当局对内蒙古问题毫无兴趣。
自治区内蒙古人的同化仍在继续，越来越多的中国移民涌入自治地区，
他们很快就会成为该地区人口的多数。
局势正在恶化，具有蒙古族背景的异议分子正积极试图引起美国与苏
联的注意。

0x00223925.text: After a long hesitation, a half-decision was made to return the territories selected in 1969 to Inner Mongolia, but leave the national policy unchanged. This decision was, in general, met with neutral, although it caused some discontent among the nationalist party members, as well as the Mongolian People's Republic, which accused us of the "genocide of the Mongolian population" and trying to attract the attention of the Soviet Union...
0x00223925.translated:
经过长时间犹豫，作出一个“半决定”：
把1969年挑选出来的地区归还内蒙古，
但民族政策不作改变。
总体上，这一决定得到了中性回应，尽管它在民族主义党内成员中引
起了一些不满；同时，蒙古人民共和国也指责我们“对蒙古族人口实
施种族灭绝”，并试图引起苏联的注意……

0x00223C96.text: After a long hesitation, a half-decision was made to stop the assimilation policy of the Mongolian population of the autonomy, but not to return the territories seized in 1969 into its composition.  The mausoleum of Genghis Khan, the tomb of Wang Zhaojun, the Wu Dan monastery and the Five Pagodas temple are open again to visit, the traditional Nadom festival revived, the publication of the newspaper "Namengu zhibao" in Mongolian begins. This decision was welcomed with approval, although our budget has to incur additional expenses.
0x00223C96.translated:
经过长时间犹豫，作出一个“半决定”：
停止对自治区蒙古族人口的同化政策，但不把1969年被夺走的地
区重新纳入其版图。成吉思汗陵、王昭君墓、
乌丹寺以及五塔寺重新对外开放参观，传统那达慕节日得以恢复，
蒙古文报纸《内蒙古之报》（Namengu zhibao）
开始出版发行。此决定受到赞同欢迎，尽管我们的预算不得不承担额
外开支。

0x002240EB.text: , stunned by the revealed truth about the state of affairs in Inner Mongolia, decided to look more deeply at the national issue and personally visited all 3 small autonomous regions - Inner Mongolia, Guangxi Zhuang AR and Ningxia Hui AR. After a series of meetings with the party and soviet leadership of these regions, as well as representatives of national minorities (Mongols, Zhuans and Huizu), Comrade Chairman returned to Beijing in deep thought, which resulted in the adoption of the "Concept of the National Policy of the PRC", which replaced the nationalist the nature of the "Basic Principles for the Implementation of Regional National Autonomy in the PRC" 1952. In accordance with the "Concept", autonomous regions received broader rights, the state pledged to protect the national culture of national minorities, the traditional way of life and the national economy, to increase the volume of literature and print publishing in national languages, to allocate quotas for national minorities in all authorities and universities. An important decision was also made - not only the soviet authorities, but also the district autonomous committees of the CPC should be headed by representatives of national minorities. All this allowed you to receive the sincere support of the national elites (we hope they will not forget this gesture if anything happens), the approval of the USSR and the USA - but also the fury of conservative party members...
0x002240EB.translated:
在被揭露的内蒙古真实情况震惊之后，决定更深入地研究民族问题，
并亲自走访全部3个小型自治区——内蒙古、
广西壮族自治区与宁夏回族自治区。
经过与这些地区的党和苏维埃领导层进行一系列会谈，
以及与少数民族代表（蒙古族、壮族与回族）
交流后，同志主席带着深思回到北京，进而通过了《中华人民共和国
民族政策纲要》，以取代1952年《在中华人民共和国实行区域民
族自治的基本原则》中带有民族主义性质的内容。
根据《纲要》，自治区获得更广泛的权利；
国家承诺保护少数民族的民族文化、传统生活方式与民族经济，
增加少数民族语言的文献与出版发行量，
并在所有机关与高校为少数民族分配名额。
另一个重要决定也作出——不仅苏维埃当局，
连中共的地区自治委员会也应由少数民族代表担任负责人。
所有这些，使你得以赢得民族精英的真诚支持（希望他们在发生什么
事时不会忘记这一姿态），也获得苏联与美国的认可——但同时也激
怒了保守派党内成员……

0x00224C6A.text: The war is gaining momentum and it seems Iran is not going to give up so easily. The United States and the USSR made duty calls for peace, but in fact both supported Iraq, since Islamic Iran is inconvenient to both of them.
0x00224C6A.translated:
战争正在升级，看来伊朗并不打算轻易认输。
美国和苏联都口头呼吁和平，但实际上两者都在支持伊拉克，
因为伊斯兰伊朗对双方都不方便。

0x00224E57.text: Nothing has happened. Arab states remain relatively fragmented, which give an advantage to pro-American Israel.
0x00224E57.translated:
什么也没发生。阿拉伯国家仍相对分裂，
这反而给亲美的以色列带来优势。

0x00224F38.text: Thanks to the intervention of our intelligence, most of the opponents of the union quickly subsided, and our willingness to mediate in the unification of Arab countries and give them free aid for the development of joint statehood eventually led to an agreement on negotiations. In August, a historical conference of Egypt, Libya and Syria was held in Cairo, after which it was decided to form a confederal United Arab Republic with a common currency, army, jointly resolving foreign policy issues and prospects for further economic and political integration. The new state declared its loyalty to the principles of Arab socialism and the need to continue the formation of a single state of all Arabs, which excited Israel, who asked for additional military aid from the United States. The USSR welcomed the creation of the UAR, but the United States was unhappy with the appearance in the Middle East of such a powerful opponent of their hegemony.
0x00224F38.translated:
多亏情报部门的介入，反对联盟的多数势力很快偃旗息鼓；
而我们愿意在阿拉伯国家统一问题上居中调停，
并为发展共同国家形态提供无偿援助，最终促成了谈判协议。
8月，埃及、利比亚与叙利亚在开罗举行了一次具有历史意义的会议；
会后决定组建一个邦联制的阿拉伯联合共和国，
实行共同货币与军队，共同解决外交政策问题，
并为进一步的经济与政治一体化铺路。
新国家宣称忠于阿拉伯社会主义原则，强调继续建立全体阿拉伯人的
单一国家的必要性，这令以色列兴奋不已——以色列随即向美国请求
追加军事援助。苏联欢迎阿联（UAR）
的成立，但美国对中东出现这样一个强有力、
足以挑战其霸权的对手却并不满意。

0x002256A3.translated: 再见了，我们亲爱的米什卡……

0x002256DD.text: rejected the proposal to boycott the Moscow Olympics, calling it "an American provocation". He personally called Leonid Ilyich Brezhnev and said that "China will in no way join the American boycott and will send his team to Moscow", and also wished good luck to Soviet athletes. The touched Soviet leader in response expressed a desire to meet personally with Comrade
0x002256DD.translated:
他拒绝了抵制莫斯科奥运会的提议，称之为“美国的挑衅”。
他亲自给列昂尼德·伊里奇·勃列日涅夫打电话，
说“中方绝不会参加美国的抵制，并将派出代表队赴莫斯科”，
同时还祝苏联运动员好运。
被感动的苏联领导人则表示希望能亲自会见同志

0x002259C0.text: at the opening ceremony and wished success to the Chinese team. In the end, 63 states declared a boycott - the US and their satellites, teams of
0x002259C0.translated:
在开幕式上会面，并祝中国代表队取得成功。
最终，63个国家宣布抵制——美国及其卫星国，
队伍包括

0x00225AF5.text: Mozambique and Qatar refused to participate in the games, and the governments of England, France, Italy and Spain were given the right to decide whether to send athletes to Moscow or not, to their Olympic committees (after all, they sent their teams). At the opening ceremony, IOC President Michael Morris, before giving the floor to Leonid Brezhnev, particularly thanked those athletes who came on their own initiative, despite the boycott. The Chinese team took 3rd place, losing to the USSR and the GDR, winning 35 gold, 30 silver and 38 bronze medals, as well as setting several records. These games went down in history as the Olympiad with the most competently organized and memorable closing ceremony - when the symbol of the games - Mishka - flied away to the song by A. Pakhmutova and N. Dobronravov «Good bye, Moscow!», many (even foreigners) could not hold back tears - it was so powerful and atmospheric. At the closing ceremony, instead of the flag of the United States (the country where the next Olympiad will be held), the flag of the city of Los Angeles was hoisted, which hinted that the USSR would recall this boycott...
0x00225AF5.translated:
莫桑比克和卡塔尔拒绝参加比赛，而英国、
法国、意大利和西班牙等国政府则被授权由各自的奥委会决定是否派
运动员赴莫斯科（毕竟他们也派了队伍）。
开幕式上，国际奥委会主席迈克尔·莫里斯在把发言权交给列昂尼
德·勃列日涅夫之前，特别感谢那些在抵制情况下仍自发前来参赛的
运动员。中国代表队获得第3名，输给苏联和德意志民主共和国，
赢得35枚金牌、30枚银牌和38枚铜牌，
并创造了数项纪录。这届奥运会载入史册，
因其闭幕式组织得最得当、最令人难忘——当比赛的吉祥物米什卡飞
向阿·帕赫穆托娃和N·多布罗涅拉沃夫演唱的《再见吧，
莫斯科！》时，许多人（甚至外国人）都忍不住落泪——太有力量、
太有氛围了。闭幕式上，升起的不是将举办下一届奥运会的美国国旗，
而是洛杉矶市旗，这暗示苏联将撤回这次抵制……

0x002263DE.text: While the USSR and the United States exchanged threats and complained about each other in the IOC, China — quite unexpectedly for everyone — simply ignored both Olympics. In response to a complete bewilderment of the IOC’s request for the reasons for the lack of Chinese athletes in Moscow, Hua Guofeng and the head of the PRC Olympic Committee, Zhong Shitong, referred to China’s difficult financial situation, which did not allow us to take part in the Games. It seems that our explanations there caused a strong doubt, but we received an official warning - a boycott of games in Los Angeles automatically deprives us of membership in the IOC. The people also do not understand why the country's leadership did not respond to the Games. In the end, 63 states declared a boycott - the US and their satellites, teams of
0x002263DE.translated:
当苏联和美国在国际奥委会里互相威胁、
互相抱怨时，中国——出乎所有人意料——干脆两届奥运会都置之不
理。面对国际奥委会对中国运动员为何缺席莫斯科而感到完全困惑，
华国锋和中华人民共和国奥委会负责人钟世桐以中国财政困难为由，
表示这使我们无法参加比赛。
看来我们在那里的解释引起了强烈怀疑，
但我们还是收到了一纸正式警告——抵制洛杉矶的比赛将自动剥夺我
们在国际奥委会的成员资格。
群众也不明白，为什么国家领导层没有回应这些比赛。
最终，63个国家宣布抵制——美国及其卫星国，

The Chairman of the Central Committee of the LCY, Stevan Doronsky, gave a speech in memory of Tito, after which the column moved along the street of Prince Milos and the October Revolution Boulevard up to the 25 May Museum. The last speech was made by the Chairman of the Presidium of the SFRY, Lazar Kolisevski, in front of the House of Flowers and the stands meant for foreign statesmen. To the sounds of the «Internationale» after 3:00 pm, the coffin was brought into the House of Flowers, where Josip Broz Tito rested from now on. |The PRC delegation, led by
0x002292ED.translated:

0x0022AC34.text: The Chinese leadership has not responded to the events in Poland, except for the joint editorial of the newspaper "Renmin Ribao" and the magazine "Hongqi", which called for the warring parties "to find a compromise solution for the socialist and people's democratic future of Poland". This position was approved by both the USSR and Poland itself. |In this situation, the army took all the responsibility for the fate of the country. Enlisting the support of the USSR and guaranteeing its military non-intervention, the Minister of National Defense of the NDP, General Wojciech Jaruzelski, created the Military Council of National Salvation and on December 13, 1981 announced the introduction of martial law throughout the territory of the NDP. Decisive actions of the Polish Army, the Security Council and ZOMO (special units of the Civil Militia), the entire asset "Solidarity" and the PUWP leadership were interned and order in the country more or less restored. Announcing the "new line of socialism", Jaruzelski began economic reforms on the model of the Hungarian. However, the cardinal problems were not solved, which later will surely make itself known...
0x0022AC34.translated:
中国领导层对波兰的事态没有回应，除了一篇《人民日报》和《红旗
》杂志的联合社论，呼吁交战双方“为波兰社会主义和人民民主的未
来找到一个折中解决方案”。
这一立场得到了苏联和波兰本身的认可。
 | 在这种情况下，军队承担了国家命运的全部责任。
国防部长、波兰人民共和国（NDP）总参将雅鲁泽尔斯基将军争取
到苏联的支持，并保证苏联不会进行军事干预，
于1981年12月13日成立“民族拯救军事委员会”，
并宣布在NDP全境实行戒严。
波兰军队、安全委员会以及ZOMO（民兵的特种部队）
的果断行动，连同“团结”这一全部资产和波兰统一工人党（PUW
P）领导层都被拘押，国家秩序或多或少得以恢复。
雅鲁泽尔斯基宣布“新的社会主义路线”，
并开始按匈牙利模式进行经济改革。
然而，关键问题并未解决，日后必将显现出来……

0x0022B54D.text: Understanding that in the current situation only the Polish Army could somehow influence the situation and stop the impending counter-revolution, we contacted his command headed by the National Defense Minister of Poland, General Wojciech Jaruzelski. As it turned out, we were not the only ones who demanded that he restore order — the USSR also put pressure, but Jaruzelski hesitated. Finally, he decided - but categorically demanded that the USSR and the PRC not intervene in the process. Having received our guarantees, on December 13, 1980, the Polish generals created the Military Council of National Salvation and imposed martial law on the whole territory of Poland. Decisive actions of the Polish Army, the Security Council and ZOMO (special units of the Civil Militia), the entire asset "Solidarity" and the PUWP leadership were interned and order in the country more or less restored. All power in the country passed to the Supreme Council of Armed Forces, which immediately caused accusations of "establishing a military dictatorship", and the United States has already called for a fight against "the Soviet military junta of Jaruzelski". The PRC and the USSR also issued the NDP large interest-free loans to repay the national debt. It seems that the situation is recovering, and the Polish example taught our party something...
0x0022B54D.translated:
我们认识到，在当前局势下，只有波兰军队才能在某种程度上左右局
势、阻止迫在眉睫的反革命。
因此，我们联系了由波兰国防部长雅鲁泽尔斯基将军领导的指挥部。
事实证明，我们并不是唯一要求他恢复秩序的人——苏联也施加了压
力，但雅鲁泽尔斯基仍犹豫不决。
最终，他作出了决定——但明确要求苏联和中华人民共和国不要介入
这一进程。得到我们的保证后，1980年12月13日，
波兰将军们成立“民族拯救军事委员会”，
并在波兰全境实行戒严。
波兰军队、安全委员会和ZOMO（民兵特种部队）
的果断行动，使“团结”这一全部力量以及波兰统一工人党（PUW
P）领导层都被关押，国家秩序或多或少得以恢复。
国家一切权力转交给武装力量最高委员会，
这立刻引发了“建立军事独裁”的指责，
美国也已经呼吁对“雅鲁泽尔斯基的苏联军事集团”进行斗争。
中华人民共和国和苏联还向NDP提供了大额无息贷款，
用于偿还国债。看来局势正在好转，而波兰的例子也给我们党上了一
课……

0x0022BFCA.text: MSS agents through the underground Communist Party of Kazimierz Mijal came to the head of the "concrete" faction in the PUWP - Albin Siwak, who hates "Solidarity" and has repeatedly demanded to use weapons against it. Through his connections in the national catholic group "PAX" and the right-wing nationalist society "Grunwald", Siwak quickly achieved their agreement on a coalition with "concrete" and CPP. On December 2, at a joint meeting of the PUWP Central Committee and the State Council, former head of state Edward Gierek was removed. But immediately after this, Comrade Siwak demanded the immediate convocation of the Sejm and the declaration of martial law in the country. The State Council tried to resist, but then ORMO fighters broke into the meeting room. For two months in the country there was a de facto civil war in miniature, but the security forces of Poland supported the coup and, thus, ensured the victory of the coalition. The PUWP was dissolved, the CPP was legalized, "Solidarity" was virtually destroyed, and its right wing entered the Front of National Unity. The new leadership of Poland has already announced a course on "socialism with Polish national identity" and to come closer with us. The USSR is furious, but after the statements of the Polish leaders that "Poland does not intend to withdraw from the Warsaw Pact and the CMEA in any way and is in favor of the development of Soviet-Polish relations along the lines of good-neighborliness and cooperation", somewhat calmed down and de facto acknowledged changes.
0x0022BFCA.translated:
国家安全部（MSS）特工通过卡齐米日·米贾尔的地下共产党，
接触到波兰统一工人党（PUWP）中“混凝土派”的头目阿尔宾·
西瓦克。他憎恨“团结”，并多次要求对其动用武器。
凭借他在民族天主教团体“PAX”和右翼民族主义社团“格伦瓦尔
德”的关系，西瓦克很快就促成了他们同意与“混凝土派”和CPP
结成联盟。12月2日，在PUWP中央委员会与国务委员会的联合
会议上，前国家元首爱德华·吉莱克被撤职。
但就在此后不久，西瓦克同志就要求立即召开议会（Sejm），
并在全国宣布戒严。
国务委员会试图抵抗，但随后ORMO武装人员闯入会议室。
两个月内，国内出现了“微型内战”的事实局面；
但波兰安全力量支持了政变，从而确保了联盟的胜利。
PUWP被解散，CPP被合法化，“团结”几乎被摧毁，
其右翼进入“民族统一阵线”。
波兰新领导层已经宣布实行“带有波兰民族特征的社会主义”的路线，
并表示要与我们更靠近。
苏联十分恼怒，但在波兰领导人表示“波兰无论如何都不打算退出华
沙条约和经互会，并赞成按照睦邻友好与合作的方针发展苏波关系”
之后，才稍稍冷静下来，并在事实上承认了变化。

0x0022CBEB.text: The news of Gierek’s resignation made a very negative impression on you. At 23 o'clock you summoned the Soviet ambassador and asked to transfer personally to comrade Leonid Ilyich Brezhnev the following: "At this hour, the responsible tests for the fate of socialism in Poland, the Communist Party of China, fraternal parties of the allied states, all socialist countries cannot take the position of an outside observer. What happening in Poland is not only an internal affair of the Poles. Today at night we will appeal to all the leaders of the Warsaw Pact states with an urgent appeal to undertake vigorous joint military efforts in order to prevent of the collapse of socialism in Poland. The leadership of the People's Republic of China and the CPC is confident that socialist Poland can still be saved. Imperialism can and must be prevented in the cause of socialism".
0x0022CBEB.translated:
吉莱克辞职的消息给你留下了非常负面的印象。
23点时，你召见苏联大使，并要求他亲自向列昂尼德·伊里奇·勃
列日涅夫同志转达如下内容：“在这一时刻，
检验波兰社会主义命运的责任性考验，检验中共以及盟国兄弟党、
所有社会主义国家，不能采取旁观者的立场。
波兰发生的事情不仅是波兰人的内部事务。
今天夜里，我们将向华沙条约国家的所有领导人发出紧急呼吁，
要求他们采取有力的共同军事行动，以防止波兰社会主义的崩溃。
中华人民共和国和中共的领导层相信，社会主义波兰仍然可以被挽救。
为了社会主义事业，必须、也能够阻止帝国主义。
”

0x0022D2C2.text: Our appeal found support from the leadership of the GDR, Czechoslovakia, and then the leadership of the USSR. The military invasion plan was transmitted by Marshal N.V. Ogarkov, Chief of the General Staff of the USSR Supreme Soviet to Deputy Polish General Staff General T. Hupalovsky. The plan provided for the introduction of Soviet, East German and Czechoslovak troops into Polish territory. Polish troops were to remain in the barracks. The invasion force consisted of 15 Soviet divisions, 2 German and 1 Czechoslovak. A reconnaissance of the routes and troop concentration areas was conducted, in which Polish representatives took an active part. The operation involved: from the Czechoslovak People's Army - the headquarters of the Western Military District and two army headquarters; from the National People's Army of the GDR - two army headquarters; from the Soviet Army - the headquarters of the State Civil Aviation Command, its two army headquarters and the headquarters of the Northern Group of Forces. |On December 9, 1980, units of the Northern Group of Forces of the Armed Forces of the USSR, together with units of the National People’s Army of the GDR and the Czechoslovak People’s Army, entered Polish territory and began a rapid advance towards the key cities of the country. Parts of the Polish Army did not offer any resistance. "Solidarity" went underground, the PUWP leadership was arrested and taken to the USSR. The new leadership of the PPR, headed by General Wojciech Jaruzelski, announced a course on the "new line of socialism", which envisages carrying out reforms within the framework of Marxism under the supervision of Soviet troops. The United States is in a frenzy and full swing accusing the USSR and us of establishing a military dictatorship in Poland".
0x0022D2C2.translated:
我们的呼吁得到了德意志民主共和国（GDR）
领导层、捷克斯洛伐克领导层的支持，随后也得到了苏联领导层的支
持。军事入侵计划由苏联最高苏维埃总参谋长、
元帅N.V.奥加尔科夫传达给波兰副总参谋长、
将军T.胡帕洛夫斯基。
该计划规定将苏联、东德和捷克斯洛伐克部队引入波兰境内。
波兰军队则留在军营中。
入侵兵力由15个苏联师、2个德国师和1个捷克斯洛伐克师组成。
对路线和部队集结地域进行了侦察，其中波兰方面代表积极参与。
行动包括：来自捷克斯洛伐克人民军——西部军区司令部和两个集团
军司令部；来自GDR国家人民军——两个集团军司令部；
来自苏联军队——国家民航司令部、其两个集团军司令部以及北方兵
团司令部。 |1980年12月9日，
苏联武装力量北方兵团的部队，联合GDR国家人民军和捷克斯洛伐
克人民军的部队进入波兰境内，并迅速向该国的要害城市推进。
波兰军队的一部分没有进行任何抵抗。
“团结”转入地下，PUWP领导层被逮捕并押往苏联。
由雅鲁泽尔斯基将军领导的波兰人民共和国（PPR）
新领导层宣布实行“新的社会主义路线”，
即在苏联部队监督下，在马克思主义框架内进行改革。
美国则陷入疯狂，正大肆指责苏联和我们在波兰建立军事独裁。
”

0x0022E0C5.text: Unfortunately, the Soviet leadership, and then the leadership of the rest of the Warsaw Pact countries, did not decide on the use of troops to restore order, but supported the Polish military and sanctioned independent actions. The Minister of National Defense of the NDP, General Wojciech Jaruzelski, created the Military Council of National Salvation and on December 13, 1981 announced the introduction of martial law throughout the territory of the NDP. Decisive actions of the Polish Army, the Security Council and ZOMO (special units of the Civil Militia), the entire asset "Solidarity" and the PUWP leadership were interned and order in the country more or less restored. Announcing the "new line of socialism", Jaruzelski began economic reforms on the model of the Hungarian. However, the cardinal problems were not solved, which later will surely make itself known...
0x0022E0C5.translated:
不幸的是，苏联领导层，随后是华沙条约其他国家的领导层，
并未决定动用部队来恢复秩序，而是支持波兰军方，
并批准其自行采取行动。
NDP国防部长雅鲁泽尔斯基将军成立“民族拯救军事委员会”，
并于1981年12月13日宣布在NDP全境实行戒严。
波兰军队、安全委员会和ZOMO（民兵特种部队）
的果断行动，使“团结”这一全部力量以及PUWP领导层都被拘押，
国家秩序或多或少得以恢复。
雅鲁泽尔斯基宣布“新的社会主义路线”，
并开始按匈牙利模式进行经济改革。
然而，关键问题并未解决，日后必将显现出来……

0x0022E79E.text: We came into contact with the CIA and reached agreements on joint actions. But the situation took an unexpected turn - in the wake of intensified unrest, Stanislaw Kania, after secret consultations with the army command, unexpectedly announced his resignation from all posts. The first secretary of the PUWP Central Committee became a reform supporter, Mieczyslaw Rakowski, who was close to the Minister of National Defense of Poland, General Wojciech Jaruzelski. Through his connections in the "Solidarity", Rakowski made contact with Walesa and offered a compromise advantageous to both sides - "Solidarity" officially legalized, but refused to fight power and went to the parliament, it will receive several portfolios in the new government and admission to the drafting of a broad reform. He agreed. Rakowski announced the concept of "new line of socialism", implying very broad reforms following the example of Hungary and Yugoslavia. Leadership "Solidarity" supported these reforms and announced the cessation of demonstrations and strikes. The situation is slowly normalizing, despite the fact that the USSR reacted to such an unexpected "exit" with very strong suspicion, and if Rakowski loses control of the situation during the reforms, then Poland will be waiting for its 1968th...
0x0022E79E.translated:
我们与中央情报局（CIA）取得联系，
并就联合行动达成协议。
但局势出现了意外转折——在骚乱加剧的背景下，
斯坦尼斯瓦夫·卡尼亚在与军队指挥部秘密磋商后，
竟然意外宣布辞去所有职务。
PUWP中央委员会第一书记由改革派支持者、
与波兰国防部长雅鲁泽尔斯基将军关系密切的米耶奇斯瓦夫·拉科夫
斯基担任。拉科夫斯基凭借其在“团结”中的关系与瓦文萨取得联系，
并提出对双方都有利的折中方案——“团结”被正式合法化，
但拒绝争夺政权，转而进入议会；它将在新政府中获得若干内阁席位，
并参与起草一揽子改革。
他同意了。拉科夫斯基宣布“新的社会主义路线”理念，
意味着将效仿匈牙利和南斯拉夫进行非常广泛的改革。
“团结”领导层支持这些改革，并宣布停止示威和罢工。
局势正在慢慢走向正常，尽管苏联对这种意外“出局”反应极为强烈
地怀疑；而如果拉科夫斯基在改革过程中失去对局势的控制，
那么波兰将迎来它的1968年……

0x0022F1B9.text: Unfortunately, even though we supported the efforts of the United States to destabilize the situation in Poland, it did not work out to achieve positive results. At first, everything went according to plan - in December, "Solidarity" attempted a coup with the support of the broad masses of the people and was able to seize the government quarter in Warsaw. But then the unexpected happened - Stanislaw Kania fled to Bialystok and turned to the PCC of the Warsaw Pact for military assistance. On December 9, 1980, units of the Northern Group of Forces of the Armed Forces of the USSR, together with units of the National People’s Army of the GDR and the Czechoslovak People’s Army, entered Polish territory and began a rapid advance towards the key cities of the country. Parts of the Polish Army either joined them or remained neutral. "Solidarity" was actually destroyed, and Lech Walesa barely managed to escape to the American embassy in Warsaw. The new leadership of the PPR, headed by General Wojciech Jaruzelski, announced a course on the "new line of socialism", which envisages the implementation of reforms within Marxism under the supervision of Soviet troops...
0x0022F1B9.translated:
不幸的是，尽管我们支持美国破坏波兰局势的努力，
但并未能取得积极成果。
起初一切都按计划进行——12月，“团结”在广大群众的支持下发
动政变，成功夺取了华沙的政府区。
但随后发生了意外——斯坦尼斯瓦夫·卡尼亚逃往比亚韦斯托克，
并向华沙条约的波兰共产党（PCC）请求军事援助。
1980年12月9日，苏联武装力量北方兵团的部队，
联合GDR国家人民军和捷克斯洛伐克人民军的部队进入波兰境内，
并迅速向该国要害城市推进。
波兰军队的一部分要么加入了他们，要么保持中立。
“团结”实际上被摧毁，莱赫·瓦文萨几乎才得以逃到华沙的美国使
馆。由雅鲁泽尔斯基将军领导的波兰人民共和国（PPR）
新领导层宣布实行“新的社会主义路线”，
即在苏联部队监督下，在马克思主义框架内实施改革……

0x0022FB06.text: On May 27, aviation and army units of South Korea, as part of five divisions, broke into the city center and captured it in just 90 minutes. The number of killed civilians according to various estimates ranges from several hundred to several thousand.
0x0022FB06.translated:
5月27日，作为五个师的一部分，韩国空军和陆军部队突入市中心，
仅用90分钟便将其占领。
根据不同估算，被杀害的平民人数从数百到数千不等。

0x0022FCFF.text: Thanks to our supply of weapons and the introduction of confusion in the plans of the South Korean army and sabotage, the assault on Gwangju has become a long and bloody character. Moreover, having learned (thanks to our agents) about the massacre that is taking place, people from other cities and regions of South Korea also came out to protest, turning into open clashes with the army and the police, seizing administrative buildings and armories. In the end, the army managed to seize Gwangju, brutally cracking down on the rebels, and the rest of the biggest insurrections were somehow crushed. However, protests in various cities are still ongoing and the stability of the government of Chun Doo-hwan hangs in the balance.
0x0022FCFF.translated:
多亏我们提供武器，并在韩国军队的部署中制造混乱、
实施破坏，针对光州的进攻变成了一场漫长而血腥的战斗。
更何况，在（多亏我们的特工）得知正在发生的屠杀之后，
韩国其他城市和地区的人们也纷纷出来抗议，
演变为与军队和警察的公开冲突，夺取行政大楼和军械库。
最终，军队还是设法占领了光州，对反叛者进行残酷镇压，
其余最大的起义也不知怎的被压了下去。
然而，各地的抗议仍在继续，权力集团全斗焕政府的稳定摇摇欲坠。

0x002302B2.text: We called on the South Korean authorities and the insurgent Gwangju to negotiate and find a compromise. These statements were supported by the rebels themselves, but due to the fact that the United States (with the exception of some politicians who supported our statement) did not express any support for the protesters and a peaceful resolution of the conflict, our call was ignored by the authorities. On May 27, aviation and army units of South Korea, as part of five divisions, broke into the city center and captured it in just 90 minutes. The number of killed civilians according to various estimates ranges from several hundred to several thousand.
0x002302B2.translated:
我们呼吁韩国当局与光州起义者进行谈判、
寻求折中。这些表态得到了起义者本身的支持，
但由于美国（除了一些支持我们表态的政客外）
并未对抗议者以及通过和平方式解决冲突表示任何支持，
我们的呼吁被当局无视。
5月27日，作为五个师的一部分，韩国空军和陆军部队突入市中心，
仅用90分钟便将其占领。
根据不同估算，被杀害的平民人数从数百到数千不等。

0x002307D5.text: After the South Korean army captured the city in 90 minutes, brutally suppressing the uprising, we expressed support for the actions of Chun Doo-hwan, saying that such tough measures were the only adequate response to the chaos organized by the insurgents. The South Korean government thanked us for the support, but quite a few countries, especially the socialist camp, took it with extreme disapproval.
0x002307D5.translated:
在韩国军队用90分钟攻占城市、对起义进行残酷镇压之后，
我们表示支持全斗焕的行动，称这种强硬措施是对起义者所策划的混
乱所能作出的唯一恰当回应。
韩国政府对我们的支持表示感谢，但不少国家，
尤其是社会主义阵营，对此极为不满。

0x00230B1C.text: Conservatives continue to hold their posts, undermining your reforms and with the people and the CPC. And the reformers themselves are unhappy with your passivity.
0x00230B1C.translated:
保守派继续把持岗位，破坏你的改革，并与人民和中共作对。
而改革派自己也对你的消极不满。

0x00230C65.text: At the V Plenum of the CPC Central Committee in February, Wang Dongxing, Ji Dengkui, Chen Xilian and Wu De were criticized for "ultra-left tendencies", they were accused of participating in the repressions of the Cultural Revolution and named "The Little Gang of Four". As a result of the plenum, all four were removed from party and government posts, deprived of any influence. The same fate befell the conservatives clinging to them in the lower echelons. Their places are already occupied by your loyal supporters-refomrers, and the people they are promoting.
0x00230C65.translated:
2月召开的中共第V次中央全会（五届？）
上，王东兴、纪登奎、陈希连和吴德因“左倾”而遭到批评；
他们被指控参与了文化大革命的镇压，并被称为“‘四人帮’的小帮
”。全会结果是，这四人全部被撤出党政岗位，
失去任何影响力。那些在基层紧跟他们的保守派也遭遇同样的下场。
他们的位置已经被你忠诚的支持者——改革派——以及他们所推举的
人所占据。

0x002310CC.text: At the V Plenum of the CPC Central Committee in February, Wang Dongxing, Ji Dengkui, Chen Xilian and Wu De were criticized for "ultra-left tendencies", they were accused of participating in the repressions of the Cultural Revolution and named "The Little Gang of Four". As a result of the plenum, all four were removed from party and government posts, deprived of any influence. The same fate befell the conservatives clinging to them in the lower echelons.
0x002310CC.translated:
二月召开的中共十一届五中全会（V Plenum）
上，汪东兴、纪登奎、陈希然（Chen Xilian）
和吴德因“极左倾向”遭到批判，被指控参与了文化大革命的镇压，
并被称为“小四人帮”。
全会结果是四人全部被撤销党政职务，失去任何影响力。
那些在基层死抱着他们不放的保守派，也遭遇同样下场。

0x00231461.text: The problems of Zhou Enlai's heirs

0x002314A7.text: Reformers continue to hold their posts, undermining your undertakings and your reputation with the people and the CPC. And the left wing itself is dissatisfied with your passivity.
0x002314A7.translated:
改革派继续把持岗位，破坏你的事业，也损害你在人民和中共中的声
誉。而左翼本身也对你的消极不满。

0x00231612.text: At the 5th Plenum of the CPC Central Committee in February, the old reformers, such as Deng Xiaoping, Ye Jianying and Zhao Ziyang, were severely criticized for their revisionist positions, their striving for bourgeois liberalization and the betrayal of Mao's ideas. Despite heated discussions, following the results of the plenum, reformers and some moderates were removed from party and government posts, deprived of any influence. The same fate befell the reformers they cover in the lower echelons.
0x00231612.translated:
二月召开的中共十一届五中全会（5th Plenum）
上，邓小平、叶剑英、赵紫阳等“老改革派”因其修正主义立场、
鼓吹资产阶级自由化、背叛毛泽东思想而遭到严厉批判。
尽管讨论激烈，但在全会结果公布后，改革派以及部分中间派被撤销
党政职务，失去任何影响力。
那些在基层为他们遮护的改革派，也遭遇同样下场。

0x002319FF.text: At the 5th Plenum of the CPC Central Committee in February, the old reformers, such as Deng Xiaoping, Ye Jianying and Zhao Ziyang, were severely criticized for their revisionist positions, their striving for bourgeois liberalization and the betrayal of Mao's ideas. Moreover, these accusations even supported the moderates once solidary with the reformers, thanks to the fact that you carried out, so much desired by them, the coagulation of the Cultural Revolution and the reappraisal of Mao. As a result of the plenum, the reformers were removed from party and government posts, deprived of any influence. The same fate befell the reformers they cover in the lower echelons.
0x002319FF.translated:
二月召开的中共十一届五中全会（5th Plenum）
上，邓小平、叶剑英、赵紫阳等“老改革派”因其修正主义立场、
鼓吹资产阶级自由化、背叛毛泽东思想而遭到严厉批判。
更有甚者，这些指控甚至也“照顾”了曾与改革派同一阵线的中间派
——因为你做了他们梦寐以求的事：把文化大革命“定型”，
并重新评价毛。结果是改革派被撤销党政职务，
失去任何影响力。那些在基层为他们遮护的改革派，
也遭遇同样下场。

0x00231F4A.text: According to your order, the leaders of the reformers were arrested on trumped up charges and were permanently removed from politics. After that, with the active participation of the media controlled by us, the discredit of reformist ideas and supporters of repressed reformers began, with which the party began to be cleared of them. The people and the party are themselves unhappy and consider it a repetition of the events of the Cultural Revolution, but we got rid of our opponents.
0x00231F4A.translated:
奉你的命令，改革派头目被以莫须有的罪名逮捕，
并被永久逐出政治舞台。
之后，在我们控制的媒体积极配合下，开始对改革主义思想及被镇压
的改革派支持者进行抹黑，党内也随之开始清除他们。
人民和党内人士都不高兴，认为这不过是文化大革命的重演，
但我们总算除掉了对手。

0x0023233F.text: Nothing has changed, the Naxalites continue their attacks, and the Indian government with varying success is trying to contain them. But who knows, maybe someday they will come in handy to us, because they also operate in the territories to which we pretend...
0x0023233F.translated:
一切照旧，人民解放游击队（Naxalites）
继续发动袭击，印度政府时而得手、时而失手，
试图遏制他们。但谁知道呢，也许有一天他们会派上用场——因为他
们也活动在我们“假装”不去管的那些地区……

0x0023254A.text: After long disputes and hesitations, the Indian government nevertheless agreed to negotiate with the Naxalites with our mediation. With great difficulty, following the results of the negotiations, they managed to achieve a transition to peaceful struggle in exchange for places in local governments and self-government bodies (in a few they even managed to get the majority) and recognize them as legal political force. Of course, some troops and groups have already called it a betrayal, but what do we care about these terrorists? Our influence in eastern India has been greatly strengthened.
0x0023254A.translated:
经过长期争论与犹豫，印度政府最终还是同意在我们的斡旋下与人民
解放游击队（Naxalites）谈判。
谈判结果极其不易，他们才换取到在地方政府和自治机构中的席位（
少数地方甚至拿下多数），并承认他们为合法政治力量。
固然也有一些部队和团体已把这称作背叛，
但我们在乎这些恐怖分子吗？
我们在印度东部的影响力已大为增强。

0x002329F1.text: The PLA units managed to break down the defenses of the first border units relatively quickly, but then they rested on Indian fortifications well organized since our last border war. It seems that the war will be longer and bloodier than we thought... Meanwhile, the whole world is already looking askance at us and demands that we immediately sit at the negotiating table.
0x002329F1.translated:
解放军部队相对迅速地击溃了第一道边防，
但随后却陷入了印度方面自上次边境战争以来就组织得很好的工事。
看来这场战争会比我们想象的更久、更血腥……
与此同时，全世界已经在冷眼旁观，要求我们立刻坐到谈判桌前。

0x00232CFE.text: The Janata Party was extremely popular with the people and all analysts predicted that they would take the place of the INC and become the main party of the country for decades, but eventually, under the pressure of internal squabbles and intrigues, Janata Party leader Morarji Desai resigned as prime minister and the coalition itself fell apart, causing a major political vacuum in the country. His successor, Charan Singh, is likely to remain in power well into the 1980 elections, where a motley coalition of the INC, leftist Janata Party and Communist Party is predicted to win, after which Gandhi may come to power again.
0x00232CFE.translated:
人民党（Janata Party）在民众中极受欢迎，
所有分析人士都预测他们将取代国大党（INC），
成为国家数十年的主要政党；但最终，
在党内争斗与阴谋的压力下，人民党领袖莫拉尔吉·德赛（Mora
rji Desai）辞去总理职务，联盟本身也随之瓦解，
造成全国性的重大政治真空。
他的继任者查兰·辛格（Charan Singh）
很可能执政到1980年选举之后——届时预计由国大党、
左翼人民党和共产党组成的混合联盟将获胜，
之后甘地（Gandhi）可能再次上台。

0x002331E7.text: In the end, under the pressure of internal squabbles and intrigues, the  Janata leader Morarji Desai resigned as prime minister. Charan Singh, who replaced him, is likely to hold out until the elections of 1980, after which Gandhi will replace him again.
0x002331E7.translated:
最终，在党内争斗与阴谋的压力下，人民党领袖莫拉尔吉·德赛辞去
总理职务。由他接任的查兰·辛格很可能撑到1980年选举，
之后甘地又将取而代之。

0x002333E6.text: Our diplomats managed to convince Janatа leader Morarji Desai of the need to accept the demands of the left wing, primarily relating to the ban on dual membership - in Janata and other parties, directed mainly against representatives of the right wing, both in their own parties. As a result, most of them preferred their parties and were expelled from Janata, while Desai retained the post of prime minister with the support of the left wing. Having defined its political orientation, Janata is now implementing a leftist policy aimed mainly at developing production and fighting poverty, for which we had to give India a loan at a low rate. It seems now the party has been rehabilitated in the eyes of the people and has every chance in the upcoming elections.
0x002333E6.translated:
我们的外交人员成功说服人民党领袖莫拉尔吉·德赛，
接受左翼提出的要求——主要是禁止“双重党籍”：
在人民党及其他政党之间的双重任职，主要针对各自党内的右翼代表。
结果是他们中的大多数选择留在本党，
并被逐出人民党；而德赛则在左翼支持下保住了总理职位。
明确了政治取向后，人民党正在推行以发展生产、
反贫困为主的左翼政策，为此我们不得不以低利率向印度提供贷款。
看来该党已在人民眼中“翻案”，在即将到来的选举中大有机会。

0x002339DD.text: Our diplomats managed to convince Janatа leader Morarji Desai of the need to repel the demands of the left wing concerning, primarily relating to the ban on dual membership - in Janata and other parties, directed mainly against representatives of the right wing, both in their own parties. As a result, most of the left wing was excluded for splitting and violation of the principles of collective leadership, while Desai retained the post of prime minister with the support of the right wing. Having defined his political orientation, Janata is now implementing a right-liberal policy aimed mainly at attracting foreign investment and forming "genuine democracy", to which we had to give India a loan at a low rate. It seems now the party has been rehabilitated in the eyes of the people and has every chance in the upcoming elections.
0x002339DD.translated:
我们的外交人员成功说服人民党领袖莫拉尔吉·德赛，
拒绝左翼提出的要求——主要是关于禁止“双重党籍”：
在人民党及其他政党之间的双重任职，主要针对各自党内的右翼代表。
结果是左翼大多数因分裂和违反集体领导原则而被排除在外，
而德赛则在右翼支持下保住了总理职位。
明确了自己的政治取向后，人民党现在推行以吸引外资、
建立“真正的民主”为主的右翼自由化政策，
为此我们不得不以低利率向印度提供贷款。
看来该党已在人民眼中“翻案”，在即将到来的选举中大有机会。

0x00234068.text: The decision on some questions of the history of the CPC
0x00234068.translated: 关于中共历史若干问题的决议

0x002340DA.text: From 27 to 29 June 1981, Beijing hosted the 6th Plenum of the Central Committee of the Communist party of China of the 11th convocation, which was attended by 195 members of the CPC Central Committee and 114 candidates for the CPC Central Committee, as well as 53 invited persons. The agenda of the Plenum was: consideration and adoption of "Decisions on some questions of the history of the CPC since the founding of the PRC". Unanimously adopted by the Plenum "The decision on some questions of the history of the CPC since the founding of the PRC" from the Marxist position — the position of dialectical and historical materialism correctly summed up the most important events in the history of the party for 32 years after the formation of the PRC, analyzed the subjective factors and social causes of errors, gave a fair assessment of the place of the great leader and wise teacher, comrade Mao Zedong, in the history of the Chinese revolution, fully justified the great importance of Mao Zedong's ideas as the guiding ideas of our party. The "Decision" confirmed the correctness of the way of building a modern socialist power, and also indicated the further direction of the development of the cause of socialism in our country and the work of the party.
0x002340DA.translated:
1981年6月27日至29日，北京召开中共十一届六中全会。
出席全会的有中共中央委员195人、候补委员114人，
以及53名列席人员。
全会的议程是：审议并通过《中华人民共和国成立以来中共历史若干
问题的决议》。全会一致通过《中华人民共和国成立以来中共历史若
干问题的决议》，从马克思主义立场——辩证唯物主义和历史唯物主
义的立场——正确总结了中华人民共和国成立后32年中党的历史上
最重要的事件，分析了错误的主观因素和社会原因，
对伟大领袖和导师毛泽东同志在中国革命史上的地位作出了公正评价，
充分论证了毛泽东思想作为我党指导思想的重大意义。
《决议》确认了建设现代化社会主义强国道路的正确性，
并指明了我国社会主义事业发展的进一步方向以及党的工作。

0x00234AB7.text: From 27 to 29 June 1981, Beijing hosted the 6th Plenum of the Central Committee of the Communist party of China of the 11th convocation, which was attended by 195 members of the CPC Central Committee and 114 candidates for the CPC Central Committee, as well as 53 invited persons. The agenda of the Plenum was: consideration and adoption of "Decision on some questions of the history of the CPC since the founding of the PRC". Unanimously adopted by the Plenum "the Decision on some questions of the history of our party since the formation of China" from a Marxist position — the positions of dialectical and historical materialism correctly summed up the most important events in the history of the party for 32 years after the formation of the PRC, and especially the "cultural revolution", scientifically analyzed the correct and erroneous in the leading ideas of the party during these events, analyzed the subjective factors and social causes of errors, gave a fair assessment of the place of the great leader and teacher of comrade Mao Zedong in the history of the Chinese revolution, fully justified the great importance of Mao Zedong's ideas as the guiding ideas of our party.
0x00234AB7.translated:
1981年6月27日至29日，北京召开中共十一届六中全会。
出席全会的有中共中央委员195人、候补委员114人，
以及53名列席人员。
全会的议程是：审议并通过《中华人民共和国成立以来中共历史若干
问题的决议》。全会一致通过《我国建国以来党的历史若干问题的决
议》，从马克思主义立场——辩证唯物主义和历史唯物主义的立场—
—正确总结了中华人民共和国成立后32年中党的历史上最重要的事
件，尤其是“文化大革命”，科学分析了党在这些事件中指导思想的
正确与错误，分析了错误的主观因素和社会原因，
对毛泽东同志作为伟大领袖和导师在中国革命史上的地位作出公正评
价，充分论证了毛泽东思想作为我党指导思想的重大意义。

0x002353FC.text: From 27 to 29 June 1981, Beijing hosted the 6th Plenum of the Central Committee of the Communist party of China of the 11th convocation, which was attended by 195 members of the CPC Central Committee and 114 candidates for the CPC Central Committee, as well as 53 invited persons. The agenda of the Plenum was: consideration and adoption of "Decision on some questions of the history of the CPC since the founding of the PRC". "The decision on some questions of the history of our party since the formation of the PRC" caused extremely serious disputes and was adopted with a small majority of votes. It is with the Marxist position, the position of dialectical and historical materialism summarized the most important events in the history of the party for 32 years after the founding of the PRC, and in particular "cultural revolution", criticized all incorrect in the guiding ideas of the party in the course of these events, analyzed the subjective factors of Mao Zedong and the social causes of errors, gave a fair assessment of the place of Mao Zedong in the history of the Chinese revolution - as "Eastern despot and tyrant", fully justified the great importance of the ideas of Marx-Engels-Lenin as the guiding ideas of our party and rejected the anti-Marxist views of Mao Zedong.
0x002353FC.translated:
1981年6月27日至29日，北京召开中共第十一届中央委员会
第六次全体会议。出席会议的有中共中央委员195人、
中共中央候补委员114人，以及53名列席人员。
全会的议程是：审议并通过《中华人民共和国成立以来我党历史若干
问题的决议》。“关于中华人民共和国成立以来我党历史若干问题的
决议”引发了极其严重的争论，并以少数票通过。
该决议以马克思主义立场、以辩证唯物主义和历史唯物主义的立场，
总结了中华人民共和国成立后32年我党历史上最重要的事件，
尤其是“文化大革命”，批判了在这些事件过程中党在指导思想上的
一切错误，分析了毛泽东的主观因素以及错误的社会原因，
对毛泽东在中国革命史上的地位作出了相对公允的评价——称其为“
东方的专制暴君”；同时充分论证了马克思-恩格斯-列宁思想作为
我党指导思想的重大意义，并否定了毛泽东的反马克思主义观点。

0x00235E0F.text: From 27 to 29 June 1981, Beijing hosted the 6th Plenum of the Central Committee of the Communist party of China of the 11th convocation, which was attended by 195 members of the CPC Central Committee and 114 candidates for the CPC Central Committee, as well as 53 invited persons. The agenda of the Plenum was: consideration and adoption of "Decisions on some questions of the history of our party since the formation of the PRC". The plenary considered the "Decision" and considered it "insufficiently prepared and quite wrong", sending it for revision to the commission.
0x00235E0F.translated:
1981年6月27日至29日，北京召开中共第十一届中央委员会
第六次全体会议。出席会议的有中共中央委员195人、
中共中央候补委员114人，以及53名列席人员。
全会的议程是：审议并通过《中华人民共和国成立以来我党历史若干
问题的决议》。全会审议了这份《决议》，
认为其“准备不足且相当错误”，于是将其送交委员会修改。

0x0023628A.text: The Commission corrected the excesses in the text, highlighting the leadership role of Chairman Mao in the Chinese revolution and the development of the country, but pointing to excesses of both right and left. This version was adopted by the Plenum.
0x0023628A.translated:
起草机构对文稿中的偏差进行了修正，强调毛主席在中国革命和国家
发展中的领导作用，同时指出右和左两方面的偏差。
该版本被全会通过。

0x00236481.text: The Commission corrected the excesses in the text, guided by the principle of "correcting everything wrong and strengthening everything right", giving a balanced assessment of the 40-70s period. This option was adopted by the Plenum.
0x00236481.translated:
起草机构对文稿中的偏差进行了修正，遵循“纠正一切错误、
发扬一切正确”的原则，对40—70年代作出相对均衡的评价。
该方案被全会通过。

0x00236656.text: The Commission corrected the excesses in the text, focusing on Khrushchev's 1956 "secret report", as well as documents of Western intelligence agencies and Soviet publications, exposing Mao Zedong and his time of leadership. This option was adopted by the Plenum.
0x00236656.translated:
起草机构对文稿中的偏差进行了修正，重点引用赫鲁晓夫1956年
的“秘密报告”，以及西方情报机构的文件和苏联出版物，
揭露毛泽东及其领导时期。
该方案被全会通过。

0x00236867.text: From 27 to 28 June 1981, Beijing hosted the 6th Plenum of the Central Committee of the Communist party of China of the 11th convocation, which was attended by 195 members of the CPC Central Committee and 114 candidates for the CPC Central Committee, as well as 53 invited persons. The agenda of the Plenum was: consideration and adoption of "Decisions on some questions of the history of our party since the formation of the PRC". At the request Of the Chairman of the CPC, the issue was removed from the agenda, stating that it is "obsolete and unimportant". The Plenum is completing its work.
0x00236867.translated:
1981年6月27日至28日，北京召开中共十一届六中全会。
出席全会的有中共中央委员195人、候补委员114人，
以及53名列席人员。
全会的议程是：审议并通过《中华人民共和国成立以来我党历史若干
问题的决议》。应中共主席的要求，该议题从议程中撤下，
理由是“过时且不重要”。
全会正在完成其工作。

0x00236D44.text: Immediately after the air strike, Saddam Hussein spoke at an emergency meeting of the Council of Ministers of Iraq with a bright speech, in which he said: "the Blow that was struck today at the reactor "Tammuz" was not sudden for us. But, of course, it becomes painful, because it is one of the good fruits of the revolution, which we have long cared a lot about politically, scientifically and economically... This is not because they are afraid of the Iraqi atomic bomb, as the leader of the Tel Aviv gang says, but because they are afraid of scientific, social, economic, political, balanced and compact development, which is seriously aimed at building a new Iraq... We do not have an international side, so we will postpone all the excuses, because the blow was struck against us... You understand why there was a war - not just to direct a blow to the Iraqi nuclear reactor, but to stop the Iraqi rise... and you understand why the war will continue...". We fully supported Saddam and condemned the "bandit attack of American mercenaries from Israel" and also suggested economic and military aid to Iraq, to which Hussein agreed with pleasure. Although Iraq continues to pursue a multi-vector foreign policy, without reducing cooperation with the USSR and the United States, there is a certain bias in our direction... American allies in the middle East are furious, but the US itself reacted surprisingly calmly...
0x00236D44.translated:
空袭发生后不久，萨达姆·侯赛因在伊拉克部长会议紧急会议上发表
慷慨激昂的讲话，他说：“今天对‘塔穆兹’反应堆所打的这一击，
对我们来说并不突然。
当然，它会让人痛，因为它是革命的一个丰硕成果——我们长期在政
治、科学和经济上都非常重视它……
这并不是因为他们害怕伊拉克的原子弹——正如特拉维夫那伙人的
头目所说——而是因为他们害怕科学、社会、
经济、政治的均衡而紧凑的发展，这种发展是严肃地为了建设一个新
的伊拉克……我们没有站队，所以我们将推迟所有借口，
因为这一击是打在我们身上……
你们明白为什么会有战争——不仅仅是为了打击伊拉克的核反应堆，
而是为了阻止伊拉克的崛起……
你们也明白为什么战争还会继续……
”我们全力支持萨达姆，并谴责“来自以色列的美国雇佣军匪徒袭
击”，同时建议向伊拉克提供经济与军事援助，
侯赛因对此欣然同意。
尽管伊拉克继续奉行多方向的外交政策，
在不削弱与苏联和美国合作的同时，仍对我们这边有某种倾斜……
中东的美国盟友勃然大怒，但美国本身却出奇地冷静……

0x00237861.text: Immediately after the air strike, Saddam Hussein spoke at an emergency meeting of the Council of Ministers of Iraq with a bright speech, in which he said: "the Blow that was struck today at the reactor "Tammuz" was not sudden for us. But, of course, it becomes painful, because it is one of the good fruits of the revolution, which we have long cared a lot about politically, scientifically and economically... This is not because they are afraid of the Iraqi atomic bomb, as the leader of the Tel Aviv gang says, but because they are afraid of scientific, social, economic, political, balanced and compact development, which is seriously aimed at building a new Iraq..." Iraq appealed to the UN, demanding to condemn Israel's actions, and Saddam was supported by both superpowers - the USSR and the United States. The security Council demanded for Israel to pay compensation and refrain from such actions in the future. In Israel itself, many of the opposition members, led by Shimon Peres, criticized the government's decision. However, defense minister Ariel Sharon firmly responded to the criticism: "an integral element of our military policy is the firm intention to prevent the access of enemy states to nuclear weapons. Therefore, we must eliminate this threat in the bud". According to our data, Iraq has increased the purchase of weapons in the USSR and the United States, taking a course for a qualitative re-equipment of its army.

而萨达姆同时得到两大超级大国——苏联和美国——的支持。
安理会要求以色列赔偿，并在未来停止此类行动。
以色列国内，许多反对派议员在西蒙·佩雷斯（Shimon Pe
res）带领下批评政府决定。
然而国防部长阿里埃尔·沙龙（Ariel Sharon）
对批评作出坚定回应：“我们军事政策的一个组成要素，
就是坚决阻止敌对国家获得核武器。
因此，我们必须在萌芽阶段消除这种威胁。
”据我们掌握的情况，伊拉克已增加从苏联和美国购买武器的数量，
走上对军队进行质的换装之路。
