0x002389D7.text: decided to offer to help Iraq resume its nuclear programme, to which Saddam gladly agreed. In the nuclear center named after the July revolution (Thuvaitha desert) , Chinese workers appeared, and soon the CNP-200 nuclear reactor was delivered there (while the attempt of "Mossad" agets to blow up the ship on which we transported it was prevented). Work on nuclear weapons is in full swing, according to our scientists, by 1988 Iraq will have 3 atomic bombs, and in 1995 - already 5. Israel is furious and accuses  "Han chauvinists" in "world domination", but the Soviet Union and the United States had not yet responded to this.
0x002389D7.translated:
决定帮助伊拉克恢复核计划，萨达姆对此欣然同意。
在以七月革命命名的核中心（图韦塔伊萨沙漠）
里，中国工人到来，并很快把CNP-200核反应堆运抵（与此同
时，“摩萨德”企图炸毁我们运输该设备的船只的行动被挫败）。
据我们的科学家称，核武器研制正如火如荼：
到1988年伊拉克将拥有3枚原子弹，
1995年则将达到5枚。
以色列勃然大怒，指责“汉族沙文主义者”在“世界霸权”，
但苏联和美国尚未对此作出回应。

0x00238EC6.text: Now that Iraq may have its own nuclear weapons, Saddam Hussein began a large-scale campaign to "return everything robbed from us by the imperialists" and "cleansing the nation from enemies and zionists". Iraq is heavily militirizing and starts to cut diplomatic ties, going into international isolation...
0x00238EC6.translated:
既然伊拉克可能拥有自己的核武器，萨达姆·侯赛因便发动大规模运
动，口号是“把帝国主义从我们这里抢走的一切都夺回来”，
以及“清除民族中的敌人和犹太复国主义者”。
伊拉克加紧军事化，并开始切断外交关系，
走向国际孤立……

0x0023912D.text: The Iraqi nuclear programme attracted the attention of the IAEA. It accused Iraq of violating the NPT and demanded that it must work only on a peaceful atom under the control of international organizations. Since the Soviet Union and the United States supported this demand, Hussein was forced to agree. However, starting a peaceful program also failed - on December 1, the Israel air force made a second air strike and the reactor was completely destroyed. Because he was afraid of losing power, he decided to go to our side.
0x0023912D.translated:
伊拉克的核计划引起了国际原子能机构（IAEA）
的关注。它指控伊拉克违反《不扩散核武器条约》（NPT），
并要求伊拉克只能在国际组织监管下从事和平利用核能。
由于苏联和美国支持这一要求，侯赛因被迫同意。
然而，启动和平计划也同样失败——12月1日，
以色列空军实施第二次空袭，反应堆被彻底摧毁。
出于担心失去权力，他决定转向我们这边。

0x0023954E.text: We fully approved the Israeli air strike on the reactor "Tammuz" and condemned Hussein for his course on militarism, great Arab chauvinism and the suppression of the Kurdish minority. This caused a serious misunderstanding in the party and the people, which did not expect such an open support for Israel after so many years of criticism of its policy. In response, the Iraqi Council of Ministers issued a communiqué accusing China of "supporting a zionist gang from Tel Aviv" and decided to break off diplomatic relations. Our Embassy was forcibly expelled from Baghdad, and Iraq increased purchases of weapons in the USSR and the United States, taking a course for a qualitative re-equipment of its army. It looks like there's a new war in the Middle east...
0x0023954E.translated:
我们完全赞同以色列对“塔穆兹”反应堆的空袭，
并谴责侯赛因的军国主义路线、泛阿拉伯沙文主义以及对库尔德少数
民族的压制。这在党和人民中造成了严重误解——他们并不指望在多
年批评以色列政策之后，会出现如此公开的支持。
作为回应，伊拉克部长会议发表公报，指控中国“支持来自特拉维夫
的犹太复国主义匪帮”，并决定断绝外交关系。
我们的使馆被强行逐出巴格达；与此同时，
伊拉克增加了从苏联和美国购买武器的数量，
走上对军队进行质的换装之路。
看来中东又要爆发新战争了……

0x00239B6D.text: The Ministry of foreign affairs of the PRC issued a communiqué in which it officially expressed support for "protesters for their legitimate democratic rights" to Kosovo demonstrators. This caused a sharp indignation of Yugoslavia, which accused China of interfering in its internal affairs, and its non-aligned Movement, which accused China of "maoist hegemony". The USSR and the US ignored this, largely because of the "independent" position of the SFRY, which was not included in any of the blocs. A state of emergency was imposed in Kosovo and  parts of the JNA entered, which by 3 April had suppressed all protests and restored order in the province. There was found evidence of the intervention of Albania. Massive cleanings of the separatists began.
0x00239B6D.translated:
中华人民共和国外交部发表公报，正式表示支持科索沃示威者“为其
正当民主权利而进行的抗议”。
这引起南斯拉夫的强烈愤怒：它指责中国干涉其内政；
而其不结盟运动则指责中国搞“毛主义霸权”。
苏联和美国对此置之不理，主要是因为南斯拉夫社会主义联邦共和国
（SFRY）采取“独立”立场，不属于任何阵营。
科索沃实施紧急状态，部分南斯拉夫人民军（JNA）
进入当地，到4月3日已镇压了所有抗议并恢复了省内秩序。
还发现阿尔巴尼亚介入的证据。
对分裂分子的“大清洗”随即开始。

0x0023A158.text: At a closed meeting of the Politburo, it was decided to take advantage of the problems of Yugoslavia and provide full assistance to the Kosovo separatists. As a "transfer point" we decided to use the Chinese Embassy in Belgrade. Having received weapons and money from us, the Kosovo separatists were able to organize armed resistance to parts of the JNA and the people's militia. In Pristina began the most real street-fighting, in which Yugoslav military actively have been applying artillery and aircraft, resulting in a destroyed city. Reports "Pristina is on fire!" were dispersed around the world, which dealt a strong hit to the international prestige of the SFRY, and although the rebellion was still managed to be suppressed by June, huge funds are needed for the restoration of the region, which Yugoslavia does not have. |In April 1981, at a meeting of the Presidium of the SFRY and the Federal Council for the protection of the constitutional order, L. Kolishevsky said: "We must be fully aware of the fallacy and extreme reactionism of the thesis – the weaker Serbia, the stronger Kosovo (or any other of our republics). As well as the thesis – the smaller the autonomy of Kosovo within Serbia, the stronger Serbia. This can be also said about the thesis – weak Serbia – strong Yugoslavia". The nationalists are beginning to strengthen their positions in the country...
0x0023A158.translated:
在政治局闭门会议上，决定利用南斯拉夫的麻烦局势，
向科索沃分裂分子提供全面援助。
作为“转运点”，我们决定使用驻贝尔格莱德的中国使馆。
科索沃分裂分子从我们这里获得武器和资金后，
便能够组织对部分JNA和民兵的武装抵抗。
普里什蒂纳（Pristina）爆发了最真实的街头巷战，
南斯拉夫军队积极使用炮火和飞机，导致城市被毁。
“普里什蒂纳正在燃烧！
”的报道传遍世界，给SFRY的国际声望造成重创。
尽管叛乱仍在6月前被压下，但要恢复该地区需要巨额资金，
而南斯拉夫根本拿不出来。
|1981年4月，在SFRY主席团会议以及联邦维护宪法秩序委
员会上，L.科利舍夫斯基（L. Kolishevsky）
说：“我们必须充分认识到这种论断的谬误与极端反动性——塞尔维
亚越弱，科索沃（或我们任何其他共和国）
越强。以及这种论断——在塞尔维亚内部，
科索沃自治越小，塞尔维亚越强。
也可以说，塞尔维亚弱——南斯拉夫强。
”民族主义者开始在国内巩固其立场……

0x0023AC25.text: Our ambassador in Tirana came to comrades Enver Hoxha and Ramiz Alia (party curator of Sigurimi), giving them our proposal.
0x0023AC25.translated:
我们驻地拉那（Tirana）的大使前往同志恩维尔·霍查（En
ver Hoxha）和拉米兹·阿利亚（Ramiz Alia，
西古里米（Sigurimi）党内负责人），
向他们提出我们的建议。

0x0023AD20.text: They agreed to our help. In Albania there has arrived group of employees of the China's MSS, which has quickly established cooperation with Sigurimi. As a result, although JNA managed to suppress the rebellion, they couldn't completely pacify the province. We can start riots there again.
0x0023AD20.translated:
他们同意我们的援助。
中国国家安全部（MSS）的一批工作人员已抵达阿尔巴尼亚，
并迅速与西古里米建立合作。
结果是，尽管JNA设法压制了叛乱，却没能彻底平息该省。
我们可以在那里再次煽动骚乱。

0x0023AF63.text: A state of emergency was imposed in Kosovo and parts of JNA entered, which by 3 April had suppressed all protests and restored order in the province.
0x0023AF63.translated:
科索沃实施紧急状态，部分JNA进入当地，
到4月3日已镇压了所有抗议并恢复了省内秩序。

0x0023B090.text: Spittle in the face, punch in the jaw and a bullet in the head
0x0023B090.translated: 唾沫糊脸、拳头打下巴、子弹打脑袋

0x0023B10E.text: Using the state apparatus in his hands and Sigurimi, Shehu managed to mobilize his supporters and isolate Hoxha and then held an extraordinary Congress of the Central Committee of PLA, where he said that the 1st Secretary for medical reasons for some time will not be able to fulfill his duties. His opponents had to give up their positions in the party and the government at best, but many of them simply ended up in Sigurimi prisons or died under strange circumstances. And soon it was announced about the death of Hoxha from the aggravated disease, after which it was not difficult for Shehu to get the post of 1st Secretary of the Central Committee of PLA. He has already begun cautious negotiations with Yugoslavia, the USSR and the socialist camp countries, which seem to welcome such a change of leadership, although nothing much has changed in Albania's domestic policy.
0x0023B10E.translated:
谢胡（Shehu）凭借手中的国家机器和西古里米（Siguri
mi），动员起自己的支持者，把霍查孤立起来，
随后又召开了人民军（PLA）中央委员会的非常大会。
他在会上宣布：由于医疗原因，第一书记在一段时间内将无法履行职
责。对手们最多只能交出党内和政府中的职位，
但许多人最终要么被关进西古里米监狱，
要么死于离奇的境况。
不久又宣布霍查因病情加重而死亡；之后，
谢胡要拿到人民军中央委员会第一书记的职位并不困难。
他已经开始与南斯拉夫、苏联以及社会主义阵营国家进行谨慎谈判—
—看起来他们欢迎这种领导层更替，尽管阿尔巴尼亚的国内政策并没
有太大变化。

0x0023B7ED.text: And Shehu restored relations with China much faster, establishing trade and inviting our advisers to the country.
0x0023B7ED.translated:
谢胡恢复同中国的关系更快，建立贸易，
并邀请我们的顾问到该国。

0x0023B8D2.text: As a result, the relationship between Shehu and Hoxha continued to worsen, and on December 18, 1981 was announced the suicide of Shehu, after which he was accused in treason and espionage in favor of the United States, the USSR and Yugoslavia. As Prime Minister he was replaced by lacking initiative and loyal Adil Charcani.
0x0023B8D2.translated:
结果，谢胡与霍查的关系继续恶化。
1981年12月18日宣布谢胡自杀，
随后他被指控为美国、苏联和南斯拉夫从事叛国与间谍活动。
作为总理，他被缺乏主动性、忠诚的阿迪尔·查尔卡尼所取代。

0x0023BB5D.text: As a result, the relationship between Shehu and Hoxha continued to worsen, and on December 18, 1981 was announced the suicide of Shehu, after which he was accused in treason and espionage in favor of the United States, the USSR and Yugoslavia. As Prime Minister he was replaced by lacking initiative and loyal Adil Charcani. All this time we supported the actions of Hoxha and welcomed the liberation of Albania from the spy Shehu, for which we received thanks from Tirana.
0x0023BB5D.translated:
结果，谢胡与霍查的关系继续恶化。
1981年12月18日宣布谢胡自杀，
随后他被指控为美国、苏联和南斯拉夫从事叛国与间谍活动。
作为总理，他被缺乏主动性、忠诚的阿迪尔·查尔卡尼所取代。
整个期间，我们支持霍查的行动，并欢迎阿尔巴尼亚从“间谍谢胡”
手中获得解放，为此我们收到了地拉那方面的感谢。

0x0023BF36.text: With the help of our special services and the supply of our weapons, the CPP and the NDM were able to deploy large-scale agitation and protests, accompanied by a surge of guerrilla activity. These grievances were soon joined by other political forces and ordinary citizens. Of course, the protests were soon severely suppressed by the police, and the guerrilla offensive was contained by the army, but it seems that we have dealt a serious damage to the regime of Marcos, which did not expect such a sudden and brazen intervention of China. In the end, he managed to win the presidential election, gaining 52% of the vote, but he will have to be much more careful in his actions, and the influence of the Communist party has increased markedly. Perhaps, helping them further, we will still see the victory of the Philippine revolution...
0x0023BF36.translated:
在我们特工部门的协助以及武器供应下，
菲律宾共产党（CPP）和民族民主运动（NDM）
得以展开大规模煽动与抗议，并伴随游击活动的骤然升温。
很快，这些不满又被其他政治力量和普通民众所加入。
当然，抗议很快遭到警方严厉镇压，游击攻势也被军队遏制，
但看来我们已经对马科斯政权造成了严重打击——他显然没料到中国
会如此突然、如此大胆地插手。
最终，他还是设法赢得总统选举，获得52%的选票，
但他在行动上将不得不更加谨慎，而共产党的影响力也显著上升。
也许在进一步帮助他们之后，我们仍将看到菲律宾革命的胜利……

0x0023C5C3.text: As a result, Marcos managed to win the presidential election, gaining a devastating 88% of the vote. Looks like the Philippines is waiting for the continuation of his policy.
0x0023C5C3.translated:
结果，马科斯最终赢得总统选举，拿下了惊人的88%选票。
看来菲律宾正在等待他政策的延续。

0x0023C722.text: After Marcos managed to win the presidential election with a crushing 88% of the vote, we congratulated him on his victory and expressed hope for the further rapprochement of our countries, which began in 1975. Marcos was happy to take advantage of our offer, but many groups of Filipino maoists called it a betrayal, and the influence of the communist party somewhat fell.
0x0023C722.translated:
在马科斯以压倒性88%选票赢得总统选举后，
我们向他表示祝贺，并表达希望两国进一步走近——这种关系始于1
975年。马科斯很乐意利用我们的提议，
但许多菲律宾毛派团体称之为背叛，共产党影响力也因此有所下降。

0x0023CA31.text: personally called Brezhnev and said that the situation in Romania threatens directly to the cause of building socialism in Romania and the stability of the entire Soviet bloc, and therefore its solution needs to encompass the entire socialist camp. The Soviet leader supported our idea, as a result of which an extraordinary meeting of the CMEA was convened, where it was decided to provide Romania with assistance for the payment of debts in the form of gratuitous monetary assistance and preferential import-export conditions for Romania to the CMEA (the main costs, of course, were incurred by us and the Soviet Union). Ceausescu thanked us and the other members of the CMEA for their help and has already announced an adjustment to the austerity regime aimed at easing it. Of course, even small austerity measures have displeased Romanian citizens, but nothing that Ceausescu could not cope with. According to our estimates, at this rate he will be able to pay off debts by the end of the 80's without serious consequences for the economy and living standards.
0x0023CA31.translated:
他亲自打电话给勃列日涅夫，表示罗马尼亚的局势直接威胁到在罗马
尼亚建设社会主义的事业以及整个苏联阵营的稳定，
因此其解决必须覆盖整个社会主义阵营。
苏联领导人支持我们的设想，于是召集了经互会（CMEA）
特别会议，决定以无偿的货币援助形式，
向罗马尼亚提供偿债援助，并给予罗马尼亚对经互会的优惠进出口条
件（当然，主要费用由我们和苏联承担）。
齐奥塞斯库感谢我们及经互会其他成员的帮助，
并已宣布对紧缩体制作出调整，旨在缓和它。
当然，即便是小规模的紧缩措施也让罗马尼亚市民不满，
但这对齐奥塞斯库来说并非难以应付。
按我们的估算，以这种速度，他将在80年代末在不对经济与生活水
平造成严重后果的情况下还清债务。

0x0023D286.text: Despite the profitability of these measures, they have already caused a decline in the growth of the Romanian economy and a drop in living standards, which causes mass discontent among the Romanian population. Ceausescu is still doing well with them, but who knows how it will end...
0x0023D286.translated:
尽管这些措施“有利可图”，但它们已经导致罗马尼亚经济增长放缓、
生活水平下降，引发罗马尼亚民众的普遍不满。
齐奥塞斯库目前还能应付得了，但谁知道结局会怎样……

0x0023D4BF.text: Taking advantage of our good relations with Romania, we offered Ceausescu a large-scale financial assistance to ease the debt burden, which he gladly accepted. We had to fork out a lot, but in the end he announced an adjustment to the austerity regime aimed at easing it. Of course, even small austerity measures have displeased Romanian citizens, but nothing that Ceausescu could not cope with. And the opportunities for imports he used to expand trade with us.
0x0023D4BF.translated:
借助我们同罗马尼亚的良好关系，我们向齐奥塞斯库提供了大规模财
政援助，以减轻债务负担，他欣然接受。
我们不得不付出不少代价，但最终他宣布对紧缩体制作出调整，
旨在缓和它。当然，即便是小规模的紧缩措施也让罗马尼亚市民不满，
但这对齐奥塞斯库来说仍算不上什么。
与此同时，他利用进口机会来扩大同我们的贸易。

0x0023D8B0.text: declared the aim of the party to cleanse the socialist system of the right and left excesses. He sharply opposed those who demanded to break the existing system to the ground and rebuild the country on the Western model. In the course of the revision of the Charter was confirmed the increase of probationary period to 5 years, and experience of the candidate member of the Politburo - to 8 years. The composition of the newly elected CPC Central Committee included 210 members and 138 candidate members of the CPC Central Committee.
0x0023D8B0.translated:
提出党的目标是清除社会主义制度中的“右”和“左”的过火现象。
他尖锐反对那些主张把现行制度彻底推倒、
并按西方模式重建国家的人。
在对党章的修订过程中，确认将预备期延长至5年，
政治局候补委员的任职经历延长至8年。
新当选的中共中央委员会由210名委员和138名候补委员组成。

0x0023DCDF.text: In the Report of the Central Committee of the CPC Congress, comrade
0x0023DCDF.translated: 在中共十二大中央委员会工作报告中，同志

0x0023DD6A.text: focused on the results of the VI Plenum of the Central Committee of the CPC 11 convocation and adoption "Decisions on some questions of the history of the CPC since the foundation of China", in which "with all responsibility was studied and summarized the way our party followed since 1949, the successes and mistakes made in socialist construction, as well as the place of comrade Mao Zedong, who, due to various factors, made or allowed to make these mistakes". Immediately after the Congress, the media reduced the mention of Mao Zedong, a number of his works ("Little red book", "On the ten most important relationships", "Controversy about the General line of the international communist movement") was gradually withdrawn from the libraries, as well as stopped their reissue, mandatory study of"maozedongidea" was changed to optional. Although Mao Zedong is in no way crossed out of the history of China and the CPC, and it's still quite possible to go to jail for his criticism , his role is reduced to the role of Vladimir Lenin in the USSR - a certain "good grandfather and leader of the Revolution" - and nothing else.
0x0023DD6A.translated:
重点阐述了中共十一届中央委员会第六次全体会议的成果，
以及通过《建国以来中共党史若干问题的决议》。
其中“以全部责任”对本党自1949年以来的道路、
社会主义建设中的成就与失误，以及毛泽东同志在其中所处的位置—
—“由于各种因素，造成或允许造成这些失误”——进行了研究与总
结。大会一结束，媒体就减少对毛泽东的提及；
他的多部著作（《小红书》《论十大关系》《关于国际共产主义运动
总路线的争论》）逐步从图书馆撤下，并停止再版；
“必须学习毛泽东思想”改为“自愿学习”。
尽管毛泽东在中国和中共的历史中并未被一笔勾销，
对他的批评仍然很可能坐牢，但他的作用被压缩为苏联的弗拉基米尔
·列宁那样——某种“革命的好祖父和领袖”——仅此而已。

0x0023E63F.text: On the last day of the XII Congress of the CPC, comrade
0x0023E63F.translated: 在中共十二大最后一天，同志

0x0023E6B1.text: asked the delegates to stay for another meeting - this time closed. At this meeting, he in silence read the paper "On the personality cult of Mao Zedong and overcoming its consequences", in which the founder of China was accused of "the perversion of Marxism-Leninism, the establishment of a cult of personality and mass terror against political opponents, distortion of socialist legality, the support of the group of Lin Piao," etc., the delegates went in a depressed state, having accepted the report without discussion. Later, it was read in all Communist party organizations, causing shock and rejection. The demolition of Mao Zedong's monuments, the removal of his works and portraits from libraries and book stores began, and the media published revelatory materials about the "Great Helmsman". The USSR and the USA have approved our debunking of the personality cult of Mao, however, millions of unhappy start to resist. Wide popularity has received "Tugan" movement (a mass withdrawal from the CCP, often accompanied by the public destruction of party card), and the maoist movement in the West, one after the other accuse us of "khrushchevist revisionism" and "betrayal". Our positions have been seriously undermined both inside and outside the country, and the party left without ideological support will obviously not defend you if there is an attempt of a coup...
0x0023E6B1.translated:
要求代表们再留下开一次会——这次是闭门会议。
在会上，他默读了文件《论毛泽东个人崇拜及其后果的克服》。
文件指控这位中国的奠基者“歪曲马克思列宁主义，
建立个人崇拜并对政治对手实行群众恐怖，
歪曲社会主义法制，支持林彪集团”等等。
代表们带着沉闷的情绪进入会场，在没有讨论的情况下接受了报告。
随后，这份文件在各级共产党组织中传阅，
引起震动与抵触。拆除毛泽东的纪念碑、
从图书馆和书店撤下他的著作与肖像开始进行，
媒体还刊发了关于“伟大舵手”的揭露材料。
苏联和美国对我们揭穿毛的个人崇拜表示认可，
但数以百万计的不满者开始抵抗。
“退党”（“Tugan”）运动广泛传播（大规模退出中共，
常伴随公开焚毁党员证），而西方的毛派运动也接连指责我们“赫鲁
晓夫式修正主义”和“背叛”。
我们在国内外的立场都遭到严重削弱；如果有人企图发动政变，
那没有了意识形态支撑的党显然不会替你挡灾……

0x0023F19C.text: You personally called Janos Kadar and informed him about the decision of the Standing Committee of the National People's Congress to allocate a loan of $ 3.5 billion to Hungary at a very low interest rate. This allowed the country to avoid default and not to resort to new loans. Kadar as the head of the State Council of the people's Republic of Hungary, expressed the Chinese people a huge thanks on behalf of the Hungarian people, but the Soviet Union and the United States are not happy about this, and the press is already writing about "Chinese economic expansion in Europe".
0x0023F19C.translated:
你亲自打电话给亚诺什·卡达尔，告知全国人大常委会决定以极低利
率向匈牙利提供35亿美元贷款。
这样一来，匈牙利得以避免违约，不必再去借新的贷款。
卡达尔作为匈牙利人民共和国国务委员会主席，
代表匈牙利人民向中国人民表达了巨大的感谢，
但苏联和美国对此并不高兴，媒体已经在写“中国产业在欧洲的经济
扩张”。

0x0023F629.text: The ideological Department of the Central Committee authorized the printing of a large number of critical materials about the situation in Hungary. "Goulash socialism" is announced as "phony market audit", Kadar is recalled his participation in a counterrevolutionary coup in 1956 and endorsed by the group of Imre Nagy, HSWP is called "foolish marxist party of social-renegades" and the socialist system in Hungary - "built on American money decoration". Based on all this, it was concluded that all market reforms are revisionism and the way to the economic abyss. The party and the people did not accept the new promotion of already rather boring propaganda, and Hungary expresses us categorical protest, which was supported by the Soviet Union. I don't think that's what we wanted...
0x0023F629.translated:
中央委员会的宣传思想部门授权大量印发批判匈牙利局势的材料。
《“古拉什社会主义”》被宣布为“假装的市场审计”；
卡达尔被追忆其在1956年反革命政变中的参与，
并得到伊姆雷·纳吉集团的支持；匈牙利社会主义工人党（HSWP）
被称为“愚蠢的马克思主义社会叛徒党”；
匈牙利的社会主义制度则被说成“用美国钱财装饰起来的”。
据此得出结论：所有市场改革都是修正主义，
通向经济深渊。党和人民并不接受这种本就相当乏味的宣传再度加码；
匈牙利向我们提出了坚决抗议，而这也得到了苏联的支持。
我想这并不是我们想要的……

0x0023FC52.text: This morning, the Chinese ambassador in Budapest came to Janos Kadar and on our behalf offered an interest-free loan of $ 3.5 billion. Kadar was ready to agree at once, but the ambassador's subsequent words sobered him up - in exchange for a loan, the Politburo of the Central Committee of HSWP should rehabilitate the group of Bela Bisku, restoring them to the party and in positions, and the Bela co-opt into their ranks. This caused a sharp protest of the Hungarian leader and, as a result of a long verbal sparring, it was possible to reach only a compromise - a number of colleagues of Bisku are co-opted in the Central Committee, and Hungary receives a loan of 1.5 billion dollars. This allowed the country to avoid an immediate default, but still had to take a new loan from the IMF. Thanks to us, now the left opposition has appeared in the HSWP, but it will need a lot of time for the final registration... In addition, the USSR is very dissatisfied with our interference in its sphere of influence.
0x0023FC52.translated:
今天早晨，中国驻布达佩斯大使拜会亚诺什·卡达尔，
并代表我们提出一笔无息35亿美元贷款。
卡达尔本来准备立刻答应，但大使随后的一番话让他清醒过来——作
为贷款的交换，匈牙利社会主义工人党（HSWP）
中央委员会政治局应当为贝拉·比斯库集团平反，
使他们重返党内并恢复职务，并让贝拉进入他们的队伍。
此举引发匈牙利领导人的强烈抗议。
经过一番冗长的口舌交锋，最终只达成了折中方案——比斯库的若干
同僚被吸纳进中央委员会，匈牙利获得15亿美元贷款。
这样一来，匈牙利得以避免立刻违约，但仍不得不向国际货币基金组
织（IMF）再借一笔新贷款。
多亏了我们，HSWP内部现在出现了左翼反对派，
但要完成最终登记还需要很长时间……
此外，苏联对我们干涉其势力范围极为不满。

0x00240435.text: called the Ambassador of the HPR in Beijing and gave him a letter to Janos Kadar, in which he offered to take the national debt of the HPR to China to avoid default and to issue an interest-free loan of 4.5 billion dollars - but in exchange for the rehabilitation of the group Bela Bisku and co-optation of the Bisku in the Politburo of the Central Committee of HSWP. At the same time our agents provoked the unrest in the units of "Worker police" (paramilitary organization of HSWP, in which there were certain left-conservative moods), and threw dirt on the chief ideologist of the Hungarian reforms - Less Nersa (who was a social-democrat with experience and was a minister in the government of Imre Nagy). Realizing that the refusal to help China could provoke a new 1956 year, Kadar was forced to agree. Bela Biszku with our help fairly quickly organized the left opposition, and Gershu had to retire from politics. It seems that there's a new coming split in HSWP , which is only contained by living Kadar... |Under pressure from the left opposition and wishing to preserve at least the external unity of the party, Kadar announced the "multi-vector" foreign policy of Hungary and began to establish cultural and trade relations with us. The USSR and the USA are furious, and we have strengthened our influence in Europe. However, we now have to fulfill Hungarian debt obligations...
0x00240435.translated:
他在北京召见匈牙利人民共和国驻华大使，
并交给他一封写给亚诺什·卡达尔的信：
信中提出由匈牙利人民共和国把对中国的国家债务接下，
以避免违约，并发放一笔无息45亿美元贷款——但作为交换条件，
是为贝拉·比斯库集团平反，并将比斯库吸纳进匈牙利社会主义工人
党（HSWP）中央委员会政治局。
同时，我们的特工还煽动“工人警察”部队（HSWP的准军事组织，
其中存在某些左翼保守情绪）的骚乱，
并向匈牙利改革的首席意识形态负责人——莱斯·内尔绍（莱斯·内
尔绍是有经验的社会民主党人，曾在伊姆雷·纳吉政府中担任部长）
泼脏水。卡达尔意识到拒绝帮助中国可能引发新的1956年，
只得被迫同意。在我们的帮助下，贝拉·比斯库很快组织起左翼反对
派，格尔舒不得不退出政治。
看来HSWP内部又将出现新的分裂，而这只能靠“活着的卡达尔”
暂时压住……|在左翼反对派的压力下，
并希望至少保住党外部的统一，卡达尔宣布匈牙利的“多维向”外交
政策，开始同我们建立文化与贸易关系。
苏联和美国勃然大怒，而我们在欧洲的影响力也得到了加强。
不过，我们现在必须履行匈牙利的债务义务……

0x00240F14.text: We did not interfere in any way in the affairs of Hungary. The country managed to avoid default by taking new loans from the IMF, which only delayed the negative trends - but for a long time, so that we could not influence it. |"At the same time, according to Hungarian comrades, Hungary should deepen its participation in international cooperation, so as not to invent something that has long been discovered in other countries".
0x00240F14.translated:
我们丝毫没有干涉匈牙利的事务。
该国通过向IMF再借新贷款，得以避免违约，
只是把负面趋势拖延了——拖延了很久，
以至于我们无法再对其施加影响。
|“与此同时，据匈牙利同志所说，匈牙利应当深化其参与国际合作，
以免去发明那些早已在其他国家被发现的东西。
”

0x00241273.text: By negotiating with a certain part of the Politburo behind the scenes, we were able to convince them that only with Chinese help could they get out of the debt hole created jointly by both the government of Janos Kadar and Karoly Grosz. Eventually they agreed to our proposal to replace Karoly Grosz with Imre Pozhgay by holding an emergency party congress and criticising Grosz. As a result, János Kádár retired from the nominal position of the Chairman of the MSZMP, and Karoly Grosz took his place. The real ruler of the country became the General Secretary, Imre Pozhgay, who realised to whom he owed his position and was aware of whose hands Hungary's debt obligations were in.
0x00241273.translated:
通过幕后与政治局的某些成员进行谈判，
我们终于说服他们：只有在中国的帮助下，
他们才能从由卡达尔政府与格罗什政府共同挖出的债务深坑中爬出来。
最终，他们同意我们的提议：召开紧急党代会、
批判格罗什，以便用伊姆雷·波兹盖取代卡罗伊·格罗什。
结果，亚诺什·卡达尔从名义上的MSZMP主席位置上退下，
卡罗伊·格罗什接替了他的位置。
真正掌控国家的人变成了总书记伊姆雷·波兹盖——他明白自己的位
置欠了谁的情，也清楚匈牙利的债务义务握在谁的手里。

0x002417CA.text: On April 3, the UN security Council adopted resolution 502, demanding the withdrawal of Argentine troops from the Islands, but despite this, no one seems to believe in Britain's victory. But maybe we should help Argentina, even though there are cruel anti-Communist dictators, to once again hit colonialism?
0x002417CA.translated:
4月3日，联合国安理会通过第502号决议，
要求阿根廷军队撤出群岛。
但尽管如此，似乎没有人相信英国会赢。
也许我们应该帮助阿根廷——即便那里有残酷的反共独裁者——再一
次打击殖民主义？

0x00241A55.translated: 斯塔夫罗波尔农学家之难

0x00241A97.text: Today's number in the "Jenmin Jibao" was out with an article, "the Reformer in the Politburo of the CPSU Central Committee", in which Fyodor Kulakov was named "marxist-decentralizer, titoist "communist", a dangerous enemy of the entire international communist and workers' movement". Particular emphasis in the article was placed on the fact that Kulakov may be highly likely to lead the USSR after the death of Leonid Brezhnev. At the same time, our special services have organized a leak of information about the reformist aspirations of Kulakov in the CPSU Central Committee. At the July (1977) Plenum of the CPSU Central Committee, Fyodor Kulakov was criticized and deprived of all his posts. He suffered from acute stomach disease, which caused a weakening of the nervous system, and on the night of July 17, 1977, he died suddenly from heart paralysis. Thus, we have greatly weakened the reformist wing of the CPSU...
0x00241A97.translated:
《人民报》今天刊出一篇文章《苏共中央政治局的改革者》，
文中把费奥多尔·库拉科夫称为“马克思主义的分权派、
铁托式的‘共产党’，是整个国际共产主义与工人运动的危险敌人”。
文章特别强调：库拉科夫很可能在列昂尼德·勃列日涅夫去世后领
导苏联。与此同时，我们的特工部门也在苏共中央内部安排了关于库
拉科夫改革野心的“泄密”。
在苏共中央七月（1977年）全会上，
费奥多尔·库拉科夫遭到批判，并被剥夺全部职务。
他患有急性胃病，导致神经系统衰弱；1977年7月17日晚，
他突然死于心脏麻痹。
就这样，我们大大削弱了苏共中央的改革派力量……

0x002421D0.text: We organized a large-scale campaign to denigrate Kulakov in the media. He was branded as "a corruptionist, a bureaucrat, a titoist, , a careerist, an opportunist, the worst enemy of the CPSU and the CPC, the wolf in sheep's clothing", etc. Comrade Chairman, on one of his speeches briefly  mentioned that, if "such people as Fyodor Kulakov, will head the Soviet Union - we are not to talk with them about anything, because they are biased against us, against the Communist party of China, against the Chinese people". This caused the CPSU Central Committee a strong suspicion, Kulakov was called to the Committe of party control for a talk with its head, Arvid Pelshe. He, joining forces with the all-powerful KGB chief Yuri Andropov, was able to break through the Politburo decision on the appointment to the post of First Secretary of the Central Committee of the Communist party of Moldova - in fact, in honorable exile. Nominees of Kulakov have already been started to be removed from posts and transfered to lower positions. And so, he's no longer an obstacle...
0x002421D0.translated:
我们在媒体上组织了一场大规模抹黑库拉科夫的运动。
他被贴上“贪腐分子、官僚、铁托式、（逗号处原文有缺漏）
野心家、机会主义者、苏共中央和中共最凶恶的敌人、
披着羊皮的狼”等标签。
主席同志在一次讲话中还简短提到：如果“像费奥多尔·库拉科夫这
样的人将领导苏联——我们就不必跟他们谈任何事情，
因为他们对我们、对中国共产党、对中国人民怀有偏见”。
这引起了苏共中央的强烈怀疑。
库拉科夫被召到党内监察委员会，接受委员会负责人阿尔维德·佩尔
舍的谈话。他与拥有至高权力的克格勃头子尤里·安德罗波夫联手，
得以突破政治局关于任命库拉科夫为摩尔达维亚共产党中央委员会第
一书记的决定——实际上是“光荣流放”。
库拉科夫的提名人已经开始从岗位上被撤下，
并调到更低的位置。于是，他不再是障碍……

0x00242A29.text: We organized a large-scale campaign to denigrate Kulakov in the media. He was branded as "a corruptionist, a bureaucrat, a titoist, , a careerist, an opportunist, the worst enemy of the CPSU and the CPC, the wolf in sheep's clothing", etc. Comrade Chairman, on one of his speeches briefly  mentioned that, if "such people as Fyodor Kulakov, will head the Soviet Union - we are not to talk with them about anything, because they are biased against us, against the Communist party of China, against the Chinese people". However, Kulakov, having learned about this, did not lose his head, as we planned, and spoke at the Plenum of the CPSU Central Committee with a bright speech, in which he accused China of "spreading slander on the leninist Central Committee, maoist hegemony, the desire to split the CPSU and create an alternative maoist "false party", conducting a quiet counter-revolution in the Soviet Union and occupying Siberia and the far East". With his primitive lie he was able to intimidate most members of the Politburo, including Brezhnev, and whitewash himself.

他指控中国“散布对列宁主义中央委员会的诽谤、
毛主义霸权、企图分裂苏共中央并建立一个替代的毛主义‘假党’，

凭借他那种粗糙的谎言，他吓住了包括勃列日涅夫在内的多数政治局
成员，并为自己洗清了嫌疑。

0x00243292.text: And nothing happened. Kulakov continues to occupy the post, advancing to the top reform-minded party members, led by his ally in the Stavropol region - Mikhail Gorbachev.
0x00243292.translated:
什么也没有发生。库拉科夫继续占着岗位，
向党内最高层的改革派靠拢——由他在斯塔夫罗波尔地区的盟友米哈
伊尔·戈尔巴乔夫领衔。

0x00243411.text: At 14:35 Pyotr Masherov left the building of the Central Committee of the CPB towards the city of Zhodino by car GAZ-13 "Chaika", which ran a 60-year-old driver E. Zaitsev. Masherov sat next to the driver, behind — security officer major V. F. Chesnokov. Contrary to existing instructions, there were not a car of GAI with the appropriate coloring and flashing lights,but the white "Volga" with an alarm loud-speaking installation, but without flashing lights. At the turn to the poultry farm near the city of Smolevichi on the highway "Moscow-Minsk" in "Chaika" was hit by loaded with potatoes dump truck GAZ-SAZ-53B under the control of the driver N. Pustovite. No one survived - Masherov, his driver and security guard were killed on the spot, the driver of the truck - died from a large loss of blood on the way to the hospital. The General Prosecutor's office of the USSR conducted an investigation that ruled out the intentional nature of the crime. KGB hadn't been agreed with it and insisted on the involvement of foreign intelligence services. In the course of the conflict between the Prosecutor's Office (with the support of the Ministry of Internal Affairs) and the KGB, Masherov's excessive reformist tendencies came to light, which forced the KGB to relent and Andropov to lose some influence in the Party apparatus.

14时35分，彼得·马谢罗夫乘坐GAZ-13“海鸥”轿车离开
白俄罗斯共产党（CPB）中央委员会大楼，
前往日尔季诺市。驾驶员是60岁的E·扎伊采夫。
马谢罗夫坐在驾驶员旁边，后排是安全官员中校V·F·切斯诺科夫。
与既有指示相反，并没有配备相应涂装和警灯闪烁的GAI警车护
送；而是一辆白色“伏尔加”，装有警报扩音装置，

靠近斯莫列维奇市附近的通往家禽农场的转弯处，
“海鸥”被一辆装满土豆的自卸卡车GAZ-SAZ-53B撞上，
卡车由司机N·普斯托维特驾驶。
无人幸免——马谢罗夫、他的司机和警卫当场死亡，
卡车司机则因失血过多在前往医院途中死亡。
苏联总检察院进行了调查，排除了犯罪的故意性质。
克格勃对此不认同，坚持认为有外国情报机构参与。
在检察机关（得到内务部支持）与克格勃的冲突过程中，
马谢罗夫过度的改革倾向被揭露出来，迫使克格勃让步，
并使安德罗波夫在党内机关中的影响力有所下降。

0x00243E78.text: Our agents have been in contact with Tikhon Kiselyov - Chairman of the Council of Ministers of the BSSR, which has teamed up with dissatisfied with the policy of Masherov Belarusian party members - and gave him the dirt on Masherov (in particular, he approved of Kosygin's economic reform and required to develop a planning system that would stimulate the economic interest of enterprises. The reason was his desire to gradually move away from the administrative and command methods of economic management. Also, by the initiative of Masherov, BSSR regularly held seminars on various problems of the national economy, not agreed with the Central Committee of the CPSU). Kiselev, being at the same time the Deputy Chairman of the Council of Ministers of the USSR, made a meeting with Mikhail Suslov and gave him this information. Masherov was summoned to Moscow and critisized, deprived of his position and sent into retirement.
0x00243E78.translated:
我们的特工同季霍恩·基谢廖夫取得联系——他是白俄罗斯苏维埃社
会主义共和国（BSSR）部长会议主席；
同时也与对马谢罗夫政策不满的白俄罗斯党内成员结成了同盟——并
向他提供了关于马谢罗夫的“脏料”（例如：
他赞同柯西金的经济改革，并要求建立一种能够刺激企业经济利益的
计划体系。原因在于他希望逐步摆脱经济管理中的行政命令方式。
此外，马谢罗夫还主导让BSSR定期就国民经济各类问题举办研讨
会，而这些并未得到苏共中央的同意）。
基谢廖夫身兼苏联部长会议副主席，便与米哈伊尔·苏斯洛夫会面，
并把这些信息转交给他。
马谢罗夫被召到莫斯科，遭到批判，被剥夺职务并被打发到离休岗位。

0x00245453.text: On June 16 in the cities of Tselinograd, Kokchetav and Karaganda began mass protests of the Kazakh population against the granting of autonomy to the German minority. Protesters carried banners with inscriptions: "Our land is uniform and indivisible for everyone!" and chanted slogans: "No to German Autonomous region in Ermentau!". Three days after the first protest, on one of the outskirts of Tselinograd, crowds gathered from all the surrounding streets again, demanding an answer to the questions: "What fate awaits the Kazakhs on their land?" and "What about autonomy?". The leadership and law enforcement agencies of the Kazakh SSR secretly supported the demonstrators and did not prevent the distribution of leaflets calling to go to a protest rally in the dormitories. We took advantage of this and officially made public this fact, accusing Kunaev of "neo-fascism" and "violation of Lenin's principles of national policy". Through the MSS was also merged compromising material on a large number of persons from his entourage suspected of corruption. On December 16, during the record short Plenum of the Central Committee of Kazakhstan, which lasted only 18 minutes, Dinmukhamed Kunayev was removed from the post of First Secretary of the Central Committee of Kazakhstan and retired. In his place was elected Chairman of the Council of Ministers of the Kazakh SSR technocrat Baiken Ashimov.
0x00245453.translated:
6月16日，齐林诺格勒、科克切塔夫和卡拉干达三地爆发了哈萨克
族民众针对给予德意志少数民族自治权的群众抗议。
抗议者举着写有“我们的土地对每个人都是统一的、
不可分割的！”的标语，并高喊“反对在埃尔门套设立德意志自治州！
”。第一次抗议后三天，在齐林诺格勒郊外，
来自周边各条街道的人群再次集结，要求回答“哈萨克人在自己的土
地上将遭遇怎样的命运？
”以及“自治又将如何？
”等问题。哈萨克苏维埃社会主义共和国的领导层和执法机构暗中支
持示威者，并未阻止在宿舍区散发号召参加抗议集会的传单。
我们利用了这一点，并正式公开了这一事实，
指控库奈耶夫“新法西斯主义”和“违反列宁民族政策原则”。
通过MSS（国家安全机构）还汇总了大量与其随从有关、
涉嫌腐败的“妥协材料”。
12月16日，在创纪录的哈萨克斯坦中央委员会全体会议上（仅持
续18分钟），丁穆哈迈德·库奈耶夫被撤去哈萨克斯坦中央委员会
第一书记职务并办理退休。
由技术官僚贝肯·阿希莫夫当选为哈萨克苏维埃社会主义共和国部长
会议主席。

0x00245F46.text: We urgently sent to the Central Committee of the CPSU all the information about the upcoming performances in the Kazakh SSR, pointing to the involvement of the entire party elite of the republic. Our warning was taken into account, so on June 16 in Tselinograd, Kokchetav and Karaganda were introduced units of Internal troops of the Ministry of internal Affairs of the USSR, which prevented the demonstrations. Kunayev was summoned to Moscow, where after a conversation with Arvid Pelshe and Mikhail Suslov, he wrote a statement asking to be released from all posts in connection with the "state of health".
0x00245F46.translated:
我们紧急向苏共中央送交了关于哈萨克苏维埃社会主义共和国即将发
生的动乱的全部情报，并指出这牵涉到该共和国的整个党内精英。
我们的警告被采纳了：因此在6月16日，
齐林诺格勒、科克切塔夫和卡拉干达部署了苏联内务部内卫部队的单
位，阻止了示威活动。
库奈耶夫被召到莫斯科；在与阿尔维德·佩尔舍和米哈伊尔·苏斯洛
夫会谈后，他写下声明，要求因“健康状况”解除其所有职务。

0x00246409.text: We urgently sent to the Central Committee of the CPSU all the information about the upcoming performances in the Kazakh SSR, pointing to the involvement of the entire party elite of the republic. However, our warning was ignored. On June 16 in the cities of Tselinograd, Kokchetav and Karaganda began mass protests of the Kazakh population against the granting of autonomy to the German minority. Protesters carried banners with inscriptions: "Our land is uniform and indivisible for everyone!" and chanted slogans: "No to German Autonomous region in Ermentau!". As a result, the authorities agreed with the demands of the demonstrators and announced that the issue of German autonomy in Kazakhstan was completely removed from the agenda.
0x00246409.translated:
我们紧急向苏共中央送交了关于哈萨克苏维埃社会主义共和国即将发
生的动乱的全部情报，并指出这牵涉到该共和国的整个党内精英。
然而，我们的警告被置之不理。
6月16日，齐林诺格勒、科克切塔夫和卡拉干达三地爆发了哈萨克
族民众针对给予德意志少数民族自治权的群众抗议。
抗议者举着写有“我们的土地对每个人都是统一的、
不可分割的！”的标语，并高喊“反对在埃尔门套设立德意志自治州！
”。结果，当局同意了示威者的要求，
并宣布：哈萨克斯坦的德意志自治问题已彻底从议程中取消。

0x002469D0.text: On June 16 in the cities of Tselinograd, Kokchetav and Karaganda began mass protests of the Kazakh population against the granting of autonomy to the German minority. Protesters carried banners with inscriptions: "Our land is uniform and indivisible for everyone!" and chanted slogans: "No to German Autonomous region in Ermentau!". As a result, the authorities agreed with the demands of the demonstrators and announced that the issue of German autonomy in Kazakhstan was completely removed from the agenda.
0x002469D0.translated:
6月16日，在采利诺格勒、科克切塔夫和卡拉干达三座城市，
哈萨克族群众开始了针对给予德意志少数民族自治权的群众性抗议。
抗议者举着写有“我们的土地，归全体所有，
统一而不可分割！”的标语，并高喊口号：
“反对在厄尔门套设立德意志自治区！
”结果，当局同意了示威者的要求，并宣布：
哈萨克斯坦的德意志自治问题已被彻底从议程中撤下。

0x00246DCB.text: Our investigation uncovered significant misconduct by 1st Secretary Rashidov's team in Uzbekistan, involving the fraudulent inflation of cotton harvest targets through the forgery of stones and rubble, rampant nepotism, and bribery using rams and cars. Some associates concealed gold in their homes during Moscow inspections. The evidence, including photographs, anonymous interviews, and statistical documentation, was submitted to the USSR Council of Ministers through our embassy. To expose Rashidov, we disseminated this information through Chinese newspapers and even reaching Radio Liberty and Voice of America. This deprived Soviet leaders of the opportunity to hush up the case. As a result of the investigations, the SU underwent mass inspections in all republics and exemplary expulsions from the party took place in several countries. Instead of Rashidov a young and experienced industrial organizer Akil Salimov became the new 1st Secretary of the CPUz. In Moldavia, Ivan Bodiul, the 1st Secretary, was dismissed for negligence after a significant fraud discovery. His "Moldavian experience" in the agro-industrial complexes was recognized as ineffective. However, no special reshuffle followed, and Semyon Grossu, the former Chairman of the Council of Ministers, assumed the leadership. Corruption and nepotism in Azerbaijan led to the resignation of Heydar Aliyev and the heads of ministries and the KGB of the Azerbaijan SSR. In their place, Azerbaijani communists led by Abdurakhman Vezirov, who had been sent into political exile as ambassadors by Aliyev, were appointed to leading posts. They now attempt to adjust the work of the state apparatus using soft power. The leadership of the Turkmen SSR, headed by Mukhamednazar Gapurov, was suspended and expelled for corruption and embezzlement. Nazar Suyumov, a former foreign minister and a great specialist in geology and gas and oil production, assumed leadership and began reorienting the economy towards the development of the gas and oil industry. Audits were conducted within the RSFSR member republics, and the global discussion about Soviet leadership issues played to our advantage.
0x00246DCB.translated:
我们的调查揭露了乌兹别克斯坦第一书记拉希多夫团队的严重失职：
通过伪造石块和瓦砾来虚报棉花收购/产量指标、
猖獗的任人唯亲，以及用公羊和汽车行贿。
部分同伙在莫斯科检查期间把黄金藏在家中。
包括照片、匿名采访和统计材料在内的证据，
已通过我方使馆提交给苏联部长会议。
为揭露拉希多夫，我们把这些信息通过中国报纸广为散布，
甚至传到“自由欧洲电台”和“美国之音”。
这使苏联领导层失去了掩盖案件的机会。
调查结果导致苏联各加盟共和国普遍开展大规模检查，
并在数个国家出现了党内的典型开除处分。
拉希多夫被撤换后，年轻且经验丰富的工业组织者阿基尔·萨利莫夫
出任中共乌兹别克加盟共和国（CPUz）
新的第一书记。在摩尔达维亚，第一书记伊万·博迪乌尔因重大诈骗
案被发现后以失职为由遭到撤职；他在农业—工业综合体中的“摩尔
达维亚经验”被认定为无效。
然而并未出现特别的人事大调整，原部长会议主席谢苗·格罗斯乌接
过领导权。阿塞拜疆的腐败和任人唯亲导致阿利耶夫及阿塞拜疆苏维
埃社会主义共和国各部部长和克格勃负责人辞职。
取而代之的是由阿卜杜拉赫曼·韦齐罗夫领导的阿塞拜疆共产党人—
—他曾被阿利耶夫以“驻外大使”名义送去政治流放。
如今他们试图借助“软实力”来调整国家机关的运转。
由穆哈梅德纳扎尔·加普罗夫担任的土库曼苏维埃社会主义共和国领
导层因腐败和挪用公款被停职并开除。
前外交部长、地质以及天然气与石油生产方面的专家纳扎尔·苏尤莫
夫出任领导，并开始把经济重新导向天然气与石油工业的发展。
RSFSR加盟共和国内部开展了审计，
而围绕苏联领导问题的全球讨论反倒对我们有利。

0x00247ED8.text: While Brezhnev left for talks in Vienna, Yuri Andropov, who had an exacerbation of long-tormented his kidney disease, went for treatment in the Crimea. However, it was a one-way trip - in the Crimea, he caught a cold and finally came down — he developed phlegmon (purulent inflammation of the fiber) and there was a sharp deterioration in general health. The operation was successful, but the postoperative wound did not heal. The body was very weak and could not fight intoxication. Andropov fell into a coma, from which he never came out. July 9, 1979, the Chairman of the KGB of the USSR died. People in the know said that "it was not necessary to Andropov to go to the farm of Shcherbitsky. He also has his pride and his KGB". The new head of the union KGB was Semyon Tsvigun, who started "office" mass cleaning, and in place of the Andropov people in large numbers came workers from the KGB of the Ukrainian SSR. This reinforces the influence of Vladimir Shcherbitsky, who has now become the de facto sole successor to Leonid Brezhnev. That's fine with us...
0x00247ED8.translated:
当勃列日涅夫动身前往维也纳会谈时，饱受长期折磨的肾病又发作的
尤里·安德罗波夫则去克里米亚治病。
然而这是一趟“单程票”——在克里米亚，
他受了风寒，最终病情恶化：他得了蜂窝织炎（纤维组织的化脓性炎
症），全身状况急剧下滑。
手术虽然成功，但术后伤口不愈。
身体极度虚弱，已无法抵抗中毒。
安德罗波夫陷入昏迷，之后再也没有醒来。
1979年7月9日，苏联克格勃主席去世。
知情人士说：“安德罗波夫不必去谢尔比茨基的农场。
他也有他的骄傲和他的克格勃。
”苏联统一克格勃的新负责人是谢苗·茨维贡，
他开始在“办公室”里搞大规模清洗；而原安德罗波夫系的人被大量
替换为来自乌克兰苏维埃社会主义共和国克格勃的工作人员。
这进一步巩固了弗拉基米尔·谢尔比茨基的影响力——如今他已成了
列昂尼德·勃列日涅夫的事实上的唯一接班人。
对我们来说……这样也好……

0x00248729.text: As soon as news came from Vienna about Leonid Brezhnev's arrival in the capital of Austria - the 8th Main Directorate of the KGB of the USSR by order of the first Deputy Chairman of the Committee General Semyon Tsvigun disconnected the government communication, thus completely isolating the Secretary General from information from the USSR. Meanwhile, with the help of the opposition in the KGB, Mikhail Suslov and Vladimir Shcherbytsky quickly gathered an emergency Central Committee Plenum, in which Yuri Andropov was accused of "the transformation of the KGB into a personal shop, the preparation of an anti-government coup, communication with CIA and Israel's secret service, the slandering of Fyodor Kulakov and Pyotr Masherov", etc. We quickly organized information support of the Plenum, adding fuel to the fire with publications of "revelatory material" about Andropov. The dumbfounded head of the KGB tried to resist, but after the speech of Vladimir Shcherbitsky, who directly accused Andropov of preparing the murder of Brezhnev, he realized that he had lost. The Plenum adopted the decision on the withdrawal of Andropov from all posts, expelling him from the party and arresting him. The new Chairman of the KGB of the USSR is the head of the Ukrainian KGB Vitaly Fedorchuk, who began mass cleaning Andropov staff and replacing them with proven employees of the republican Committees. Perhaps our most dangerous enemy in the USSR is now completely neutralized...
0x00248729.translated:
维也纳传来消息：列昂尼德·勃列日涅夫抵达奥地利首都——苏联克
格勃第八总局奉委员会第一副主席谢苗·茨维贡之命，
切断了政府通信，从而使总书记与来自苏联的情报完全隔绝。
与此同时，在克格勃内部反对派的帮助下，
米哈伊尔·苏斯洛夫和弗拉基米尔·谢尔比茨基迅速召集紧急中央委
员会全会。在会上，尤里·安德罗波夫被指控“把克格勃变成私人店
铺、准备反政府政变、与美国中央情报局及以色列情报机构勾连、
诬陷费奥多尔·库拉科夫和彼得·马舍罗夫”等等。
我们迅速组织对全会的信息支援，借助刊发关于安德罗波夫的“揭密
材料”给火上浇油。克格勃头目试图抵抗，
但在弗拉基米尔·谢尔比茨基的发言中——他直接指控安德罗波夫准
备谋杀勃列日涅夫——对方这才意识到自己已经输了。
全会通过决议：撤销安德罗波夫所有职务，
将其开除出党并逮捕。
苏联克格勃新主席是乌克兰克格勃负责人维塔利·费多尔丘克，
他开始对安德罗波夫系人员进行大规模清洗，
并用经验证的共和国党委工作人员替换他们。
也许我们在苏联最危险的敌人，如今已被彻底中和……

0x002492B4.text: As soon as news came from Vienna about Leonid Brezhnev's arrival in the capital of Austria - the 8th Main Directorate of the KGB of the USSR by order of the first Deputy Chairman of the Committee General Semyon Tsvigun disconnected the government communication, thus completely isolating the Secretary General from information from the USSR. Meanwhile, with the help of the opposition in the KGB, Mikhail Suslov and Vladimir Shcherbytsky quickly gathered an emergency Central Committee Plenum, in which Yuri Andropov was accused of "the transformation of the KGB into a personal shop, the preparation of an anti-government coup, communication with CIA and Israel's secret service, the slandering of Fyodor Kulakov and Pyotr Masherov", etc. We quickly organized information support of the Plenum, adding fuel to the fire with publications of "revelatory material" about Andropov. However, Andropov kept his head and leaning on her supporters in the Central Committee of the Communist party and loyal security officers, has announced Suslov and Shcherbitsky as "the second anti-party group" turning the Plenum into the court over them. The result was the exclusion of Suslov and Shcherbitsky from the CPSU and the rise of Andropov, who became the Second Secretary of the CPSU and the actual successor of Leonid Brezhnev, who was notified of everything and supported his actions.

格勃第八总局奉委员会第一副主席谢苗·茨维贡之命切断政府通信，
使总书记与来自苏联的情报完全隔绝。
与此同时，在克格勃内部反对派的帮助下，
米哈伊尔·苏斯洛夫和弗拉基米尔·谢尔比茨基迅速召集紧急中央委
