我们迅速组织对全会的信息支援，借助刊发关于安德罗波夫的“揭密
材料”给火上浇油。然而，安德罗波夫稳住阵脚，
依靠其在共产党中央委员会中的支持者以及忠诚的安全部门人员，
宣布苏斯洛夫和谢尔比茨基为“第二个反党集团”，
把全会变成对他们的“审判”。
结果是：苏斯洛夫和谢尔比茨基被开除出苏共，
安德罗波夫则乘势上台——他成为苏共第二书记，
并成为列昂尼德·勃列日涅夫的事实接班人。
勃列日涅夫已被告知一切，并支持他的行动。

0x00249D77.text: And nothing happened. Yuri Andropov gradually cleans the KGB of his opponents and strengthens the influence of the Central Committee of the CPSU, becoming the actual successor of Leonid Brezhnev and promoting reformist party members such as Yegor Ligachev, Mikhail Gorbachev and Vladimir Dolgikh.
0x00249D77.translated:
什么也没有发生。尤里·安德罗波夫逐步清除克格勃中的对手，
加强苏共中央委员会的影响力，成为列昂尼德·勃列日涅夫的事实接
班人，并推动像叶戈尔·利加乔夫、米哈伊尔·戈尔巴乔夫和弗拉基
米尔·多尔吉赫这样的改革派党内人士。

0x00249FEE.text: Israel announced the beginning of operation "Peace to Galilee", the purpose of which, according to Israeli representatives, is the elimination of PLO bases and the creation of a demilitarized zone in southern Lebanon. Israel has announced that it is not going to attack the group of Syrian armed forces in Lebanon, and Syria itself has refrained from fighting, but given the fact that the Syrians control a huge part of Lebanon, the clash between them and the forces of the IDF seems only a matter of time. It is noteworthy that the United States, traditionally supportive of Israel, reacted quite restrained and did not particularly appreciate its "peacekeeping" impulses.
0x00249FEE.translated:
以色列宣布启动代号“加利利的和平”行动。
根据以色列代表的说法，该行动目的在于消灭巴解组织（PLO）
的据点，并在黎巴嫩南部建立非军事区。
以色列表示不会袭击驻黎巴嫩的叙利亚武装力量集团；
叙利亚本身也克制地没有交火。
但考虑到叙利亚控制了黎巴嫩相当大的一部分地区，
双方与以色列国防军（IDF）之间的冲突似乎只是时间问题。
值得注意的是，传统上支持以色列的美国反应相当克制，
并没有特别欣赏它的“维和”冲动。

0x0024A563.translated: 津巴布韦种族隔离的终结

0x0024A59F.text: We have established diplomatic relations with the government of Mugabe and expressed our intention to develop close cooperation between China and Zimbabwe, reinforcing our good intentions with material assistance, which Mugabe gladly accepted, stating readiness for full cooperation.
0x0024A59F.translated:
我们已同穆加贝政府建立外交关系，并表示愿意发展中津之间的紧密
合作；以物质援助来强化我们的善意。
穆加贝欣然接受，并表示准备进行全面合作。

0x0024A7D8.text: Our interaction with the new government was limited to the establishment of diplomatic relations. Nothing special happened.
0x0024A7D8.translated:
我们与新政府的互动仅限于建立外交关系。
没有发生什么特别的事。

0x0024A8ED.text: As a result, Konstantin Chernenko was elected General Secretary of the CPSU Central Committee. Many saw him as a convenient compromise figure that would allow the Union to avoid large-scale changes and upheavals and it seems he will meet their expectations.
0x0024A8ED.translated:
结果，康斯坦丁·切尔年科当选为苏共中央委员会总书记。
许多人认为他是个便于折中的人物，能够让联盟避免大规模变动与动
荡，看来他也将满足他们的期待。

0x0024AAF2.text: As a result, Vladimir Shcherbitsky was elected General Secretary of the CPSU Central Committee. This is not surprising - removing Andropov, with the support of Suslov and the trust of Brezhnev, he became the main contender for the position. It seems the USSR is waiting for a few more years of stability.
0x0024AAF2.translated:
结果，弗拉基米尔·谢尔比茨基当选为苏共中央委员会总书记。
这并不意外——在苏斯洛夫的支持和勃列日涅夫的信任下，
他除掉了安德罗波夫，成为该职位的主要竞争者。
看来苏联还将等待几年的稳定。

0x0024AD55.text: As a result, Yuri Andropov was elected General Secretary of the CPSU Central Committee. During the years of the KGB leadership, he concentrated in his hands a huge power that allowed him to win this fight, and many saw him as a pragmatic and tough ruler, so necessary for the Soviet Union now.
0x0024AD55.translated:
结果，尤里·安德罗波夫当选为苏共中央委员会总书记。
在克格勃领导的岁月里，他把巨大的权力集中于手中，
正是凭借这股力量他赢得了这场斗争。
许多人认为他是务实而强硬的统治者——而这正是苏联如今所必需的。

0x0024AFA2.text: Hong Kong Goodbye, Macao hasta la vista?

0x0024AFF4.text: With the help of special services, state-owned companies and pro-Chinese lobbying organizations, we were able to establish contacts with the three main syndicates of the Triad - «14K», «Sun Yee On» and «Wo Shing Wo». They received guarantees from us of the inviolability of their members and assets and a proposal for profitable investment of their capital in the country's economy (in particular, in the production of ephedra) on extremely favorable terms. The leaders of the Triads, who were already preparing to relocate their centers in the United States, agreed to our proposal. They are beginning to invest heavily in our southern provinces, and also use their influence to neutralize the actions of opponents of China's reunification (in particular, critical materials disappeared from the media, all protests were quickly dispersed by Triad members with the acquiescence of corrupt police, and a number of businessmen emigrated from Hong Kong and Macao). Thus, we now have the support of syndicates, but also the growing influence of the criminal world and corruption.
0x0024AFF4.translated:
在特工部门、国有企业以及亲华游说组织的帮助下，
我们得以同三大“青帮”集团——“14K”“新义安”和“和胜和
”建立联系。他们从我们这里获得了关于其成员与资产不可侵犯的保
证，并得到一项在我国经济中进行高收益投资的提议（尤其是麻黄草
生产），条件极为优厚。
三大帮派的头目早已准备把核心转移到美国，
对我们的提议表示同意。
他们开始在我国南方省份大举投资，并利用影响力去中和反对中国统
一者的行动（例如，批评性材料从媒体上消失；
在腐败警察的默许下，所有抗议都被青帮成员迅速驱散；
还有一批商人从香港和澳门移民）。
因此，我们如今既有帮派的支持，也迎来了犯罪世界与腐败势力日益
增长的影响。

0x0024B85F.text: We have established contacts with the three largest syndicates of the Triads - «14K», «Sun Yee On» and «Wo Shing Wo». They received guarantees from us of the inviolability of their members and assets, but these conditions did not suit their managers. The negotiations ended in nothing, but their very fact, not without the help of the MSS, leaked to the media in Hong Kong and Macau, frightened the local disaffected, many of whom, having decided not to risk, emigrated. It can be considered our partial success, although after 1997 we will have to be fought the Triads seriously.
0x0024B85F.translated:
我们已同三大“青帮”集团——“14K”“新义安”和“和胜和”
建立联系。他们从我们这里获得了关于其成员与资产不可侵犯的保证，
但这些条件并不符合他们管理层的口味。
谈判最终无果而终，不过在中间情报部门（MSS）
的帮助下，这件事本身还是泄露到了香港和澳门的媒体上，
吓坏了当地不满者。许多人决定不冒险，
选择了移民。可以说这是我们的一部分成功，
尽管在1997年之后，我们仍得认真对付这些青帮。

0x0024BCEA.text: We have established contacts with the three largest syndicates of the Triads - «14K», «Sun Yee On» and «Wo Shing Wo». They received guarantees from us of the inviolability of their members and assets, with which their leaders agreed. They use their influence to neutralize the actions of opponents of China's reunification (in particular, critical materials disappeared from the media, all protests were quickly dispersed by Triad members with the acquiescence of corrupt police, and a number of businessmen emigrated from Hong Kong and Macao). However, the MSS does not allow the Triad to gain a foothold in the southern provinces of the country, and after 1997 we will start a systematic struggle against them.
0x0024BCEA.translated:
我们已同三大“青帮”集团——“14K”“新义安”和“和胜和”
建立联系。他们从我们这里获得了关于其成员与资产不可侵犯的保证，
并得到了他们领导层的同意。
他们利用影响力去中和反对中国统一者的行动（例如，
批评性材料从媒体上消失；在腐败警察的默许下，
所有抗议都被青帮成员迅速驱散；还有一批商人从香港和澳门移民）。
然而，MSS不允许青帮在我国南方省份站稳脚跟；
在1997年之后，我们将对他们展开系统性的斗争。

0x0024C27D.text: flatly refused any negotiations with the Hong Kong crime syndicates. After a series of anti-China incidents, in Hong Kong and Macao, a systematic campaign began to discredit the agreement on their transfer to China, which ended in mass pogroms and the decision of the English and Portuguese parliaments to refuse to ratify the agreement.
0x0024C27D.translated:
彻底拒绝与香港犯罪集团进行任何谈判。
此后，在香港和澳门发生了一系列反华事件，
一场系统性的运动开始抹黑关于将其移交给中国的协议，
最终以大规模的暴乱以及英国和葡萄牙议会决定拒绝批准该协议而告
终。

0x0024C524.text: However, our friends put pressure on them and were able to achieve the fulfillment by the British and Portuguese side of their obligations. Hong Kong and Macao will be returned, as established, in 1997 and 1999, respectively.
0x0024C524.translated:
不过，我们的朋友对他们施加了压力，并促使英方与葡方履行其义务。
香港与澳门将按既定安排分别于1997年和1999年回归。

0x0024C6E9.text: «Either the Communist Party will win corruption, or corruption will win the Communist Party»  - declared Comrade Chairman at a meeting of the Politburo. The PRC Ministry of Public Security and the CPC Central Commission for Discipline Inspection have launched a large-scale campaign to combat the corrupt elites in the southern provinces of the PRC adjacent to Hong Kong and Macao, as well as the recently opened SEZ. Hundreds of functionaries of all levels were removed from their posts, thousands of people were expelled from the CPC, millions of yuan stolen from the state were confiscated, and Chengdu mayor Chen Xitong ("Chinese Grishin") who stole several billion yuan from the people and built himself a luxury villa was sentenced to be shot. This completely disorganized all corrupt elements, which made it possible to somewhat correct the situation and break the corrupt contacts of our elites with their colleagues from Macao and Hong Kong. The latter "just in case" emigrate.
0x0024C6E9.translated:
“要么共产党战胜腐败，要么腐败战胜共产党”——同志主席在政治
局会议上宣告。中华人民共和国公安部和中共中央纪律检查委员会已
启动大规模行动，打击紧邻香港与澳门的中国南方省份以及最近新开
放的经济特区中的腐败精英。
数百名各级干部被撤职，数千人被开除出党，
数以百万计从国家窃取的资金被没收；成都市市长陈希同（“中国格
里申”）因从群众手中偷走数十亿元并为自己建造豪华别墅，
被判处枪决。这彻底打乱了所有腐败分子的体系，
使我们得以在一定程度上扭转局面，并切断我方精英与澳门、
香港同行之间的腐败联系。
后者“以防万一”移民。

0x0024CEC0.text: In response to these events, the entire "civilized world" burst into angry speeches about the DPRK. We did not give official statements, but an article was published in the "Renmin Ribao" with a sharp condemnation of the terrorist methods of the DPRK. On the border of the two Koreas, in the meantime, several armed provocations took place on both sides...
0x0024CEC0.translated:
针对这些事件，整个“文明世界”都爆发出对朝鲜民主主义人民共和
国（DPRK）的愤怒发言。
我们没有发表官方声明，但《人民日报》上刊登了一篇对朝鲜恐怖手
段进行严厉谴责的文章。
与此同时，在两朝边境，双方都发生了数起武装挑衅……

0x0024D18B.text: In response to these events, the entire "civilized world" burst into angry speeches about the DPRK.  We fully supported the North Korean position, calling the incident a provocation of South Korea and condemning it. On the border of the two Koreas, in the meantime, several armed provocations took place on both sides...
0x0024D18B.translated:
针对这些事件，整个“文明世界”都爆发出对朝鲜民主主义人民共和
国（DPRK）的愤怒发言。
我们完全支持朝鲜方面的立场，称这起事件是南朝鲜的挑衅并予以谴
责。与此同时，在两朝边境，双方都发生了数起武装挑衅……

0x0024D40E.text: In response to these events, the entire "civilized world" burst into angry speeches about the DPRK. On the border of the two Koreas, in the meantime, several armed provocations took place on both sides...
0x0024D40E.translated:
针对这些事件，整个“文明世界”都爆发出对朝鲜民主主义人民共和
国（DPRK）的愤怒发言。
与此同时，在两朝边境，双方都发生了数起武装挑衅……

0x0024D5E1.text: The Chinese government decided to allocate additional funds for the modernization of light and heavy industry, improving the quality of products and upgrading equipment. The main vector of the new five-year plan was the development of industry.
0x0024D5E1.translated:
中国政府决定追加资金，用于轻重工业现代化，
提高产品质量并更新设备。
新的五年计划的主要方向是发展工业。

0x0024D7CC.text: The Chinese government decided to allocate funds for the mechanization and introduction of new technologies in the field of agriculture. The main priority of the new five-year plan was announced agriculture.
0x0024D7CC.translated:
中国政府决定拨款用于农业机械化以及引进新技术。
新的五年计划的主要优先事项宣布为农业。

0x0024D96D.text: The Chinese government decided to improve the quality of service in the service sector, for which additional funds were allocated from the budget. The primary objective of the five-year plan was proclaimed modernization of the service sector.
0x0024D96D.translated:
中国政府决定提高服务业的服务质量，并从预算中追加拨款。
五年计划的首要目标被宣布为服务业现代化。

0x0024DB54.text: The Chinese government announced the economic development program for the current five-year plan, which indicates the need to accelerate scientific and technological progress and the introduction of new methods of managing the national economy. The priority branch of the new five-year plan became science.
0x0024DB54.translated:
中国政府公布了本五年计划的经济发展方案，
指出必须加快科学技术进步，并引入管理国民经济的新方法。
新的五年计划的优先领域成为科学。

0x0024DDBB.text: Despite the proposals of the State Planning Committee, the Chinese government announced the need for the uniform development of all sectors of the national economy, for which additional funds were allocated from the country's budget
0x0024DDBB.translated:
尽管国家计划委员会提出了建议，中国政府仍宣布必须实现国民经济
各部门的均衡发展，并从国家预算中追加拨款

0x0024DFBA.text: Our special services assisted PASOK in carrying out their campaign and actively disrupted the campaign of New Democracy. They also managed to form a coalition of left forces from PASOK, CPG and other left-wing parties. As a result, the left coalition won the election, forming the first socialist government in the country's history. With our and Soviet support, it completed the formal withdrawal of Greece from NATO and stopped the processes of European integration
0x0024DFBA.translated:
我们的特工部门协助PASOK开展竞选活动，
并积极破坏“新民主党”的竞选。
与此同时，他们还成功促成由PASOK、
希腊共产党（CPG）及其他左翼政党组成的左翼联盟。
结果，左翼联盟赢得选举，组建了该国历史上第一个社会主义政府。
在我们和苏联的支持下，它完成了希腊正式退出北约的进程，
并阻止了欧洲一体化进程

0x0024E363.text: Our special services assisted the New Democracy in conducting their campaign and actively disrupted the PASOK campaign. They also managed to achieve the accession to the coalition with the New Democracy of some small right-wing parties, which together led them to victory in the elections. The new government intends to carry out further economic reforms aimed at ensuring the membership of Greece in the EEC, and to restore the country's activities in NATO.
0x0024E363.translated:
我们的特工部门协助“新民主党”开展竞选，
并积极破坏PASOK的竞选。
他们还设法促成一些小型右翼政党加入“新民主党”领导的联盟，
从而共同使其在选举中获胜。
新政府打算继续推进旨在确保希腊加入欧洲共同体（EEC）
的经济改革，并恢复该国在北约中的活动。

0x0024E6FA.text: As a result, the New Democracy won the elections with a small margin. The new government intends to carry out further economic reforms aimed at ensuring the membership of Greece in the EEC, and to restore the country's activities in NATO.
0x0024E6FA.translated:
结果，“新民主党”以微弱优势赢得选举。
新政府打算继续推进旨在确保希腊加入欧洲共同体（EEC）
的经济改革，并恢复该国在北约中的活动。

0x0024E911.text: At an emergency meeting of the Politburo of the Central Committee of the CPC, the events that took place were declared "a counter-revolutionary rebellion inspired by the American and Taiwanese special services", after which the majority of votes decided to force it down. By order of the PLA General Staff Chief, General Yang Dezhi, troops were reinforced with tanks and armored personnel carriers in Beijing, but as they advanced to the square they ran into barricades and stubborn resistance from the gangsters armed with "Molotov cocktails". With the support of armored vehicles, the barricades were broken, after which part of the PLA defeated the main camp of the protesters and cleared the Tananmen Square, and the stripping of workers and student quarters continued for several days. Thus, the situation was taken under control. The movement "Tuidang" was outlawed,
0x0024E911.translated:
在中共中央政治局紧急会议上，所发生的事件被定性为“受美国和台
湾特务指使的反革命暴乱”，随后以多数票决定强行镇压。
根据解放军总参谋长杨德志将军的命令，
部队在北京增援了坦克和装甲运兵车，但当他们推进到广场时，
遭遇路障以及手持“莫洛托夫鸡尾酒”的暴徒顽强抵抗。
在装甲车辆的支援下，路障被冲破；随后，
部分解放军击溃了抗议者的主要营地并清理了天安门广场，
对工人和学生宿舍的搜查/清剿行动又持续了数天。
于是局势被控制住了。
“退党”（Tuidang）运动被取缔，

0x0024EFE6.text: and his supporters were removed from their posts and expelled from the CPC, arrests of opponents of reform and opening-up began, and Fang Lizhi fled to the United States. Western countries have declared our regime "bloody tyranny", the USSR and its allies remained silent. The organized protest movement was suppressed, dissatisfied people go underground.
0x0024EFE6.translated:
他和他的支持者被撤职并逐出中共，打击改革开放的反对者的逮捕行
动开始，方励之逃往美国。
西方国家宣称我们的政权是“血腥暴政”，
苏联及其盟友却保持沉默。
有组织的抗议运动被镇压，不满者纷纷潜伏地下。

0x0024F2B1.text: Fearing looting, the mayor of Beijing ordered the introduction of reinforced armored personnel units of the People's Armed Police into the city, which cordoned off Tiananmen Square and drove out the protesters from the adjacent streets (while suffering major losses in the technique burned by "Molotov cocktails"). After that, Comrade Chairman personally spoke to the demonstrators, persuading them to disperse. A significant part of them left the square, the rest were dispersed by policemen with tear gas and blank shots. Order in the capital was restored, but the unrest spread to Shanghai, Ningbo and several other cities...
0x0024F2B1.translated:
为防止抢劫，北京市市长下令将人民武装警察的加固装甲运兵车部队
开进城内，封锁天安门广场，并把抗议者从相邻街道驱赶出去（同时
在被“莫洛托夫鸡尾酒”点燃的技术装备上遭受重大损失）。
随后，主席同志亲自对示威者讲话，劝其散去。
相当一部分人离开了广场，剩下的则被警察以催泪瓦斯和鸣枪驱散。
首都秩序恢复了，但骚乱却蔓延到上海、
宁波以及其他数座城市……

0x0024F79C.text: Fearing looting, the mayor of Beijing ordered the introduction of reinforced armored personnel units of the People's Armed Police into the city, which cordoned off Tiananmen Square and drove out the protesters from the adjacent streets (while suffering major losses in the technique burned by "Molotov cocktails"). The crowd met the Chairman with a whistle and shouting, which caused his hastily retreat. At an emergency meeting of the Politburo of the CPC Central Committee, it was decided to make concessions to the demonstrators and send the party’s leadership to resign. Сomrade
0x0024F79C.translated:
为防止抢劫，北京市市长下令将人民武装警察的加固装甲运兵车部队
开进城内，封锁天安门广场，并把抗议者从相邻街道驱赶出去（同时
在被“莫洛托夫鸡尾酒”点燃的技术装备上遭受重大损失）。
人群用口哨和叫喊声迎接主席，迫使他仓促退却。
中共中央政治局紧急会议决定：向示威者作出让步，
并让党的领导层辞职。
Сomrade

0x0024FC2D.text: became the new General Secretary, who proclaimed a policy of deepening reforms and large-scale democratization of the country. Most of the protesters dispersed, satisfied with this, the rest were driven out by the People's Armed Police. China is waiting for changes...
0x0024FC2D.translated:
成为新的总书记，宣告实行深化改革、在全国范围内大规模推进民主
化的政策。大多数示威者散去，对此感到满意；
其余的则被人民武装警察驱逐。
中国正在等待变化……

0x0024FE4A.text: At an emergency meeting of the Politburo of the Central Committee of the CPC, violent disputes broke out - the conservative wing demanded to use force (especially Wang Zhen spoke out for this), the liberal wing wanted to make concessions, the reformist wing was hesitant. In the end, the liberals succeeded - the entire CPC leadership resigned. Сomrade
0x0024FE4A.translated:
中共中央政治局紧急会议上爆发激烈争论——保守派主张动用武力（
尤其是王震大力主张），自由派想要作出让步，
改革派则犹豫不决。最终，自由派得逞——中共全体领导层辞职。
Сomrade

0x00250121.text: became the new General Secretary, who proclaimed a policy of deepening reforms and large-scale democratization of the country. However, the movement "Tuidang" considered this to be a proof of the weakness of the country's leadership and organized large-scale demonstrations throughout the country that ended with government’s resignation and China’s entry into the transitional period. The Communist Party loses power in the country and its fate is clearly under threat...
0x00250121.translated:
成为新的总书记，宣告实行深化改革、在全国范围内大规模推进民主
化的政策。然而，“退党”运动认为这正是国家领导层软弱的证明，
于是组织全国范围的大规模示威，最终以政府辞职告终，
中国进入过渡时期。共产党在国内失去政权，
其命运显然岌岌可危……

0x00250502.text: At the extraordinary Plenum of the CPC Central Committee, by a majority of votes, it was decided to abandon Marxism-Leninism, Maoism and Xiaopism in favor of modern European communism, modeled on the French, Italian, Spanish and Japanese Communist Parties. Corresponding changes were made to the program documents of the CPC. This causes a certain dissatisfaction with the most conservative part of the partocrats, but on the whole the party adopted a new ideology, realizing the need for changes.
0x00250502.translated:
在中共中央的非常全会上，经过多数票表决，
决定放弃马克思列宁主义、毛主义和小平主义，
转而支持以法国、意大利、西班牙和日本共产党为样板的现代欧洲共
产主义。中共的纲领文件作出了相应修改。
这在最保守的党阀群体中引起一定不满，
但总体上党接受了新的意识形态，认识到必须进行变革。

0x002508E7.text: At the extraordinary Plenum of the CPC Central Committee, after long disputes, it was decided to return to the precepts of Chen Duxiu and Zhang Guotao and recognize the social democratic character of the party. Corresponding changes were made to the program documents of the CPC. This causes strong dissatisfaction with the conservative part of the partocrats, there is a certain danger of a split in the CPC. Time will tell whether you did the right thing...
0x002508E7.translated:
在中共中央的非常全会上，经过长期争论，
决定回到陈独秀和张国焘的主张，承认党的社会民主党性质。
中共的纲领文件作出了相应修改。
这引起党阀中保守派的强烈不满，中共内部出现分裂的某种危险。
时间会告诉你们是否做了正确的事……

0x00250C80.text: At the extraordinary Plenum of the CPC Central Committee, a group of party members prevailed, suggesting that they return to the origins of the Chinese revolutionary movement — Sun Yat-sen and the second version of his "Three Principles of the People" (fighting feudalism and capitalism, democratization of the state and social system, improving the lives of workers and restriction of monopoly capital). Corresponding changes were made to the program documents of the CPC. The CPC began to converge with the Revolutionary Committee of the Kuomintang and the left-nationalist groups, which is popular with the people, but causes obvious disapproval of the party members.
0x00250C80.translated:
在中共中央的非常全会上，一批党员占了上风，
主张回到中国革命运动的源头——孙中山及其“人民三民主义”的第
二版（反对封建主义和资本主义、国家与社会制度的民主化、
改善工人生活并限制垄断资本）。
中共的纲领文件作出了相应修改。
中共开始与国民党革命委员会以及深受群众欢迎的左翼民族主义团体
趋同，但这却引起党员们明显反对。

0x002511BF.text: At the extraordinary Plenum of the CPC Central Committee, supporters of the preservation of Marxism-Maoism-Xiaopism won. The movement "Tuidang" is gaining strength and actively attacking the CPC, the party is losing the support of the population, and behind it the power in the field. It seems there will be no place for it in the new China...
0x002511BF.translated:
在中共中央的非常全会上，主张保留马克思主义—毛主义—小平主义
者获胜。“退党”运动势头增强，正积极攻击中共；
党正在失去群众支持，且在各领域的力量也逐渐失势。
看来在新中国里它恐怕没有立足之地……

0x002514B4.text: "National Revolution United Front"  was dissolved, and we began to create electoral legislation, in our interests, of course. The electoral system is designed in such a way as to provide groups that sympathize with us with an advantage, we have banned all parties that could be banned, while others will have to overcome many bureaucratic barriers for admission to elections. Meanwhile, the last remnants of the bloody censorship and control of China’s past are washed out by new publicity and freedom.
0x002514B4.translated:
“民族革命统一战线”被解散，我们开始着手制定选举立法——当然
是为了我们的利益。选举制度被设计成：
让同情我们的群体占据优势；我们已经禁止了所有能够被禁止的政党，
而其他政党则必须跨越重重官僚障碍才能获得参选资格。
与此同时，过去那种血腥审查与控制的最后残余，
也被新的宣传与自由冲刷殆尽。

0x002518A3.text: "National Revolution United Front" was dissolved, and we began to create electoral legislation, the freest and most honest in the world! On the other hand, the euphoria of the upcoming free elections allowed us to avoid large-scale "unscrewing the screws", although for the species the pressure on religion had to be relaxed.
0x002518A3.translated:
“民族革命统一战线”被解散，我们开始制定选举立法——世界上最
自由、最诚实的选举！
另一方面，即将到来的自由选举带来的狂喜情绪，
让我们得以避免大规模“拧螺丝”，尽管就物种而言，
宗教压力还是得有所放松。

0x00251B30.text: "National Revolution United Front"  was dissolved, and we began to create electoral legislation, the freest and most honest in the world! On the other hand, the euphoria of the upcoming free elections and the reduction of state control allowed us to keep our religion policy almost unchanged - yes, legally the administration of religious services was simplified, but in fact priests and temples are still under the control of the MSS and the local administration.
0x00251B30.translated:
“民族革命统一战线”被解散，我们开始制定选举立法——世界上最
自由、最诚实的选举！
另一方面，即将到来的自由选举带来的狂喜以及国家控制的减弱，
使我们得以让宗教政策几乎不变——是的，
法律上简化了宗教事务的管理，但实际上，
神职人员和寺庙仍在国家安全部（MSS）
和地方行政的控制之下。

0x00251ED3.text: All proposals to slow down the restructuring and democratization were harshly criticized by the current leader. "National Revolution United Front"  was dissolved, and we began to create electoral legislation, the freest and most honest in the world! At the same time, the democratization of all aspects of public life was begun, not only in words but also in deeds. The people, of course, pleased, but for how long?..
0x00251ED3.translated:
当前领导人对任何放慢改组与民主化的提议都予以严厉批评。
“民族革命统一战线”被解散，我们开始制定选举立法——世界上最
自由、最诚实的选举！
与此同时，公共生活各方面的民主化也开始了，
不仅停留在口头上，更落实在行动中。
人民当然高兴，但能高兴多久？……

0x00252230.text: A campaign was launched on the large-scale automation of the planning of our economy, regional computer centers are actively being built and put into operation, and coordination is gradually being established between them. The statistics department is already predicting us a serious increase in productivity and improved supply, but not everyone in the party is happy with your innovations
0x00252230.translated:
在全国范围内大规模实现经济规划自动化的运动已经启动：
各地区的计算机中心正在积极建设并投入运行，
它们之间的协调也在逐步建立。
统计部门已经预测：生产力将显著提高、
供给将得到改善，但并非党内所有人都对你们的创新感到满意。

0x0025253F.text: It was stated the need for a gradual and cautious introduction of such a new technology. The automation of grassroots planning departments is extremely slow and is being crushed by bureaucrats. At this rate, the desired productivity growth will not be reached soon.
0x0025253F.translated:
会议强调，需要循序渐进、谨慎引入这种新技术。
基层规划部门的自动化推进极其缓慢，正被官僚们压制。
照这样下去，所期望的生产力增长短期内难以实现。

0x0025277C.text: The government of Burkina Faso has received our ambassadors, and official relations have been established. Now Sankara is starting his radical transformation program. In his plans: the elimination of hunger, the creation of a system of free education and health care, the fight against epidemics and corruption, mass vaccination of children. Because of its anti-imperialist views, the leader of Burkina Faso is increasingly involved in the «Non-Aligned Movement», remaining a sharp critic of colonialism and neo-colonialism, «humanitarian aid» from the Western powers and international economic organizations of the neoliberal sense, seeing it as a form of neo-colonialism. To achieve the goal of a radical transformation of society, Sankara established an authoritarian regime, banned a number of political organizations and free media, which he considered a threat to his plans, which, however, didn’t hit on his popularity of «people's liberator»».
0x0025277C.translated:
布基纳法索政府接见了我们的使节，正式关系已经建立。
现在，桑卡拉开始推行他激进的改造计划。
计划包括：消除饥饿，建立免费教育与医疗体系，
打击流行病与腐败，对儿童进行大规模接种。
由于其反帝立场，布基纳法索领导人愈发卷入“不结盟运动”，
始终是殖民主义与新殖民主义的尖锐批评者，
亦批判西方强国及新自由主义色彩的国际经济组织所提供的“人道援
助”，认为这是一种新殖民主义形式。
为实现社会的激进转型目标，桑卡拉建立了威权政权，
取缔了一些政治组织和自由媒体，认为它们会威胁他的计划——不过
这并未动摇他作为“人民解放者”的人气”。

0x00252EEF.text: We didn’t react to another military coup that is happening now, almost every day. According to the data of international organizations, mass repressions of the state apparatus and a number of entrepreneurs are unfolding in Burkina Faso, which peculiar to the «totalitarian regimes». It's good that we are not involved.
0x00252EEF.translated:
我们没有对眼下几乎每天都在发生的又一次军事政变作出反应。
根据国际组织的数据，布基纳法索正在展开针对国家机器与一批企业
家的大规模镇压，这正是“极权政权”的典型做法。
好在我们并未卷入其中。

0x0025316E.text: The delegation from China arrived in Ouagadougou to meet with a new friend of the Chinese people. We have offered food and military assistance. Delighted with our friendliness, Thomas Sankara, during a solemn dinner, expressed us words of true gratitude: «With the help of our Chinese friends, imperialistic tyranny will go into the past along with this millennium, and all people will live in a society of equality and freedom!». Now, by analogy with China, and with our support, Sankara begins radical experiments in the economy, declaring a revolutionary transition from feudalism to socialism, bypassing capitalism so that it will be greeted with enthusiasm among the people. Now the main task of the government has become the industrialization and construction of mechanized agricultural cooperatives, the development of education, infrastructure and medicine. Also, thanks to our agents, the opposition no longer cares for Sankara, which allowed his power to stabilize. France, which is beginning to look for ways to overthrow him and return Burkina Faso to the orbit of its influence, expressed strong discontent with Sankara’s reforms.
0x0025316E.translated:
中国代表团抵达瓦加杜古，去会见中国人民的新朋友。
我们提供了粮食和军事援助。
托马斯·桑卡拉在一场庄严的晚宴上，因我们的友好而深受感动，
向我们表达了真挚的感谢之词：“在中国朋友的帮助下，
帝国主义的暴政将随着这个千年一起进入过去，
所有人都将生活在平等与自由的社会里！
”如今，桑卡拉在我们的支持下，仿照中国在经济领域开始激进试验，
宣称从封建主义向社会主义的革命性过渡，
绕开资本主义，以便得到人民的热烈欢迎。
现在，政府的主要任务变成了推进工业化、
建设机械化农业合作社，发展教育、基础设施与医疗。
同时，多亏了我们的特工，反对派不再关心桑卡拉，
这使他的权力得以稳定。
法国则开始寻找推翻他的办法，并把布基纳法索拉回到其影响轨道，
对桑卡拉的改革表达了强烈不满。

0x00253A8B.text: Andropov’s funeral took place at 12:00 on February 14, 1984 near the Kremlin wall on Moscow’s Red Square. Heads of state and government of many countries.
0x00253A8B.translated:
安德罗波夫的葬礼于1984年2月14日12时在莫斯科红场克里
姆林宫墙外举行。许多国家的国家元首和政府首脑。

0x00253BC2.text: |Contrary to expectations, Alexander Yakovlev, a man with a reputation as an orthodox Marxist and an active campaigner against nationalism in the culture of the previous decade, became General Secretary of the CPSU Central Committee. Thanks to his diplomatic experience in Canada, he had developed strong and lasting connections with parts of the Western political elite who might well help pursue the USSR's "rapprochement with the West" course. New appointments to top government positions could well be expected. As we know, economist Leonid Abalkin is running for head of the Soviet government, and the Presidium of the Supreme Soviet may well be headed by Mikhail Gorbachev.
0x00253BC2.translated:
|出乎意料的是，亚历山大·雅科夫列夫——以正统马克思主义者的
名声著称，并在上个十年文化领域积极反对民族主义的人——成为苏
共中央总书记。由于他在加拿大的外交经验，
他与西方政治精英中的部分人士建立了牢固而持久的联系，
这些人或许能够帮助推进苏联的“对西方缓和”路线。
对最高层政府职位的新任命，人们大可期待。
众所周知，经济学家列昂尼德·阿巴尔金正在竞逐苏联政府首脑一职，
而最高苏维埃主席团也可能由米哈伊尔·戈尔巴乔夫出任。

0x00254113.text: | As expected, Konstantin Chernenko was elected General Secretary. However, given his age, he will not stay in this position for long.
0x00254113.translated:
|如预期所示，康斯坦丁·切尔年科当选总书记。
不过鉴于他的年纪，他不会在这个位置上久留。

0x00254222.text: The USSR thanked us for our condolences and received the Chinese delegation. Andropov’s funeral took place at 12:00 on February 14, 1984 near the Kremlin wall on Moscow’s Red Square.
0x00254222.translated:
苏联对我们的慰问表示感谢，并接见了中国代表团。
安德罗波夫的葬礼于1984年2月14日12时在莫斯科红场克里
姆林宫墙外举行。

0x00254391.text: Our leader personally led the Chinese delegation and was warmly received in the USSR. Andropov’s funeral took place at 12:00 on February 14, 1984 near the Kremlin wall on Moscow’s Red Square. Heads of state and government of many countries.
0x00254391.translated:
我们的领导人亲自率领中国代表团，并在苏联受到热情接待。
安德罗波夫的葬礼于1984年2月14日12时在莫斯科红场克里
姆林宫墙外举行。许多国家的国家元首和政府首脑。

0x00254574.text: |  As expected, Konstantin Chernenko was elected General Secretary. However, given his age, he will not stay in this position for long.
0x00254574.translated:
|如预期所示，康斯坦丁·切尔年科当选总书记。
不过鉴于他的年纪，他不会在这个位置上久留。

0x002546AD.text: Following the election, Carter still managed to maintain power. A key factor in his gain was that moderate foreign policy generally performed well, despite criticism from conservatives. The US is waiting for another 4 years of reign democrats.
0x002546AD.translated:
选举之后，卡特仍设法保住了权力。
他得以获益的关键因素在于：尽管遭到保守派批评，
中间路线的外交政策总体上表现不错。
美国正在等待民主党再执政4年。

0x00254896.text: As a result of the election, Carter was defeated by Reagan. The economic crisis and foreign policy failures affected the mood of Americans, who preferred to follow the populist slogans of the Republicans. Now, under the leadership of Reagan, the United States is waiting for a new round of active confrontation with the USSR.
0x00254896.translated:
由于选举结果，卡特被里根击败。
经济危机与外交政策失利影响了美国人的情绪，
他们更愿意追随共和党的民粹口号。
如今，在里根的领导下，美国正等待与苏联进行新一轮积极对抗。

0x00254B43.text: Thanks to our support, the leader of orthodox Stalinists Mohammad Yahiaoui was able to crack down on the right opposition and an emergency congress of the NLF appointed him as general secretary, and the National People's Assembly appointed him acting president of Algeria, early elections are scheduled for February 8, 1979, however, with a one-party system and non-alternative elections the result is known in advance. In the country, the persecution of «reactionary classes» begins and the predecessor's course towards industrialization continues. The new government announced a change in the vector of foreign policy to a pro-Chinese one and invited us to sign a very profitable trade contract. The Soviet Union negatively reacted «to the intervention of China in the internal affairs of Algeria»
0x00254B43.translated:
多亏我们的支持，正统斯大林主义者领袖穆罕默德·亚希奥维得以打
击右派反对派；民族解放阵线（NLF）
的紧急代表大会任命他为总书记，阿尔及利亚全国人民议会又任命他
为代总统。1979年2月8日提前举行选举，
然而在一党制与无竞争选举的情况下，结果早已在事先知晓。
国内开始迫害“反动阶级”，而前任推动工业化的路线继续延续。
新政府宣布：外交政策方向转为亲华，并邀请我们签署一份极其有利
的贸易合同。苏联对“中方干预阿尔及利亚内政”作出了消极反应。

0x00255184.text: We supported Chadli Bendjedid and the reform wing of the National Liberation Front, as a result of which a number of the most active Stalinists were arrested, the rest had to vote for Benjedid, and the pro-Western liberal Bouteflika was removed from the post of Minister of Foreign Affairs and moved to secondary roles. The emergency congress of the NLF appointed Benjedid as general secretary, and the National People's Assembly appointed him acting president of Algeria, early elections are scheduled for February 8, 1979, however, with a one-party system and non-alternative elections, the result is known in advance. The country is preparing full-scale reforms to support the sole peasantry and small business, which will help get rid of the excessive influence of the state on the economy. The President thanked us for the support and offered us a profitable trade contract, and the Soviet Union positively perceived Chinese assistance to Algeria, unlike the United States.
0x00255184.translated:
我们支持恰德利·本杰迪德以及民族解放阵线的改革派。
结果是：一批最活跃的斯大林主义者被逮捕，
其余人不得不投票支持本杰迪德；亲西方的自由派布特弗利卡被撤下
外交部长职务，调到次要岗位。
NLF的紧急代表大会任命本杰迪德为总书记，
全国人民议会任命他为阿尔及利亚代总统。
1979年2月8日提前举行选举，但在一党制与无竞争选举下，
结果早已在事先知晓。
国家正准备全面改革，以扶持单一农民与小工商业，
这将有助于摆脱国家对经济过度的影响。
总统感谢我们的支持，并向我们提供一份有利的贸易合同；
与美国不同，苏联对中国援助阿尔及利亚的态度是积极的。

0x0025592B.text: With the help of our agents, the liberal foreign minister, Bouteflika, cracked down on internal opposition in the party, and an emergency congress of the NLF elected him as general secretary; the National People's Assembly appointed him acting president of Algeria. The elections were postponed indefinitely due to the new global political reform and the creation of a new constitution for the country. The President announced a change in the vector of the economy and a transition to a mixed market system. The ban on foreign investment and medium-sized enterprises was lifted, privatization of unprofitable enterprises began. The new government announced the beginning of in-depth cooperation with Western countries in the field of foreign policy, which caused discontent of the USSR, and was positively received by the USA and NATO. Bouteflika thanked us for the support and offered a very profitable contract.
0x0025592B.translated:
在我们特工的帮助下，自由派外交部长布特弗利卡打击了党内的内部
反对力量；NLF的紧急代表大会选举他为总书记，
全国人民议会任命他为阿尔及利亚代总统。
由于新的全球政治改革以及国家新宪法的制定，
选举被无限期推迟。总统宣布：经济方向调整，
并向混合市场体制过渡。
取消了对外资与中型企业的禁令，不盈利企业的私有化开始推进。
新政府宣布在外交政策领域与西方国家开展深入合作，
这引起了苏联的不满，却得到了美国和北约的积极回应。
布特弗利卡感谢我们的支持，并向我们提供了一份极其有利的合同。

0x00256050.text: The emergency congress of the NLF appointed the leader of the reformers, Chadli Bendjedid, as the «compromise» general secretary, the National People's Assembly appointed him acting president of Algeria, early elections are scheduled for February 8, 1979, however, with a one-party system and non-alternative elections, the result is known in advance. Extremely moderate reforms begin in Algeria, which, however, cannot please anyone.
0x00256050.translated:
NLF的紧急代表大会任命改革派领袖恰德利·本杰迪德为“折中”
总书记，全国人民议会任命他为阿尔及利亚代总统。
1979年2月8日提前举行选举，但在一党制与无竞争选举下，
结果早已在事先知晓。
阿尔及利亚开始推行极其温和的改革，然而这却谁也无法取悦。

0x002563B7.text: XII World Festival of Youth and Students
0x002563B7.translated: 第十二届世界青年与学生联欢节

0x00256409.text: Our application has been accepted. A delegation of members of our youth organizations and the best Chinese students and members of the Chinese Communist Youth Union were sent to Moscow. The political program of the festival included the establishment of a new international economic order, discussion of the problem of economic assistance to backward and developing countries, the fight against poverty and unemployment, environmental issues were raised. The festival held numerous concerts of popular groups and amateur groups, exhibitions of artists and photographers. Everyone was satisfied with the event and we did not fail by sending a delegation there, all the more this contributed to the improvement of our relations not only with the USSR, but also with the capitalist countries.
0x00256409.translated:
我们的申请获得批准。
我们派出由青年组织成员组成的代表团，
以及中国最优秀的学生和中国共产主义青年团成员赴莫斯科。
联欢节的政治议程包括：建立新的国际经济秩序，
讨论对落后与发展中国家的经济援助问题，
反贫困与反失业，并提出环境议题。
联欢节举办了大量群众团体与业余团体的演唱会，
展出了艺术家与摄影师的作品。
大家对活动都很满意，我们派代表团前去并未白费——更重要的是，
这促进了我们同苏联乃至资本主义国家的关系改善。

0x00256A36.text: The USSR, which is in bad relations with us, decided to use its ties in the WFDY and use its position as the host country, as a result, our application for participation was rejected. However, not only we, but also some other countries and left movements were dissatisfied with it.
0x00256A36.translated:
与我们关系不佳的苏联决定借助其在世界青年与学生联欢节（WFD
Y）中的关系，并利用东道主地位，结果我们参与的申请被拒绝。
不过，不仅我们，其他一些国家以及左翼运动也对此表示不满。

0x00256C6B.text: The political program of the festival included the establishment of a new international economic order, discussion of the problem of economic assistance to backward and developing countries, the fight against poverty and unemployment, environmental issues were raised. The festival held numerous concerts of popular groups and amateur groups, exhibitions of artists and photographers. For us, nothing happened, since we decided not to send a delegation.
0x00256C6B.translated:
该节庆的政治议程包括建立新的国际经济秩序，
讨论对落后和发展中国家的经济援助问题，
开展反贫困与反失业斗争，并提出环境议题。
节日期间举办了大量流行乐队与业余团体的演出，
以及艺术家和摄影师的展览。
对我们来说，什么也没发生——因为我们决定不派代表团。

0x00256FF8.text: While the XII World Festival of Youth and Students was held in Moscow, we decided to emphasize our independence from the USSR and organized our own "World Progressive Youth Festival" in Beijing, where representatives of countries allied to China and those who for one reason or another did not send a delegation arrived to Moscow. In general, our people were satisfied with the event, and our ties with the Allies strengthened, but the international left movement looks at all this with distrust.
0x00256FF8.translated:
在莫斯科举行第十二届世界青年与学生节期间，
我们决定突出对苏联的独立性，于是在北京组织了我们自己的“世界
进步青年节”。前往莫斯科的，是那些与中国结盟的国家代表，
以及因种种原因未派代表团的国家代表。
总体而言，我们的人对这次活动感到满意，
同盟关系也进一步加强了，但国际左翼运动对此却充满不信任。

0x0025740D.text: As a result, the Democratic International was established. It is still difficult to talk about whether this will help anti-communist rebels in their actions, but this event is significant and contributes to the growth of influence of the USA, which actively support this formation.
0x0025740D.translated:
结果，民主国际成立了。
至于这是否会在行动上帮助反共叛乱者，
目前仍难说，但这件事意义重大，并有助于美国影响力的增长——美
国正积极支持这一组织。

0x00257642.text: Having managed to urgently establish cooperation between our agents in Angola and border countries, as well as secretly persuading the USSR and the pro-Soviet Angola authorities to cooperate, we were able to organize a series of terrorist attacks in Jamba. Unfortunately, UNITA leader Jonas Savimbi and American puppeteers were not injured, but we managed to eliminate the informal contras leader Adolfo Calero, prominent Mujahideen representative Abdul Rahim Wardak and the leader of the Hmong movement Pa Kao Her. In addition to the collapse of the coalition, the death of many prominent figures of world anti-communism seriously hit American influence and helped the USSR. That is why all the main accusations flew against him, however, Americans suspect something about our participation.
0x00257642.translated:
我们先是紧急促成了安哥拉境内我方特工与邻国之间的协作，
又秘密劝说苏联以及亲苏的安哥拉当局配合，
于是得以在贾姆巴组织一系列恐怖袭击。
遗憾的是，UNITA领导人乔纳斯·萨维姆比以及美国的幕后操盘
者并未受伤；但我们成功清除了非正式“反政府武装”头目阿道尔福
·卡莱罗、著名圣战组织代表阿卜杜勒·拉希姆·瓦达克，
以及蒙族（苗族）运动领袖帕·高·赫。
除联盟土崩瓦解外，许多世界反共名流的死亡也沉重打击了美国影响
力，并帮助了苏联。于是，所有主要指控都飞向了他——不过，
美国人怀疑我们参与了其中。

0x00257C75.text: We supported the formation of the Democratic International and its readiness to fight Soviet aggression around the world. Its participants perceived this statement differently, but generally reacted positively, as did the Americans, who benefited from it the most. Our benefit is still unclear, but Soviet influence has definitely declined.
0x00257C75.translated:
我们支持民主国际的组建，并支持其宣称随时准备在全世界对抗苏联
的侵略。其参与者对这番表态的理解不尽相同，
但总体反应积极；美国人也同样如此——他们从中获益最多。
至于我们能得到什么，目前仍不清楚，但苏联的影响力确实下降了。

0x00257F46.text: A conference between the countries of our union was held in Shanghai, ending with the signing of the so-called The Shanghai Agreement, which implies the creation of a single visa space between our countries and the simplification of passport and visa control with the prospect of a complete rejection of the need for foreign passports. The agreement gradually begins to work and the people are satisfied, only with this it begins to get carried away by foreign culture and cast doubt on our state principles. It will now be easier for criminals and dissidents to escape from China, and smugglers - to smuggle their goods to us. But the ties between our countries have further strengthened, and tourism profits will replenish our budget.
0x00257F46.translated:
我们联盟各国的会议在上海举行，最终签署了所谓《上海协议》。
该协议意味着在我们各国之间建立统一的签证空间，
并简化护照与签证管控，甚至展望彻底取消对外国护照的需求。
协议开始逐步见效，民众也感到满意——只是从此便开始沉迷外来文
化，并对我们的国家原则产生怀疑。
现在，罪犯和异议分子将更容易从中国逃离，
走私者也更容易把货物走私到我们这里。
但我们各国之间的联系进一步加强，旅游收入也将补充我们的预算。

0x00258549.text: Under the guise of exercises, our troops entered the country, quickly disarming their army, arresting the government and suppressing discontent. The new government was allocated financial assistance to consolidate loyalty.
0x00258549.translated:
借着演习的名义，我军进入该国，迅速解除其军队武装，
逮捕政府并镇压不满。
新政府获得财政援助，以巩固其忠诚。

0x0025870A.text: is with us again, but our diplomatic reputation leaves much to be desired.
0x0025870A.translated: 又回到我们这边了，但我们的外交声誉仍然差强人意。

0x002587A3.text: Through backstage intrigues, secret killings and the mobilization of politicians and the military who remained loyal to us, we managed to organize a coup in favor of those who are ready to continue to cooperate with us. The new government was allocated financial assistance to consolidate loyalty.
0x002587A3.translated:
通过幕后阴谋、秘密暗杀，以及动员那些仍忠于我们的政界人士和军
方力量，我们成功组织了一场政变，支持那些愿意继续与我们合作的
人。新政府获得财政援助，以巩固其忠诚。

0x002589FA.text: is with us again, but other countries suspect something and express their dissatisfaction
0x002589FA.translated: 又回到我们这边了，但其他国家起了疑心，并表达不满

0x00258AB1.text: It was decided not to resort to radical measures, but to appease the country and at the same time to economically tie it to us. This helped force independence supporters to abandon hasty plans, and friendship supporters with China gained additional power.
0x00258AB1.translated:
决定不采取激烈手段，而是安抚该国，同时在经济上把它绑到我们这
边。这迫使支持独立的人放弃仓促计划，
而支持与中国友好的力量则获得了额外权力。

0x00258CB4.text: is with us again and we managed to avoid any diplomatic problems, but only supporters of independent politics have not disappeared.
0x00258CB4.translated:
又回到我们这边了，我们也成功避免了任何外交问题；
只是支持独立路线的人并未消失。

0x00258DBF.text: It was decided not to resort to radical measures, but only to demand from the country's leadership guarantees of membership in our bloc, while maintaining the ability to pursue an independent foreign policy. After long negotiations and hesitations, they finally agreed.
0x00258DBF.translated:
决定不采取激烈措施，只是向该国领导层提出加入我们阵营的保证，
同时保留其推行独立外交政策的能力。
经过长期谈判与犹豫，他们终于同意了。

0x00258FDE.text: is still in our alliance, but is actively building up new contacts with other countries, and this might backfire in the future.
0x00258FDE.translated:
仍在我们的联盟之内，但正积极同其他国家建立新联系——这也许
会在未来反噬我们。

0x002590E1.text: As a result, not meeting any resistance from our side, the country decided to leave our bloc and is already establishing new contacts. Better then social imperialism!
0x002590E1.translated:
结果，由于我们这边没有遭遇任何阻力，
该国决定退出我们的阵营，并已经在建立新的联系。
比起社会帝国主义还要好！

0x00259254.text: Thanks to the coordinated work of our special services, rumors about upcoming job cuts and wages due to the growing financial crisis were spread at several of the largest factories in the capital of Bangladesh. The very next day, the whole city was paralyzed by strikes and clashes between workers and the armed police, shots were heard in some areas. However, due to public pressure and growing unrest, the president had to announce early parliamentary elections, which, not without our help, were won by the coalition of the left, and Sheikh Hasina Wazed became the new prime minister. The new government announced the start of socio-economic reforms and the expansion of trade between China and Bangladesh. The world community, in general, ignored the change of government, but the US suspects us of involvement in the incident.
0x00259254.translated:
多亏我方特工部门的协同工作，随着日益加剧的金融危机，
孟加拉国首都几家最大的工厂里散布了“将要裁员、
工资将被削减”的谣言。
就在第二天，整个城市便因罢工以及工人与武装警察之间的冲突而瘫
痪，部分地区还传出了枪声。
然而在舆论压力与动乱不断升级之下，总统不得不宣布提前举行议会
选举；而在我们不无帮助的情况下，左翼联盟赢得选举，
谢赫·哈西娜·瓦兹德成为新任总理。
新政府宣布启动社会经济改革，并扩大中国与孟加拉国之间的贸易。
国际社会总体上忽视了换届，但美国怀疑我们参与了这起事件。

0x002598D5.text: Bangladeshi government continues to control the situation, timely suppressing strikes.
0x002598D5.translated: 孟加拉国政府继续掌控局势，及时镇压罢工。

0x00259984.text: President Ershad thanked us for the help and suggested holding a summit between China and Bangladesh on «expanding trade and economic cooperation». At the negotiations, relations between our countries were restored, and China officially recognized Bangladesh’s independence from Pakistan, and new trade contracts were signed.
0x00259984.translated:
埃尔沙德总统感谢我们的帮助，并建议就“扩大贸易与经济合作”在
中国与孟加拉国之间举行峰会。
在谈判中，两国关系得以恢复；中国正式承认孟加拉国脱离巴基斯坦
的独立，并签署了新的贸易合同。

0x00259C11.translated: 阿尔巴尼亚斯大林的终结

0x00259C3F.text: Ramiz Alia, as expected, did not "break what works so well." Full and absolute supervision of the party over all areas of public life was maintained, and the orthodox Stalinist wing continued to dominate the PPSH. However, the regime nevertheless underwent some insignificant changes: mass repressions quickly curtailed, arrests of clergymen ceased, and the suppression of dissent became “more precise”. And, despite the fact that Alia has no plans to resume active relations with the Soviets, the roll of Albanian foreign policy in favor of greater openness is beginning to be felt.
0x00259C3F.translated:
如预料所示，拉米兹·阿利亚并没有“打破那些运转得如此良好的东
西”。党对公共生活各领域的全面、绝对监督仍被维持，
正统斯大林主义派继续主导阿尔巴尼亚劳动党（PPSH）。
然而政权毕竟还是经历了一些微不足道的变化：
大规模镇压很快被压缩，神职人员的逮捕停止了，
对异议的镇压也变得“更有分寸”。
而尽管阿利亚并无计划恢复与苏联的积极关系，
但阿尔巴尼亚外交政策向更开放方向转动的趋势，
已经开始显现。

0x0025A0D0.text: Absolutely unexpected news from Tirana! In the most seemingly unshakable ideological country, there was a terrorist attack, and what scale! Ramiz Alia, the current general secretary and successor of Hoxha, was completely assassinated during his planned visit to one of the capital's factories. Despite the vigilant guards surrounding the country's leader, the terrorist worker managed to fire several well-aimed shots, one of which hit straight into the lungs. Alia passed away on the way to the hospital. In order to suppress possible popular unrest, a triumvirate of the leaders of the Hoxhaists - Hoxha-Chuko-Chamkani was created. Through a terrorist worker, the special services managed to reach a whole group of Kosovo Albanians, who allegedly were plotting against other members of the Politburo. This incident led to a new round of party purges and repressions in the state. Hoxhaism triumphed again, Albania continues to be isolated.
0x0025A0D0.translated:
从地拉那传来绝对意想不到的消息！
在这看似最稳固的意识形态国家，竟发生了恐怖袭击——而且规模何
等惊人！现任总书记、霍查的继承人拉米兹·阿利亚，
在他原定访问首都一座工厂期间被彻底暗杀。
尽管围在国家领导人身边的警卫十分警惕，
恐怖袭击者仍设法连发数枪精准射击，其中一枪直接击中肺部。
阿利亚在前往医院的途中就已去世。
为压制可能出现的群众骚乱，成立了霍查派领导人的三人执政——霍
查—丘科—查姆卡尼。
通过这名恐怖袭击者，特工部门还设法接触到一整批科索沃阿尔巴尼
亚人，据称他们正密谋对付政治局其他成员。
此次事件引发了国家内党内清洗与镇压的新一轮。
霍查主义再次得胜，阿尔巴尼亚继续被孤立。

0x0025A82D.text: The Chinese leader sent a letter of condolences to the Albanian Foreign Ministry, suggesting that he "restart" relations between China and Albania. A week later, Ramiz Alia paid a diplomatic visit to the PRC, the “Sino-Albanian friendship treaty” was re-signed, and China extended a solid loan to Albania for a long-term period as a sign of reconciliation between our countries.
0x0025A82D.translated:
中国领导人向阿尔巴尼亚外交部发去唁电，
暗示要“重启”中阿关系。
一周后，拉米兹·阿利亚对中华人民共和国进行了外交访问；
“中阿友好条约”重新签署；作为两国和解的标志，
中国还向阿尔巴尼亚提供了长期、坚实的贷款。

0x0025AB50.text: Somalia's situation continues to deteriorate, and Mohamed Siad Barre is expanding military cooperation with the United States.
0x0025AB50.translated:
索马里局势继续恶化，穆罕默德·西亚德·巴雷正在扩大与美国的军
事合作。

0x0025AC4F.text: We sent humanitarian and military support to the regime of Mohamed Siad Barre, which allowed Somalia to recover from the devastating effects of the Ogaden War. As a result, the government launched a large-scale attack on the armed opposition, thereby strengthening the regime of the SRSP. The leader of the country, Barre, thanked China for the support provided and has already announced the expansion of cooperation between our countries.
0x0025AC4F.translated:
我们向穆罕默德·西亚德·巴雷政权提供了人道与军事援助，
使索马里得以从奥加登战争的毁灭性影响中恢复。
于是，政府对武装反对派发动了大规模攻势，
从而巩固了SRSP政权。
巴雷作为国家领导人，感谢中国所提供的支持，
并已宣布扩大两国间的合作。

0x0025AFC0.text: Thanks to the support of our special services, the influential military Mohammad Ali Samatar, having conspired with the generals, presented Mohamed Siad Barre with an ultimatum, according to which the president should immediately resign. As a result, the leader of Somalia, under pressure from the military, was forced to resign. The presidency was taken by the compromise foreign minister, Abdirahman Jama Barre, whose actions are de facto controlled by the top generals. Somalia made a ceasefire with Ethiopia, abandoning any territorial claims, and the country's government restored relations with the Soviet Union, broken during the Ogaden conflict. The new government declared military neutrality by joining the Non-Aligned Movement, but Somalia is becoming increasingly closer to other Arab countries. Having not forgotten about our support, the Somali government invited us to expand trade cooperation between our countries.
0x0025AFC0.translated:
多亏我方特工部门的支持，颇具影响力的军方人物穆罕默德·阿里·
萨马塔尔与将领们密谋后，向穆罕默德·西亚德·巴雷提出最后通牒，
要求总统立即辞职。
结果，在军方压力之下，索马里领导人被迫下台。
总统职位由“折中”的外交部长阿卜迪拉赫曼·贾马·巴雷接任，
而他的行动实际上受最高将领控制。
索马里与埃塞俄比亚达成停火，放弃任何领土主张；
同时该国政府恢复了与苏联的关系——这段关系在奥加登冲突期间被
打断。新政府加入不结盟运动，宣称实行军事中立，
但索马里正越来越靠近其他阿拉伯国家。
索马里政府没有忘记我们的支持，邀请我们扩大两国间的贸易合作。

0x0025B709.text: As a result, the current Secretary of the Central Committee, Yegor Ligachev, was elected General Secretary of the CPSU Central Committee. He managed to enlist the support of moderate party members, first of all, Andrei Gromyko, and put forward his candidacy, which, according to the old Bolshevik tradition, was approved unanimously.
0x0025B709.translated:
结果，中共中央现任书记叶戈尔·利加乔夫当选为苏共中央总书记。
他设法争取到了温和派党员的支持，首先是安德烈·葛罗米柯，
并提出自己的候选资格；按照老布尔什维克传统，
该提名获得一致通过。

0x0025B9A6.text: As a result, Mikhail Gorbachev was elected General Secretary of the CPSU Central Committee. He phenomenally quickly organized a congress and ensured the delivery of members of the Politburo by military aviation, without saying anything to his opponent Romanov. With the support of Gromyko and the moderate, he was able to lead the Communist Party with a minimal margin of vote. What awaits the Soviet Union?
0x0025B9A6.translated:
结果，米哈伊尔·戈尔巴乔夫当选为苏共中央委员会总书记。
他以惊人的速度组织了大会，并通过军用航空确保政治局成员到场，
却对对手罗曼诺夫只字未提。
在葛罗米柯与温和派的支持下，他以极小的票差带领共产党前进。
苏联接下来会怎样？

0x0025BCD7.text: As a result, Grigory Romanov was elected the General Secretary of the CPSU Central Committee, who, having learned of Chernenko’s death, immediately flew to Moscow, where he managed to rally conservative and moderate circles around him. Interesting times await the Soviet Union.
0x0025BCD7.translated:
结果，格里戈里·罗曼诺夫当选为苏共中央委员会总书记。
他在得知切尔年科去世后，立刻飞往莫斯科，
在那里成功集结了保守派与温和派的力量。
苏联将迎来有趣的时代。

0x0025BF04.text: As a result, Victor Grishin was elected General Secretary of the CPSU Central Committee. With the support of the conservative majority, which had long been secretly agreeing on the election of Grishin, and frustrating Gorbachev’s plans, he managed to head the CPSU without any problems. The Soviet Union expects several more years of Brezhnev stability.
0x0025BF04.translated:
结果，维克托·格里申当选为苏共中央委员会总书记。
在保守多数派的支持下——他们早已秘密商定格里申的当选，
并挫败戈尔巴乔夫的计划——他顺利接掌苏共中央。
苏联还将迎来数年“勃列日涅夫式稳定”。

0x0025C1C9.text: Despite numerous debates, in the end, Mikhail Gorbachev was elected General Secretary of the CPSU Central Committee. He phenomenally quickly organized a congress and ensured the delivery of members of the Politburo by military aviation, without saying anything to his opponent Romanov. With the support of Gromyko and the moderate, he was able to lead the Communist Party with a minimal margin of vote. What awaits the Soviet Union?
0x0025C1C9.translated:
尽管争论不断，最终米哈伊尔·戈尔巴乔夫当选为苏共中央委员会总
书记。他以惊人的速度组织了大会，并通过军用航空确保政治局成员
到场，却对对手罗曼诺夫只字未提。
在葛罗米柯与温和派的支持下，他以极小的票差带领共产党前进。
苏联接下来会怎样？

0x0025C52C.text: Despite numerous debates, in the end, Grigory Romanov was elected General Secretary of the CPSU Central Committee, who, having learned of Chernenko’s death, immediately flew to Moscow, where he managed to rally conservative and moderate circles around him. Interesting times await the Soviet Union.
0x0025C52C.translated:
尽管争论不断，最终格里戈里·罗曼诺夫当选为苏共中央委员会总书
记。他在得知切尔年科去世后，立刻飞往莫斯科，
在那里成功集结了保守派与温和派的力量。
苏联将迎来有趣的时代。

0x0025C783.text: Despite numerous debates, in the end, Victor Grishin was elected General Secretary of the CPSU Central Committee. With the support of the conservative majority, which had long been secretly agreeing on the election of Grishin, and frustrating Gorbachev’s plans, he managed to head the CPSU without any problems. The Soviet Union expects several more years of Brezhnev stability.
0x0025C783.translated:
尽管争论不断，最终维克托·格里申当选为苏共中央委员会总书记。
在保守多数派的支持下——他们早已秘密商定格里申的当选，
并挫败戈尔巴乔夫的计划——他顺利接掌苏共中央。
苏联还将迎来数年“勃列日涅夫式稳定”。

0x0025CA7A.translated: 自动化是一个自然的过程

0x0025CABA.text: The socialist economy continues to function stably, for the time being…
0x0025CABA.translated: 社会主义经济目前仍在稳定运转……

0x0025CB4B.text: Glory to the chairman! Glory to the CPС! This day will go down in the history of China, as the day of the «Great Breakthrough». Our Dear Leader announced the beginning of major changes in our country - the transition of the PRC to the rails of full-scale automation and computerization of all planning and production in the country, and also announced the creation of a «Center for Automated Economic Management», which is about to begin its work. The new project received the working name IECS - «Intersectoral Electronic Control System». Now in the country «heated» discussions about the haste of the introduction of these measures have flared up, and some party politicians declare the «anti-Marxist nature of reforms». However, the project was launched and nothing will stop the inevitable changes in the country, right?
0x0025CB4B.translated:
向主席致敬！向中共致敬！
这一天将载入中国史册，成为“伟大突破”的日子。
我们敬爱的领袖宣布，我国将开始重大变革——中华人民共和国将走
上全面自动化的轨道，并实现全国所有计划与生产的计算机化；
同时宣布成立“自动化经济管理中心”，
该中心即将开始工作。
新工程的代号为IECS——“跨部门电子控制系统”。
如今，全国范围内关于仓促推行这些措施的“热烈”讨论已经燃起，
部分党内政客还宣称改革具有“反马克思主义性质”。
然而工程已经启动，难道没有什么能阻止我国不可避免的变革，
对吧？

0x0025D1BE.text: Glory to the chairman! Glory to the CPС! This day will go down in the history of China, as the day of the «Great Breakthrough». Our Dear Leader announced the beginning of major changes in our country - the transition of the PRC to the rails of full-scale automation and computerization of all planning and production in the country, and also announced the creation of a «Center for Automated Economic Management», which is about to begin its work. The new project received the working name IECS - «Intersectoral Electronic Control System». Also, thanks to our close friendship with the Soviet people, we requested qualified assistance from the USSR, and now a delegation led by academician Anatoly Kitov has arrived in China. In China, meanwhile, «heated» discussions about the haste of the introduction of these measures have flared up, and some party politicians declare the «anti-Marxist nature of reforms». However, the project was launched and nothing will stop the inevitable changes in the country, right?
0x0025D1BE.translated:
向主席致敬！向中共致敬！
这一天将载入中国史册，作为“伟大突破”的日子。
我们敬爱的领袖宣布，我国将开始重大变革——中华人民共和国将走
上全面自动化、全国所有计划与生产的计算机化之路；
并宣布成立“自动化经济管理中心”，该中心即将开始工作。
新项目的代号为IECS——“跨部门电子控制系统”。
此外，得益于我们同苏联人民的密切友谊，
我们向苏联请求合格的援助，如今，由院士阿纳托利·基托夫率领的
代表团已抵达中国。与此同时，中国国内关于这些措施引入过于仓促
的“激烈”讨论也燃起了火花，部分党内政客宣称“改革具有反马克
思主义性质”。然而，项目已经启动，谁也阻止不了我国不可避免的
变革，对吧？

0x0025D9A9.text: Glory to the chairman! Glory to the CPС! This day will go down in the history of China, as the day of the «Great Breakthrough». Our Dear Leader announced the beginning of major changes in our country - the transition of the PRC to the rails of full-scale automation and computerization of all planning and production in the country, and also announced the creation of a «Center for Automated Economic Management», which is about to begin its work. The new project received the working name IECS - «Intersectoral Electronic Control System». In addition, thanks to our warm relations with Western countries, we were able to invite a delegation of European mathematics scientists led by Stafford Beer, who had previously become famous for the development of the Chilean «Cybersyn». Now in the country «heated» discussions about the haste of the introduction of these measures have flared up, and some party politicians declare the «anti-Marxist nature of reforms». However, the project was launched and nothing will stop the inevitable changes in the country, right?
0x0025D9A9.translated:
向主席致敬！向中共致敬！
这一天将载入中国史册，作为“伟大突破”的日子。
我们敬爱的领袖宣布，我国将开始重大变革——中华人民共和国将走
上全面自动化、全国所有计划与生产的计算机化之路；
并宣布成立“自动化经济管理中心”，该中心即将开始工作。
新项目的代号为IECS——“跨部门电子控制系统”。
另外，凭借我们同西方国家的友好关系，
我们得以邀请由斯塔福德·比尔率领的欧洲数学科学家代表团——他
此前因开发智利的“赛博辛”而声名鹊起。
如今，中国国内关于这些措施引入过于仓促的“激烈”讨论也燃起了
火花，部分党内政客宣称“改革具有反马克思主义性质”。
然而，项目已经启动，谁也阻止不了我国不可避免的变革，
对吧？

0x0025E24A.text: Today, in all the newspapers of the country, the article «Appeal to the People» was published, in which Comrade Chairman calls on every citizen who loves his homeland and party, to those who are not indifferent to the fate of China to resist the «bourgeoisie accomplices» and «partisan revisionists» who raised their heads again. Inspired masses gathered at rallies in Tiananmen Square in support of the actions of the government and comrade chairman. As a result, over 300 thousand people came to the main square of the country, chanting slogans about the continuation of the cultural revolution against the reactionary classes. Under pressure from public anger, the conspirators had to resign from their posts, and local partocrats pacified their ardor. This is a great victory for our people! Glory to the chairman! Glory to the CPС!
0x0025E24A.translated:
今天，全国各报刊登了《致人民的呼吁》一文。
文中，同志主席号召每一位热爱祖国与党、
对中国命运不漠不关的公民，去抵制那些再次抬头的“资产阶级帮凶
”和“党内派别的修正主义者”。
受鼓舞的群众在天安门广场集会，支持政府与同志主席的行动。
结果，超过30万人涌向全国的主广场，
高喊口号，要求继续向反动阶级进行文化大革命。
迫于群众愤怒的压力，阴谋者不得不辞去职务，
而地方党棍也被迫收敛了热情。
这是我们人民的伟大胜利！
向主席致敬！向中共致敬！

0x0025E8D5.text: Thanks to the coordinated work of our agents, opponents of our policy of automation in the highest echelons of power were removed from all posts and are about to be brought to a fair trial. On the ground, in turn, a campaign was launched to eradicate corruption, which shook the position of several tens of thousands of party workers who spoke out against the policies pursued by the Communist Party. The political repressions against the opponents of Our Dear Leader provoked the discontent of the rest of the party workers, who, for reasons of personal security, had to hide their resentment. Nevertheless, this is our grand victory! Glory to the chairman! Glory to the CPС!
0x0025E8D5.translated:
多亏我们特工的协同工作，反对我们自动化政策的权力高层人物已被
撤离一切岗位，即将接受公正审判。
与此同时，在基层又发动了肃贪运动，动摇了数以万计党务人员的地
位——他们曾公开反对中共所推行的路线。
对我们敬爱的领袖的对手所进行的政治打击，
引起了其余党务人员的不满；出于个人安全的考虑，
他们不得不把怨气藏起来。
尽管如此，这仍是我们的宏大胜利！
向主席致敬！向中共致敬！

0x0025EE20.text: The next day, loyal military divisions entered Beijing, the conspirators were arrested and put on trial. A curfew was established in the capital, the streets of the city are controlled by military units, and the situation seems to be gradually stabilizing. The most proactive partocrats were fired, and the rest had to pacify their flurry of criticism in the direction of the policy pursued by Comrade
0x0025EE20.translated:
第二天，忠诚的军队开进北京，阴谋者被逮捕并接受审判。
首都实行宵禁，城市街道由军队单位控制，
局势似乎正在逐步趋于稳定。
最积极的党棍被撤职，其余人则不得不把对同志所推行路线的激烈批
评按下去……

0x0025F147.text: . Nevertheless, the enemies of the working class are defeated, this is our grand victory! Glory to the chairman! Glory to the CPC!
0x0025F147.translated:
……尽管如此，工人阶级的敌人已经被打败——这就是我们的宏大胜
利！向主席致敬！向中共致敬！

0x0025F282.text: The government urgently allocated funds to develop a system to protect IECS from external attacks, which received the working title «The Great Wall of China». It is assumed that the protection will be ready and introduced in 8 months, but for now, our economy will not be easy.
0x0025F282.translated:
政府紧急拨款，用于开发一套保护IECS免受外部攻击的系统，
该系统的工作代号为“中华大防线”。
预计该防护将在8个月内完成并投入使用，
但就目前而言，我们的经济日子不会好过。

0x0025F4AF.text: The government urgently allocated funds to develop a system to protect IECS from external attacks, which received the working title «The Great Wall of China». In addition, we requested the help of specialists and engineers from the USSR who will help us to quickly eliminate vulnerabilities in our system and return it to operation. It is assumed that the protection will be ready and introduced in 6 months, but for now, our economy will not be easy.
0x0025F4AF.translated:
政府紧急拨款，用于开发一套保护IECS免受外部攻击的系统，
该系统的工作代号为“中华大防线”。
此外，我们还请求苏联派遣专家与工程师，
帮助我们迅速消除系统中的漏洞并恢复运行。
预计该防护将在6个月内完成并投入使用，
但就目前而言，我们的经济日子不会好过。

0x0025F838.text: The Chinese government issued a decree on the «Problems of Automation and Their Solutions», which refers to the excessive haste in computerization and automation of planning and the unpreparedness of the Chinese economy for too rapid and radical changes, especially in such a technocratic bias. The IECS project was reorganized into the «Division for the Control of Production Automation», the main task of which is no longer the creation of a unified computerized system. What will come of it, time will tell.
0x0025F838.translated:
中国政府发布了关于《自动化问题及其解决办法》的法令，
指出在计划的计算机化与自动化方面过于仓促，
以及中国经济对过快、过于激进的变革缺乏准备——尤其是在这种偏
向技术官僚路线的情况下。
IECS项目被改组为“生产自动化控制司”，
其主要任务不再是建立一套统一的计算机化系统。
至于结果如何，时间自会说明。

0x0025FC37.translated: 南斯拉夫社会主义自治的煎熬

0x0025FC8F.text: Neither Petar Stamboliс (Serb), nor Mika Spiljak (Croat), who replaced him as Chairman of the Presidium of the SFRY, did not dare to carry out the reforms proposed by the commission. SFRY took additional loans from the IMF and the USSR, which would only prolong the agony of the Yugoslav economy for a while...
0x0025FC8F.translated:
无论是塞尔维亚人彼得尔·斯坦博利奇，
还是在SFRY主席团主席一职上接替他的克罗地亚人米卡·斯皮利
亚克，都不敢执行委员会提出的改革。
SFRY又向IMF和苏联追加借款，这只会暂时延长南斯拉夫经济
的痛苦……

0x0025FEFE.text: Our Chairman personally called Petar Stambolic (Serb), Milka Planinc (Croatian) and Mitja Ribicic (Slovene), passing them our proposal for the restructuring of the public debt of Yugoslavia in exchange for refusing to reform. Suddenly it became clear that the Yugoslavs themselves do not know exactly who and how much they owe - so many debts Yugoslavia has accumulated. We had to intercede for the SFRY at the UN and use the capabilities of the MSS to at least put some pressure on the IMF and the IBER on determining the amount of debt. Finally, lenders issued a final bill - $ 53 billion at 8% per annum, agreeing to write off the rest. We will pay part of these funds as a guarantor of the agreement; Yugoslavia will pay the rest on our own. The Yugoslav leadership thanks us for saving us from the economic collapse, the SFRY has already entered into new profitable trade contracts with us and is establishing cultural ties between its republics and our autonomous regions. True, the salvation of Yugoslavia from financial collapse clearly did not benefit our economy...
0x0025FEFE.translated:
我们主席亲自致电塞尔维亚的彼得尔·斯坦博利奇、
克罗地亚的米尔卡·普拉宁茨以及斯洛文尼亚的米特亚·里比契奇，
把我们的提案转交给他们：以拒绝改革为交换，
重组南斯拉夫的公共债务。
突然间才明白，南斯拉夫人自己都不清楚到底欠了谁、
欠了多少——债务积累得太多了。
我们不得不在联合国为SFRY斡旋，并动用MSS的能力，
至少对IMF和IBER施加压力，促使其确定债务数额。
最终，放贷方开出“最终账单”——年息8%，
总计530亿美元，并同意注销其余部分。
我们将以协议担保方身份支付其中一部分资金；
其余部分由南斯拉夫自行承担。
南斯拉夫领导层感谢我们拯救他们免于经济崩溃；
SFRY已经与我们签订了新的、颇有利润的贸易合同，
并在其各共和国与我们自治地区之间建立文化联系。
只是，南斯拉夫免于金融崩溃的“救命恩情”，
显然并未给我们的经济带来好处……

0x00260767.text: The leadership of the Warsaw bloc member countries was very alarmed by the work of the "Kraigher Commission" and offered Yugoslavia major financial assistance in exchange for refusing to implement the reforms it proposed. We also supported this proposal. Fearing that they would become completely economically dependent on the USSR and China, the Yugoslav leadership politely refused to help - however, the "Kraigher Commission" was disbanded, some of its members were expelled from the Communist Union of Yugoslavia, and Sergei Kraigher was retired. However, after this, Yugoslavia expanded its participation in the CMEA activities and applied for membership in the Council as a full member. Cooperation with the CMEA member countries allowed revitalizing the economy of Yugoslavia, but sooner or later debts still have to be paid...
0x00260767.translated:
华沙条约组织成员国的领导层对“克拉伊赫尔委员会”的工作极为警
惕，并提出：只要南斯拉夫拒绝执行其提出的改革，
就给予其巨额财政援助。
我们也支持了这一提议。
南斯拉夫领导层担心自己会在经济上彻底依赖苏联与中国，
于是礼貌地拒绝了援助——但“克拉伊赫尔委员会”还是被解散，
部分成员被开除出南斯拉夫共产党联盟，
谢尔盖·克拉伊赫尔也被退职。
然而在此之后，南斯拉夫扩大了其参与经互会活动的程度，
并申请以正式成员身份加入该委员会。
与经互会成员国的合作确实使南斯拉夫经济得以焕发生机，
但债务迟早还是得偿还……

0x00260DEE.text: The work the "Kraigher commission" and the news that military spending will be the first to be cut, caused strong discontent among the officers of the YPA. We decided to take advantage of this and support the dissatisfied, pushing them to an open speech. On March 1, the 252nd Armored Brigade, the 1st Proletarian Mechanized Division and the 453rd Mechanized Brigade of the YPA rebelled and quickly occupied Belgrade. The military counterintelligence forces arrested the entire leadership of the country and the Union of Communists of Yugoslavia. The power passed to the Military Council for the Defense of the People of Yugoslavia, headed by General Veljko Kadijevic (Yugoslav) and Admiral Branko Mamula (Slovenian supporter of unified Yugoslavia), who declared "allegiance to the case of Marx-Engels-Lenin and Comrade Tito" and "uncompromising the fight against enemies and traitors, the protection of the brotherhood and unity of the peoples and nationalities of Yugoslavia". Instead of the disbanded UKY, the League of Communists – Movement for Yugoslavia was created, in which the entire leadership also passed into the hands of the military. Yugoslavia announced the cessation of the policy of "non-alignment", withdrawal from the Non-Aligned Movement and the orientation towards the socialist camp, "equally headed by the USSR and China", as well as the refusal to pay all debts. The US has already stated that it will not leave this unanswered, and in Slovenia there is a significant increase in separatist sentiments...
0x00260DEE.translated:
“克拉伊赫尔委员会”的工作以及“军费将首先削减”的消息，
引发了YPA军官们的强烈不满。
我们决定借此机会支持那些不满者，推动他们公开发声。
3月1日，YPA的第252装甲旅、第1无产阶级机械化师以及第
453机械化旅叛乱，并迅速占领贝尔格莱德。
军事反情报力量逮捕了国家全部领导层以及南斯拉夫共产党联盟。
政权转交给“南斯拉夫人民国防军事委员会”，
由将军维尔科·卡迪耶维奇（南斯拉夫人）
和海军上将布兰科·马穆拉（斯洛文尼亚人，
统一南斯拉夫的支持者）领导。
他们宣称“忠于马克思-恩格斯-列宁事业与同志铁托”，
并“毫不妥协地打击敌人和叛徒，保卫南斯拉夫各民族与各族人民的
兄弟情谊与团结”。在取代已解散的UKY之后，
成立了“共产主义者联盟——南斯拉夫运动”，
其中全部领导层也同样落入军方手中。
南斯拉夫宣布停止“非结盟”政策，退出不结盟运动，
并转向社会主义阵营，“由苏联与中国共同领导”，
同时拒绝偿还全部债务。
美国已经表态不会对此置之不理，而在斯洛文尼亚，
分离主义情绪也显著上升……

0x002619E1.text: As soon as the US became aware of the work of the commission, Yugoslavia received an offer to obtain new loans on terms favorable to it - but only with the approval of a package of market reforms. After we supported him and advised the leadership of the SFRY on informal channels to agree - Petar Stambolic (Serb) resigned early from the post of Chairman of the Presidium of the SFRY, and Milka Planinc (Croatian) - resigned as prime minister of the SFRY. They were replaced by supporters of reforms Mika Spiljak and Ante Markovic (both Croats), who began the implementation of the project developed by the commission. Privatization of state property began, zadrugas were finally eliminated and farming was allowed, and free economic zones were opened in Dubrovnik and Split. True, the liquidation of the Federation Fund caused sharp discontent among the underdeveloped republics and autonomous regions, the YNA command was outraged by the sharp reduction in military spending, and the transfer of Slovenia and Croatia to full cost accounting led to a sharp surge in nationalism and separatism...
0x002619E1.translated:
美国一旦得知委员会的工作，南斯拉夫就收到一份提议：
在对其有利的条件下获得新贷款——但前提是必须批准一揽子市场化
改革。我们支持了这一点，并通过非正式渠道向SFRY领导层建议
同意：彼得尔·斯坦博利奇（塞尔维亚人）
提前辞去SFRY主席团主席职务，米尔卡·普拉宁茨（克罗地亚人）
也辞去SFRY总理职务。
改革支持者米卡·斯皮利亚克和安特·马尔科维奇（两人均为克罗地
亚人）接替了他们，开始执行委员会制定的方案。
国有资产私有化启动，zadrugas（集体农业合作组织）
终于被取消，允许农耕；并在杜布罗夫尼克与斯普利特开设自由经济
区。只是，联邦基金的清算引发了欠发达共和国与自治地区的强烈不
满；YNA司令部对军费大幅削减感到愤怒；
而斯洛文尼亚与克罗地亚转向完全成本核算，
则导致民族主义与分离主义急剧升温……

0x00262274.text: Yugoslavia was in a very difficult situation and was forced to introduce severe austerity, which led to impoverishment and shortages of even essential foodstuffs and fuel. And that's where we came in. Through urgent negotiations with Prime Minister Milka Planinc, we were able to agree on the purchase of Yugoslav debt bonds and their partial restructuring in exchange for the access of our enterprises on favourable terms to the Yugoslav market. Such penetration into the Yugoslav market will, in the long term, enable us to intervene cautiously in the country's domestic politics.
0x00262274.translated:
南斯拉夫处境极其艰难，被迫推行严厉的紧缩政策，
导致贫困化，甚至连必需的食品与燃料都出现短缺。
于是我们出手了。通过与总理米尔卡·普拉宁茨的紧急谈判，
我们达成协议：以购买南斯拉夫债券并对其进行部分重组为交换条件，
让我们的企业以优惠条件进入南斯拉夫市场。
长期来看，这种渗透将使我们得以谨慎介入该国的国内政治。

0x0026275B.text: Despite the protests of principled party members who learned about the agreement, we were still able to achieve cooperation with Khun Sa, who decided that it was better not to refuse such help. Now, MSS agents and PLA employees are involved in the protection of the opium industry and are helping to smuggle drugs to the west, where, at our insistence, the vast majority of "goods" now go. The surge in heroin sales in the West does not affect its economy and the health of the population in the best way and requires more effort from the police in these countries, which requires more budget money. The Shang separatists launched new actions against the government forces of Burma, although they did not achieve much success. Since we took care of secrecy, we have nothing to officially present to us, but the authorities of Burma still guess and reduce turnover with us, and some of our local officials and involved officers also decided to join a profitable business. Let's hope our profit makes up for it.
0x0026275B.translated:
尽管有些坚持原则的党内成员在得知协议后提出抗议，
我们仍然成功与坤沙达成合作——他认为，
拒绝这种帮助不如不拒绝。
如今，MSS特工与解放军人员参与鸦片产业的安保，
并协助将毒品走私到西方；而在我们的坚持下，
绝大多数“货物”如今都流向那里。
西方海洛因销量的暴涨，并没有以最好的方式影响其经济与民众健康，
反而要求这些国家的警方投入更多精力——这又需要更多预算资金。
掸邦分裂势力对缅甸政府军又发动了新行动，
虽然并未取得太多成效。
由于我们把保密工作做得周全，我们也没有什么可供官方拿出来的“
证据”，但缅甸当局仍然心里有数，减少与我们的周转；
而我们一些地方官员与牵涉其中的军官也决定加入这门“赚钱的生意
”。但愿我们的利润能抵消这一切。

0x00262F40.text: At our meeting of representatives of the PRC, Laos, Burma and Thailand, a program was adopted to jointly combat organized crime in Southeast Asia. Employees of the Chinese MSS, together with the law enforcement agencies of these countries, conducted many investigations, revealing the numerous links of drug dealers with government officials and revealing some sales routes. It also made it possible to more accurately establish the location of the syndicate centers and conduct several successful raids with the help of the armies of the allied countries and the PLA. Of course, the Golden Triangle is still far from completely defeated, but these measures have seriously complicated the life of drug dealers and made it easier for our partners, for which they sincerely thanked us, and Burma, which was most relieved by the decline in Shan separatism, finally outlined the pro-Chinese vector of its foreign policy.
0x00262F40.translated:
在我们同中华人民共和国、老挝、缅甸与泰国代表的会晤中，
会议通过了一项联合打击东南亚有组织犯罪的方案。
中国MSS的工作人员与上述国家的执法机构共同开展了大量调查，
揭露了毒贩与政府官员之间错综复杂的关系，
也查明了一些贩运路线。
与此同时，这也使我们得以更准确地掌握犯罪集团的据点位置，
并在盟军与解放军的协助下成功实施了数次突袭。
当然，金三角仍远未被彻底击败，但这些措施已大大加难毒贩的日常
生计，也让我们的伙伴更轻松——他们为此真诚地向我们致谢；
而缅甸在掸邦分裂势力衰退后最为宽慰，
终于勾勒出其对外政策的亲华方向。

0x0026367F.text: Today, our Leader at the head of the Chinese delegation paid a historic visit to Taipei, during which, in closed negotiations, it was decided to form a commission to develop principles for the gradual reintegration of Taiwan and mainland China. Of course, foreign owners will retain all their rights, and the province of Taiwan will receive broad economic and political autonomy for the long term. Everything related to the US military will be determined by already concluded treaties, after which the question of their stay will be decided by the united government. And although all this is still on paper only and needs to be worked out extensively taking into account mutual interests, and the timing of Taiwan's return to the fold of China has not been determined, our population enthusiastically accepted this news, and border control was significantly weakened. As a result of all this, it has become much easier for liberal ideas to penetrate us from Taiwan, and the Americans fear for their influence on the island, but our people are very pleased.
0x0026367F.translated:
今天，由我方领袖率领的中国代表团对台北进行了具有历史意义的访
问。在闭门谈判中，双方决定成立一个委员会，
制定关于台湾与大陆逐步实现重新统一的原则。
当然，外资所有者将保留其全部权利；台湾省将获得长期的广泛经济
与政治自治。所有与美国军队相关的事项，
将由已签订的条约来确定，之后其驻留问题将由统一政府作出决定。
尽管这一切目前仍停留在纸面上，还需要在充分考虑双方利益的前提
下进行细化落实；而台湾回归中国大家庭的时间表尚未确定，
但我们的民众对这一消息热烈接受，边境管控也显著放松。
正因如此，来自台湾的自由化思潮更容易渗透进来；
美国人也担心其在岛上的影响力，但我们的人民却非常高兴。

0x00263EC2.text: Today, our Leader at the head of the Chinese delegation paid a historic visit to Taipei, during which the negotiating parties decided to mutually recognize each other. From now on, the PRC and the Republic of Taiwan (into which the Republic of China was renamed under the terms of the agreement) will exist as two independent states. It also put an end to many years of disputes over territories and a legitimate government, which brought our relations to a new level. The United States welcomed our move and provided us with significant financial assistance in support of our policies. However, many were unhappy that the two China remained divided, apparently, forever.
0x00263EC2.translated:
今天，由我方领袖率领的中国代表团对台北进行了具有历史意义的访
问。在谈判过程中，双方决定相互承认。
自此以后，中华人民共和国与“台湾共和国”（在协议条款下，
将中华民国更名为此）将作为两个独立国家并存。
这也结束了多年来关于领土与合法政府的争议，
使我们的关系提升到新的水平。
美国欢迎我们的举动，并为支持我们的政策提供了可观的财政援助。
然而，仍有不少人不满：两個中国似乎将永远分裂下去。

0x002D785C.text: there is no place to further democratization

0x002D78E6.text: Call a loyal part of the people in support

0x002D793C.text: Break up the protest from the inside by the secret services
0x002D793C.translated: 由情报部门从内部瓦解抗议。

0x002D79FA.text: Urgently allocate money for social programs
0x002D79FA.translated: 紧急拨款用于社会项目。

0x002D7A52.translated: 请求外国人道主义援助。

0x002D7ACE.text: Call on business by carrot and stick policy to solve social problems
0x002D7ACE.translated: 以恩威并施的手段动员工商界解决社会问题。

0x002D7B59.text: We can't call on business, we don't have it

0x002D7D49.text: Our influence is too weak, so we cannot limit it

0x002D7E45.text: Bribe U.S. senators to keep the issue quiet
0x002D7E45.translated: 贿赂美国参议员，让此事噤声。

0x002D7ED5.text: Need 5.0 money in the Swiss bank

0x002D8471.translated: 农业和工业方面的处境并不太好

0x002D8DE0.translated: 保持沉默，目标不明，别卷进交火

0x002DB068.text: Release and let go back to Lhasa, but under the supervision of the Ministry of State Security (4 agent networks).
0x002DB068.translated: 释放并让他回拉萨，但要在国家安全部的监督下（4个特工网络）。

0x002DB14D.text: Or let him be in prison, or let him be free.
0x002DB14D.translated: 要么继续关着，要么放他自由。

0x002DBB27.text: Sow chaos in the ranks of the MSZMP hoping to catch a fish in these muddy waters.

0x002DBBCC.translated: 让中共的MSS和人事官来处理这些问题。

0x002DBC65.translated: 加入与改革派的争论，并作出你自己的否认。

我们与米贾尔的波兰共产党、希瓦克的“混凝土”、

0x002DEC11.text: Moderates will not agree with us
0x002DEC11.translated: 中间派不会跟我们站在一起

0x002DEC53.text: Arrest the leaders of the reformers and start a campaign against their supporters. All by the covenants of Mao!
0x002DEC53.translated: 逮捕改革派头目，发动对其支持者的运动——一切照毛主席的指示！

0x002DED34.text: Let them continue to partisan, this is enough for us so far
0x002DED34.translated: 让他们继续党争就行，这对我们目前已足够

0x002DEDAC.text: Achieve the inclusion of Naxalites in local government in exchange for the cessation of hostilities
0x002DEDAC.translated: 以停火为代价，让纳萨尔派进入地方政府

0x002DEE75.text: Get ready for war. Send troops.

0x002DEEB5.text: We are not forging relationships to start a war now!
0x002DEEB5.translated: 我们现在不是为了拉关系就要开战！

0x002DEF4F.text: Support the left wing (-6 agents, -10 from the budget)

0x002DEFBD.text: Janata will not listen to us

0x002DEFF7.text: Support the right wing (-6 agents, -10 from the budget)

0x002DF0C7.text: If you want peace, prepare for war

0x002DF10D.translated: 全体会议批准了这一选项。

0x002DF17B.text: What did you write here?! Immediately send the text for revision!
0x002DF17B.translated: 你这写的是什么？！立刻把稿子送去修改！

0x002DF200.text: The question of "Decision" is removed from the agenda at the request of the Chairman.
0x002DF200.translated: 应主席要求，“决议”议题从议程中撤下。

0x002DF2AD.text: This issue is too important for the CCP to remove it from the agenda.
0x002DF2AD.translated: 这件事太重要了，中共不可能把它从议程上拿掉。

0x002DF33A.text: We will condemn the airstrike and offer Hussein to expand cooperation (-8 from the budget).
0x002DF33A.translated: 我们将谴责空袭，并向侯赛因提出扩大合作（-8预算）。

0x002DF3F3.text: Saddam Hussein - authoritarians, and a chauvinist. We don't need to support him!
0x002DF3F3.translated: 萨达姆·侯赛因——专制者、沙文主义者。我们不需要支持他！

0x002DF496.text: Who cares? Let Saddam deal with his own problems...
0x002DF496.translated: 谁管他？让萨达姆自己去处理他的问题……

0x002DF4FE.text: We will help Iraq to resume its nuclear program. Let imperialism tremble! (-15 from the budget, -10 agents).
0x002DF4FE.translated:
我们将帮助伊拉克恢复核计划。
让帝国主义发抖吧！（-15预算，-10名特工）

0x002DF5D9.text: Give Iraq an atomic bomb?! You want to start a Third world war?
0x002DF5D9.translated: 给伊拉克原子弹？！你们想发动第三次世界大战？

0x002DF659.text: We will approve the airstrike and condemn Hussein for militarism and chauvinism.
0x002DF659.translated: 我们将批准空袭，并谴责侯赛因的军国主义和沙文主义。

0x002DF6FC.text: We can't justify what the Zionists did!
0x002DF6FC.translated: 我们无法为犹太复国主义者所做的一切辩护！

0x002DF74C.text: We will diplomatically support the Kosovo separatists, but nothing more.
0x002DF74C.translated: 我们将以外交方式支持科索沃分离主义者，仅此而已。

0x002DF80F.text: Offer Albania its assistance in the separation of Kosovo from Yugoslavia (-5 agents -5 from the budget).
0x002DF80F.translated:
向阿尔巴尼亚提供援助，推动科索沃从南斯拉夫分离（-5名特工，
-5预算）。

0x002DF8E2.text: Why do we need to help Albania?
0x002DF8E2.translated: 我们为什么要帮助阿尔巴尼亚？

0x002DF946.text: We will assist the Kosovo separatists with special services and money (-10 agents -10 from the budget).
0x002DF946.translated:
我们将以特工与资金协助科索沃分离主义者（-10名特工，
-10预算）。

0x002DFA17.text: We are not interested in the Affairs of Yugoslavia.
0x002DFA17.translated: 我们对南斯拉夫的事务不感兴趣。

0x002DFA7F.text: Help Shehu to organize a coup (-8 agents).
0x002DFA7F.translated: 帮助谢胡组织政变（-8名特工）。

0x002DFB6F.text: Why would we support Hoxha after he turned his back on us?
0x002DFB6F.translated: 他背弃了我们，我们凭什么还支持霍查？

0x002DFBE5.text: Provoke unrest and to support the Maoists (-10 agents -8 the strength of the army).
0x002DFBE5.translated: 煽动骚乱，并支持毛主义者（-10名特工，-8军队实力）。

0x002DFCFA.text: Congratulate Marcos after his victory and try to establish cooperation.
0x002DFCFA.translated: 马科斯胜利后表示祝贺，并试图建立合作。

0x002DFD8B.text: We don't need cooperation with American puppets.
0x002DFD8B.translated: 我们不需要同美国傀儡合作。

0x002DFDED.text: We will call on the socialist camp to help Romania jointly (-10 from the budget).
0x002DFDED.translated: 我们将号召社会主义阵营共同援助罗马尼亚（-10预算）。

0x002DFE92.text: The socialist camp won't listen to us.
0x002DFE92.translated: 社会主义阵营不会听我们的。

0x002DFEE0.text: Let him pay his debts, that's not our problem.
0x002DFEE0.translated: 让他自己偿还债务，这不是我们的事。

0x002DFF3E.text: Provide material assistance to Romania (-30 from the budget).
0x002DFF3E.translated: 向罗马尼亚提供物资援助（-30预算）。

0x002DFFBA.text: Romania is not worth our efforts.
0x002DFFBA.translated: 罗马尼亚不值得我们投入。

0x002DFFFE.text: Not to bring up the subject of "cult of personality" and to hold the Congress in peace.
0x002DFFFE.translated: 不提“个人崇拜”这个话题，和平召开大会。

0x002E00AF.text: It's time to tell the party the truth!

0x002E00FD.text: Mention of "individual errors" Mao, under the pretext of combating which we begin a cautious departure from him.
0x002E00FD.translated: 提及“毛的个人错误”，以打击之名，开始谨慎地与他渐行渐远。

0x002E0210.text: We will use the experience of Khrushchev - he did it, and we will!
0x002E0210.translated: 我们要借鉴赫鲁晓夫的经验——他做了，我们也要做！

0x002E0297.text: Are you crazy to act like Khrushchev?!!
0x002E0297.translated: 你疯了吗，竟敢学赫鲁晓夫？！！
