0x002E02E7.text: We will provide Hungary with economic assistance without preconditions (-35 from the budget).
0x002E02E7.translated: 我们将对匈牙利提供无条件的经济援助（-35预算）。

0x002E03A4.text: We are not rich enough to sponsor kadarists.
0x002E03A4.translated: 我们不富到能资助卡达尔派。

0x002E03FE.text: We use the problems of the HPR to discredit market reforms.
0x002E03FE.translated: 利用匈牙利人民共和国的种种问题，抹黑市场改革。

0x002E0476.text: The example of Hungary is not proof of the failure of reforms.
0x002E0476.translated: 匈牙利的例子并不能证明改革失败。

0x002E04F4.text: We will offer Hungary economic aid, but in exchange for the rehabilitation of the Bisku Group (-15 from the budget, -8 Agents).
0x002E04F4.translated:
我们将向匈牙利提供经济援助，但作为交换条件，
恢复“比斯库集团”的名誉（-15预算，
-8名特工）。

0x002E0627.text: We will fully support the rehabilitation of the Bisku Group in exchange for taking over the Hungarian national debt (-45 Money, -10 Agents).
0x002E0627.translated:
我们将全力支持恢复“比斯库集团”的名誉，
以换取接管匈牙利国家债务（-45金钱，
-10名特工）。

0x002E0742.translated: 这对我们来说太激进了！

0x002E078A.text: Through diplomatic offices, agree with part of the Politburo to repay the loan in exchange for the election of Pozhgay as the General Secretary (-45 Money)
0x002E078A.translated:
通过外交渠道，与部分政治局成员达成协议：
以偿还贷款为交换条件，换取选举波日盖为总书记（-45金钱）。

0x002E08F9.text: Who will win - the military regime of Argentina or the weakened and distant Britain?
0x002E08F9.translated: 究竟谁会赢——阿根廷的军事政权，还是衰弱而遥远的英国？

0x002E09A4.text: We organize a leak of information to the Central Committee of the CPSU and discredit Kulakov (-5 Agents).
0x002E09A4.translated: 我们向苏共中央委员会泄露信息，并抹黑库拉科夫（-5名特工）。

0x002E0AA1.text: We will publish revelatory materials about Kulakov in our media (-2 Money).
0x002E0AA1.translated: 我们将在媒体上刊发关于库拉科夫的揭露材料（-2金钱）。

0x002E0B62.text: We'll save that for the future...

0x002E0BA6.text: Car accident - the choice of professionals! (-8 Agents).
0x002E0BA6.translated: 车祸——专业人士的选择！（-8名特工）。

0x002E0C18.text: We get in touch with the Belarusian party members and through them pass to Suslov dirt on Masherov (-5 Money).
0x002E0C18.translated:
我们与白俄罗斯党内成员取得联系，并通过他们向苏斯洛夫递送关于
马舍罗夫的污点材料（-5金钱）。

0x002E0D19.text: We use every effort to discredit Kunaev, once in the Republic will start riots (-10 Agents).
0x002E0D19.translated: 我们不遗余力地抹黑库纳耶夫，一旦他进入共和国就会引发骚乱（-10名特工）。

0x002E0DD4.text: We will pre-empt him and warn him about the impending provocations of the CPSU Central Committee (-3 Agent).
0x002E0DD4.translated: 我们将先发制人，警告他苏共中央即将发动的挑衅（-3名特工）。

0x002E0EAF.text: We don't have a good enough relationship with Brezhnev to let him know.
0x002E0EAF.translated: 我们和勃列日涅夫关系不够好，没法让他知道。

0x002E0F40.text: We do not care about the Affairs of the Soviets.
0x002E0F40.translated: 我们不关心苏联的事务。

0x002E0FA2.text: Our journalists, on behalf of our embassy, will investigate Rashidov's activities under the guise of reporting on the arts of Uzbekistan. (-3 agents, -3 money)
0x002E0FA2.translated:
我们的记者将以报道乌兹别克斯坦文艺为名，
代表使馆调查拉希多夫的活动（-3名特工，
-3资金）。

0x002E1129.text: We will help the head of the KGB to go to the other world, writing off this kidney failure. Ukrainian KGB will cope with this task (-10 Agents, -5 Money).
0x002E1129.translated:
我们将帮助克格勃头子“去往另一个世界”，
把这次肾衰当作既成事实。
乌克兰克格勃会处理这项任务（-10名特工，
-5资金）。

0x002E1260.text: Suslov and Shcherbitsky convene the Plenum of the Central Committee, and attack Andropov with our information support (-7 Money).
0x002E1260.translated:
苏斯洛夫和谢尔比茨基召集中央委员会全会，
并在我们的情报支持下打击安德罗波夫（-7资金）。

0x002E1365.text: We don't have enough influence on the CPSU.
0x002E1365.translated: 我们对苏共的影响力不够。

0x002E13BD.text: Another war in the middle East...

0x002E1401.text: We congratulate Mugabe on his victory and send him financial aid (-5 from the budget).
0x002E1401.translated: 我们祝贺穆加贝的胜利，并向他提供财政援助（-5预算）。

0x002E14B0.text: We can be friends with him later.
0x002E14B0.translated: 以后我们可以和他做朋友。

0x002E1518.text: We do not have enough influence on the CPSU.
0x002E1518.translated: 我们对苏共的影响力不够。

0x002E15F8.text: We will negotiate with the Triads on favorable for them terms. (-4 agents)
0x002E15F8.translated: 我们将与三合会谈判，争取对他们有利的条件（-4名特工）。

0x002E168F.text: We can not negotiate with Organized crime!
0x002E168F.translated: 我们不能与有组织犯罪谈判！

0x002E16E5.text: We could use a tactical alliance with syndicates. But it will not save them from purge. (-2 Agents)
0x002E16E5.translated: 我们可以与黑帮集团进行战术性结盟。但这救不了他们免于清洗（-2名特工）。

0x002E17F4.text: What do we care about these bandits?
0x002E17F4.translated: 我们管这些土匪干什么？

0x002E183E.text: It is time to strike a powerful blow against organized crime in the southern provinces of the country! (-8 agents)
0x002E183E.translated:
是时候对全国南方各省的有组织犯罪发动强有力的打击了！
（-8名特工）

0x002E1925.text: These are quite honest businessmen supporting reforms and openness. We have no right to suspect them.
0x002E1925.translated:
这些人是相当正派的商人，支持改革开放。
我们没有权利怀疑他们。

0x002E1A8A.text: Invest in industrial upgrading (-1 from budget)

0x002E1AEA.text: Continue enhanced mechanization of agriculture (-1 from budget)
0x002E1AEA.translated: 继续加强农业机械化（-1预算）

0x002E1B6A.text: Invest in improving the quality of services (-1 from the budget)
0x002E1B6A.translated: 投资提升服务质量（-1预算）

0x002E1BED.text: Focus the five-year plan on the development of scientific research (-1 from the budget)
0x002E1BED.translated: 把五年计划重点放在发展科研上（-1预算）

0x002E1C9E.text: Direct forces on the uniform development of the economy (-1 from the budget)
0x002E1C9E.translated: 把力量投向经济的均衡发展（-1预算）

0x002E1D39.translated: 支持泛希腊社会主义运动（P

0x002E1D81.text: This is a counter-revolutionary rebellion, and the traitors will answer for it! Connect me with the General Staff...
0x002E1D81.translated:
这是反革命叛乱，叛徒们要为此付出代价！
把我接到总参谋部……

0x002E1E6C.text: Block the square by the People's Armed Police and try to persuade the protesters to disperse.
0x002E1E6C.translated: 由人民武装警察封锁广场，并设法劝说抗议者散去。

0x002E1F29.text: Retire. Let the Party decide who deserves to lead the country at this difficult time.
0x002E1F29.translated: 退下。让党来决定在这个困难时刻谁配领导国家。

0x002E1FD6.text: Fulfill the demands of the protesters.

0x002E2024.text: We reject Marxism-Maoism-Xiaopism in favor of European communism, modeled on the CPJ.
0x002E2024.translated: 我们摒弃马克思主义—毛泽东主义—邓小平主义，转而支持以中共为样板的欧洲共产主义。

0x002E20D1.text: Returning to the social democracy with Chinese characteristics according to the precepts of Chen Duxiu.
0x002E20D1.translated: 依照陈独秀的教诲，回到具有中国特色的社会民主。

0x002E21A2.text: Accept left Chinese nationalism, as bequeathed by the great Sun Yat-sen.
0x002E21A2.translated: 接受孙中山遗泽的左翼中国民族主义。

0x002E2235.text: Why do we have to comply with the requirements of some street bullies?
0x002E2235.translated: 我们为什么非得服从一些街头恶棍的要求？

0x002E22C4.text: We are preparing free elections in the NPC, as much as possible limiting other parties, but other requirements will have to be met
0x002E22C4.translated:
我们正在为全国人大筹备尽可能限制其他党派的自由选举，
但其他要求也必须满足。

0x002E23CB.text: The elections are not so terrible as the bourgeois "freedoms". Do without it.
0x002E23CB.translated: 选举并没有那么可怕，倒是资产阶级的“自由”才可怕。不要它。

0x002E2468.text: Elections are not so terrible as leaving religion unattended. Do without it.
0x002E2468.translated: 选举并没有那么可怕，放任宗教不管才可怕。不要它。

0x002E2503.text: If we want the people to love us, we must fulfill all of its requirements!
0x002E2503.translated: 如果我们想让人民爱戴我们，就必须满足它的全部要求！

0x002E259A.text: We are starting a large-scale implementation of automated systems
0x002E259A.translated: 我们正在启动大规模推行自动化系统。

0x002E261F.text: Haste never ended well, let it be introduced gradually and not all at once
0x002E261F.translated: 欲速则不达，让它循序渐进，而不是一口气全上。

0x002E26B6.text: Recognize the current government and send ambassadors.
0x002E26B6.translated: 承认现政府，并派遣大使。

0x002E27BA.text: We do not have enough resources and influence
0x002E27BA.translated: 我们资源和影响力不够。

0x002E2816.text: Do nothing. We were not invited
0x002E2816.translated: 什么也不做。我们又没被邀请。

0x002E286C.text: Send Chinese delegation to the funeral
0x002E286C.translated: 派遣中国代表团出席葬礼。

0x002E28E6.text: Our leader will personally go to say goodbye to Yuri Vladimirovich
0x002E28E6.translated: 我们的领袖将亲自前往向尤里·弗拉基米罗维奇告别。

0x002E2A03.text: We will help the orthodox in the fight against revisionism
0x002E2A03.translated: 我们将帮助正统派同修正主义作斗争。

0x002E2A79.text: We do not have enough power

0x002E2AB1.text: Support moderate reformers in the modernization of socialism
0x002E2AB1.translated: 在社会主义现代化中支持温和改革派。

0x002E2B2B.text: Facilitate the rise to power of pro-Western liberals
0x002E2B2B.translated: 促成亲西方自由派上台。

0x002E2BD7.text: Provoke anti-government rallies by supporting the opposition
0x002E2BD7.translated: 通过支持反对派来煽动反政府集会。

0x002E2C51.text: We have our own problems at home.
0x002E2C51.translated: 我们国内也有自己的问题。

0x002E2CFD.text: We do not have enough influence on the CPSU
0x002E2CFD.translated: 我们对苏共的影响力不够。

0x002E2DC9.text: Send a delegation to the festival

0x002E2E25.text: Conduct your own festival for the allied countries (-2 from the budget)
0x002E2E25.translated: 为盟国举办你们自己的庆典（预算-2）。

0x002E2EB6.text: Recruit a group of Kosovo Albanians and launch a terrorist attack (-6 agent networks)
0x002E2EB6.translated: 招募一批科索沃阿尔巴尼亚人并发动恐怖袭击（特工网络-6）。

0x002E2F63.text: Our intelligence will not cope with this
0x002E2F63.translated: 我们的情报系统应付不了这件事。

0x002E2FB5.text: Try to build relationships with the new management (-3 from the budget)
0x002E2FB5.translated: 试图同新管理层建立关系（预算-3）。

0x002E30B8.text: Arrange a terrorist attack and disrupt the conference
0x002E30B8.translated: 策划恐怖袭击，打乱会议

0x002E3150.text: Send military and humanitarian assistance to Somalia (-8 from the budget, -5 agent networks, -5 army strength)
0x002E3150.translated:
向索马里派遣军事与人道援助（预算-8，
特工网络-5，军力-5）

0x002E325D.text: Organize a party coup against Barre (-8 agent networks)
0x002E325D.translated: 组织针对巴雷的党内政变（特工网络-8）

0x002E32CD.text: We have no strength to be distracted by this
0x002E32CD.translated: 我们没有精力被这件事牵扯

0x002E3327.text: Let's wait a couple more years... or more...

0x002E3381.text: Announce a course on automation of production and create a commission for its implementation (-10 from the budget)
0x002E3381.translated: 宣布生产自动化方针，并成立实施委员会（预算-10）

0x002E3468.text: Start automation and invite Soviet scientists
0x002E3468.translated: 启动自动化，邀请苏联科学家

0x002E34F6.text: We are set to work, Western experts will help us!
0x002E34F6.translated: 我们准备开工，西方专家会来帮我们！

0x002E355A.text: Ask for help from the West? Are you seriously?
0x002E355A.translated: 向西方求助？你们是认真的吗？

0x002E35B8.text: Give up the fight and resign

0x002E35F2.text: Call on the masses to fight against partyocracy
0x002E35F2.translated: 号召群众反对党霸统治

0x002E3652.text: People do not need a new cultural revolution!
0x002E3652.translated: 人民不需要再来一场新的文化大革命！

0x002E36AE.text: Arrest conspirators and start persecution against the most proactive partocrats (-40 agent networks)
0x002E36AE.translated: 逮捕阴谋分子，并对最积极的党派头子展开迫害（特工网络-40）

0x002E3779.translated: 国家安全部不会支持我们！

0x002E37AB.translated: 动员忠诚军官对付阴谋分子

0x002E3839.text: Allocate funds to develop a protection system (-25 from the budget)
0x002E3839.translated: 拨款研发防护系统（预算-25）

0x002E38C2.text: Fund development and request assistance from specialists from the USSR (-25 from the budget)
0x002E38C2.translated: 资助研发，并请求苏联专家支援（预算-25）

0x002E397D.text: It seems that China is not ready for such changes, it is necessary to slow down automation
0x002E397D.translated: 看来中国还不准备好迎接这种变化，有必要放慢自动化步伐

0x002E3A34.text: We cannot give up our achievements!
0x002E3A34.translated: 我们不能放弃我们的成果！

0x002E3A7C.text: What do we care about Yugoslavia? Let the titoists themselves deal with their problems!
0x002E3A7C.translated: 我们管南斯拉夫干什么？让铁托派自己去处理他们的问题！

0x002E3B2D.text: We will offer Yugoslavia a restructuring of its debts subject to a rejection of the reform plan (-5 agents, -20 from the budget).
0x002E3B2D.translated:
我们将向南斯拉夫提出债务重组条件：拒绝改革计划（特工-5，
预算-20）。

0x002E3C32.text: Why do we need to restructure their debts?
0x002E3C32.translated: 我们为什么要重组他们的债务？

0x002E3C88.text: We join the proposal of the USSR.

0x002E3CCC.text: We don’t have enough influence for the Soviet Union and Yugoslavia to listen us
0x002E3CCC.translated: 我们影响力不够，苏联和南斯拉夫不会听我们的

0x002E3D6D.text: We will support a group of military men led by Veljko Kadijeviс and Branko Mamula
0x002E3D6D.translated: 我们将支持由维尔科·卡迪耶维奇和布兰科·马穆拉领导的一伙军人

0x002E3E12.text: Support the military junta? In Yugoslavia? Nonsense!
0x002E3E12.translated: 支持军事集团？在南斯拉夫？荒唐！

0x002E3EBA.text: We don’t have enough influence for the USA and Yugoslavia to listen us
0x002E3EBA.translated: 我们影响力不够，美国和南斯拉夫不会听我们的

0x002E3F49.text: Offer to repurchase debt obligations with partial repayment in exchange for the admission of Chinese investments on favourable terms in the economy
0x002E3F49.translated:
提出以部分偿还为条件回购债务义务，以换取在经济领域以优惠条件
引进中国投资

0x002E40E0.text: Go to an agreement with drug dealers (-1 intelligence network)
0x002E40E0.translated: 与毒贩达成协议（情报网络-1）

0x002E415E.text: The Chinese people did not fight opium magnates so that we would hobnob with them
0x002E415E.translated: 中国人民并不是为了跟鸦片大亨们称兄道弟才去斗争的

0x002E4203.text: Help allied countries in the fight against drug dealers (-2 intelligence networks, -2 army strength)
0x002E4203.translated: 协助盟国打击毒贩（情报网络-2，军力-2）

0x002E4340.text: They are not ready to agree to such an agreement
0x002E4340.translated: 他们还不准备同意这样的协议

0x002E43A2.text: Recognize each other and end hostility!

0x002E43F2.text: Establish an analogue of the Schengen agreement only for members of our military alliance
0x002E43F2.translated: 仅对我们军事同盟成员建立类似申根协议的安排

0x002E44A7.text: Establish an analogue of the Madrid agreement only for members of our military alliance
0x002E44A7.translated: 仅对我们军事同盟成员建立类似马德里协议的安排

0x002E4558.text: We do not have a military alliance

0x002E459E.text: Establish an analogue of the Schengen agreement for members of all our alliances
0x002E459E.translated: 对我们所有同盟成员建立类似申根协议的安排

0x002E4641.text: Establish an analogue of the Madrid agreement for members of all our alliances
0x002E4641.translated: 对我们所有同盟成员建立类似马德里协议的安排

0x002E46E0.text: Send troops and return the country to our course ({0} army strength, -3 from the budget)
0x002E46E0.translated: 派兵出击，把国家拉回我们的轨道（{0}军力，预算-3）

0x002E4793.text: Our army does not have enough strength and authority
0x002E4793.translated: 我们的军队力量和威望不足

0x002E47FD.text: Organize a coup in favor of forces loyal to us (-10 agents, -3 from the budget)
0x002E47FD.translated: 组织政变，扶持忠于我们的势力（-10名特工，预算-3）

0x002E489E.text: Organize a coup in favor of forces loyal to us (-20 agents, -6 from the budget)
0x002E489E.translated: 组织政变，扶持忠于我们的势力（-20名特工，预算-6）

0x002E493F.text: Bind the country economically, allocating financial assistance and a favorable loan (-10 from the budget)
0x002E493F.translated: 在经济上把国家绑牢，提供财政援助并给出优惠贷款（预算-10）

0x002E4A14.text: Do not impede independent politics in exchange for maintaining membership in our bloc (-5 agents, -1 from the budget)
0x002E4A14.translated:
不阻碍其独立政治，以换取其继续留在我们的阵营（-5名特工，
预算-1）

0x002E4B01.translated: 我们必须尊重他们的选择

0x002F175C.text: A terrible thing happened. After 2 transferred heart attacks on September 9 at 0 h. 10 min. On the 83rd year of life, the great leader and teacher of the Chinese people, Chairman Mao Zedong, passed away. As long as all the people and the party are grieving, we need to convene the funeral commission and decide how we are conduct the chairman in his last journey.
0x002F175C.translated:
发生了极其悲惨的事情。
9月9日0时10分，经过两次转危为安的心脏病发作，
在他83岁高龄，中国人民伟大领袖和导师毛泽东主席逝世。
只要全国人民和全党都在悲痛，我们就需要召开治丧委员会，
决定如何护送主席走完他最后的旅程。

0x002F1A35.text: According to the recently received information, several senior party members who are dissatisfied with your rule have agreed to remove you at the next congress of the Central Committee. You need to urgently do something if you do not want to repeat the fate of the revisionist Khrushchev in 1964.
0x002F1A35.translated:
根据最近收到的情报，几位对你统治不满的高级党内人士已达成共识，
准备在下一次中央委员会会议上罢免你。
若不想重演1964年那位修正主义的赫鲁晓夫的下场，
你必须立刻采取行动。

0x002F1C88.text: Dissatisfied with your politics, people went to mass rallies throughout the country and began to build tent camps in squares, distribute leaflets and even storm local government agencies. Different groups of protesters are dissatisfied with different aspects of your government, but they all require the democratization of the system in order to be able to limit your influence on Chinese politics.
0x002F1C88.translated:
由于对你的政策不满，民众在全国范围内举行群众集会，
并开始在广场搭建帐篷营地、散发传单，
甚至冲击地方政府机关。
不同的抗议群体对你政府的不满点各不相同，
但他们都要求对制度进行民主化，以便能够限制你在中国政治中的影
响。

0x002F1FA7.text: Your policy has led to a catastrophic decline in the standard of living in the country, people live in abominable conditions and the vast majority lack the ability to purchase even basic necessities. Of course, this leads to numerous protestswhere people demand to deal with this situation. Given the fact that the soldiers are also unhappy with the terrible conditions of detention, we can not count on the army.
0x002F1FA7.translated:
你的政策导致全国生活水平急剧崩塌，人民生活在令人作呕的境况中，
绝大多数连最基本的生活必需品都买不起。
当然，这就引发了大量抗议，人们要求解决这一局面。
考虑到士兵们对这种极其恶劣的羁押条件同样不满，
我们不能指望军队。

0x002F22E4.text: Our relations with the USA have reached a critically low level. Their propaganda already accuses China of all possible and impossible crimes, and our intelligence reports on the turmoil in the Pentagon and activity at American bases in Southeast Asia. We urgently need to somehow correct the situation if we don’t want the Third World War.
0x002F22E4.translated:
我们同美国的关系已降到极其危险的低点。
他们的宣传已经把中国指控为一切可能与不可能的罪行，
而我们的情报也报告了五角大楼内部的动荡以及美国在东南亚基地的
活动。若不想爆发第三次世界大战，我们必须尽快设法扭转局势。

0x002F258D.text: Our relations with the USSR have reached a critically low level. Their propaganda already accuses China of all possible and impossible crimes, and our intelligence reports on the turmoil in the General Staff of the USSR and the movement of Soviet troops on the border. We urgently need to somehow correct the situation if we don’t want the Third World War.
0x002F258D.translated:
我们同苏联的关系已降到极其危险的低点。
他们的宣传已经把中国指控为一切可能与不可能的罪行，
而我们的情报也报告了苏联总参谋部的动荡以及边境苏军的调动。
若不想爆发第三次世界大战，我们必须尽快设法扭转局势。

0x002F2858.text: Encouraged by liberals and nationalists, residents of the Tibet Autonomous Region took to mass demonstrations for independence and secession from the PRC, which gradually develop into unrest. People demand "liberation" from "the occupation of 1950" and the majority of ethnic Tibetans support them. However, some are just satisfied with the requirements of greater autonomy than we can take advantage of.
0x002F2858.translated:
在自由派和民族主义者的鼓动下，西藏自治区的居民走上大规模示威，
要求独立并从中华人民共和国分离；这种行动逐渐演变为动乱。
人们高喊要“解放”，以“摆脱1950年的占领”，
而多数藏族同胞支持他们。
然而，也有人只是满足于争取比我们所能接受的更大自治要求。

0x002F2B83.text: Encouraged by liberals and nationalists, residents of the Xinjiang Uygur Autonomous Region took to mass demonstrations for independence and secession from the PRC, which gradually develop into unrest. People demand "liberation" from "the occupation of 1949" and the majority of ethnic Uighurs support them. However, there is a counterweight to them from the Hanzu, and some of the Uighurs are just satisfied with the requirements of greater autonomy than we can take advantage of.
0x002F2B83.translated:
在自由派和民族主义者的鼓动下，新疆维吾尔自治区居民举行大规模
独立与脱离中华人民共和国的示威活动，
并逐渐发展为骚乱。人们要求从“1949年的占领”中获得“解放
”，多数维吾尔族同胞支持他们。
然而，汉族方面形成了牵制力量，且有些维吾尔人只是满足于比我们
所能利用的更大自治要求。

0x002F2F46.text: Our industry is in an unprecedented decline - some of the plants are idle, some are about to close and everyone is working on outdated equipment.
0x002F2F46.translated:
我们的工业正陷入前所未有的衰退——有些工厂停工，
有些工厂即将关闭，而所有人都在使用落后的设备在干活。

0x002F306B.text: Our agriculture is in unprecedented decline - there was no such disorder even in times of great leap forward!
0x002F306B.translated:
我们的农业也陷入前所未有的衰退——即便在大跃进时期也从未出现
过如此的混乱！

0x002F3148.text: Our service sector is in terrible decline - most of the stores and establishments do not work, and the quality of service in the working ones is simply terrible.
0x002F3148.translated:
我们的服务业陷入惨重衰退——大多数商店和机构都停摆，
而仍在运转的那些，其服务质量简直糟透了。

0x002F328D.text: There is too little money in our budget and reserve fund. If it continues like this, we soon will not be able to maintain  the normal work of our state.
0x002F328D.translated:
我们的预算和储备金太少。
若继续这样下去，我们很快就无法维持国家的正常运转。

0x002F33C0.text: For several years, ruling in Democratic Kampuchea, the Red Khmers of Pol Pot pursued an openly aggressive policy towards neighboring Vietnam, often attacking border villages and killing civilians en masse. And it seems that Vietnam’s patience has come to an end - quite recently the Vietnamese army launched a full-scale invasion of Cambodia to overthrow the Pol Pot regime, using the Kampuchean United Front for National Salvation, consisting of Khmer left dissidents as cover. Given that Pol Pot has been our faithful ally all this time, it would be worth helping him. Although on the other hand, it may be worth replacing the brazen dictator in favor of more reasonable officers from the Kampuchea army. This, of course, will not stop the war, but Vietnam, which has set itself the goal of overthrowing Pol Pot, will find itself in a difficult situation.
0x002F33C0.translated:
在数年间统治民主柬埔寨的波尔布特红色高棉，
对邻国越南奉行公然的侵略政策，经常袭击边境村庄并大规模屠杀平
民。看来越南的忍耐也到头了——就在不久前，
越南军队对柬埔寨发动了全面入侵，以推翻波尔布特政权，
并以由高棉左派异议人士组成的柬埔寨民族救国阵线作为掩护。
鉴于波尔布特一直是我们忠实的盟友，帮助他似乎是值得的。
另一方面，也许可以考虑用更“讲道理”的柬埔寨军方军官来替换这
位张狂的独裁者。当然，这并不会停止战争，
但把目标锁定为推翻波尔布特的越南将陷入困境。

0x002F3A75.text: After the fall of the military junta in 1973 and the transfer of power to the civilian government, Thailand entered the period of "chaotic democracy". The victories of the communist forces throughout Indochina contribute to the growth of leftist sentiments, led by the Maoist Communist Party of Thailand, which is engaged in both partisan and legal activities. They are opposed by the right-wing military, landowners and other royalists, which often leads to clashes. Under these conditions, against the backdrop of the outbreak of the crisis of the Thai economy, the democratic Prime Minister Kukrit Pramoj is forced to hold early elections. Maybe this is our chance, if not to lure away, then at least destabilize the bastion of imperialism in Indochina?
0x002F3A75.translated:
1973年军事政变集团垮台、政权转交给文人政府之后，
泰国进入了“混乱的民主”时期。
整个印度支那的共产党力量的胜利，助长了以泰国毛派共产党为首的
左翼情绪，该党既从事党派活动也从事合法活动。
与之对立的是右翼军方、地主以及其他王党势力，
因此常常引发冲突。在这种条件下，伴随着泰国经济危机的爆发，
民主派总理库克里特·普拉莫吉被迫举行提前选举。
也许这就是我们的机会：如果不能把他们拉走，
至少也要动摇印度支那帝国主义的堡垒？

0x002F4060.text: Against the background of social instability and constant confrontation between left and right forces, the royal family of Thailand decided in September to organize the return to the country of the radical right general Thanom Kittikachorn, the country's former prime minister responsible for the bloody repression and overthrown by public speeches in 1973. Kittikachorn himself was not wants to return to politics and wished to take monasticism, but the official announcement of his return and his meeting with the king caused dissatisfaction of a part of society with the right . Premier Pramoj resigned, which, however, was rejected, a wave of student and trade union demonstrations swept through, one of which is taking place at the Thammasat University, to which right-wing militants are already raiding. According to our data, the military are preparing a brutal suppression of the demonstration.
0x002F4060.translated:
在社会不稳定以及左右势力持续对峙的背景下，
泰国王室在9月决定组织把激进右翼将领、
该国前总理坦农·基蒂卡宗（因1973年的公开演说而被推翻，
并对血腥镇压负有责任）遣返回国。
基蒂卡宗本人并不想回到政治舞台，反而希望出家修行，
但他回国的官方宣布以及他与国王的会面，
引发了社会中一部分人对右翼的不满。
普拉莫吉总理辞职，但这一辞职遭到否决；
一波又一波学生与工会的示威浪潮席卷而来，
其中一场正在进行的地点是法政大学，而右翼武装分子已经在对那里
进行突袭。根据我们的情报，军方正在准备对这次示威进行残酷镇压。

0x002F476F.text: After long and bloody battles, the conflict named "
0x002F476F.translated: 经过漫长而血腥的战斗，这场名为“

0x002F47D7.text: " is finally over. The Ministry of Foreign Affairs has taken care of everything and is now ready to give you a quick overview of the outcome of the war.
0x002F47D7.translated:
的冲突终于结束了。
外交部已经把一切安排妥当，现在准备向你快速汇报战争的结果。

0x002F490A.text: After a long and bloody fighting conflict "
0x002F490A.translated: 经过一场漫长而血腥的战斗冲突“

0x002F4984.text: The winner in the end came

0x002F49BE.text: side, having achieved their goals in the war.
0x002F49BE.translated: 一方，他们在战争中达成了目标。

0x002F4A1C.text: Neither side achieved a decisive victory, so the white peace was signed, returning the borders to the pre-war state.
0x002F4A1C.translated:
双方都未取得决定性胜利，于是签署了白色停战协议，
使边界恢复到战前状态。

0x002F4B09.text: Congratulations on your appointment to the post of Premier of the State Council of the People's Republic of China, Comrade Hua Guofeng. As you know, your predecessor was Zhou Enlai, who gained popularity and respect among the people at home and abroad for his honesty and administrative talents. However, he was also an active promoter of economic reforms and promoted reformers in the party, such as his protege Deng Xiaoping. For these reasons, the death of Zhou on January 8, 1976 caused great grief among the people, which dissatisfied Mao and the leadership of the CCP, who reacted very reservedly to his death. Rumor has it Mao Zedong himself set the campaign of Five "no" in motion — not to wear mourning bands, not to make wreaths, not to make memorials, not to hold memorial ceremonies and not to hang photos of Zhou Enlai — yet no one is sure, since Mao is now barely reachable because of his bad legs and overall health, and decisions have to be made quickly with no time to wait. And you, as a new prime minister, can influence its execution.
0x002F4B09.translated:
祝贺你被任命为中华人民共和国国务院总理，
同志华国锋。你知道，你的前任是周恩来，
他凭借为人正直和行政才能，在国内外赢得了人民的普遍爱戴与尊敬。
然而，他也是经济改革的积极推动者，
并在党内提拔改革派人士，例如他的得意门生邓小平。
正因如此，1976年1月8日周的逝世在人民中引起了极大悲痛，
这令毛泽东和中共领导层不满，他们对周的去世反应十分克制。
传闻说，毛泽东本人亲自发动了“五个不”运动——不戴孝带、
不献花圈、不立纪念、不搞追悼仪式、不挂周恩来照片——但究竟是
否如此，谁也说不准，因为毛现在因腿疾和整体健康状况已几乎难以
接近，决策又必须迅速作出，来不及等待。
你可影响此举措的执行。

0x002F5348.text: The death of Zhou Enlai seriously affected the position of his protege Deng Xiaoping, who was left without the patronage of the former prime minister. He is now under constant attack by the radicals headed by Mao Zedong’s wife Jiang Qing, and on February 2, Xiaoping was transferred to work in the field of external relations. With the permission of Mao Jiang and her supporters, they managed to launch a campaign "Criticize Deng and fight with right" and begin an active persecution of Deng in the media. It is noteworthy that although Mao treats Xiaoping with disbelief, he is not yet participating in his persecution. And what should we do, given that Hua Guofeng has never been on good terms with either Jiang Qing or Xiaoping?
0x002F5348.translated:
周恩来的逝世严重动摇了他的门生邓小平的地位，
使他失去了前总理的庇护。
他如今正遭到以毛泽东之妻江青为首的激进派的持续攻击，
2月2日，邓小平被调往从事对外关系领域的工作。
在毛江及其支持者的许可下，他们得以发起“批邓反右”的运动，
并在媒体上对邓小平展开积极迫害。
值得注意的是，尽管毛对小平抱有不信任态度，
但他目前尚未参与对小平的迫害。
那么，在华国锋从来与江青和邓小平都处不好关系的情况下，
我们该怎么办？

0x002F5937.text: On March 25, 1976, the Shanghai newspaper «Wenhuibao» printed an article calling an unnamed Zhou a «capitalist-roader». Some read it as a posthumous strike on Zhou Enlai, others say it targets Zhou Rongxin, while Deng’s capitalist-roadings fan the Enlai rumor to stoke public grief. The text was ordered by Shanghai party chief Zhang Chunqiao and also swipes at Deng and his reform ideas. The masses do not yet know which Zhou is under attack, but emotions are rising — we must decide how to respond.
0x002F5937.translated:
1976年3月25日，上海报纸《文汇报》刊登一篇文章，
称一位未具名的“周”为“资本主义道路的当权派”。
有人把它视为对周恩来的身后打击，也有人说矛头指向周荣鑫；
而邓的“走资本主义道路”则把“恩来谣言”煽得更旺，
以激起公众的悲愤。文章由上海市委书记张春桥下令刊发，
同时也对邓及其改革主张进行鞭挞。
群众还不清楚究竟是哪一位周遭到攻击，
但情绪正在升温——我们必须决定如何应对。

0x002F5D22.text: Numerous attempts by the CCP to discredit the late Zhou Enlai have caused only discontent among the people. On April 4, on the day of the traditional holiday of remembrance of the departed, the citizens of Beijing carried wreaths in memory of Zhou Enlai to Tiananmen Square to the Monument to the people's heroes. Before nightfall, about 2 million people visited the square, and the mountain of wreaths reached 20 meters in height. On this occasion, an emergency meeting of the Politburo of the CPC Central Committee was convened under the chairmanship of Mao Zedong. Jiang Qing and Zhang Chunqiao propose first to address the people by radio to separate mourners from provocateurs, and only then use force if needed. Wu De is trying to avoid violence altogether. The responsibility was placed on you and the mayor of Beijing, Wu De; what line will we choose?
0x002F5D22.translated:
中共多次试图抹黑已故周恩来，结果只引起了群众的不满。
4月4日，传统的清明纪念日，首都北京的市民携带花圈，
向天安门广场人民英雄纪念碑缅怀周恩来。
天黑前约有200万人到访广场，花圈堆成的“山”高达20米。
就在此时，在毛泽东主持下，中共中央政治局紧急会议召开。
江青和张春桥主张先通过广播对群众说话，
把吊唁者与挑衅者分开，必要时再动用武力。
汪东兴正努力尽量避免暴力。
责任落在你和北京市市长汪东兴身上——我们将选择哪条路线？

0x002F63DB.text: On July 28, a magnitude 8.2 earthquake on the Richter scale occurred in the city of Tangshan, Hebei Province, at 03:42 local time, as a result of which the city was almost completely destroyed. The destruction also took place in Tianjin and in Beijing, located just 140 km to the west. Several aftershocks, the strongest of which had a magnitude of 7.1, led to even greater sacrifices. According to preliminary data, from 200 to 600 thousand people died. According to the head of the Shanghai City Seismological Department, Zhang Jun, the main reason for the colossal destruction was the lack of the necessary measures of seismic protection during the construction.
0x002F63DB.translated:
7月28日，河北省唐山市在当地时间03:42发生里氏8.2级
地震，致使全城几乎被夷为平地。
天津以及位于西面仅140公里的北京也遭到破坏。
数次余震接连发生，其中最强达7.1级，
造成更大的伤亡。据初步数据，死亡人数在20万至60万之间。
上海市地震局负责人张军认为，造成巨大破坏的主要原因是建设过程
中缺乏必要的抗震防护措施。

0x002F6910.text: After Mao died, and you finally concentrated power in your hands, it is time to determine the future path of China, because every faction of the CCP sees it in its own way. Conservative Maoists are in favor of continuing Mao’s policies, but without questionable experiments, which means the end of the Cultural Revolution and campaigning. The reformers, of course, are in favor of ending the Cultural Revolution and large-scale reforms primarily in the economy, in order to improve the Chinese economy after Mao’s failed attempts to intervene in her work. All moderates believe that China needs change, but some will need an end to the Cultural Revolution and a small economic reorganization, while others join the reformers demanding deep market reforms. However, the radical Maoists are in no hurry to part with the idea of ??the Cultural Revolution and want to continue it, taking into account errors and excesses.
0x002F6910.translated:
毛主席去世后，你终于把权力集中到自己手中——现在是决定中国未
来道路的时候了，因为中共各派都各自看法。
保守的“毛派”主张继续毛的政策，但不搞那些可疑的“试验”，
这就意味着结束文化大革命和群众运动。
改革派当然主张结束文化大革命，并以经济为主进行大规模改革，
以便在毛对经济工作屡屡干预却失败之后，
改善中国经济。所有中间派都认为中国需要改变，
但有人需要先结束文化大革命、进行小规模的经济调整；
也有人加入改革派，要求进行深度的市场改革。
然而激进的“毛派”并不急于放弃“文化大革命”的想法，
仍想继续推进，只是要“吸取错误和纠正过火”。

0x002F703D.text: Now that our Chairman, Mao Zedong, has passed away, the internal party struggle again flared up in the CCP. On the one hand, there are four closest to the Great Helmsman supporters of the line on the continuation of the Cultural Revolution, but with a course on normalizing relations with the USSR: Jiang Qing is Mao’s spouse and the head of the Cultural Revolution Group of the CPC Central Committee, Wang Hongwen is a prominent member, at the tenth party congress, he was actually declared the successor to Mao, Zhang Chunqiao and Yao Wenyuan. On the other hand, the reformers, who are gaining strength, led by the disgraced ideologist of the half-market reforms of the early 70s, Deng Xiaoping, who are in favor of the earliest possible withdrawal of the Cultural Revolution and the beginning of large-scale market reforms with the unchanged anti-Soviet course. Moreover, it is the left radicals who are currently the greatest threat to our government, but to neutralize them, it will be necessary to ally with reformers such as Secretary of Defense Ye Jianying. Maybe it's better to negotiate with them and use them to fight reformers?
0x002F703D.translated:
既然我们敬爱的主席毛泽东已经逝世，中共内部的斗争又一次在党内
燃起。其一，是“四个最靠近伟大舵手”的支持者，
主张继续文化大革命，但同时又要走向同苏联关系正常化的路线：
江青是毛的配偶，也是中共中央“文化大革命”领导小组负责人；
王洪文是重要成员；在第十次党代会上，
他实际上被宣布为毛的接班人；张春桥、
姚文元亦在其中。其二，是正在壮大的改革派，
由70年代初“半市场改革”的臭名昭著思想家邓小平领衔，
主张尽早撤出文化大革命，并在保持不变的反苏路线前提下，
开启大规模市场改革。
更重要的是，如今对我们政府最大的威胁来自左派激进分子；
要中和他们，就必须与像国防部长叶剑英这样的改革派结盟。
也许更好的是先跟他们谈判，把他们拿来对付改革派？

0x002F7926.text: The wobbly compromise between the Guofeng and the radical left is cracking at the seams. Frank dissatisfaction with the agreement of many more moderate party members greatly undermined the position of the current chairman, and his gentleness in resolving these issues threatens to lead to unpredictable consequences. Moreover, the four require more decisive measures against the opposition and revisionists in the party, and at the same time further expanding their powers to follow Mao’s course. If this continues further, Guofeng will have to transfer power to the left more and more. Wang Dongxing - the leader of 8341 Special Regiment, who remains loyal to the chairman, is still ready to help in the fight against them. Although, given the increased strength of the left, thanks to the compromise in October, perhaps the best solution would be to remove only the most ambitious Jiang Qing and Wang Hongwen, keeping the agreement with the rest?
0x002F7926.translated:
华国锋与激进左派之间那种摇摇欲坠的妥协，
已经在裂缝里崩开。许多更温和的党内成员对这份协议的直率不满，
极大削弱了现任主席的地位；他在处理这些问题时的“温和”，
又可能引发难以预料的后果。
更何况“四人帮”要求对党内反对派和“修正主义者”采取更果断的
措施，同时进一步扩大他们的权力，以继续沿着毛的路线前进。
若继续这样下去，华国锋就不得不越来越多地把权力交给左边。
汪东兴——8341特种团的负责人，仍对主席忠心耿耿，
依然准备协助对他们的斗争。
不过，考虑到左派力量增强，且依靠10月的妥协，
或许最好的办法是只拿掉最野心勃勃的江青和王洪文，
而对其余人保留协议？

0x002F8091.text: It is the day of the national elections in the NPC. And since we occupy a dominant position in Chinese politics, we can intervene a little in their conduct, so that everything will remain same. Or just rely on the Chinese people’s faith in us.
0x002F8091.translated:
全国人大选举的日子到了。
既然我们在中国政治中占据主导地位，我们可以在他们的行动上稍加
干预，让一切照旧。或者就干脆依靠中国人民对我们的信任。

0x002F827A.text: For a long time, the Chinese territories of Hong Kong and Macao were under British and Portuguese colonial control. However, the fascist regime of the "Estado Novo" in Portugal was overthrown in 1974, the 99-year lease of Britain adjacent to Hong Kong of the New Territories is coming to an end, and both countries are under pressure from the 1960 UN Decolonization Declaration, so they are ready to go Compromise, and this is our chance to return what is rightfully ours. Of course, they will never voluntarily hand over the colonies if they are not convinced of the inviolability of the property of their own and foreign citizens, but also try to achieve wide autonomy for the territories of China.
0x002F827A.translated:
长期以来，香港和澳门等中国领土一直处于英国与葡萄牙的殖民控制
之下。然而，葡萄牙“埃斯塔多·诺沃”法西斯政权于1974年被
推翻；与香港相邻的新界的99年租约即将到期；
两国又都承受着1960年联合国《非殖民化宣言》的压力，
因此他们准备走向妥协——这就是我们收回理应属于我们的东西的机
会。当然，如果他们不确信本国及外国公民财产的不可侵犯性，
他们绝不会心甘情愿地交出殖民地；同时也会试图为中国领土争取广
泛的自治。

0x002F87F5.text: Major General Suharto, who seized power in Indonesia in 1965, immediately began to destroy his political opponents, especially the Communist Party. In 1965-66 alone, about 3 million people were killed on charges of sympathy for the Communists. National minorities get this also, including the Chinese, who are still legally discriminated against. Suharto’s repressive regime was maintained through US support and profitable economic contacts with the countries of Southeast Asia. However, now that we have cut off Indonesia from most of its partners, causing a collapse of its economy, an active protest movement is taking place in the country. And although many protests go under the left slogans, they are clearly not enough for a socialist revolution.
0x002F87F5.translated:
1965年夺取印尼政权的苏哈托中将，
立即开始摧毁他的政治对手，尤其是共产党。
仅在1965—66年间，就有约300万人因“同情共产党”之名
被杀害。民族少数同样遭殃，包括仍在法律上受到歧视的华人。
苏哈托的高压统治靠美国支持以及与东南亚国家的有利经济往来维持。
然而如今我们已把印尼与其大多数伙伴切断，
使其经济崩溃；国内正爆发积极的抗议运动。
尽管许多抗议打着左派口号，但显然还不足以引发社会主义革命。

0x002F8DDC.text: For a long time, the DPRK has been moving away from Marxism-Leninism and replacing it with the original Juche ideology with elements of mysticism and traditionalism and the personality cult of Kim Il Sung. All this is accompanied by periodic repression against political opponents of Kim Il-sung. The economy of the DPRK depends heavily on contacts with China and our help, so our recent sanctions have been a heavy blow to it. And therefore we can demand certain concessions from the North Korean government. Just do not forget that the USSR also provides assistance to the DPRK...
0x002F8DDC.translated:
长期以来，朝鲜民主主义人民共和国一直在背离马克思列宁主义，
用带有神秘主义与传统主义色彩的“主体思想”取而代之，
并塑造金日成的个人崇拜。
与此同时，这一切都伴随着对金日成政治对手的周期性镇压。
朝鲜经济高度依赖同中国的联系与我们的援助，
因此我们最近的制裁对它是沉重打击。
因而我们可以向朝鲜政府提出某些让步要求。
只是别忘了，苏联也在向朝鲜提供援助……

0x002F926B.text: Since the creation of Israel in 1948 in the territory of the former British Palestine, the Arab population there, actually deprived of the right to self-determination and subjected to discrimination by the Israeli authorities, has fought for the destruction of Israel and the creation of an Arab state in Palestine, in which they were supported by neighboring Arab countries. All this resulted in several Arab-Israeli wars, constant shelling and terrorist attacks against Israel by the Palestine Liberation Organization and the return raids of the Israeli army. The last of them, in Lebanon, ended in complete failure, without even receiving support from the United States, and now Israel is ready to negotiate with the PLO on the status of Palestinians, in which we can act as intermediaries.
0x002F926B.translated:
自1948年以原英国托管巴勒斯坦领土建立以色列以来，
当地阿拉伯人口实际上被剥夺了自决权，
并遭到以色列当局的歧视；他们为摧毁以色列、
在巴勒斯坦建立阿拉伯国家而斗争，并得到周边阿拉伯国家的支持。
由此引发了数次阿以战争；巴勒斯坦解放组织对以色列的持续炮击与
恐怖袭击，以及以色列军队的反击突袭。
最后一次发生在黎巴嫩，彻底失败，甚至连美国的支持都未获得；
如今以色列准备就巴勒斯坦人的地位与巴解组织谈判，
而我们可以充当中间人。

0x002F98A0.text: The uprising in Gwangju, thanks to our support, spilled over into neighboring regions and caused enormous damage to the reputation of the South Korean government, and our recent blow to its economy led to a new surge of protests, under the pressure of which Jong Doo-hwan agreed to hold free presidential elections and even allow two famous opposition leaders - Kim Dae-jung and Kim Young-sam, the first of whom in particular has much more peaceful views towards the DPRK. By ensuring his victory in the elections and putting pressure on the DPRK, we could lead Korea to the long-awaited unification.
0x002F98A0.translated:
光州起义在我们的支持下外溢到周边地区，
给韩国政府的声誉造成巨大损害；而我们对其经济的近期打击又引发
了新一轮抗议浪潮。在压力之下，郑斗焕同意举行自由总统选举，
甚至允许两位著名反对派领袖——金大中和金泳三参选；
其中金大中尤其对朝鲜民主主义人民共和国持更为温和的立场。
只要确保他在选举中获胜，并对朝鲜施压，
我们就能把韩国引向久盼的统一。

0x002F9D53.text: With the help of our intervention in Mongolia, large-scale protests began, calling for reforms and a departure from strict pro-Soviet policy. Not wanting a repetition of events in Czechoslovakia and the entry of Soviet troops, the MPR seems ready to make some concessions and carry out limited democratization, like Kadar in Hungary. We could use this in order to lead pro-Chinese people to Mongolian politics and the media in order to provide them with a more... independent foreign policy.
0x002F9D53.translated:
借助我们对蒙古的介入，大规模抗议开始了，
要求改革，并摆脱一味严守的亲苏政策。
为了避免重演捷克斯洛伐克的事态、避免苏军入境，
蒙古人民共和国似乎愿意作出一些让步，
并进行有限的民主化——类似匈牙利的卡达尔。
我们可以利用这一点，把亲华人士引入蒙古的政治与媒体，
从而让他们拥有更……
独立的外交政策。

0x002FA12C.text: Zulfikar Ali Bhutto was the president of Pakistan since 1971 and the prime minister since 1973. Bhutto followed the course of Islamic socialism, which was reflected in broad social programs and the nationalization of many sectors of the economy. In foreign policy, he adhered to anti-imperialism and tried to build friendly relations with neighboring countries, left the pro-American SEATO and the British Commonwealth, and managed to detente with India after the Third Indo-Pakistani war. However, after the Bhutto's Pakistan People’s Party won the election in March 1977, the opposition accused him of fraud and began protests that Bhutto harshly suppresses. All this does not like the army, which, led by General Muhammad Zia-ul-Haq and with the support of the United States, is preparing a military coup. By preventing it and giving Bhutto material assistance for the construction of socialism, we could firmly consolidate our positions in Pakistan.
0x002FA12C.translated:
祖尔菲卡尔·阿里·布托自1971年起任巴基斯坦总统，
自1973年起任总理。
布托奉行伊斯兰社会主义路线，这体现在广泛的社会计划以及对经济
许多部门的国有化。在外交上，他坚持反帝主义，
努力同邻国建立友好关系，退出亲美的东南亚条约组织（SEATO）
和大英联邦，并在第三次印巴战争后成功实现了与印度的缓和。
然而，1977年3月布托的“巴基斯坦人民党”赢得选举后，
反对派指控他舞弊，并发起抗议；而布托对抗议进行严厉镇压。
军方对此并不买账——由穆罕默德·齐亚-乌尔-哈克将军领导，
并得到美国支持的军方，正在准备军事政变。
只要阻止它，并为布托建设社会主义提供物质援助，
我们就能在巴基斯坦牢固巩固我们的立场。

0x002FA8A1.text: After the defeat of the Gang of four, power nominally passed to you, but in fact you have to share it with those who helped you get it - with Minister of Defense Ye Jianying, a staunch reformer who defended Xiaoping during the Cultural Revolution, and Li Xiannian, more moderate, but also supporting reformers. On the other hand, there are three of your most loyal conservative supporters — Ji Denkui, Wang Dongxing, and Chen Xilian. If you want not to be stoped, you should strike at the reformers and promote your supporters, however, would such arbitrariness cause discontent in the party and would you rather restrict yourself to one of the two? On the other hand, if you are focused on reforms, it will probably be more useful to negotiate with reformers. Although who knows if they will want...
0x002FA8A1.translated:
四人帮被打倒后，权力名义上交到了你手里，
但实际上你必须与那些帮你拿到权力的人分担——国防部长叶剑英，
这位在文化大革命期间力保邓小平的坚定改革派；
以及更为温和、但同样支持改革派的李先念。
另一方面，还有你最忠诚的三位保守支持者——纪登奎、
汪东兴和陈希贤。若你不想被人阻挡，就应当打击改革派、
提拔你的支持者；可这种任意妄为会不会引起党内不满？
你更愿意在两者之间只选其一吗？
另一方面，如果你把重心放在改革上，或许与改革派谈判更有用。
只是，谁知道他们是否愿意……

0x002FAEE4.text: After the death of Mao, you took the course of curtailing the Cultural Revolution, and achieved certain results in this - mass campaigns are no longer observed. However, the repressive grip of the state since the time of Cultural Revolution has not yet weakened, and the reformers, together with the people, are now demanding to "unscrew the nuts". In addition to civic liberalization, many consider it necessary to also ease the pressure on traditions and religion, which increased many times during the Cultural Revolution. Some advocate only for the cessation of anti-traditionalist rhetoric with the preservation of state atheism, others propose, according to the Soviet model, to declare nominal freedom of conscience while keeping religious institutions and figures under strict state control. You decide.
0x002FAEE4.translated:
毛主席去世后，你采取了压缩文化大革命的路线，
并取得了一定成效——大规模群众运动不再出现。
然而，自文化大革命以来国家的高压之手并未减弱；
改革派与群众如今正要求“拧松螺丝”。
除公民层面的松绑外，许多人还认为有必要缓解对传统与宗教的压力
——这种压力在文化大革命期间被加大了许多。
有的人主张只停止反传统的口号，同时保留国家无神论；
也有人按苏联模式提出：在名义上宣布良心自由，
但让宗教机构与宗教人士继续置于严格的国家控制之下。
你来决定。

0x002FB53D.text: Since 1968, a precarious cooperation has been established in Iraq between the ruling Ba'ath and the Iraqi Communist Party within the framework of the Progressive National Patriotic Front of Iraq. In May 1972, 2 representatives of the ICP were officially introduced to the government, although the Communist Party was still in an informal position. However, the cooperation turned out to be short-lived. Recently, the Ba'ath leadership in Iraq has once again begun to unleash repression against the Communists, but there is still room for maintaining a fragile coalition. Maybe we should somehow intervene in the situation?
0x002FB53D.translated:
自1968年以来，在伊拉克“伊拉克进步民族爱国阵线”的框架下，
执政的阿拉伯复兴社会党与伊拉克共产党之间建立了脆弱的合作关
系。1972年5月，尽管共产党仍处于非正式地位，
但其两名代表被正式纳入政府。
然而，这种合作很快就昙花一现。
最近，伊拉克复兴党领导层又一次开始对共产党人施加镇压，
但仍有空间维持一种脆弱的同盟。
也许我们应该以某种方式介入局势？

0x002FBA1C.text: Since 1970, Egypt has been headed by Anwar Sadat. Immediately after he came to power, he began a departure from the policy of Gamal Abdel Nasser and the ideas of pan-Arabism and Arab socialism - during the so-called. "Corrective Revolution" almost all Nasser’s associates were arrested, including Vice President Ali Sabri (a supporter of friendship with the USSR and the Communists), in 1971 the United Arab Republic was renamed the Arab Republic of Egypt, which meant a break with the course on pan-Arab integration . And in 1973 began the rapprochement of Egypt with the United States, which was accompanied by a rise in anti-Soviet sentiment and a break with Libya and Syria. In 1975, Sadat attempted to destabilize the ruling Arab Socialist Union (ASU), and this year - an unprecedented case - began negotiations to restore relations with Israel! Liberalization of the economy and the penetration of Egyptian foreign capital into the market led to widespread discontent among the general population, and the war with the once fraternal Libya finally undermined Sadat’s authority. Mass rallies flooded the whole country, demanding the resignation of the president. We can take advantage of this and achieve the return to power of supporters of the socialist course. The USSR and the fraternal Arab countries clearly will not object, but the reaction of the United States will not be so warm...
0x002FBA1C.translated:
自1970年起，埃及由安瓦尔·萨达特执政。
上台伊始，他就开始背离加迈勒·阿卜杜勒·纳赛尔的政策以及泛阿
拉伯主义和阿拉伯社会主义的理念——在所谓“纠正革命”期间，
纳赛尔的几乎所有同僚都被逮捕，包括副总统阿里·萨布里（支持同
苏联与共产党友好）。
1971年，阿拉伯联合共和国更名为埃及阿拉伯共和国，
这意味着与泛阿拉伯一体化路线彻底决裂。
1973年，埃及开始向美国靠拢；伴随而来的是反苏情绪上升，
并与利比亚和叙利亚决裂。
1975年，萨达特试图动摇执政的阿拉伯社会主义联盟（ASU），
而今年——史无前例——竟开始与以色列恢复关系的谈判！
经济放开以及埃及外资进入市场，导致广大民众普遍不满；
而与曾经“兄弟”的利比亚的战争，最终瓦解了萨达特的权威。
全国各地爆发群众集会，要求总统辞职。
我们可以借此机会，实现社会主义路线支持者的复权。
苏联和“兄弟”阿拉伯国家显然不会反对，
但美国的反应恐怕不会那么温和……

0x002FC507.text: In the early 1960s, in order to cope with the devastating effects of the Great Leap, in the PRC, under the leadership of Deng Xiaoping and Zhou Enlai, large-scale self-government economic reforms and the possibility of private land tenure were launched, which eventually led to the dismantling of central planning. Mao did not interfere with their conduct, as he feared dissatisfaction on the part of the majority in the CCP, who still remembered the failure of the Great Leap, and realizing their necessity at that time. However, now the Great Leap is far behind and maybe at this moment the revival of the plan will allow our economy to reach a new level? On the other hand, the reform wing still believes that further reforms are needed in the economy and wants to develop them.
0x002FC507.translated:
20世纪60年代初，为应对“大跃进”的毁灭性后果，
在中华人民共和国境内，由邓小平和周恩来领导，
启动了大规模的“自主管理”式经济改革，
并允许土地私有承包，最终导致中央计划被拆解。
毛并未干预他们的行动，因为他担心中共多数派的不满——他们仍记
得大跃进的失败，并且也意识到当时这样做的必要性。
然而如今大跃进早已远去，也许此刻重新恢复计划，
会让我们的经济达到新的水平？
另一方面，改革派仍认为经济还需要进一步改革，
并希望把它继续推进。

0x002FCB24.translated: 关于“解决……问题”的委员会

0x002FCB5C.text: The death of Comrade Mao Zedong, the beginning of the inner-party struggle in the CCP and our refusal to continue the course of the so-called "The Great Proletarian Cultural Revolution" caused a strong ferment inside the party. According to the Ministry of Public Security, ideas about the "wrongness of the ideas of Mao", "the fallacy of the CCP’s course", "the distortion by Mao Zedong and his surroundings of the history of the country and the party" and so on are beginning to spread in some party organizations. This runs the risk of splitting the Communist Party and completely eradicating all the successes of China’s socialist development. The Politburo of the CPC Central Committee decided to begin work on a document that will give an official assessment of the entire path that the PRC and the CPC passed under the leadership of Mao Zedong since 1949, for which they form a commission of 50 people. However, it is necessary to decide who will head it, and determine the approximate composition. Remember that your decision will have far-reaching consequences and may lead to a revision of the entire ideological line of the CCP.
0x002FCB5C.translated:
毛泽东同志的逝世，中共党内斗争的开始，
以及我们拒绝继续所谓“伟大无产阶级文化大革命”的路线，
导致党内出现强烈的思想涌动。
据公安部称，关于“毛的思想的错误性”“中共路线的谬误”“毛泽
东及其身边人的歪曲了国家与党的历史”等观点，
正在一些党组织中开始传播。
这有可能导致共产党分裂，并彻底抹杀中国社会主义发展的全部成就。
中共中央政治局决定着手起草一份文件，
对中华人民共和国和中共自1949年以来在毛泽东领导下走过的全
部道路作出官方评价，并为此成立一个由50人组成的委员会。
然而必须决定由谁来担任负责人，并确定大致的组成。
记住，你的决定将产生深远影响，甚至可能导致对中共全部意识形态
路线的修订。

0x002FD445.text: Comrade Chairman, a letter from a large group of Tibetan clergy has come to the Central Committee in which they urge you to consider releasing 10th Panchen Lama from prison (Panchen Lama is the second lama after the Dalai Lama in the Gelug school of Tibetan Buddhism - note MSS ). Lobsang Trinley Lhundrub Chokyi Gyaltsen, aka 10th Panchen-Lama, refused to flee with the Kuomintang people to Taiwan in September 1949 and supported the formation of the PRC, later playing an important role in reuniting Tibet with our Motherland. However, he then sharply condemned the Chineseization of the Tibet Autonomous Region, for which he was declared "the enemy of the Tibetan people" in 1964, arrested and imprisoned in the Beijing Tsingcheng prison, where he currently resides. We can free him, thereby significantly improving relations with Tibetan monks and the population of the autonomy. But does it make sense? Maybe it is better to eliminate the unreliable lama and get our protege Gyaltsen Norbu elected as Panchen-Lama?
0x002FD445.translated:
主席同志，一封来自大批藏传佛教僧俗人士的来信已送达中央委员会，
信中敦促你考虑释放第十世班禅喇嘛出狱。
（班禅喇嘛是格鲁派中仅次于达赖喇嘛的第二位活佛——注：
MSS。）罗桑·晋美·伦珠布·却吉坚赞（即第十世班禅喇嘛）
在1949年9月拒绝随国民党人员逃往台湾，
并支持中华人民共和国的建立，后来在推动西藏与祖国重新统一方面
发挥了重要作用。然而此后他又尖锐批评西藏自治区的“汉化”，
因此在1964年被宣布为“西藏人民的敌人”，
被捕并关押在北京清城监狱，至今仍在那里。
我们可以释放他，从而显著改善与藏传僧侣及自治区民众的关系。
但这样做是否有意义？
也许更好的是铲除这位不可靠的喇嘛，并让我们扶持的格桑诺布当选
为班禅喇嘛？

0x002FDC3E.text: Former Indian Prime Minister since 1966, Indira Gandhi, the head of the INC, during her reign, carried out active leftist reforms in the socio-economic sphere, which even provoked a split in the INC and the exit of the right wing. During her reign, considerable success was achieved in the economy and the fight against poverty, but the state of emergency in the country since 1971 plays into the hands of the opposition from Janat party, which accuses Gandhi of corruption, nepotism and authoritarianism. Under these conditions, Gandhi decided to organize early parliamentary elections. Given that Gandhi has always pursued a pro-Soviet and unfriendly policy towards the PRC, and also entered into conflicts with friendly to us Pakistan, only recently having detented in these matters, could an opposition victory strengthen our influence. Janata Party unites people of different views from socialists to conservatives and does not have a coherent program, but the easier it will be for us to manage it. Although it may be, if we help Indira, will she remember this and continue moving towards the restoration of our relationship?..
0x002FDC3E.translated:
自1966年以来担任印度总理的、印度国民大会党（INC）
领袖英迪拉·甘地，在执政期间在社会经济领域推行积极的左翼改革，
甚至引发了INC分裂以及右翼势力退出。
她执政期间在经济与反贫困方面取得了相当成效，
但自1971年以来印度国内实行的紧急状态，
却正好为来自“人民党”（Janat party）
的反对派提供了武器；该党指控甘地腐败、
任人唯亲与专制。基于这些条件，甘地决定组织提前举行议会选举。
考虑到甘地一贯奉行亲苏、对中华人民共和国不友好的政策，
并且还与我们友好的巴基斯坦发生冲突——只是最近才在这些问题上
缓和——那么反对派若获胜，是否会增强我们的影响力？
人民党把从社会主义者到保守派的不同观点的人团结在一起，
并没有连贯的纲领，但这也许更便于我们操控。
只是，如果我们帮助英迪拉，她会记得这份情吗，
并继续朝着修复我们关系的方向走下去……？

0x002FE51B.text: For some time now, protests have been taking place in Shah Iran aimed at the difficult socio-economic situation of the people, the Shah’s pro-American policies, the rampant corruption of the ruling elites and the oppression of the Shiite clergy by the state. However, today the protests went into a hot phase after the anti-government demonstration was shot by the police in Qom, which was caused by a slanderous article about Ayatollah (the highest spiritual title of Shiite Islam) Khomeini, the spiritual leader of the protests, who was expelled from the country in 1964. After this, protests and strikes swept many cities in Iran. Islamist movements, such as the Movement for a Free Iran and the Society of Fighting Clergy, are the driving forces of the upcoming revolution, but other organizations also work to overthrow the Shah, the largest of which are the Democratic National Front of Iran and the Marxist-Leninist People’s Party of Iran. The revolution in Iran can dramatically change the balance of power in the Middle East, so maybe we should intervene?
0x002FE51B.translated:
一段时间以来，在“沙阿伊朗”境内爆发抗议，
矛头指向民众艰难的社会经济处境、沙阿的亲美政策、
执政精英的猖獗腐败，以及国家对什叶派宗教人士的压迫。
然而今天，抗议进入了白热化阶段：在库姆，
警方对反政府示威开枪；这又是由一篇诽谤霍梅尼（什叶派伊斯兰最
高宗教头衔“阿亚图拉”的称号）的文章引发的——霍梅尼是抗议的
精神领袖，1964年被驱逐出境。
此后，伊朗多座城市爆发抗议与罢工。
诸如“争取自由伊朗运动”和“斗争宗教人士协会”等伊斯兰主义运
动，是即将到来的革命的推动力量；但也有其他组织在推动推翻沙阿，
其中最大的包括伊朗民主民族阵线和伊朗马列主义人民党。
伊朗革命可能会剧烈改变中东力量格局——也许我们该介入？

0x002FED6E.text: For a long time, Vietnam tried to balance between us and the USSR, because despite our differences with the Soviets, our volunteers fought together in the Indochinese wars on the side of socialist Vietnam. But already with the end of the war and unification, Vietnam gradually became more and more pro-Soviet, more and more moving away from us.|
0x002FED6E.translated:
长期以来，越南试图在我们与苏联之间保持平衡：
尽管我们与苏联存在分歧，但我们的志愿军曾在对印支的战争中与苏
方并肩，站在社会主义越南一边作战。
然而随着战争结束与国家统一，越南逐渐越来越亲苏，
越来越远离我们。|

0x002FF023.text: After Le Duan’s trip to Moscow in 1977, a further rapprochement of Vietnam and the USSR began with the prospect of joining the CMEA, which he intends to join from day to day. However, part of the country's leadership opposes such an ardent rapprochement with the USSR, because there are no special threats to Vietnam, especially after the overthrow of Pol Pot in Cambodia, in Asia. And this is our chance to intervene and stop the spread of Soviet hegemony.
0x002FF023.translated:
1977年黎德寿赴莫斯科之后，越南与苏联的进一步靠拢开始了，
前景是加入经互会（CMEA），而他打算“日复一日”地加入。
然而，国家领导层中的一部分人反对这种对苏联过于热烈的靠拢，
因为对越南并不存在特殊威胁——尤其是在亚洲、
波尔布特在柬埔寨被推翻之后。
于是，这就是我们介入并阻止苏联霸权扩散的机会。

0x002FF3B8.text: After Le Duan’s trip to Moscow in 1977, a further rapprochement of Vietnam and the USSR began with the prospect of joining the CMEA, which he intends to join from day to day. We apparently can not prevent this, not least because of the fact that Vietnam wants to enlist Soviet support against Pol Pot in pro-Chinese Cambodia.
0x002FF3B8.translated:
1977年黎德寿赴莫斯科之后，越南与苏联的进一步靠拢开始了，
前景是加入经互会（CMEA），而他打算“日复一日”地加入。
我们显然无法阻止这一点，至少因为越南希望争取苏联支持，
以对付亲华柬埔寨境内的波尔布特。

0x002FF645.text: Your desire to pursue a conservative policy that is completely inconsistent with the diminishing strength of your supporters eventually led to widespread dissatisfaction of the CPC’s reformist wing, supported by the moderates. They want your removal from power and require the start of extensive market reforms with the attraction of foreign investment and China's access to the world market, arguing that "the economy should prevail over the ideology". That is what their leader
0x002FF645.translated:
你执意推行一种与支持者力量日益衰弱完全不相称的保守政策，
最终导致以中间派支持的中共改革派阵营普遍不满。
他们要你下台，并要求启动广泛的市场改革：
吸引外资、让中国进入世界市场；他们的论点是“经济要服从于意识
形态”。这正是他们的领袖

0x002FFA0A.text: at the current plenum of the CPC Central Committee says to you, with which the majority of those present agree. Need to do something if you do not want to lose power!
0x002FFA0A.translated:
在中共中央委员会现阶段的全体会议上对你说的，
而在场多数人也表示赞同。
若你不想丢掉权力，就必须做点什么！

0x002FFB5B.text: After announcing a course on market reforms, our economists developed a plan for the first reforms and finally submitted it so that the CPC leadership could approve it. It includes the empowerment of individual state-owned enterprises, the introduction of market methods for their work and the promotion of small private and cooperative entrepreneurship.
0x002FFB5B.translated:
在宣布市场改革路线之后，我们的经济学家制定了第一轮改革方案，
并最终提交给中共领导层以供批准。
方案包括：赋予部分国有企业更大的自主权；
在其运作中引入市场化方法；并推动小型私营与合作制企业的发展。

0x002FFE22.text: Interesting news came from Hungary. Bela Biszku, a conservative communist who actively participated in the suppression of the Hungarian uprising in 1956 and was the Minister of the Interior from 1957 to 1961, and now secretary of the HSWP, always opposed Kadar's economic and political liberal reforms. Realizing that words couldn’t stop him, he made a group of similar conservatives around himself and decided to organize an inner-party coup, asking for support from the head of the KGB, Yuri Andropov. However, according to our data, Andropov simply "betrayed" Biszku's plans to Kadar, which Biszku himself doesn’t know yet. Now we have a chance to help Biszku with our agents and return Hungary to the path of building true socialism. Or you can always try to raise a new uprising in Hungary with the help of small arms supplies and intelligence coordination - this time truly communist and pro-Chinese - then Hungary is guaranteed to be ours! But we must act quickly.
0x002FFE22.translated:
匈牙利传来一则有趣的消息。
贝拉·比斯库（Bela Biszku）
是一名保守的共产党人：他曾积极参与1956年镇压匈牙利起义，
并在1957年至1961年担任内务部长；
如今又是匈牙利社会主义工人党（HSWP）
总书记。他一贯反对卡达尔的经济与政治自由化改革。
意识到言语无法阻止对方，他便在自己周围聚拢了一批同类保守派，
并决定组织一次党内政变，向克格勃头目尤里·安德罗波夫寻求支持。
然而据我们掌握的情况，安德罗波夫只是把比斯库的计划“出卖”
给了卡达尔——而比斯库本人至今还不知道。
现在我们有机会派出特工帮助比斯库，把匈牙利拉回建设真正社会主
义的道路。或者你也可以继续尝试：在小型武器供给与情报协调的帮
助下，在匈牙利再起一场新的起义——这一次是真正的共产主义、
真正亲华——那么匈牙利保证会是我们的！
但我们必须迅速行动。

0x003005BB.text: From the middle of this year, the stormy activity of students and intellectuals began throughout the country, especially in Beijing, which hangs big-character poster (wall newspapers with large hieroglyphs used for propaganda and protest) in the streets and publishes self-made magazines. Big-character poster and the journals oppose the CPC's conservatism, criticize the Cultural Revolution, call for economic and political liberalization, and express support for the reformers in the CPC, which NAME actively uses. Moreover, in 1977, the reformers themselves actively published in their journals and newspapers under their control critique of our policies, saying that it "does not agree with Marxism" that "the economy should prevail over ideology" and that "pragmatism is the only criterion for revealing the truth", describing the practical advantages of market reforms in their vision.
0x003005BB.translated:
从今年年中开始，全国范围内学生与知识分子的“风暴式”活动兴起，
尤其在北京：街头张贴大字报（用大幅汉字图形进行宣传与抗议的
墙报），并出版自办刊物。
大字报与期刊反对中共的保守路线，批判文化大革命，
呼吁经济与政治的自由化，并公开支持中共内部的改革派——而NA
ME正积极利用这一点。
此外，1977年，改革派本人也在他们控制的刊物与报纸上积极发
表批评文章，指责我们的政策“与马克思主义不符”，
认为“经济要服从于意识形态”，并宣称“实用主义才是揭示真理的
唯一标准”，从他们的设想中描述市场改革的现实好处。

0x00300CB4.text: Urgent news! On April 27, in Afghanistan, as a result of the instability of power, impoverishment and discontent of the people by the arrest of the leaders of the left opposition party PDPA, a military coup took place beforehand planned by the PDPA. The general public welcomed the revolution. Having come to power, the PDPA, headed by Nur Muhammad Taraki, began the construction of socialism and an orientation toward the USSR. However, the future of Afghanistan is still vague, as in the PDPA itself there remains an overwhelming split between the Khalq and Parcham factions, which actually existed as 2 independent parties from 1966 to 1977. Khalq, consisting mainly of low-income and semi-proletarian groups, in the course of opposition activities focused on illegal work and advocated a revolutionary struggle, and now seeks to organize a quick transition of the country to socialism and the dictatorship of the proletariat. Parcham , which in the years of the opposition gave priority to legal and parliamentary struggle, now stands for gradual, general democratic reforms and generally inclined to reformism, believing that Afghanistan is not ready to build socialism. In the meantime, the CPC is seriously concerned about the expansion of Soviet influence in the region.
0x00300CB4.translated:
紧急消息！4月27日，阿富汗因政权不稳、
人民贫困与不满——在逮捕左翼反对党PDPA领导人之后——发生
了此前由PDPA预先策划的军事政变。
广大民众欢迎这场革命。
PDPA在努尔·穆罕默德·塔拉基领导下上台后，
开始建设社会主义，并转向苏联。
然而，阿富汗的前途仍不明朗：因为PDPA内部仍存在压倒性的“
喀尔克派”与“帕尔查姆派”分裂——这两派实际上在1966至1
977年间就作为两个独立政党存在。
喀尔克派主要由低收入与半无产阶级群体构成，
在反对活动中侧重非法工作，主张革命斗争；
如今则试图迅速把国家转向社会主义与无产阶级专政。
帕尔查姆派在反对时期优先进行合法与议会斗争，
如今主张渐进的、普遍的民主改革，并总体倾向改革主义，
认为阿富汗尚不具备建设社会主义的条件。
与此同时，中共对苏联势力在该地区的扩张深感忧虑。

0x003016B3.text: After the April revolution, the PDPA faced many difficulties, and in the rapidly gaining strength of the Khalq party, the struggle between one of the PDDP founders Taraki and his student Amin had already begun. Amin is a supporter of radical politics, an uncompromising struggle against feudal remnants and the harsh suppression of political opponents. At the same time, he, being an ardent Pashtun (the dominant people of Afghanistan - note) nationalist, is largely responsible for sabotaging the national policy of the PDPA and, trying to concentrate power in his own hands, he maintained a split between Khalq and Parcham. Despite the fact that the Soviet leadership repeatedly warned Taraki about Amin's conspiratorial plans, he did not heed until the very last moment. On September 14, during the visit of Amin to Taraki, the first one was attacked (it is not known exactly whether it was real or staged by Amin himself), and on September 16, Amin at the plenum of the People's Democratic Party Central Committee removed Taraki from his duties, having previously isolated him with loyal army units in the residence. It is noteworthy that, although Amin tried to maintain good relations with the USSR, according to our data, he is not at all opposed to establishing close relations with the PRC, and this may be our chance.
0x003016B3.translated:
4月革命之后，PDPA面临许多困难；
随着喀尔克党迅速壮大，PDPA创始人之一塔拉基与其学生阿明之
间的斗争早已开始。阿明支持激进政治，
主张对封建残余进行毫不妥协的斗争，并对政治对手进行严厉镇压。
同时，作为狂热的普什图族（阿富汗的主导民族——注）
民族主义者，他在很大程度上要为破坏PDPA的民族政策负责；
而且为了把权力集中到自己手中，他维持了喀尔克派与帕尔查姆派之
间的分裂。尽管苏联领导层曾多次警告塔拉基阿明的阴谋计划，
但塔拉基直到最后一刻才未予理会。
9月14日，阿明访问塔拉基期间，塔拉基遭到袭击（究竟是确有其
事还是由阿明本人导演，尚不得而知）；
9月16日，阿明在人民民主党中央委员会全体会议上撤掉塔拉基的
职务，并在此之前已用忠诚的军队单位将其隔离在住所内。
值得注意的是，尽管阿明试图维持同苏联的良好关系，
但据我们掌握的情况，他并不反对同中华人民共和国建立密切关系—
—这也许就是我们的机会。

0x00302114.text: After the recent Amin's coup, the USSR in every possible way was looking for ways to eliminate the careless usurper. According to our data, the Soviet leadership has established contact with members of the PDPA from various factions, such as Karmal, Sarwari and Watanjar, who fled from Afghanistan because of Amin’s purges and is ready to use them to replace Amin. The key point of the plan is the neutralization of Amin and his loyal entourage by Soviet special forces, whose cover should be provided by Soviet troops, whom, since the beginning of the year, the PDPA and Amin personally have been insistently asked to enter, despite the constant refusals of the USSR. However, it seems that under pressure from the circumstances, the Soviet leaders decided to change the decision and the first Soviet units crossed the border as early as December 25 with the task of protecting important military facilities and objects of Soviet-Afghan cooperation. Now is our chance to seize the initiative in Afghanistan, if it is possible to prevent the displacement of Amin. However, this can be done only with good relations with the USSR, otherwise USSR would run through a brick wall, but not give us Afghanistan.
0x00302114.translated:
在最近阿明发动政变之后，苏联方面千方百计寻找办法，
消灭这位粗心的篡权者。
根据我们的情报，苏联领导层已经同来自PDPA各派的成员建立了
联系，例如卡尔迈勒、萨尔瓦里和瓦坦贾尔等人——他们因阿明的清
洗而逃离阿富汗，并准备被用来替代阿明。
该计划的关键在于：由苏联特种部队对阿明及其忠诚随从进行“中和
”，而掩护则由苏联军队提供。
自年初以来，尽管苏联方面不断拒绝，PDPA与阿明本人仍一再坚
持要求苏军入境。然而看来，在形势压力之下，
苏联领导层决定改变方案：12月25日，
第一批苏联部队就已越过边境，任务是保护重要军事设施以及苏阿合
作的相关目标。现在是我们在阿富汗夺取主动权的机会——如果有可
能阻止阿明被取代的话。
不过这只能在同苏联保持良好关系的前提下才能做到，
否则苏联就会撞上“砖墙”，但也不会把阿富汗交给我们。

0x00302A81.text: After the recent events that contributed to the deterioration of the situation in Afghanistan, the long-standing uprising of the Islamists and other reactionaries supported by the United States has entered a hot phase. The USSR, in accordance with the recently adopted plan, introduces troops into Afghanistan at the request of the DRA government, which has already caused a wave of indignation in the west. Despite the fact that the population initially met the Soviet troops quite friendly, the cases of militant attacks on them have become more frequent. At the same time, the tasks of a limited contingent, which initially included only the protection of important objects, are gradually expanding and, it seems, will eventually reach its full participation in hostilities. The battle for Afghanistan has begun and we need to decide who we will support in it.
0x00302A81.translated:
在最近那些导致阿富汗局势恶化的事件之后，
长期以来由美国支持的伊斯兰主义者与其他反动势力的起义已进入白
热化阶段。根据最近通过的计划，苏联应阿富汗民主共和国政府的请
求向阿富汗派遣军队；这已经在西方引发一波愤慨。
尽管当地民众起初对苏军相当友好，但对其进行武装袭击的事件日益
增多。同时，最初仅包括保护重要目标的有限兵力，
其任务正在逐步扩大，似乎最终将全面卷入战事。
争夺阿富汗的战斗已经开始，我们必须决定在其中支持谁。

0x00303142.text: After the April revolution, the PDPA faced many difficulties associated with a lack of experience among its members and an abundance of feudal and religious remnants in Afghanistan, however, due to the relative equality of forces between the two factions of PDPA, it was possible to avoid major political conflicts. In particular, the members of both Parcham and Khalq, with the support of the USSR, succeeded in removing Amin from the government and the Central Committee with accusations of violating the principles of collective leadership and Pashtun nationalism. However, the uprisings of the reactionary groups, especially the Islamists, which began at the beginning of the year, are gaining momentum. Some citizens of Pakistan and Iran are joining them, illegally crossing the border, and even the USA manage to somehow drag their weapons and advisers to Afghanistan to help the mujaheddin. Under these conditions, the USSR, at the numerous requests of the Afghan leadership, decided to introduce a small contingent of its troops, which would have to guard important military installations and cities, freeing the forces of the DRA army to fight the rebels. It seems that their large-scale participation in hostilities is not expected, but the West has already condemned it, calling it an invasion.
0x00303142.translated:
4月革命之后，PDPA面临许多困难：
一方面是成员缺乏经验，另一方面是阿富汗境内封建与宗教残余势力
众多；但由于PDPA两派之间力量相对均衡，
得以避免重大政治冲突。
特别是，在苏联的支持下，帕尔查姆派与喀尔克派的成员成功地以“
违反集体领导原则”和“普什图民族主义”为由，
将阿明从政府与中央委员会中清除。
然而，年初开始的反动集团起义——尤其是伊斯兰主义者的起义——
正在迅速升温。一些巴基斯坦与伊朗的公民也加入其中，
非法越境；甚至美国也设法把武器与顾问拖到阿富汗，
帮助圣战者。在这些条件下，苏联在阿富汗领导层的多次请求下，
决定派遣一小部分军队：他们必须守卫重要军事设施与城市，
从而解放阿富汗民主共和国军队的力量去对付叛乱者。
看起来他们不会大规模卷入战事，但西方已经对此进行谴责，
称之为“入侵”。

0x00303BA5.text: From the very beginning of anti-government demonstrations in Afghanistan and the response of the DRA government, many Islamic radicals, terrorists and priests fled to Pakistan, where they teamed up with their local "colleagues". Subsequently, after the start of armed riots in Afghanistan, refugees flowed into Pakistan, who were awaited by Islamic terrorist organizations that had formed there. Pakistan itself does not take special measures in relation to them beyond the usual, it seems that Bhutto has enough problems there, but it may be worthwhile to provide him with undercover assistance in order to stop such outrages? On the other hand, the United States is very interested in the possibility of helping the Afghan rebels through Pakistan, and if Bhutto can not agree with the United States in any way, then he could with us. By transporting American weapons and advisers through Pakistan, we could "cut" money from Americans and strike at Soviet social-imperialism.
0x00303BA5.translated:
从阿富汗反政府示威一开始、以及阿富汗民主共和国政府的反应开始，
许多伊斯兰激进分子、恐怖分子和宗教人士就逃往巴基斯坦，
并在那里与当地的“同伙”结成同盟。
随后，随着阿富汗境内武装骚乱的爆发，
难民涌入巴基斯坦；而在那里的伊斯兰恐怖组织早已等候他们。
巴基斯坦本身似乎并未对他们采取超出常规的特别措施——看来布托
在那儿已经够头疼了；但也许值得给他提供一些隐蔽援助，
以制止这类暴行？另一方面，美国对通过巴基斯坦帮助阿富汗叛乱者
的可能性非常感兴趣；如果布托无论如何都无法与美国达成一致，
那么他或许可以与我们达成一致。
通过把美国武器与顾问经由巴基斯坦运送过去，
我们就能“掐断”美国人的钱袋，并打击苏联的社会帝国主义。

0x00304348.text: During the Great Leap, almost all of China’s agriculture was organized into agricultural communes, renowned for their total socialization of equipment and personal belongings, failed experiments with artisanal steelmaking and disgusting productivity. After the reforms of Zhou Enlai, the communes were partly reformed, partly disbanded, but in a modified version, they still continue to work. Many in the CPC believe that it is time to reform the agriculture, but there is no consensus. Moderates and reformers propose the introduction of a family contracting system, which implies the creation of family entrepreneurship in the countryside with compulsory public procurement. Another part of the reformers proposes to introduce a system of full-fledged private farming. We will have to allocate loans to start-up entrepreneurs for the necessary purchases, but reformers promise that these costs will pay off more than in the short term. And part of the party proposes to return to basics to organize a system of collective farms on the Soviet model, which will allow to overcome technological backwardness, because Stalin managed to did it? The truth is that the necessary mechanization needs money...
0x00304348.translated:
大跃进期间，几乎全国农业都被组织进农业公社——以对器材和私人
财物的彻底社会化、土法炼钢的失败实验以及令人作呕的生产率而闻
名。周恩来改革之后，公社被部分改造、
部分解散，但在改良版里仍继续运转。
中共内部不少人认为该改革农业了，但并无共识。
温和派和改革派主张推行家庭联产承包制，
意味着在农村培育家庭经营，同时实行强制性的公购。
另一部分改革派则主张引入“真正的私有耕作”制度。
我们不得不为创业者拨出贷款，用于必要的采购，
但改革派保证这些成本在短期内就会回本。
还有一部分党内人士提议回到“基本路线”，
按苏联模式组织集体农场体系，以便克服技术落后——因为斯大林不
是做到了吗？事实是，所需的机械化要钱……

0x00304CAF.text: In the framework of the policy of reforms and openness in accordance with the stated course, we need to engage in attracting foreign investment. Reformers propose to create on the coast several special economic zones with tax breaks, minimum state control and other indulgences for foreign investors, where they could build their enterprises and invest in joint projects. However, in addition to creating a free economic zone, more radical leaders propose to fully open the economy to foreign investment by creating a system of joint ventures, in which foreign countries can invest in our state-owned enterprises in exchange for a portion of the profits. The greater profitability of the second option is obvious, but moderate and even some reformers criticize it for its haste.
0x00304CAF.translated:
在既定方针下推进改革开放政策，我们需要吸引外资。
改革派主张在沿海设立若干个经济特区：
减税、国家控制尽量少、对外资的其他“放宽”，
让他们在此建厂并投资合资项目。
然而，除了设立自由经济区之外，更激进的领导人还主张通过建立合
资企业制度，把经济全面向外资开放——由外国以分得利润的方式投
资我们的国有企业。第二种方案的盈利性更高是显而易见的，
但温和派，甚至一些改革派也批评其过于仓促。

0x003052C6.text: After the military coup in 1962, the government in Burma passed over to Ne Win and the Burma Socialist Programme Party headed by him, proclaiming the construction of "Burmese socialism". However, this "socialism" was characterized by the preservation of the private sector, the cultivation of chauvinistic religious and national prejudices, in fact, a departure to isolation, as well as mass repressions of all opponents of Ne Win. Therefore, the various left-wing forces that had fallen into the party after the start of the open mass recruitment in 1971, began to increasingly oppose Ne Win and his policies. According to our data, mass purges are being prepared in the Burma Socialist Programme Party against the communists and other leftists, and if we had already made contact with Burma, we could change the balance of forces in their favor with the help of our special services. However, we can also provide additional assistance to the leadership of Burma and strengthen our relationship.
0x003052C6.translated:
1962年的军事政变之后，缅甸政府转交给奈温及其领导的“缅甸
社会主义纲领党”，宣称要建设“缅甸式社会主义”。
但这种“社会主义”的特点是保留私营部门，
培植沙文主义的宗教与民族偏见——实际上是走向闭关自守——并对
奈温的所有反对者进行大规模镇压。
因此，1971年开始公开大规模招募后进入该党的各路左翼力量，
开始越来越反对奈温及其政策。
根据我们的情报，缅甸社会主义纲领党正在准备针对共产党人及其他
左翼的群众清洗；如果我们早已与缅甸取得联系，
就可以借助我们的特工力量帮助他们扭转力量对比。
不过，我们也可以向缅甸领导层提供额外援助，
增进我们的关系。

0x00305A91.text: Recently, neighboring Vietnam is increasingly moving closer to the USSR, and this despite our help in the civil war! In this regard, more and more party members believe that you need to "teach Vietnam a lesson". The plan that has been developed by the PLA for some time is simple - under the pretext of occasional clashes at the border, we declare war on it, seize the border areas, destroy the arriving units of the Vietnamese army and move as far as possible into the interior. Such a blow would force their leadership to seriously reconsider its policy towards the PRC and the USSR. However, some of the party members believe that if our relations with Vietnam are not yet so spoiled, then it makes sense to reach an agreement with him, settling our territorial claims and persuading to stop oppressing ethnic Chinese in Vietnam. However, you can do nothing, because a thin world is better than a good war, right?
0x00305A91.translated:
最近，邻国越南越来越靠拢苏联——而这竟然是在我们在内战中提供
帮助的情况下！因此，越来越多的党内成员认为你需要“给越南一点
教训”。解放军早就拟定的计划很简单——以边境偶发冲突为借口，
对其宣战，夺取边境地区，歼灭越南军队开赴而来的部队，
并尽可能深入内地。这样一记重击会迫使他们的领导层认真重新考虑
对中华人民共和国和苏联的政策。
然而，也有一些党内成员认为：如果我们同越南的关系还没到那么糟
的地步，那么与其达成协议、解决我们的领土要求，
并劝其停止对越南境内华人的压迫，才更有意义。
可你也什么都不用做——因为“薄薄的和平”总比“痛痛快快的战争
”强，对吧？

0x003061BC.text: Soon Japan should have elections to the House of Representatives of the Japanese Parliament. Against the background of government instability and corruption scandals, the Communist Party of Japan has steadily gained popularity in recent times, as has the various center-left oppositions. If we have an influence on the CPJ, then we could assist them in campaigning. In case of victory, we could improve relations with our historical adversary and finally expel the American bases from Japan.
0x003061BC.translated:
日本很快将举行众议院选举。
鉴于政府不稳和腐败丑闻的背景，日本共产党近年来稳步增势，
形形色色的中间偏左反对派也同样如此。
如果我们能对日本共产党施加影响，就可以帮助他们竞选。
万一他们获胜，我们就能改善同这位历史对手的关系，
并最终把美国基地赶出日本。

0x00306595.text: All last year, protests shook Iran - left, secular democrats and Muslim organizations of varying degrees of radicalism opposed the Shah’s authority in word and deed, organizing multiple strikes and strikes.|
0x00306595.translated:
去年一整年，抗议活动席卷伊朗——左翼、
世俗民主派以及不同程度激进的穆斯林组织，
都在言行上反对沙阿的权威，组织了多次罢工与罢课。
|

0x00306736.text: Comrade Chairman! In connection with the current situation in the international arena, a number of party members propose to organize their alternative to the Soviet economic alliance - the CMEA and the European - the EEC to continue the policy of expanding our influence and deepen trade and economic ties between the countries loyal to Beijing. However, some members of the Politburo consider this step too hasty, radical and thoughtless and suggest that this matter be postponed until better times. Although perhaps the best option would be to forget all the strife with the Soviet Union and join the Council for Mutual Economic Assistance?
0x00306736.translated:
同志主席！鉴于当前国际局势，若干党内成员提议组织我们自己的替
代方案：对标苏联的经济联盟——经互会（CMEA）
以及欧洲的共同体（EEC），以继续扩大我们影响的政策，
并加深与北京忠诚国家之间的贸易与经济联系。
然而，政治局有些成员认为此举过于仓促、
过于激进、也过于欠考虑，建议把这件事推迟到更好的时机。
尽管也许最好的选择是忘掉同苏联的一切纷争，
加入经互会？

0x00306C3D.text: After more than a happy creation of our economic union, some party members propose to consolidate success by uniting all the countries friendly to us into a single military alliance, thereby occupying a niche surrounded by the military bases of European NATO and the Soviet ATS. However, the most pragmatic party members offer to abandon this initiative, arguing that our thoughtless and radical actions can unleash a new round of the Cold War, but with a third influential force. However, China is now stronger than ever, and the extra allies will not interfere with it, will it?
0x00306C3D.translated:
在我们经济联盟“顺利成立”之后，部分党内成员提议通过把所有友
好国家联合成单一军事同盟来巩固成果，
从而占据一个被欧洲北约和苏联华约军事基地包围的“空档”。
然而，最务实的党内人士则主张放弃这一倡议，
理由是我们轻率而激进的行动可能引发新一轮冷战——而且还会多出
第三个有影响力的力量。
可中国现在前所未有地强大，多出来的盟友也不会妨碍它，
对吧？

0x003070CA.text: ! As you know, the anthem of our country since 1949 has been the "March of the Volunteers" Nie Er and Tian Han. However, during the so-called "Cultural Revolution" Tian Han was arrested on a false accusation and died in prison, and the popular song "The East Is Red", glorifying the late President Mao Zedong, became the de facto anthem. Now, when we stopped the "Cultural Revolution" and posthumously rehabilitated Tian Han, as well as normalized the situation in the country, the question arose about state symbols. A large group of party members propose to restore the "March of the Volunteers" as an anthem already officially, however, your associates, in principle agreeing with this, believe that the text of the hymn should be changed by adding references to Chairman Mao and the CPC. True for both of these options will need money for conversion. At the same time, the radical Maoists remaining in the party wrote to you with a letter in which they proposed to give the status of the hymn "The East Is Red"...
0x003070CA.translated:
! 众所周知，1949年以来我国的国歌是聂耳、
田汉的《义勇军进行曲》。
然而在所谓“文化大革命”期间，田汉因诬陷被捕并死于狱中；
而歌颂已故毛泽东主席的流行歌曲《东方红》则成了事实上的国歌。
如今我们已经停止“文化大革命”，并为田汉平反昭雪、
使国内局势走向正常，便引出了国家象征的问题。
大批党内成员主张把《义勇军进行曲》恢复为已经在官方意义上使用
的国歌；但你身边的同僚原则上同意这一点，
却认为应当通过在歌词中加入对毛主席和中共的提法来修改歌词。
无论采取这两种方案中的哪一种，都需要经费用于改制。
同时，党内仍留存的激进毛主义者给你写信，
信中提议把《东方红》赋予国歌地位……

0x003078BF.text: After the victory over the Kuomintang in 1949, the regions of China inhabited by non-Chinese people gained autonomous status, modeled on the USSR. One of them is Inner Mongolia, where ethnic Mongols live. During the so-called "Cultural Revolution" central authorities began to assimilate the Mongolian population by force, which resulted in mass clashes with the Red Guards and the riots of 1967-1969. In 1969, most of the territory of Inner Mongolia was attached to neighboring Chinese provinces in such a way that the number of Mongols in it fell to 600 thousand people and the total population of the autonomous region fell from 13 to 9 million people. Now that the CPC has recognized the fallacy of this policy, representatives of the Council of People’s Representatives of the AR of Inner Mongolia and the Mongols-communists propose to correct Mao’s mistake and restore justice by returning the lands taken from it to AR and ending the assimilation policy. This is clearly not going to please the left wing of the CPC, but it can help to enlist the support of national elites. In addition, the Mongolian People's Republic and the USSR will obviously like this step.
0x003078BF.translated:
1949年战胜国民党之后，居住着非汉族人口的中国地区获得了自
治地位，模式仿照苏联。
其中之一是内蒙古，居住着蒙古族。
在所谓“文化大革命”期间，中央当局开始强制同化蒙古人口，
结果引发了与红卫兵的大规模冲突，以及1967—1969年的骚
乱。1969年，内蒙古的大部分地区被并入邻近的中国省份，
使其中蒙古人数降至60万人，自治区总人口从1300万降至90
0万。如今中共已承认这一政策的谬误，
内蒙古自治区人民代表会议的代表以及蒙古族共产党人提议纠正毛的
错误，通过把被夺走的土地归还自治区并结束同化政策来恢复正义。
这显然不会讨好中共的左翼，但可以帮助争取民族精英的支持。
此外，蒙古人民共和国和苏联显然也会喜欢这一举措。

0x003081E6.text: The ideas of creating a united state of all Arabs in the Middle East have been in the minds of Arab rulers and intellectuals since the days of the colonial rule of foreigners in these lands. It was reflected in the United Arab Republic, which consisted of Syria and Egypt and existed from 1958 to 1971, however, due to the striving of Egyptian President Nasser, a well-known pan-Arabist, to centralize power in Egypt, Syria withdrew from it in 1961. Subsequently, in 1971, a confederative Federation of Arab Republics from Egypt, Syria and Libya was created. However, there were contradictions between its participants, which consisted primarily in the liberal pro-Western policies that came to power in Egypt after Nasser Sadat. But now, when Sadat is eliminated, and in Egypt, supporters of the old president Nasser came to power, thanks to which the FAR has formally existed until now, and the ideas of merging the Arab states have re-occupied the minds of the ruling circles. Moreover, on July 30, Israel proclaimed Jerusalem "the eternal and indivisible capital of Israel", which caused a wave of discontent in the Arab world, giving another reason to unite against a common enemy. Having allocated some material assistance and contributed to the elimination of those dissatisfied with such a development, we could revive the UAR, which would seriously change the balance of power in the Middle East and get a valuable ally. Unless, of course, they will listen to us...
0x003081E6.translated:
在中东建立“全体阿拉伯人统一国家”的设想，
自这些土地遭受外国殖民统治的年代起，
就一直萦绕在阿拉伯统治者和知识分子的脑海中。
它曾体现在“阿拉伯联合共和国”——由叙利亚和埃及组成，
存在于1958年至1971年；但由于埃及总统纳赛尔（著名泛阿
拉伯主义者）力图把权力集中到埃及，叙利亚于1961年退出。
随后，1971年又建立了由埃及、叙利亚和利比亚组成的阿拉伯共
和国邦联联邦。然而，其参与者之间存在矛盾，
主要在于：纳赛尔·萨达特之后在埃及上台的，
是偏自由主义、亲西方的政策。
但如今萨达特被清除，埃及又由支持旧总统纳赛尔的人掌权——因此
“阿联（FAR）”形式上一直延续至今——合并阿拉伯各国的想法
又重新占据了统治集团的思维。
此外，7月30日， 以色列宣布耶路撒冷为“以色列永恒且不可分
割的首都”，在阿拉伯世界引发一波不满浪潮，
提供了另一个团结起来对抗共同敌人的理由。
只要我们拨出一些物质援助，并促成消除那些对这种发展不满的人，
我们就能复兴阿联（UAR）——这将足以严重改变中东力量对比，
并获得一位宝贵盟友。
除非，当然，他们不听我们的……

0x00308D6D.text: Comrade Chairman! On July 19, 1980, the opening of the XXII Summer Olympic Games will take place in Moscow. The Soviet Union struggled to secure the right to host the Olympics and spent enormous funds on its preparation, which had to be withdrawn from other expense items (a large-scale campaign was held to sell Olympic symbols for cost recovery).
